description: #(Tag:gravity)Lets you manipulate gravity on a massive scale with immense power but little precision. Minimum 100-meter area at 50x gravity; you can rip up city blocks, but cannot handle small or delicate targets without crushing them.
name: Graviton Tyrant

description: #(Tag:movement)Lets you instantly travel to anywhere you have been while out of danger. Cost scales with distance.
name: Fast Travel

description: #(Tag:summon)Lets you conjure floating dragon-skull projections that fire energy lasers or bite, and can carry you or block attacks.
name: Gaster Blaster

description: #(Tag:meta)(Tag:necro)(Tag:space)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:summon)Makes your soul a shapeable kingdom that absorbs souls of those you kill or wayward souls you find. You can house them, manifest them as physical soldiers, sacrifice them for power, or burn them to recover energy.
name: Kingdom Soul

description: #(Tag:fae)Lets you transform into a pixie at will, gaining flight, energy reserves, and agility at the cost of size and physical power.
name: Pixie Power

description: #(Tag:recovery)(Tag:transformation)Makes you an Ajin with biological immortality, resurrecting at peak condition from your largest remaining flesh via Invisible Black Matter at no energy cost. You can summon IBM shadows to fight, defend, or scout on your orders.
name: Ajin Form

description: #(Tag:divination)Lets you know the exact dimensions and measurements of anything at a glance.
name: Measure King

description: #(Tag:movement)Lets you squeeze your body through any opening wider than 5 centimeters.
name: Slip In

description: #(Tag:alter)Lets you erect a field around yourself where no supernatural effects function except your dismissal of the field, leaving even gods to their physical bodies.
name: Normal World

description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:illusion)(Tag:mental)(Tag:stealth)Makes people incapable of perceiving you as a threat, even while harming them, granting immunity to hostility. Fails against far superior mental abilities or divine-level beings stronger than you.
name: Nice Guy

description: #(Tag:mental)(Tag:stealth)Makes you unperceivable while active, wiping you from minds and recordings the moment you are noticed. People can still deduce your existence and counter you without remembering you.
name: The Imp

description: #(Tag:enhancer)Gives you a boneless, organless Majin body that freely morphs and regenerates from any piece larger than a walnut while you have energy. You gain greatly enhanced stats and can absorb others for a portion of their strength.
name: Majin Physique

description: #(Tag:nature)(Tag:spirit)Grants Hanami-level plant control, creating energy plants, binding roots, and energy-draining cursed buds. You can draw energy from existing nature to recharge.
name: Disaster nature

description: #(Tag:aquatic)(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:transformation)(Tag:water)Lets you turn into a shark or shark hybrid at will, gaining enhanced stats boosted further underwater, razor teeth able to tear metal, water affinity, and other shark traits.
name: Shark Physique

description: #(Tag:aquatic)(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:transformation)(Tag:water)Lets you transform into an octopus or octopus hybrid at will, gaining enhanced stats boosted underwater, independent body control, slow limb and organ regeneration, and other octopus traits.
name: Octopus Physique

description: #Lets you fully or partially transform into a minotaur, gaining massively enhanced strength, stamina, durability, and regeneration at the cost of inhibitions. Training improves control.
name: Minotaur

description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:transformation)Lets you transmute touched material into any known gun plus bullets. Gun power scales with material quality.
name: Outgun

description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:summon)Lets you seal anything you defeat into 5x5 capture tokens where they cannot escape or use abilities, or instantly capture instead of killing. Targets must be unable to resist. Tokens can also transport people.
name: Capture Token

description: #(Tag:earth)Lets you create and telekinetically control gem-like crystals, with durability scaling with energy spent. You can spread them over touched surfaces.
name: Crystalline

description: #(Tag:earth)(Tag:summon)Lets you create and finely control gem-like crystals, even as powder. You can make semi-autonomous crystal golems that crumble when disabled and slowly drain energy.
name: Crystal Caesar

description: #Lets you conjure energy threads you control like limbs, with strength and number scaling with energy spent. Threads dissipate once detached from you.
name: Weaver

description: #(Tag:enhancer)Lets you transform into a Kirin or Kirin hybrid, gaining enhanced stats, speed, and lightning affinity, plus the ability to call down powerful lightning bolts.
name: Kirin Physique

description: #(Tag:illusion)(Tag:stealth)While active, makes everyone who knows you temporarily forget you and prevents anyone met from recalling your features.
name: Remember Me?

description: #(Tag:nature)Lets you minorly communicate with and control nearby plants, accelerating their growth, further boosting it with energy, and slightly altering their shape.
name: Sprout

description: #(Tag:kinesis)(Tag:nature)Lets you create, communicate with, and control nearby plants, growing grass, ripening crops, shaping them slightly, driving roots through concrete, and raising trees into barriers.
name: Sapling

description: #(Tag:kinesis)(Tag:nature)Makes you a chlorokinetic able to create and control plants in sensory range, snaring foes with branches, breaking concrete with trees, wielding vines as whips, or growing fruit on demand.
name: Bloom

description: #(Tag:kinesis)(Tag:nature)Gives you formidable chlorokinesis over plants in sensory range, growing them from soil and boosting them supernaturally, such as steel-hard wood and razor leaves. Requires a plant in range or growing one first.
name: Verdance

description: #(Tag:kinesis)(Tag:nature)Makes you a powerful chlorokinetic able to create, reinforce, and control plants in sensory range, raising forests, swallowing foes with roots, and hardening branches to cut titanium. Requires a plant in range or growing one first.
name: Overgrowth

description: #(Tag:kinesis)(Tag:nature)Makes you a master of plants able to create, reinforce, and control all plant life in sensory range, erupting forests, growing metal-strong trees, and fusing trees into treant golems, limited only by energy.
name: Flora

description: #(Tag:nature)Makes you one with nature able to create, reinforce, and control all plant life, erupting world-swallowing jungles, treant armies, and kilometer-long root spears, limited only by energy.
name: Gaia

description: #(Tag:passive)(Tag:spirit)Lets you and your abilities interact with the spiritual world, extending your perception to souls and spirits.
name: Spiritual Interaction

description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:neutral)Lets you conjure an energy bow and arrow, with arrow strength scaling with energy invested.
name: Bow and Arrow

description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:neutral)(Tag:sense)Lets you conjure an energy bow and arrow with boosted marksmanship and sharpened senses while aiming. Arrow strength scales with energy, and you can alter its shape and size.
name: Sharpshooter

description: #Lets you conjure a great energy bow whose arrows pierce most metals, growing stronger with energy invested. Aiming boosts marksmanship and senses, and you can alter arrow shape and size.
name: Odysseus Draw

description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:neutral)(Tag:sense)Lets you conjure an imitation of Hou Yi's bow firing destructive arrows that strengthen with energy invested. Aiming boosts marksmanship and senses, and you can alter arrow shape and size.
name: Hou Yi's Bow

description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:neutral)(Tag:sense)Lets you conjure an energy bow blessed by Artemis, firing arrows that pierce the toughest foes and strengthen with energy invested. Aiming boosts marksmanship, sharpens senses, and guides your shot, and you can alter arrow shape and size.
name: Artemis' Might

description: #(Tag:nature)Lets you create ripe, tasty fruits and vegetables with your own energy.
name: Bountiful Harvest

description: #(Tag:nature)Lets you create extremely refreshing fruits and vegetables from energy, which can gain unique properties from your abilities.
name: Orchard

description: #(Tag:necro)(Tag:summon)Lets you create and control bones, erupting them from surfaces in sight and raising semi-autonomous skeleton soldiers. Soldiers vanish if cancelled or swapped, and more soldiers drain more energy.
name: Bone Baron

description: #(Tag:movement)Lets you mark up to 10 items within your lifting strength to summon to you at will and return to where you summoned them from.
name: Summon Item

description: #(Tag:bio)Lets you produce and control body-spun silk for grappling, restraining, and fastening. Output and durability scale with physical stats.
name: Silk Weaver

description: #(Tag:enhancer)Lets you modestly boost all physical capabilities equally with energy. Boost scales with base stats and energy spent.
name: Lesser Physical Enhancement

description: #(Tag:enhancer)Lets you boost all physical capabilities equally with energy. Boost scales with base stats and energy spent.
name: Physical Enhancement

description: #(Tag:earth)Reinforces your skin to metal-like toughness and mass, letting even a base human shrug off bats, small-caliber bullets, and survive car crashes. It can slow your movement.
name: Iron Skin

description: #(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:spirit)Covers you in a soul barrier that boosts physical capabilities and absorbs attacks, letting you survive at least one hit before breaking.
name: Aura

description: #(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:movement)(Tag:space)Grants super strength able to lift millions of tons, high-speed flight, enhanced intellect, and a time-locked body immune to all non-spacetime effects. You can still suffocate.
name: Alexandria

description: #(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:movement)Grants average super speed, strength, durability, and flight, excelling in none but above average in all.
name: Super

description: #(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:transformation)Lets you cover your skin in a stone-like layer that boosts durability and mass.
name: Stone Skin

description: #(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:fire)Lets you burn energy to greatly boost attack power, speed, and fire abilities at the cost of defense and recovery. Longer burning means more heat and power, until your organs begin to melt.
name: Overheat

description: #(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:ice)(Tag:mental)(Tag:spirit)Freezes your soul, dulling emotions while boosting defense and cryokinetic potency at the cost of speed and offense. The colder you grow, the tougher and more frigid you become.
name: Frozen Soul

description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:tech)(Tag:transformation)(Tech) Lets you transform your body into any technology you understand, such as nanofiber muscles, weaponized prosthetics, or scanner eyes. Training can negate mass differences.
name: Certainty of Steel

description: #(Tag:alter)Makes you invulnerable to anything below reality manipulation while you wish to be unharmed, even surviving multiverse collapse unscathed.
name: Invulnerable

description: #(Tag:alter)Makes you truly immortal, with reality restoring you moments after death even from total erasure, plus regeneration fast enough to reform mid-step. Each death permanently increases all your stats.
name: Immortal

description: #(Tag:alter)Lets you exclude yourself from anything that can interact with you, such as time, physics, harm, targeting, or perception.
name: Exclusion

description: #(Tag:alter)Lets you deny the existence of anything to reality, which obeys, treating reality like clay.
name: All Fiction

description: #(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:mental)(Tag:passive)Boosts all physical stats based on danger at no energy cost: none when safe, scaling from Common when mildly endangered up to Epic when facing certain death.
name: Desperation

description: #(Tag:passive)(Tag:recovery)The more negative effects you suffer, the faster you regenerate health and energy. Curses, poison, illness, and bleeding only fuel you.
name: Masochistic Soul

description: #(Tag:recovery)(Tag:spirit)Refunds a portion of attack energy proportional to damage dealt, but doubles the cost of attacks that deal no damage.
name: Sadism

description: #(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:growth)(Tag:meta)Permanently absorbs 10% of anything you kill's stats into your own.
name: Level Up!

description: #(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:recovery)(Tag:transformation)Lets you turn into an ogre or ogre hybrid at will, gaining increased stats, regeneration, and other ogre traits.
name: Ogre Form

description: #(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:transformation)Lets you turn into a bear or bear hybrid at will, gaining enhanced stats, fangs, claws, thick hide, and other bear traits.
name: Bear Form

description: #(Tag:alter)Caps damage taken at 25% of total health per 5 seconds, regardless of attacker or attack strength.
name: Threshold Clause

description: #(Tag:alter)Lets you sacrifice 33% of your health to gain 10 seconds of invincibility. The sacrificed health cannot be healed, recovering over 1 hour.
name: Bloody Survival

description: #(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:sense)(Tag:transformation)Lets you turn into a cat or cat hybrid at will, gaining enhanced agility, senses, reflexes, claws, teeth, and other cat traits.
name: Cat Form

description: #(Tag:sense)(Tag:transformation)Lets you turn into a bat or bat hybrid at will, gaining agility, senses, sonar, flight, claws, teeth, and other bat traits.
name: Bat Form

description: #(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:sense)(Tag:transformation)Lets you turn into a wolf or wolf hybrid at will, gaining enhanced stats, claws, fangs, night vision, senses, and other wolf traits.
name: Wolf Form

description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:recovery)(Tag:spirit)Lets you shape souls by touch, reshaping bodies through them, with cost scaling against stronger targets. You can shapeshift yourself, but larger mass changes reduce energy output.
name: Idle Transfiguration

description: #(Tag:kinetic)(Tag:martial)Lets you launch fist projections by punching, with size and power scaling with energy spent. Base power equals your physical strength, usable to boost melee or strike at range.
name: Fist Projection

description: #(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:martial)Boosts each physical hit by 10% more if landed within 3 seconds of the last, stacking up to 999%. Missing the window resets the combo.
name: Combo

description: #(Tag:meta)Lets you equip abilities beyond your slots, doubling total energy consumption for each extra ability.
name: Overdraw

description: #(Tag:divination){Mystic Eyes} Lets you see weaknesses in objects and creatures highlighted in red, and with training understand them and strike break points to cripple creatures, collapse structures, or dispel spells.
name: Mystic Eyes of Flaw Perception

description: #(Tag:sense)Lets you enhance all five senses with energy, such as cross-country sight, months-old scent tracking, or city-wide hearing.
name: Enhanced Senses

description: #(Tag:divination)(Tag:sense)Lets you sense hostile or killing intent directed at you and its source, though trained killers are harder to read.
name: Sixth Sense

description: #(Tag:divination)(Tag:sense)Lets you sense incoming danger, with stronger threats producing stronger sensations.
name: Dangersense

description: #(Tag:neutral)Lets you conjure and manipulate Bungee Gum, a substance with the properties of both rubber and gum.
name: Bungee Gum

description: #(Tag:transformation)Lets you absorb a touched material to coat or transform your body and gain its properties, including esoteric ones like vibranium. Steel grants resilience and conductivity, uranium radioactivity, glass brittleness.
name: Material Absorption

description: #(Tag:transformation)Lets you absorb a touched material to coat or transform your body and gain its properties, including esoteric ones like vibranium. You can also shape your body into weapons and create more of the material with energy.
name: Greater Material Absorption

description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:transformation)(Tech) Lets you transform into a Galvanic Mechamorph that fuses with and upgrades technology proportional to your power.
name: Galvanic Mechamorph Form

description: #(Tag:kinetic)(Tag:martial)Lets you imbue thrown objects with speed proportional to energy spent, reaching Mach speeds with enough energy.
name: Greater Throw

description: #(Tag:kinetic)Lets you launch touched objects with speed scaling with energy spent, sending cars to a hundred times the speed of sound with enough energy. Larger masses cost more, and living beings can resist.
name: Launch

description: #(Tag:kinetic)Lets you create invisible forcefields that reflect kinetic attacks back at double strength, up to your power limit. Maintaining and reflecting costs energy; training improves size and shaping.
name: Reflection

description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:neutral)Lets you create varied energy blades, from throwing knives to greatswords, while gaining a minor strength boost.
name: Blademaster

description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:neutral)Lets you summon energy spears you telekinetically control, conjuring them from any solid surface.
name: Spear of Justice

description: #(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:martial)(Tag:sense)Lets you enter a battle trance unleashing all rage, drastically slowing your perception and unlocking 100% power regardless of bodily harm. It drains energy and overuse damages you.
name: Ripper Mode

description: #(Tag:neutral)Lets you manipulate atoms with great precision to transmute matter and control elements, up to transforming bodies or crafting superior matter. Requires extensive training to use well.
name: Atomic Manipulation

description: #(Tag:ice)(Tag:time)Lets you stop time at great energy cost. Far superior beings can resist the freeze.
name: Time Stop

description: #(Tag:time)Lets you calibrate time on your body, slowing the world, hastening yourself or only your perception, stalling wounds, or slowing incoming objects. Larger effects cost more energy.
name: Time Calibration

description: #(Tag:kinesis)(Tag:space)Lets you manipulate space to move things telekinetically, teleport, tear space, create pocket dimensions, warp objects, harden targets, and with training invade other worlds.
name: Space Manipulation

description: #(Tag:movement)Lets you leave to a random world on a mission, returning once completed, and revisit it later via spatial travel or vehicles. Cooldown: 1 Month.
name: Adventure Awaits!

description: #(Tag:time)Lets you freely rewind, fast-forward, travel through, and stop time while you have energy.
name: Time God

description: #(Tag:alter)Lets you raise or lower any target's luck, given enough energy.
name: Luck Manipulation

description: #(Tag:enhancer)Makes you grow stronger with anger and conflict without limit, potentially reaching universe-ending power. Escalating too far destroys your reason, leaving a mindless beast until death or extinction.
name: Wrath

description: #(Tag:mental)Massively boosts thought speed, comprehension, and reasoning beyond computer level.
name: Sage

description: #(Tag:divination)(Tag:mental)Lets you accelerate thoughts, instantly analyze objects, and gather detailed target information from basic knowledge. It acts automatically and helps manage your abilities.
name: Great Sage

description: #(Tag:magic)You are the true user of magic in this world. You dominate mana and all magic around you, rendering magic inert and uncastable, instantly learning any spell in sensory range, casting spells instantly and instinctively, and absorbing magical energy from people and the environment.
name: Magic Dominion

description: #(Tag:alter)You are the Void. You can suck in almost any kind of energy almost limitlessly, mana, energy, stamina, kinetic, electricity, Telesma, psionic, etc. Even as a base human, you could detonate a hydrogen bomb next to your face and barely feel warm.
name: The Void

description: #(Tag:alter)The Grand Nullifier. You can dispel anything you can interact with, motion in an area, all mana in an area, an individual's abilities, and their minds. You cannot dispel or nullify a lack of something.
name: Nihil

description: #(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:martial)(Tag:recovery)"Shed all worldly concerns and embrace slaughter." When activated, you lose all inhibitions, pain turns to pleasure, and all stats are massively enhanced. But its energy slowly tears your body apart as you fight, and its sense of limitless power may make you unwilling to turn it off.
name: Open Frenzy

description: #(Tag:command)"Tit for Tat" Allows you to enforce karma. Every exchange accrues karma, and if unfulfilled you can enforce it, if you saved someone's life and they have not repaid you, you can force them to perform any action or actions equal to the karmic value of their life.
name: Karmic Enforcement

description: #(Tag:draconic)(Tag:fire)(Tag:transformation)Allows you to transform into and wield the powers of a fire dragon. You generate fire from your body, control it, alter its properties such as blunt or sharp, devour flames, and are immune to all fire below your level. Eating flames recovers vitality and energy, and consuming other magic lets you temporarily incorporate it into your flames.
name: Fire Dragon Slayer

description: #(Tag:draconic)(Tag:transformation)(Tag:water)Allows you to transform into and wield the powers of a water dragon. You generate, control, alter its properties such as blunt or sharp, devour water, and are immune to water-based attacks below your level. Drinking water recovers vitality and energy, though polluted water can harm you, and consuming other magic lets you temporarily incorporate it into your water.
name: Water Dragon Slayer

description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:draconic)(Tag:healing)(Tag:transformation)Allows you to transform into and wield the powers of a sky dragon. You generate, control, alter your winds such as blunt or sharp, devour wind, heal others with your winds, and are immune to wind-based attacks below your level. Breathing air recovers vitality and energy, though polluted air harms you, and consuming other magic lets you temporarily incorporate it into your wind attacks.
name: Sky Dragon Slayer

description: #(Tag:draconic)(Tag:poison)(Tag:transformation)Allows you to transform into and wield the powers of a poison dragon. You generate, control, and alter potent poison such as corrosive, sickening, or boiling, devour poison, and are immune to all poison below your level. Consuming poison recovers vitality and energy, and consuming other magic lets you temporarily incorporate it into your poison.
name: Poison Dragon Slayer

description: #(Tag:draconic)(Tag:electric)(Tag:transformation)Allows you to transform into and wield the powers of a lightning dragon. You generate lightning from your body, control it, alter its properties such as blunt or sharp, devour lightning, and are immune to all lightning below your level. Eating lightning recovers vitality and energy, and consuming other magic lets you temporarily incorporate it into your lightning.
name: Lightning Dragon Slayer

description: #(Tag:dark)(Tag:draconic)(Tag:transformation)Allows you to transform into and wield the powers of a dark dragon. You generate shadows from your body, control them, turn into a shadow and merge with them, alter their properties such as blunt or sharp, and are immune to all dark attributes below your level. Eating shadows recovers vitality and energy, and consuming other magic lets you temporarily incorporate it into your shadows.
name: Shadow Dragon Slayer

description: #(Tag:draconic)(Tag:holy)(Tag:light)(Tag:transformation)Allows you to transform into and wield the powers of a white dragon. You generate and control Holy Light from your body, alter its properties such as blunt or sharp, and are immune to all Light and Holy attributes below your level. Eating light energy and holy objects recovers vitality and energy, and consuming other magic lets you temporarily incorporate it into your light.
name: White Dragon Slayer

description: #(Tag:draconic)(Tag:earth)(Tag:transformation)Allows you to transform into and wield the powers of an earth dragon. You generate, control, alter earth such as denser, tougher, and heavier, devour earth, and are immune to earth-based attacks below your level. Devouring earth and rocks recovers vitality and energy based on rock quality, and consuming other magic lets you temporarily incorporate it into your earth.
name: Earth Dragon Slayer

description: #(Tag:draconic)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:transformation)Allows you to transform into and wield the powers of a spirit dragon. You emit and control spiritual energy, alter your soul constructs such as blunt or sharp, shift into spirit form, possess people, and persist as a spirit after death. Devouring souls strengthens and rejuvenates you.
name: Spirit Dragon Slayer

description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:enhancer)You can freely increase the density and mass of your muscle fibers, massively increasing explosive power and durability. If fibers exceed what fits under your skin, they cover your body like a second set of muscles. More fibers burn stamina faster.
name: Muscular

description: #(Tag:life)(Tag:recovery)You can rejuvenate yourself and targets, restoring virility and health. It does not heal injuries, but cures illnesses and ailments, reverses aging, restores sacrificed lifespan, and restores rotten or ill vegetation. Stronger targets cost more energy.
name: Rejuvenation

description: #(Tag:necro)(Tag:passive)(Tag:recovery)Nothing keeps you down. While in your active slot, at the moment of death you revive 10 seconds later with health and energy restored to 50%. 7 day cooldown.
name: Rise Again

description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) You can build the technology of THE BAKERY. With enough time and resources, you can make assembly lines that compress universes into little balls for bowling, then turn every atom inside them into cookies for shipment across the multiverse.
name: Tinker - The Baker

description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:summon)(Tag:tech)You can summon a projection of any mundane weapon into your hands. It must not be tinkertech, must not exceed your current world's technology, and must not surpass Elite rank in power. You also control its ammunition, such as a beanbag shotgun, nuclear bomb launcher, automatic rifle, sword, or crossbow.
name: Militia

description: #(Tag:movement)You can step and walk on anything, water, air, space, even nothing as a solid surface.
name: Light Step

description: #(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:meta)Your abilities scale with your health. At 100% health all stats increase by +100%, at 90% by +90%, etc.
name: Perfection

description: #(Tag:enhancer)"Offence is the best defence" All physical stats except durability rise proportionally as you lower your defence. You can drop durability to -500% to raise strength to +500%.
name: No Guard

description: #(Tag:growth)(Tag:martial)You are an eternal engine for battle, growing in power every time you fight. Harder battles cause stronger, faster mid-battle growth, letting you adapt and surpass opponents. This growth is permanent.
name: Battle Growth

description: #(Tag:blood)(Tag:life)(Tag:movement)You create portals by sacrificing health, a two-way portal costs 10% of maximum health. While portals remain open, you lose access to that 10% of maximum health and it cannot heal.
name: Blood Portals

description: #(Tag:dark)(Tag:stealth)You can access the shadow-verse by sinking into shadows. Inside you can jump from shadow to shadow, bring people in and trap them with its monsters, or bring monsters out.
name: Shadowverse

description: #(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:life)"Power for Pain" With Blood Escalation active, every 1% of health lost increases all stats by 1%. The increase resets when you leave combat.
name: Bloody Escalation

description: #(Tag:movement)You can open doors to parallel worlds by trapping yourself between two objects to travel infinite parallel worlds. You can pull people and selves from parallel worlds into your own, including selves who know you are the original and accept it. If you die, all abilities and the gacha transfer to a random you across the multiverse.
name: D4C

description: #(Tag:command)(Tag:illusion)(Tag:mental)(Tag:movement)(Tag:ocular)(Tag:sense)(Tag:space)You possess Obito Uchiha's right eye, granting half of Kamui plus full Sharingan benefits such as incredible visual prowess and instant memorization. With the left eye, you access a short-range Kamui to an endless pocket dimension in your left eye. You can fully enter Kamui to reposition in the real world, semi-enter to turn intangible at stamina cost, or send touched objects into Kamui.
name: Obito's Mangekyo Sharingan Right

description: #(Tag:command)(Tag:illusion)(Tag:mental)(Tag:movement)(Tag:ocular)(Tag:sense)(Tag:space)You possess Obito Uchiha's left eye, granting half of Kamui plus full Sharingan benefits such as incredible visual prowess and instant memorization. With the right eye, you access long-range Kamui to an endless pocket dimension in your left eye. You can create ranged barrier spaces to suck objects and people into Kamui or close the door halfway to kill them, including around yourself. Larger barriers cost more energy.
name: Obito's Mangekyo Sharingan Left

description: #(Tag:command)(Tag:illusion)(Tag:mental)(Tag:movement)(Tag:ocular)(Tag:sense)(Tag:space)You possess Obito Uchiha's Eternal Mangekyo Sharingan plus all regular Sharingan benefits, with full access to Kamui. You access an endless pocket dimension called Kamui, letting you create barriers that pull people in, freely teleport within it, teleport by exiting elsewhere, turn temporarily intangible, and open portals in space to breach other dimensions.
name: Obito's Mangekyo Sharingan

description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:recovery)You convert physical force you exert into positive energy, healing people by hitting them with your body. Greater strength means greater healing. Health healed equals damage that attack would otherwise have inflicted.
name: Physical Therapy

description: #(Tag:draconic)(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:summon)(Tag:transformation)"Mother of All Dragons" You can transform yourself and any biological structure you touch into a dragon, and spawn temporary dragon projections from your body. Dragon power and shape depend on skill and energy expended, with greater violations of mass conservation costing more energy. Sentient beings can resist conversion based on strength.
name: Tiamat's Gift

description: #(Tag:time)You can reverse or accelerate an object's time by touch, withering a tree or turning it into a sapling. Stronger targets have their time altered more slowly.
name: Hands of Time

description: #(Tag:dark)(Tag:time)Your shadow is a temporal anomaly. It can stretch, move independently, leave 2D space to physically interact and attack, and alter the time of whatever it touches, rapidly aging or rejuvenating it. Stronger targets have their time altered more slowly.
name: Shadows of Time

description: #(Tag:recovery)"You are enjoying this far too much" Your lust for violence is insatiable. When hurt, you recover energy proportional to damage taken, and recover health proportional to damage you deal. You are an eternal engine of battle.
name: Bloody Lust

description: #(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:fire)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:recovery)Your heart is an Infernal Engine. When activated, regeneration increases and you can wield Hellflames. But it heats your body the longer it runs, and greater heat makes it more effective. Beware overheating and burning yourself with your own Hellflames.
name: Infernal Engine

description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:growth)(Tag:recovery)(Tag:transformation)Your body is entirely the Blacklight Virus. You can freely shapeshift down to the cellular level, absorb biological matter to grow stronger and analyze and replicate its composition, and gain all memories of targets whose brains you consume.
name: Blacklight

description: #(Tag:alter)The rules no longer matter to you. You can expend energy to remove rules affecting you or a touched target, remove gravity on yourself, magic on a target, being targetable by magic, etc. Vaguer and more impactful rules cost more energy. A broken rule slowly restores itself, but its effects do not.
name: Rule Breaker

description: #(Tag:meta)(Tag:summon)(Gacha) You can temporarily summon a random item from the Diamond Item Gacha lasting 1 hour before disappearing (you roll the gacha with a temporary ticket). This ability starts its 8-hour cooldown on use. If an elixir is pulled, its effects are temporary. 2-hour cooldown.
name: Diamond Draw

description: #(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:recovery)(Tag:transformation)You are the Chainsaw hybrid. Pulling the ripcord on your chest turns you into hybrid form, replacing your head with a chainsaw and sprouting chainsaws on your arms and optionally legs. In this form you gain enhanced physical stats and blood-fueled extreme regeneration. You are immortal in hybrid state, as long as your heart remains, pulling your ripcord revives you.
name: Chainsaw Man

description: #(Tag:kinetic)Simply point your index finger and say "Bang!" to unleash immense telekinetic force that tears apart anything in your way.
name: Bang!

description: #(Tag:movement)(Tag:sense)(Tag:space)You can freely teleport within a 50-meter range around yourself with complete spatial awareness of it. Teleportation there is instant, but repeated teleports cause increasing vertigo.
name: Spatial Displacement

description: #(Tag:movement)(Tag:space)You can warp space around yourself to move at absurd speeds. Warping accelerates you more and faster than otherwise possible, reaching extreme speeds but making precise movement difficult.
name: Warp Drive

description: #(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:meta)You can freely change attributes through forms. Offensive Form trades defence for energy output and speed, Defensive Form raises defense and resilience while lowering speed, Recovery Form trades strength for regeneration and recovery, and Speed Form drastically raises speed while sacrificing attack and defence. You can also create your own forms.
name: Form Change

description: #(Tag:transformation)You can transform into a murder of 100 crows at will. You perfectly control each crow and are equally each crow, take 1% damage per crow killed, can partially transform to send messages or spy, and return to 100 crows once fully healed even after losing 30.
name: Murder Swarm

description: #(Tag:blood)"Go beyond you" For 10 minutes all parameters are greatly increased and all regenerations amplified. Afterwards, all parameters and regenerations are greatly decreased for 24 hours. 5 day cooldown.
name: Blood Overdrive

description: #(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:recovery)"Time to go all out" Upon activation, for 4 minutes and 11 seconds all parameters and energy regeneration increase, plus ability slots are removed so you can use all abilities at once. This places immense strain on your body and can kill you. 7 day cooldown.
name: Limit Break

description: #(Tag:fire)(Tag:poison)(Tag:transformation)You can turn into a living being of heat and radiation, with everything but your skeleton becoming irradiated energy. You can conjure irradiated fireballs, superheat yourself, or launch radiation blasts. Expect collateral damage.
name: Phosphorus

description: #(Tag:buff)(Tag:debuff)(Tag:meta)You can place restraints on yourself to amplify powers, sacrifice sight to boost hearing to daredevil levels, sacrifice an arm to strengthen the other, or restrict ability slots to strengthen the rest. Amplification equals restraint severity.
name: Restraints and Amplifications

description: #(Tag:enhancer)You can charge your body with energy to empower your next move, charge a fist for a stronger punch or legs to leap over buildings. More charged energy means a stronger result.
name: Power Charge

description: #(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:growth)(Tag:meta)You inherit 9 people's collective power accumulated over generations. One For All grants incomparable physical enhancement, though overuse can break your body, plus you can awaken past users' quirks: Gearshift, Blackwhip, Float, Smokescreen, Dangersense, and Fa-Jin.
name: One For All

description: #(Tag:movement)(Tag:space)You can create indoor portals from doors and entrances inside a building. This lets you teleport yourself and others door-to-door to traverse quickly or block others from leaving.
name: Door Crossing

description: #(Tag:space)You can affix objects to other objects or locations, making them completely inviolable and immovable without spacetime interference. All kinetic energy applied while affixed releases the moment it is released. Larger mass and energy cost more energy to affix, and maintaining affixation consumes energy.
name: Kraft Works

description: #(Tag:movement)(Tag:space)You can create semi-permanent gates to teleport through. To create one, you must be incredibly familiar with the location or have visited it, and focus for 1 minute to set it. You can maintain up to 10 gates at once, improvable as you grow stronger.
name: Gate Creation

description: #(Tag:bio)You can shoot sticky, durable spider-web ropes from your body. They dissolve naturally after an hour.
name: Web Slinger

description: #(Tag:draconic)(Tag:fire)(Tag:transformation)You can take the form of a fire-breathing drake or hybrid at will. As a lesser dragon, it grants increased physical abilities, flight, and fire breath.
name: Drake Form

description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:transformation)You can transform into a Klyntar, a symbiotic amorphous race that merges with biological matter and assumes their characteristics. Bonding with or taking over a host lets you share their powers while granting them your power and physical abilities. In this form you are highly vulnerable to loud noises and fire.
name: Klyntar Form

description: #(Tag:divination)You can read an object's history by physical contact and expending energy. More energy reveals more history, how it was made, what happened to it, what it has seen, with greater accuracy.
name: Psychometry

description: #(Tag:movement)(Tag:water)You can merge with and move through water at extreme speeds, at least 10x running speed. You need a body of water at least equal to your mass to merge into and move freely through. If that water is compromised, you take considerable damage.
name: Aqueduct

description: #(Tag:divination)You can place marks on objects or creatures to monitor at any time. You always know each mark's location relative to you and its bearer's structural integrity. You can hold up to 10 marks, increasing as you grow stronger.
name: Marked

description: #(Tag:movement)(Tag:space)You can teleport, as long as you properly know a location or its coordinates, you can instantly teleport there. Teleportation is instant and scales slightly with distance, with even beginners skipping countries. Overuse can cause vertigo.
name: Teleport

description: #(Tag:anti-magic)(Tag:anti-tech)You can create a large zone around you that shuts off magical and sci-fi item functions. Inside, even Excalibur is just a very durable sword. Items far above your level are drastically weakened rather than shut off.
name: Shut Down

description: #(Tag:transformation)Stone Free lets you convert any body part into translucent string you control and move at will. The string shares your exact physical abilities and can be instinctively woven into complex patterns, etc.
name: Stone Free

description: #(Tag:movement)(Tag:nature)(Tag:transformation)You can temporarily shift into a mass of rose petals to move at superspeed for a short duration. In rose form you resist physical attacks better, but larger mass costs more energy, and directional control is reduced.
name: Petal Burst

description: #(Tag:meta)You can grant people lesser versions of your abilities. Elite rank or below drops by one rank, while Epic and Legendary drop by two ranks. Only one ability can be granted per person at a time.
name: Grant

description: #(Tag:space)You can enter any mirror as a portal to access the mirror dimension, a replica of the real world with nothing living inside. Aside from spacetime abilities, the only entry and exit is you dragging people in or out.
name: Man in the Mirror

description: #(Tag:earth)Metallurgy lets you create metal at will and control it telekinetically. You can create any mundane metal you know, and telekinetically control metals you created. Stronger or more complex metals cost more energy.
name: Metallurgy

description: #(Tag:earth)(Tag:meta)You can conjure and control any metal whose composition you know, even legendary metals like Uru, Adamantium, or Vibranium. Higher-rank metals cost more energy, and you cannot permanently create metals stronger than your rank.
name: Metallurge

description: #While in an active slot, you take no damage from anything below a certain level. Anything that would hurt no more than a light cut is ignored completely.
name: Threshold

description: #(Tag:alter)You can perform transmutation on a macro scale. You cannot build complex constructs or small applications, but can turn the ground into a proper building in under an hour. It moves slowly, so combat use is limited.
name: Building

description: #(Tag:divination)You can conjure a mental compass that acts like a regular compass.
name: Compass

description: #(Tag:divination)You can conjure a phantasmal compass in your hands that points toward your target. As long as you know the target and carry something related to it, you can track it down.
name: Prophetic Compass

description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:nsfw)(Tag:transformation)(Noncon) You can turn into a hentai tentacle creature or manifest its tentacles at will. You resemble a ball with numerous tentacles that act as both limbs and reproductive organs.
name: Tentacled Creature

description: #(Tag:command)(Tag:mental)(Tag:spirit)You emit a wavelength that alters the minds and perceptions of those it touches. You can drive a whole town to madness while passing by, and can tweak the madness exerted.
name: Madness Wavelength

description: #(Tag:time)You can speed up your own body's time in 2x, 3x, 4x increments. Greater acceleration puts more strain on body and mind.
name: Time Accel

description: #(Tag:holy)(Tag:light)(Tag:martial)You can conjure a sword of Divine Light and alter its shape. It is lightweight yet unbelievably sharp and durable, and burns struck targets with purifying holy flames. At the wielder's will, it cannot hurt even a fly despite full-power swings.
name: Divine Blade

description: #(Tag:command)(Tag:fae)(Tag:spirit)Inspired by the Fae. If you get people to wager their souls in a bet, you can claim the prize, extracting their souls and taking possession of them. It works only if the opponent internally acknowledges defeat.
name: Soul Bet

description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:recovery)You can take others' burdens onto yourself. By touching them, you transfer their injuries, exhaustion, curses, sicknesses, and other ailments to yourself.
name: Martyr

description: #(Tag:meta)(Gacha) "Lucky" When you roll this ability, whatever ticket you got it with is rolled twice and this ability is removed.
name: Reroll

description: #(Tag:divination)(Tag:sense)You can see through any physical deception and concealment, pitfalls, physical disguises, bent light, one-way mirrors, etc. Any physical illusion meant to deceive senses fails on you.
name: Disillusioned

description: #(Tag:ocular)(Tag:sense)Your eyes can see far and through objects, with level perfectly adjustable to your needs.
name: Piercing Eyes

description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:necro)A Kekkei Genkai letting you grow bones and bone constructs on and out of your body. You can reshape bones, reinforce them by increasing density, and manipulate your skeleton for defence. You can regrow bones, but still take damage from removing or growing them.
name: Dead Bone Pulse

description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:necro)All Killing Ash Bones lets you control your skeleton and grow bone constructs from your body. You can reinforce these bones, and piercing a living being makes them deteriorate to the molecular level until death. Sure-kill potency depends on the power gap between user and target.
name: All Killing Ash Bones

description: #(Tag:divination)You can tell the future across a large timeframe as prophecies. Though not very accurate, they can point to crucial information or important things. Vaguer prophecies cost less energy.
name: Prophecise

description: #(Tag:divination)You can tell the future across a short or longer span. More seconds viewed costs more energy. You see the future that would have happened had you not used Future Sight. Overuse can cause temporary brain bleeding.
name: Future Observation

description: #(Tag:divination)(Tag:mental)You can read the near future over a small, trainable timeframe. The future read is not absolute but highly probable, and more situational knowledge improves accuracy.
name: Future Reading

description: #(Tag:divination)(Tag:sense)You can predict the future by calculating a target's future. You can predict a dice rolling a 6, a slot machine result, an opponent's opening move, or rising and falling stocks. More information and better sensory abilities improve predictions.
name: Future Prediction

description: #(Tag:movement)Yomi Hustle - You can place a foresight, an afterimage of yourself, anywhere in perception range. At any moment you can teleport to it, but it vanishes if you move over 100 meters away, leave it over 1 hour, or it takes damage. You can create only one, increasable through training.
name: Foresight

description: #(Tag:nature)(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)You can genetically engineer Plants vs Zombies plants, such as flowers that turn sunlight into energy, ones that punch people, or breathe fire. More powerful and esoteric plants need more resources.
name: Tinker PvZ

description: #(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:space)(Tag:transformation)You are myth's legendary minotaur. Physical abilities, especially strength and endurance, are amplified to inhuman levels plus bull traits. You can also turn any area you are in into a labyrinth, shuffling all entries and exits to lead wherever you want. Even a future reader would be stuck a hundred years in a forest.
name: Labyrinthian

description: #(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:movement)You are not just super, you are HYPER! You have extreme physical abilities and flight, the classic super package taken to the extreme. More energy expended means stronger and faster.
name: Hyper

description: #(Tag:recovery)You are a god of healing and restoration, with domain over all healing to perform miracles by expending energy. For you, death is little different from sleeping and mythical poisons are a mild cold.
name: Divinity Healing

description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:recovery)You can enforce the Law of Restoration on a target, forcefully restoring it to its deemed "restored" state. Even corpses can return to life and even erasure reversed if something remains. More powerful, damaged, or abnormal targets cost more energy. While slotted, it activates on your own death.
name: Law of Restoration

description: #(Tag:space)There is an island inside your being. You can create doors to a spatial dimension within your existence, a small vegetated island in a vast lifeless ocean. Creating larger doors and maintaining doors consumes energy.
name: Inner Isles

description: #(Tag:draconic)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:transformation)(Tag:water)You can transform into Leviathan, the Sea Serpent of the End. As this giant mythical sea snake, you control all water in range on a massive scale, tilting seas and drowning cities, creating more water serpents, and summoning flood-causing rains. All water-based abilities and effects are massively amplified in this form.
name: Sea Serpent of the End

description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:transformation)You can gradually transform your body into any shape, but the slowness demands care. Turning into a cat takes roughly 3 hours, and you cannot increase or decrease mass by more than 500%.
name: Gradual Transformation

description: #(Tag:electric)Meltdowner lets you create and control Particle Waveform High-Speed Cannons from altered electrons, incredibly powerful, hot electron beams from your body that slice any metal like paper. More energy expended means stronger beams.
name: Meltdowner

description: #(Tag:anti-curse)(Tag:curse)(Tag:magic)Curse Breaker lets you break curses by touching them, or an area around you with training. Breakable curse strength scales with energy expended.
name: Curse Breaker

description: #(Tag:curse)(Tag:magic)Upgrade to Curse Breaker - No curse is safe around you. You can dispel and break all curses you touch, with breakable strength equal to energy expended. With enough energy you can break gods' curses.
name: Shatter Curse

description: #(Tag:ocular)(Tag:recovery)Mystical Eyes of the Pure World let you cleanse any sight-locked target, breaking curses, cleansing disease and poison, dispelling charms, and removing any status effect against the target's natural state. More powerful afflictions cost more energy and strain your eyes more.
name: Mystical Eyes of Purity

description: #(Tag:sense)You can adjust your viewpoint across three settings: 1st person is regular perception, 2nd person sees through the eyes of anyone you look at, and 3rd person views yourself like a rotatable surrounding camera.
name: Point of View

description: #(Tag:divination)You have a minimap in your vision's corner that auto-maps where you go and reveals enemies in seen places as long as you know they are hostile. You can enlarge and zoom it freely.
name: Minimap

description: #(Tag:divination)You have a megamap in your vision's corner, the cooler minimap. It maps everything within 2.5km wherever you step and tracks all living beings in real time, marking them red or blue for hostile or not. It doubles as satellite viewing.
name: Megamap

description: #(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:sense)(Tag:sound)(Tag:transformation)You can transform into a Loboan or Loboan hybrid at will. Loboans are alien werewolves with formidable physical abilities, sharp teeth and claws, and bloodhound-like tracking senses. Most notably, they unleash direct sonic howls powerful enough to cause severe damage.
name: Loboan Form

description: #(Tag:blood)(Tag:construct)(Tag:life)(Tag:summon)You can shed blood to form a ground puddle from which to summon one or several Blood Golems. Summoned strength or number scales with physical stats and blood shed (minimum 100ml).
name: Blood Golem

description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:poison)Apothecary Physique lets you manipulate your body's interior to reproduce any consumed chemical or digestible item's effects, like health, mana, iron-skin, or night-vision potions, as long as it was Epic rank or below. It also grants complete control over your biochemistry.
name: Apothecary Physique

description: #(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:holy)(Tag:movement)"At the speed of heaven" You can manifest Seraphic wings, amplifying speed and granting free high-speed flight. While manifest, you resist mundane environmental effects below Epic rank, swimming in lava, walking on water or through natural fire, ignoring fall damage, breathing in space, etc. The wings are superhumanly strong, easily bisecting people and scaling with physical stats.
name: Seraph Tracers

description: #(Tag:magic)(Tag:movement)"The very stars guide your flight" You can manifest cosmic wings granting fast flight without existing in physical space. While active they resonate with cosmic energies, boosting all spell power and accelerating energy recovery closer to night.
name: Nebula Mantle

description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:fire)"And so the sun never allowed a mortal to fly again" You can enact Icarus' Folly in an area, evoking the sun's wrath against fliers. Those exceeding 10 meters elevation burn in holy inferno, hotter the higher above ground they are. Zone width depends on energy expended, larger areas cost more. Victims instinctively sense flight's danger.
name: Icarus' Folly

description: #(Tag:martial)"Boom, headshot." Bullseye places reticle crosshairs on random spots of all targets in your vision; hitting one centrally with a projectile makes it a critical hit, amplifying power and damage. Training lets you place crosshairs more accurately.
name: Bullseye

description: #(Tag:illusion)(Tag:mental)(Tag:stealth)You can disguise yourself as others with an applied normality effect that convinces observers you are that person even when acting out of character. More out-of-character behavior costs more energy, and the effect fades if the target is absolutely stronger than you or you act in directly identity-compromising ways.
name: Perfect Impostor

description: #(Tag:alter)Your skin is uncomfortably sticky to others, as if soaked in glue or soda, though you feel no difference.
name: Sticky Icky

description: #(Tag:nsfw)(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech)(Noncon) Tinker - Allows you to build technological constructs or items related to sexual events, such as aphrodisiacs, sexual instruments, contraceptives, etc.
name: Tinker - Erotics

description: #(Tag:fire)(Tag:kinetic)The Cursed Technique of the King of Curses. Shrine grants Cleave, Dismantle, and Furnace. Dismantle sends flying invisible slashes of varying power, Cleave creates stronger instant slashes on touched targets, and Furnace manifests a powerful fire arrow. With enough mastery or enlightenment, you may unleash the Malevolent Shrine.
name: Shrine

description: #(Tag:alter)The Illusion Killer, Imagine Breaker is the ultimate negation tool. It can negate anything supernatural that could not exist on base Earth. It dwells in your right hand, but also negates your own supernatural capabilities like abilities and magic while active (Note: This is only the base Imagine Breaker and does not contain the beings sealed inside).
name: Imagine Breaker

description: #(Tag:nsfw)(Tag:transformation)(Nsfw) Allows you to alter your genitals to your liking as long as the changes aren't absurd.
name: Sex Manipulation

description: #(Tag:transformation)Allows you to swap your gender and the genders of those who don't or can't resist. Swapped forms usually take a shape you find attractive, partial swaps are possible, and changes can include mental as well as physical aspects.
name: Genderswap

description: #(Tag:command)(Tag:illusion)Your words are imbued with lies, making them sound more convincing and believable. Stronger targets and more unbelievable lies reduce effectiveness and consume more energy.
name: Deception

description: #(Tag:command)(Tag:illusion)You can assert a false truth by expending energy, convincing others of even far-fetched claims. Larger power gaps and harder-to-believe lies lower efficiency and raise energy cost.
name: Vainglory

description: #(Tag:construct)(Tag:summon)Golemancy allows you to animate inanimate objects into golems under your control. Golem power depends on material quality and your power; stronger materials cost more energy, and max golems depends on max energy (minimum 10), with stronger golems taking more slots.
name: Golemancy

description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:earth)(Tag:electric)(Tag:fire)(Tag:ice)(Tag:movement)(Tag:transformation)(Tag:water)Allows you to turn your body into any basic element while retaining control, such as fire to burn, lightning to travel cables, or wind to fly. Damage to destroyed mass in elemental form reflects back to you.
name: Elemental Sublimation

description: #(Tag:movement)(Tag:tech)(Tech) Video Travel allows you to slip into device screens and travel to other screened devices on the same network or wired together.
name: Video Travel

description: #(Tag:alter)Allows you to drain others' luck by touch and add it to your own temporarily. More energy and longer contact steals more luck with exponentially scaling cost, and stolen luck fades over time, returning to its target.
name: Luck Drain

description: #(Tag:curse)Jinx allows you to curse targets by touch to reduce their luck enough to disadvantage but not harm them. The effect grows with extra energy and power advantage, and can also be fired as a moderate-speed Hex projectile.
name: Jinx

description: #(Tag:curse)You can unleash an aura of misfortune that reduces the luck of those nearby, or narrow it to reach distant targets. More energy increases the reduction, and your power difference to the target dictates the effect.
name: Misfortune

description: #(Tag:curse)"Directing the hatred of fate" You can mark a target in sight with Malus, then expend energy to reduce the outcomes of their actions. Stronger maluses cost more energy and exhaust you, and overreaching against too strong a target can backfire.
name: Malus

description: #(Tag:divination)You can see numerous possible futures excluding precognition and enforce your chosen future by expending energy. More powerful targets and more improbable futures cost more energy and incur larger backlash, though with enough energy even absolutely improbable futures can be enforced.
name: Choosing Fate

description: #(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:meta)While United We Stand is active, you can select a familiar and add all its physical stats to your own. For each unused ability slot, you can draw strength from another familiar.
name: United We Stand

description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Allows you to build miniaturized versions of existing technology without losing quality and with reduced energy use, provided you already know how to build it.
name: Tinker - Minimisation

description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Allows you to build scaled-up versions of existing technologies, such as hundred-meter warplanes, human-sized-shell cannons, or giant microwave death chambers.
name: Tinker - Macro

description: #(Tag:nature)(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Allows you to build nature-related contraptions that utilize, help, and benefit from it, such as Bio-Domes, efficient fertilizers, animal lures, solar panels, geothermal reactors, and terraforming equipment.
name: Tinker - Ecology

description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Allows you to build energy production and use contraptions, such as hyper-efficient solar panels and wind farms, microfusion, bio, hydro, and arc reactors.
name: Tinker - Energy

description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Allows you to build industrialisation contraptions like factories, efficient production lines, autonomous drone workers, and assembly lines to build things for you at larger scale.
name: Tinker - Industrialisation

description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Allows you to build biology-augmenting contraptions like subdermal armour, biomonitors, hormone regulators, metal-bonded bone, and reinforced tendons and muscles.
name: Tinker - Augments

description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Allows you to build nanotechnology contraptions like cell-altering nanobots, trauma-hardening nanomachines, machine-disrupting nanobots, nanocameras, and nanomachine clothes.
name: Tinker - Nanomachines

description: #(Tag:movement)(Tag:space)(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Allows you to build dimension-manipulating contraptions like pocket dimension generators, teleportation sealers, dimensional rams, interdimensional portals, unbreakable spatial barriers, and drawing energy from parallel dimensions.
name: Tinker - Dimensions

description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:healing)(Tag:poison)(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Allows you to build medicine-related contraptions and production, such as poison-curing, health-bolstering, and other medicinal cures.
name: Tinker - Medicine

description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Allows you to build destruction-related contraptions like Unstable Matter Rockets, Disintegration Cannons, Black Hole Generators, and general Doomsday Devices, generally inspired by your abilities and traits.
name: Tinker - Destruction

description: #(Tag:command)(Tag:mental)(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Allows you to build mind-influencing and controlling contraptions like suggestion music, neuralyzers, mind control helmets, and mental reprogramming machines.
name: Tinker - Mind

description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:time)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Allows you to build time-related contraptions like aging grenades, time-dilated training rooms, time-stoppers, stasis barriers, and time-dilation FTL drives. This speciality is very expensive.
name: Tinker - Time

description: #(Tag:recovery)You can heal yourself and others by expending energy, but only slightly, such as scratches, scrapes, and bruises. Effectiveness depends on your power difference to the target.
name: Aid

description: #(Tag:recovery)You can heal others by expending energy, mending stabs, slashes, and broken bones, with more severe wounds costing far more. Effectiveness depends on your power difference to the target.
name: Minor Cure

description: #(Tag:recovery)You can heal yourself and others by expending energy, with healing scale tied to energy spent and more lethal wounds needing more energy. Effectiveness depends on your power difference to the target.
name: Cure

description: #(Tag:recovery)You can greatly heal yourself and others by expending energy, with stronger effects for more energy, even healing lethal wounds at higher cost. Effectiveness depends on your power difference to the target.
name: Greater Cure Wounds

description: #(Tag:recovery)You can heal yourself and others by expending energy to imbue potent healing energies. More energy yields more potent healing, with effectiveness depending on your power difference to the target.
name: Restoration

description: #(Tag:mental)"Reaper of Minds" You wield offensive mind manipulation: mind blasts, gaze-driven mind damage, crushing weaker minds, body hijacking, and living nightmares. Less destructive uses cost more energy, and effectiveness depends on the opponent's mental strength and relative power.
name: Mind Rip

description: #(Tag:meta)You can shed very salty tears at will.
name: Cry

description: #(Tag:summon)(Tag:transformation)Allows you to temporarily fuse two living beings into a new entity with both abilities. Unwilling targets resist by power, stronger fusions cost more energy, and maintaining fusion drains energy over time.
name: Super Polymerization

description: #(Tag:recovery)"Restoration, but at what cost?" Greedy Healing consumes wealth you own instead of mana, with more wealth yielding more potent restoration. A dollar barely recovers a chipped nail, while enough wealth can restore limbs or possibly a life; stronger targets and larger effects need more sacrifice of coins, artefacts, items, or even people (Infinite Money Glitch invalid).
name: Greedy Healing

description: #(Tag:gravity)(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Allows you to build gravity-manipulation technology like anti-gravity thrusters, Zero-G fields, gravity anchors, and weight training rooms. At this low rank, don't expect black hole projectors or gravitron crushers.
name: Tinker - Gravity

description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Allows you to build Entity technology such as Doomsday Drivers, Multiversal Travel, Time Bombs, and any Tinker specialisation from their universe.
name: The Tinkerer

description: #(Tag:kinetic)(Tech) Allows you to build and replicate Metal Knight's technology like mass-produced weapons, Drone Bodies, giant mechs, and large-scale drones, including Dragon Class Mechs with enough time.
name: Tinker - One Punch Man

description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) - Allows you to build far more functional technology from scraps and easily jury-rig existing tech from subpar materials.
name: Tinker - Scraps

description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Allows you to build Big Mountain Think Tank technologies including teleporters, modified monsters, pacification fields, sonic weaponry, and lobotomites.
name: Tinker - Big MT

description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Allows you to build from Dr. Kuseno's knowledge base, including immensely powerful cyborg bodies scaling from city-block to continent-buster with enough time, testing, and resources.
name: Tinker - Kuseno

description: #(Tag:fire)(Tag:martial)The All Incinerating Armageddon Blade allows you to conjure a blade of destructive flame and heat that massively amplifies Pyro effects and cuts almost anything. Its Flames of Armageddon embody oblivion, erasing existence instead of leaving ash, growing stronger with you, and unleashable as a sword beam for enough energy.
name: Armageddon Blade

description: #(Tag:ice)(Tag:martial)The Frozen Dawn allows you to conjure a Frozen Spear that massively amplifies Cryo attributes while held. It unleashes frigid energy that freezes even mana and kinetic energy, dooming stabbed targets to freeze faster if weaker, and can create additional boomerang spears as projectiles.
name: Frozen Dawn

description: #(Tag:earth)(Tag:martial)The Hammer of Continental Destruction allows you to conjure an earthen hammer that massively enhances strength and Earth attributes. Strikes reshape terrain, unleash quaking shockwaves that tear hit beings inside out, and with enough power and energy can alter an entire planet in one swing.
name: World Crusher

description: #(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:transformation)You can unleash a Gamma Mutate physique, growing large with godlike physical abilities. Physical strength grows with rage without discernible limit. (Note: Just the basic Hulk transformation, no connection shenanigans.).
name: Hulk Out

description: #(Tag:enhancer)You can transform into Garm or a Garm hybrid, gaining immense physical abilities and terrifying presence. Your teeth and claws tear even dimensional fabric, creating portals and breaking boundaries.
name: Garm Physique

description: #(Tag:spirit)(Tag:tech)(Tech) Allows you to conjure ghost ammunition for your weapons that mimics normal ammo but costs energy and disappears 1 second after hitting.
name: Ghost Ammunition

description: #(Tag:spirit)(Tag:tech)(Tech) Allows you to conjure spectre ammunition from energy for held weapons, mimicking normal ammo. You can imbue them for more power and combine them with other abilities for special properties.
name: Spectre Ammo

description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Allows you to build gel-related technology like super lubricant, impact absorption gel, hardening gel, restraint gel, fire retardant gel, and gel bombs.
name: Tinker - Gel

description: #(Tag:earth)(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Allows you to build Crystal-related technology like preservation crystals, self-repairing plates, high-capacity energy storage, and eventually crystal transmutation.
name: Tinker - Crystals

description: #(Tag:earth)(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Allows you to build Metal and Alloy-related technology like metal fabricators, wondrous alloys from mundane metals, superconductors, impossible-property metals, and metal arms and armour.
name: Tinker - Metallurgy

description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:meta)You can weaken effects and abilities by contact. Weaker abilities and longer contact increase weakening until fully disabled.
name: Dampener

description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:meta)You can shut off others' powers by physical contact, with energy cost set by your power difference to the target. Strong enough targets may only be partially affected.
name: Shut Off

description: #(Tag:enhancer)You can release a power-dampening aura around yourself. Effectiveness depends on your power difference to the target; weak targets are fully suppressed while strong targets resist.
name: Power Oppression

description: #(Tag:movement)(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Makes you supernaturally good at designing, modifying, and building Vehicles, producing engineering marvels that cannot exceed your current world's level.
name: Tinker - Vehicles (I)

description: #(Tag:movement)(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Allows you to build vehicle-related technology like a tank-armoured sports car, all-terrain including air motorcycle, or hard-light-track train. But no Killdozers yet.
name: Tinker - Vehicles (II)

description: #(Tag:movement)(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Allows you to build vehicle-related technology like space vessels, supersonic flying cars, weapons, hard-light shields, and borrowing ideas from weak minor tinker abilities.
name: Tinker - Vehicles (IV)

description: #(Tag:movement)(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) No vehicle overkill enough. Allows you to build any vehicle, from FTL starships and warp-drive motorcycles to goliath doomships, star-landing craft, or a dapper car.
name: Tinker Vehicles (V)

description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Makes you supernaturally good at designing, modifying, and building biological constructs. At this level, you can crossbreed and modify plants and create simple biology items like biomonitors.
name: Tinker - Bio (I)

description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Allows you to build biology-altering technology like operating tables, shock-absorbent dense bones, regeneration-granting artificial hearts, seamless replacement limbs, and homunculi.
name: Tinker - Bio (II)

description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Allows you to build biology-related constructs like homunculi vats, full biological overhauls, genetic alteration, scratch-built beings, and potent viruses.
name: Tinker - Bio (III)

description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Allows you to build biology-related constructs like Cloning Vats, biological powers, cracking inherited-power genetics, full genetic overhauls, and sentient assimilating viruses.
name: Tinker - Bio (IV)

description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Allows you to build biology-related constructs like decoding and granting scanned genetics-based abilities, scratch-building powerful creatures, and fabricating and assimilating Legendary rank and below biology abilities.
name: Tinker - Bio (V)

description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Allows you to build alchemy-related technology for reagents and potions like minor healing, stamina, toughening, or combat acids.
name: Tinker - Alchemy (I)

description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Allows you to build alchemy-related technology like healing, stamina, energy, disease-curing, minor permanent-buff, explosive gas, and incendiary acid potions. Stronger consumers weaken effects and vice versa, and more potent potions need better materials.
name: Tinker - Alchemy (II)

description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Allows you to build alchemy-related technology like body-altering, gunpowder, flesh-eating acid, Healing, mana, and Ironskin potions with notable potency. Stronger consumers weaken effects and vice versa, and more potent potions need better materials.
name: Tinker - Alchemy (III)

description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Allows you to build alchemy-related technology like limb-restoring healing, mana-boosting, ultra-steroid, and Epic Tier physical-trait permanent-buff potions plus many reagents.
name: Tinker - Alchemy (IV)

description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Allows you to build alchemy-related miracles with enough resources, from Panaceas, Elixirs, and Ichor to Elixirs granting Legendary rank physical traits.
name: Tinker - Alchemy (V)

description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Allows you to build Augment and Implant technology limited at this level to replacement limbs, metal bone plating, camera eyes, and metal teeth. You can surgically install them.
name: Tinker - Augments (I)

description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Allows you to build Augment and Implant technology like enhanced camera eyes, subdermal armour, reinforced tendons, hormone regulators, and hidden blades and guns. You can surgically install them.
name: Tinker - Augments (II)

description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Allows you to build Augment and Implant technology like mechanical bones, full-body augments enough for Augmented (trait), combat augments, transforming robotic arms, and metabolism regulators. You could make Robocops or Astartes-lites.
name: Tinker - Augments (III)

description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Allows you to build Augment and Implant technology for full-body conversions into tank-flipping, bullet-dodging Cyborgs, fitting impossibly many implants into one body. Go build your Adam Smashers.
name: Tinker - Augments (IV)

description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Allows you to build Augment and Implant technology to raise regular people to near-demigods, from brain supercomputers and time-dilating spines to million-ton-suplexing skeletons and laser eyes. Go build a Genos or Raiden.
name: Tinker - Augments (V)

description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Allows you to build Defence-related technology, at this level limited to reinforcing existing things plus basic shields and bulletproof glass.
name: Tinker - Defence (I)

description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Allows you to build Defence-related technology like sturdier protection constructs, limited fireproof coating, impact suits, EMP threading, and bulletproof fabric.
name: Tinker - Defence (II)

description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Allows you to build Defence-related technology like shield projectors, reinforced chassis, bullet-ignoring skintight suits, elemental coatings, and highly durable machines.
name: Tinker - Defence (III)

description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Allows you to build Defence-related technology like city-covering forcefields, trauma-hardening cloth outfits, anti-teleport Spatial Locks, and elemental hyper-paint. With effort you could make a bicycle survive ocean depths, space, and volcanoes, or a phone survive nuclear war.
name: Tinker - Defence (IV)

description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Allows you to build Defence-related technology like nigh-unbreakable space-time-bending forcefields, sun-resistant alloys, and nuclear-surviving suits. With time, resources, and experience, even gods cannot dent them.
name: Tinker - Defence (V)

description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Allows you to build ranged-weapon technology, at this level mostly mundane but supernaturally well-made pistols, snipers, bows, and slingshots.
name: Tinker - Ranged Weapon (I)

description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Allows you to build supernaturally efficient ranged weapons and ammo like steel-piercing revolvers and rudimentary railguns.
name: Tinker - Ranged Weapon (II)

description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Allows you to build supernaturally powerful gunpowder, electromagnetic, and laser weapons and ammo, each with tradeoffs, such as bolter-rivaling thermite pistols or Gustav-dwarfing cannons.
name: Tinker - Ranged Weapon (III)

description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Allows you to build supernaturally powerful gunpowder, laser, plasma, and electromagnetic guns and ammo, from army-mowing machine guns and block-wiping blasters to city-busting cannons and tank-ripping scrap guns.
name: Tinker - Ranged Weapon (IV)

description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Allows you to build god-rivaling ranged weapons limited only by resources and time, like space-ripping sniper rifles, nuclear-pistols, and Death Star-dwarfing cannons.
name: Tinker - Ranged Weapon (V)

description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Allows you to build fortification technology like self-repairing walls, hidden turrets, proximity sensors, missile batteries, laser traps, and spatial locks. Tech only works attached to a large enough building or area.
name: Tinker - Fortification

description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Allows you to build Resident Evil technology, specifically cultivating viruses like Tyrant, Uroboros, Progenitor, and parasites. It is time-intensive and can eventually remove side effects with much trial and error.
name: Tinker - Resident Evil

description: #(Tag:space)(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Allows you to build Aperture Science technology including turrets, portal guns, speed and jump gel, anti-fall boots, basic non-combat robots, and strong AI. Breadth over raw power.
name: Tinker - Aperture Science

description: #(Tag:growth)(Tag:meta)You can grant others abilities as buds of your own that manifest as sidegrades capped at Elite rank, with max level set by their innate talent. Your budded ability weakens until they assimilate it, when you can retrieve the bud to restore strength, though you can retrieve anytime.
name: Budding

description: #(Tag:nsfw)(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) (Nsfw) Allows you to research and build Taimanin technology like advanced prosthetics, genetic modification, basic cloning, augments, brainwashing, demonization, and lewd tech plus the basic sci-fi package.
name: Tinker - Taimanin

description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Allows you to build cosmetics-related technology like hyper-realistic masks, machine beautification, holograms, beauty cream, and perfumes.
name: Tinker - Cosmetics

description: #(Tag:electric)(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Allows you to build electricity-related technology like Ultra Tesla coils and thunder-harnessing constructs, separate from magnetism.
name: Tinker - Electricity

description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Allows you to build dungeon-creation constructs, magical or technological, like bigger-inside rooms, indescrutable walls, dungeon-only traps, and utility rooms. Your dungeon needs an accessible entrance and plausible path to the core, tech only works inside, and inside tech is boosted.
name: Tinker - Dungeonmaster

description: #(Tag:nature)(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Allows you to build sustenance-related constructs like efficient farms, water purifiers and condensers, vampire blood alternatives, food bars, consumable life-force alternatives, and plant light projectors. More encountered sustenance needs unlock more varied tech.
name: Tinker - Sustenance

description: #(Tag:ocular)(Tag:sense)These mystical eyes supernaturally reveal the depth of an object or location relative to something else.
name: Mystic Eyes of Depth Perception

description: #(Tag:movement)You can amplify movement with energy to move faster, without affecting agility or senses. Faster speeds cost disproportionately more energy.
name: Swiftness

description: #(Tag:kinetic)(Tag:martial)You can amplify physical impact by expending energy, making strikes deal more damage without amplifying stats.
name: Impact

description: #(Tag:stealth)You can falsify your statistics and abilities to show scrying and analysing abilities what you want instead of the truth.
name: False Data

description: #(Tag:bio)Allows you to duplicate limbs and organs, like extra arms, eyes, or a second fittable heart. Extra parts cause strain.
name: Internal Duplication

description: #(Tag:alter)You can temporarily enforce quantum tunnelling on yourself to let attacks pass through harmlessly or phase through objects. It is draining, with exponentially rising cost the longer it lasts.
name: Tunnel Effect

description: #(Tag:spirit)Allows you to summon numerous invisible hand-like appendages you freely extend and control. They are superhumanly strong and can merge into a slower, larger, stronger hand, with power and max count set by max energy.
name: Unseen Hand

description: #(Tag:recovery)(Tag:spirit)Cor Leonis lets you sense allies as light spots and take their physical and mental conditions like exhaustion onto yourself. You can also transfer conditions to willing allies.
name: Cor Leonis

description: #(Tag:time)"You return by dea-" Each death returns you in time to a set spawn point. Spawn points are random but reset after sleeping over 6 hours. Does not activate with soul or existence erasure.
name: Return By Death

description: #(Tag:ice)Allows you to create ice constructs from energy without controlling them afterward or freezing objects, such as ice walls, weapons, blocks, and boulders.
