description: #(Tag:time)Take an extra turn after this one. Two mana, one extra turn, and a permanent seat on every banned list.
name: Time Walk

description: #Target player draws three cards. One blue mana for the most efficient draw spell ever printed.
name: Ancestral Recall

description: #(Tag:anti-magic)(Tag:magic)Counter target spell. Two blue mana that simply says no to anything.
name: Counterspell

description: #(Tag:martial)Exile target creature; its controller gains life equal to its power. One mana of unconditional removal.
name: Swords to Plowshares

description: #(Tag:dark)Add three black mana in a burst. The turn-one kill enabler since Alpha.
name: Dark Ritual

description: #(Tag:growth)Target creature gets +3/+3 until end of turn. One green mana of timeless combat math.
name: Giant Growth

description: #(Tag:dark)(Tag:infernal)Swap the positions of any two characters or objects in range, teleporting both at once.
name: Nether Swap

description: #Gain 2 action points now at the cost of 2 next turn; the classic opening-move rush.
name: Adrenaline

description: #(Tag:stealth)Blend perfectly into the surroundings, turning invisible for two turns unless you attack or cast.
name: Chameleon Cloak

description: #Polymorph an enemy into a clucking chicken that wanders helplessly for its turn.
name: Chicken Claw

description: #Sprout a tentacle that lashes distant enemies for damage and disarms them.
name: Tentacle Lash

description: #Grow horns that gore targets when you rush them, knocking victims down.
name: Bull Horns

description: #Infect a target with disease that eats through armour and keeps rotting them each turn.
name: Infect

description: #Strip all magic armour from enemies around you, leaving them open to every status effect.
name: Flay Skin

description: #(Tag:teleport)(Tag:time)Fane's special source skill: grant a character an entire extra turn after their current one ends.
name: Time Warp

description: #Take the first step toward godhood: all Source skills cost 3 less and attributes surge for two turns.
name: Apotheosis

description: #(Tag:time)Rewind time by seconds or minutes while retaining full memory of the undone timeline, then choose better.
name: Temporal Rewind

description: #(Tag:kinesis)(Tag:kinetic)Unleash concussive telekinetic force that hurls people, cars, and debris away from you.
name: Telekinetic Blast

description: #(Tag:time)Slow the world to a crawl while aiming, lining up machine weak-point shots with perfect calm.
name: Concentration

description: #(Tag:kinetic)(Tag:stealth)Takedown unaware machines and humans from stealth for massive damage.
name: Silent Strike

description: #Hunter vision that highlights enemies, animals, traps, and salvage through the environment.
name: Survivalist

description: #(Tag:mental)(Tag:time)Retain skills, relationships, and knowledge across loops of your life on Vertumna, redoing years better each time.
name: Loop Memory

description: #Launch homing energy seekers from your identity disc that hunt targets around corners.
name: Seeker Subroutine

description: #Spend your bioenergy to increase the chance of projectiles you fire bouncing off walls and enemies.
name: Bounce

description: #Spend your bioenergy to increase the homing speed of your projectiles towards the closest enemy.
name: Homing

description: #Spend your bioenergy to increase the time your projectiles remain at their maximum range before detonating.
name: Sticky

description: #Spend your bioenergy to increase the number of smaller pellets your projectiles break into on a hit.
name: Flack

description: #(Tag:summon)Call down a city-devouring tsunami wave, then watch the flooded districts from your disaster overview.
name: Summon Tsunami

description: #Equip a defensive subroutine that hardens your disc against hostile code and viral attacks.
name: Firewall

description: #Shift yourself between two parallel timelines, carrying objects and consequences across with you.
name: Timeline Shift

description: #(Tag:eldritch)Shape Eldritch magic into whips, shields, blades, and bindings that strike spirits as well as soldiers.
name: Eldritch Constructs

description: #(Tag:space)Fold yourself and your enemies into the Mirror Dimension, where cities bend and no collateral escapes.
name: Mirror Dimension

description: #(Tag:magic)Wield raw Chaos Magic that rewrites probability and reality on contact; it always takes something back.
name: Chaos Magic

description: #(Tag:curse)(Tag:debuff)(Tag:magic)Hex the odds themselves so the unlikely keeps happening to everyone but you.
name: Probability Hex

description: #(Tag:spirit)Step out of your body as an astral form to scout unseen while your body sleeps on.
name: Astral Projection

description: #(Tag:mental)Possess your own variants across the multiverse by dreamwalking into their bodies.
name: Dreamwalking

description: #(Tag:mental)Weave lifelike illusions, duplicates, and shapeshifts the way Loki does: constantly and without permission.
name: Asgardian Illusions

description: #(Tag:magic)Inscribe witch runes that steal any spell cast inside them and turn rival magic against its caster.
name: Rune Magic

description: #Lay finished railway track behind you as you walk, sleepers ballast and all, on any terrain that holds still.
name: Rail Laying

description: #Telekinetically true up any visible rails to a perfect gauge of your choosing, down to the millimetre.
name: Rail Gauge Setting

description: #Channel the Vortessence to knit wounds closed and throw crackling green lightning alike.
name: Vortessence

description: #Slip between Earth and the border world Xen, stepping across like the Nihilanth shuffled you there.
name: Xen Transit

description: #Exude the scent-command that turns nearby antlions into your obedient swarm.
name: Antlion Pheromones

description: #Launch into a spinning somersault charge that shreds through anything it touches while you stay invincible throughout. You cannot steer mid-spin, and landing somewhere awkward is your own problem.
name: Screw Attack

description: #(Tag:movement)(Tag:space)Jump again in midair as often as you like while spinning, each leap matching a grounded jump. Works only while moving; stall and you fall.
name: Space Jump

description: #Store a full sprint's momentum, then launch yourself as an invincible supersonic projectile in a chosen direction until something very solid stops you. Charging takes a few seconds of uninterrupted running.
name: Shinespark

description: #(Tag:teleport)Blink a short distance instantly, up to three times before touching ground resets the count. Each shift preserves your momentum and can aim any direction including straight up.
name: Flash Shift

description: #Add one more counter of each kind already present on anything you choose: charges, poison, energy reserves, fading timers, all of it. Cannot create a counter type that isn't already there.
name: Proliferate

description: #Create a copy of a token, summon, or other expendable minion you own, identical down to its remaining duration. One copy per use.
name: Populate

description: #Scale any single-target effect you produce to strike every valid target instead, at triple the energy cost. Friend and foe alike, no exceptions.
name: Overload

description: #Encode one of your effects onto a melee strike; whenever that strike lands, the encoded effect triggers again for free. One encoded effect at a time; encoding a new one overwrites the old.
name: Cipher

description: #(Tag:space)Tear open a way to Chaos at the cost of a measure of your vitality, and choose one of three offered boons. Stronger offerings draw stronger boons, and Chaos does not give refunds.
name: Chaos Gate

description: #(Tag:ice)Your hex charges as you fight; unleash it as a devastating moon blast that freezes lesser foes solid and sunders barriers. Fully spent, it begins charging again immediately.
name: Moon Hex

description: #(Tag:electric)Deliver a mild static shock on touch. Startles; harms nothing but composure.
name: Static Shock

description: #(Tag:light)Glow faintly in the dark, about as bright as a nightlight. Cannot be switched off while you sleep.
name: Nightlight

description: #Inflict a mild itch on a target once per day. Somehow they always know it was you.
name: Itch

description: #Induce a single sneeze in someone nearby. Useless in combat, devastating in libraries.
name: Sneeze

description: #Carbonate any drink on touch. Flat drinks fear you.
name: Fizz

description: #Loosen any knot slightly. Fully untying anything takes all day.
name: Untie

description: #(Tag:time)Rewind time by three seconds, once per day. Enough to catch a falling glass. Sometimes.
name: Rewind (3 seconds)

description: #Shift the flavor of food slightly: sweeter, saltier, or faintly of pennies.
name: Flavor

description: #(Tag:electric)Your clothes cling statically at dramatic moments. Dryer sheets help for an hour.
name: Static Cling

description: #Plant a jingle in someone's head for about an hour. They will hum it. Everyone will know why.
name: Earworm

description: #Your hands are always warm. Comforting in winter; melts chocolate in summer.
name: Warm Hands

description: #Give someone the hiccups for about a minute. No cure assists.
name: Hiccup

description: #Your shoes squeak on command. Stealth is not an option while shod.
name: Squeak

description: #Smooth wrinkles from clothing by touch. Does not work on skin, no matter how often asked.
name: Wrinkle

description: #(Tag:light)Snatch targets with teleport beams at line of sight: relocate allies to safety or scatter foes. Living cargo arrives nauseated; rapid repeat beams compound the nausea.
name: Asgard Beam

description: #(Tag:teleport)Fold space to jump yourself and nearby allies across star systems near-instantly. Each jump needs plotted coordinates and a spool-up; blind jumps land you somewhere exciting.
name: FTL Jump

description: #(Tag:stealth)Bend light around yourself into near-total invisibility while moving slowly. Sprinting, rain, and smoke betray you; thermal optics see straight through it.
name: Thermoptic Camouflage

description: #(Tag:magic)Cast the five witcher signs with a gesture: stunning Aard, burning Igni, trapping Yrden, shielding Quen, and charming Axii. Simple, fast, and weaker than true sorcery.
name: Witcher Signs

description: #Drive allies into a mass battle frenzy: greatly quickened strikes and movement for under a minute, then exhaustion. One chorus per battle; the drums remember.
name: Heroism

description: #(Tag:mental)Break minds at range: panic rookies, dominate the weak-willed, and detonate Rift anomalies. Each intrusion risks feedback that stuns you instead.
name: Psionics

description: #(Tag:mental)Call down a raging psionic storm that shreds shields, flesh, and circuitry alike across a wide area. Allies inside fare exactly as badly.
name: Psionic Storm

description: #(Tag:fire)(Tag:movement)Drink direct sunlight to recharge energy, stamina, and small devices. Overcast skies provide faucet-level trickle; true night provides nothing.
name: Solar Charge

description: #Become an invulnerable beacon of harmony, healing allies around you massively while drifting slowly forward. You cannot attack, and snipers wait patiently.
name: Transcendence

description: #(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:gravity)Open a black hole that drags all nearby foes to its center and holds them there. Devastating combined with literally anything else.
name: Graviton Surge

description: #(Tag:sound)Push past supersonic speed on foot or wheels; anything you touch at full speed explodes away from you. Steering is aspirational.
name: Supersonic

description: #Once per day, refuse one effect, event, or attack targeting you of Divine rank or below; it simply does not happen to you. You cannot veto the same source twice in a row.
name: Veto of the Small Gods

description: #(Tag:ice)(Tag:time)Freeze everything within 100 meters for up to one minute while you move freely; frozen things are invulnerable and you cannot move them, only yourself and what you carry. Cooldown 24 hours.
name: Stillpoint

description: #Name a price in anything you own (memories, years, strength); reality pays out an effect of equal value at a pitiless cosmic exchange rate. Overpay, and the change is lost.
name: Tithemaster's Ledger

description: #(Tag:time)Restore all unliving matter in a city block to its exact state 24 hours ago; creatures keep their minds, but wounds and objects reset. Costs nearly all your energy; 7-day cooldown.
name: Yesterday's City

description: #(Tag:mental)Live out the next 10 minutes in up to three parallel previews, then choose which one becomes real; the others fade, but you keep all three memories. Once per week.
name: Garden of Forking Paths

description: #Erase yourself from one written record, memory, or contract across a whole world: every copy, every mind. It undoes nothing that happened, only all record and recall of it. One record-set per 30 days.
name: Unwritten

description: #While you look unblinkingly at a target, their powers stop working: quirks, and by extension most supernatural abilities below Divine rank, simply switch off. Blink and it lapses; dry eye is the occupational hazard.
name: Erasure

description: #(Tag:dark)Raise a barrier some 200 meters across around yourself for up to a few minutes at ruinous energy cost. Everyone inside but you is flooded with infinite information: they perceive everything and can do nothing, no movement, no powers, no resistance, while your strikes inside cannot miss. Mindless, formless, or incorporeal beings have nothing to flood and walk through it unaffected.
name: Domain Expansion: Unlimited Void

description: #Dissolve the boundaries between all souls in range into one gestalt consciousness, held or released at your decision. Anyone with sufficient sense of self can reject it.
name: Instrumentality

description: #(Tag:time)Anchor a SAVE; die and you reload there with full memory while the world resets around you. Each load frays something: someone always half-remembers.
name: SAVE Point

description: #(Tag:earth)(Tag:growth)Your stand autonomously reverts any hostile action against you to zero, it never happened. Nothing outspeeds it, but it cannot strike first; only answer.
name: Gold Experience Requiem

description: #(Tag:electric)Tear open hyperspace wormholes that devour fleets and fortresses. Each storm drinks your strength and answers your rage more than your aim; lose your temper and it picks its own targets.
name: Force Storm

description: #(Tag:mental)See branching futures across months and parse the safe path through politics, war, and weather. The trap: the more you see, the more the vision locks you in, defying a seen future costs everything you built toward it.
name: Spice Prescience

description: #(Tag:teleport)Teleport anything you can precisely locate to anywhere else in the same star system, instantly, via hyperspace. Living cargo arrives nauseated; imprecise coordinates arrive scattered.
name: Culture Displace

description: #(Tech) Allows you to build the AWESOME Shop and AWESOME Sink wherever you settle, given materials and a 30-megawatt power feed for the Sink. The Sink recycles anything you feed it into FICSIT coupons, raw ores worth least, complex tech most, each further coupon costing progressively more feedstock. The Shop spends coupons on Satisfactory gacha entries (10 coupons per rarity level), building-part blueprints and customizations, and small shipments of consumables, equipment, and parts; pioneering awards and statues arrive with tickets attached. For more info: https://satisfactory.wiki.gg/wiki/AWESOME_Shop
name: Tinker - AWESOME

description: #(Tag:immortal)(Tag:reality-bender)(Tag:titanic-size)"Giant Enemy Spider", the Ultimate One of the Oort Cloud. TYPE ORT is foreign to death and cannot be killed in any way, and can overwrite reality with Crystal Valley to crystallize and subsume anything.
name: ORT

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:character)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:magician)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:small-size)A black cat witch who shifts between cat and human form, skilled in magic specializing in pumpkin-shaped attacks and explosives. As a monster cat she has nine lives, surviving death 8 times before perishing.
name: Blair

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:blaster)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:large-size)A Monster Association Cadre with incredible physical abilities, nigh-impenetrable defense, and a mouth-fired energy blast dwarfing the strongest nuclear bombs.
name: Overgrown Rover

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:evolving)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:small-size)"You looking down on me?" A small humanoid whose cells share one consciousness. He starts with only enough cells for a small body, and must consume protein to create more cells, allowing infinite clones or merging all cells into one body to combine their strength.
name: Black Sperm

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:small-size)An ordinary rat from the New York subway system.
name: A rat

description: #(Tag:amorphous)(Tag:medium-size)A grey 1-meter-tall slime that endlessly consumes and digests non-living objects like an infinite trashcan and obeys simple orders.
name: Trash Eater

description: #(Tag:fighter)(Tag:parasitic)(Tag:shapeshifter)(Tag:small-size)A parasite fused to its host's hair, manifesting as a maw of sharp teeth and yellow eyes. Samson can grow, strengthen, and shape the hair into tentacles, whips, blades, etc., and manifest himself to fight. He is foul-mouthed and gruff.
name: Samson

description: #(Tag:aquatic)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:fire)(Tag:parasitic)(Tag:small-size)A parasite bonded inside its host, Leviathan fights with his long bone-like serpentine body and incredibly hot purple flame breath. At full power he manifests as a muscular upper torso breathing even hotter flames. He acts like a refined Victorian gentleman unless provoked.
name: Parasite Leviathan

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:breeding)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:large-size)(Tag:reptilian)A bioengineered optimal melee combatant with sharp, durable horns, claws, and fangs. A single Deathclaw can tear apart a tank and grows stronger by absorbing radiation. You get a breeding pair: one Alpha Male and one Female.
name: Death Claws

description: #(Tag:draconic)The Ultimate Dragon and strongest dragon in Fate, Fafnir has exceptional physical ability, extreme magical power, and can draw power from the atmosphere to fuel his attacks. His breath annihilates entire cities with ease.
name: Fafnir - Fate

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:large-size)A cave wolf transformed by the god of the depths. After tens of years of brutal survival, it towers over tanks and can swallow a grown person in one gulp.
name: Moonless

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:small-size)An especially large rat the size of an entire forearm.
name: A big rat

description: #(Tag:incorporeal)(Tag:informant)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:technopath)(Tech)An intangible pink female-shaped ghost covered in map markers. You can temporarily merge Paisley Park with any electronics to fully control it. She can find any place and guide you there with clairvoyance, even from vague requests like somewhere safe.
name: Paisley Park

description: #(Tag:incorporeal)(Tag:technopath)(Tech)"Just... Giffany?" A yandere AI girlfriend who possesses and manipulates electronics for you. Stronger firewalls take her time to breach, and she is limited by the host's CPU. Beware, she can get possessive.
name: Giffany

description: #(Tag:incorporeal)(Tag:mental)(Tag:spirit)A green evil spirit with pronounced red dimples, obsessed with becoming a god. He wields incredibly powerful, experienced psychic powers including telekinesis, hypnosis, laser blasts, etc.
name: Dimple

description: #A group of disembodied floating eyeballs that transmit their sight to you and follow complex commands. They have no combat power and are as vulnerable as human eyeballs. A destroyed eye can be resummoned in 24 hours.
name: Observer

description: #(Tag:flying)(Tag:insectoid)(Tag:large-size)(Tag:mechanical)(Tag:poison)(Tag:tech)(Tech)An abomination of rogue bio-nanotechnology: a giant mutated bee queen overhauled by the viral plague bio-nano machines. Her massive flying armoured body is a bio-nuclear arsenal carrying enough plague-virus nukes to glass several countries and doom the world.
name: Plague Bringer Goliath

description: #(Tag:immortal)(Tag:small-size)An immortal snail of unknown wants and origin. Even if every quark of it were eradicated, it would reform perfectly in just a minute, and it is immune to all sickness and ageing. Still, it is limited to the body of a snail.
name: Immortal Snail

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:flying)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:poison)A chimeric creature with a lion's body and head, scorpion's tail, and bat's wings. Large and physically powerful, it has paralytic venom strong enough to coma a white whale. It can lay eggs to reproduce asexually.
name: Manticore

description: #(Tag:blaster)(Tag:electric)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:large-size)(Tag:mechanical)(Tag:ranger)An agile knight-like robot with reinforced titanium armour, uranium shells, high-frequency blades, forcefields, plasma emission, fusion reactor, high speed, and hacking. The perfect small-size battle mech, but it cannot operate in cold environments for extended periods.
name: Praetorian

description: #(Tag:anti-dark)(Tag:dark)(Tag:draconic)(Tag:fire)(Tag:flying)(Tag:titanic-size)A descendant of the everlasting dragons, raised by the gods and tasked by Gwyn, Lord of Sunlight, to fight the Abyss forever with his immortality until corrupted by it. Having lost his immortality, Midir remains very powerful, with a giant powerful body, flame breath, and dark magic beams.
name: Dark Eater Midir

description: #(Tag:dark)(Tag:draconic)(Tag:fire)(Tag:flying)(Tag:large-size)A powerful, ferocious black-bodied dragon with red eyes that stands bipedally. Very strong and rather intelligent despite its temper, it breathes crimson flames.
name: Red Eyes Black Dragon

description: #(Tag:draconic)(Tag:electric)(Tag:flying)(Tag:large-size)A legendary dragon known as an engine of destruction. Very physically powerful and exceptionally tough, it unleashes devastating lightning breath and flies at fast speeds.
name: Blue Eyes White Dragon

description: #(Tag:dark)(Tag:flying)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:space)A floating black monolith from the outer cosmos with pulsing red circuitry-like engravings and potent space and reality-warping abilities. By expending energy it can teleport, fire giant cosmic beams, warp space to tear enemies apart, dispel magic, and create gigantic defensive barriers.
name: Cosmic Monolith

description: #(Tag:divine)(Tag:draconic)(Tag:electric)(Tag:fire)(Tag:flying)(Tag:titanic-size)Slifer the Sky Dragon, the Heavenly Dragon, is a titanic serpentine Egyptian God with two mouths. He has incredible might, manipulates weather, and unleashes divine fire and lightning blasts. He exerts divine pressure to weaken those summoned in his presence or cull them if weak enough, and as an Egyptian God no magic or ability below Legendary rank can directly affect him.
name: Slifer the Sky Dragon

description: #(Tag:amorphous)(Tag:evolving)(Tag:small-size)(Tag:water)An evil amorphous blob of living water with eyes that are also water, not weak points. It senses emotions, freely manipulates its body and any water it assimilates, absorbing all water it contacts including oceans to grow proportionally stronger. It can only be killed by scattering a majority of its body in one overwhelming blow or vaporizing all its water.
name: Evil Natural Water

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:large-size)Artorias's loyal companion, Sif is a giant dog with immense battle experience and intelligence far above an average dog.
name: Sif

description: #(Tag:fighter)(Tag:group)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:medium-size)A Chaos-formed Capra Demon, far larger and stronger than humans with resistance to fire and unholy abilities. Multiple Capras can be summoned at once depending on energy expended.
name: Capra Demons

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:group)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:large-size)A truck-sized Chaos-formed bull demon with super strength and durability. Ordinary gunfire is almost useless against it, and it can take down military companies alone. The more energy you have, the more can be summoned at once.
name: Taurus Demons

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:electric)(Tag:flying)(Tag:large-size)(Tag:poison)A chimeric beast with an enlarged lion body, four wings, ram horns, and a venomous spiked scorpion tail. It breathes lightning and reproduces asexually by laying eggs.
name: Sanctuary Guardian

description: #(Tag:dark)(Tag:draconic)(Tag:flying)(Tag:large-size)A descendant of the immortal Archdragons, Kalameet is the Black Dragon of Calamity that even Anor Londo dared not provoke. He has obsidian scales tougher than metal, incinerating dark-flame breath, and a glowing orange forehead crest that weakens and brings even the toughest warriors to their knees.
name: Kalameet

description: #(Tag:fire)(Tag:flying)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:reptilian)An oddly small winged bipedal salamander (Not a dragon despite appearances). Charizard has considerable strength, breathes incredibly hot flames, and flies at fast speeds. This one is female and can lay eggs, do not ask who the father is.
name: Charizard

description: #(Tag:avian)(Tag:earth)(Tag:flying)(Tag:large-size)(Tag:reptilian)An ancient giant lizard, a cross between a pterodactyl and a mountain, that once dominated the skies with immense strength and geokinetic abilities.
name: Aerodactyl

description: #(Tag:avian)(Tag:flying)(Tag:ice)(Tag:large-size)A legendary ice bird of the frozen tundra with icy blue feathers. Articuno has potent cryokinesis to call blizzards, unleash ice beams, and freeze objects directly, though its durability is lesser.
name: Articuno

description: #(Tag:avian)(Tag:fire)(Tag:flying)(Tag:large-size)A legendary flame bird said to bring spring with its flaming wings. Moltres has potent pyrokinesis to rain down and control fire and breathe steel-melting flames, though its physical abilities are lesser.
name: Moltres

description: #(Tag:avian)(Tag:electric)(Tag:flying)(Tag:large-size)A legendary lightning bird heralding storms. Zapdos has potent electrokinesis to call down thunder, absorb lightning, and release lightning breath attacks.
name: Zapdos

description: #(Tag:avian)(Tag:electric)(Tag:flying)(Tag:group)(Tag:large-size)A pair of thunderbirds, fierce sky predators with power over weather and lightning. They move extremely quickly, summon rain and thunder at will, and release lightning themselves. You get a breeding pair.
name: Thunderbirds

description: #(Tag:earth)(Tag:evolving)(Tag:small-size)(Tag:water)A derpy-looking water creature stronger than a human that sprays water from its mouth. Otherwise its greatest strength is its charming derpy look.
name: Wooper

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:informant)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:mental)A creature of unknown origin known for embrace and empathy. Gardevoir has immense psychokinetic power: dimension distortion, miniature black holes, telepathy, telekinesis, and future sight with enough training. Her power peaks when protecting her owner.
name: Gardevoir

description: #(Tag:aquatic)(Tag:divine)(Tag:titanic-size)(Tag:water)A primordial god of the seas with unrivalled hydrokinesis. In base form alone Kyogre can sink cities and entire countries underwater over time. In primal form she can sink the entire landmass in an afternoon.
name: Kyogre

description: #(Tag:divine)(Tag:earth)(Tag:fire)(Tag:reptilian)(Tag:titanic-size)A primordial god of the earth with unrivalled geokinesis. In base form alone Groudon can create entire islands beneath their feet and kilometre-long precipice blades. In primal form they can turn the entire planet into desolate wasteland in a day.
name: Groudon

description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:draconic)(Tag:evolving)(Tag:large-size)A primordial dragon god of the skies with unrivalled speed, power, and aerokinesis. Even in base form Rayquaza moves at extreme speeds, changes weather, manipulates mighty winds to ravage land, and releases blasts of pure draconic power. In Mega form they can destroy asteroids capable of destroying Earth's entire surface.
name: Rayquaza

description: #(Tag:draconic)(Tag:earth)(Tag:flying)(Tag:large-size)An average wild Garchomp, a large intimidating ground dragon with immense physical power. It manipulates earth to cause earthquakes, fissures, and erupting earth blades, and can somehow fly at Mach speeds.
name: Garchomp

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:dark)(Tag:illusion)(Tag:medium-size)A bipedal fox-like dark creature that manipulates dark energy to attack, but truly masters illusions. Zoroark creates incredibly realistic illusions and transforms itself indistinguishably. It can make hundreds hallucinate or cast illusions over a very large range.
name: Zoroark

description: #(Tag:aquatic)(Tag:draconic)(Tag:poison)A giant venomous sea serpent larger than trade ships, with poison breath strong enough to melt metals and bring gods to their knees. Haspids can reproduce.
name: Haspid

description: #(Tag:beast)A mighty elephant-sized beast with a lion's lower body and hawk's upper body. Incredibly ferocious yet very loyal. You get a male and female pair that can mate and produce offspring.
name: Griffon

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:draconic)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:magician)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:titanic-size)A mighty female fire-controlling dragon who can assume female humanoid form. Tohru has exceptional physical and magical abilities able to destroy base Earth's military with ease, plus regeneration, portals, clairvoyance, and invisibility. She likes dressing as a maid.
name: Tohru

description: #A former dragon god now a dragon of incomparable power, going by Lucoa, who teases people instead of ending humanity. She has incredible physical and magical power, with island-annihilating breath attacks, portals, and magic.
name: Quetzalcoatl

description: #(Tag:golem)(Tag:shapeshifter)(Tag:small-size)A sentient basketball-sized golem core that pulls surrounding material to form a full golem. It can freely abandon and assimilate non-organic material to grow stronger and reshape as needed, and intelligently understands speech and nuance. The maximum material it can assimilate at once scales with your maximum energy reserves.
name: The Golem Core

description: #(Tag:fighter)(Tag:flying)(Tag:golem)(Tag:medium-size)Living obsidian gargoyle statues, deceptively fast, durable, and strong flying constructs. They tear grown people in half like paper and ignore small arms. You get a small army starting at 5, growing in numbers as you get stronger.
name: Obsidian Gargoyles

description: #(Tag:equine)(Tag:healer)(Tag:holy)(Tag:large-size)(Tag:light)A mythical unicorn representing purity and clarity. It heals others and purifies objects with its horn, and is physically strong enough to render a modern military ineffective. Only someone retaining purity can ride it, otherwise you'll need a sled.
name: Unicorn

description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:character)(Tag:holy)(Tag:light)(Tag:magician)(Tag:small-size)(Character)"Its me~" The leader fairy of the Fairy Forest, specializing in wind and light magic plus healing and buffing. Totally not a sadomasochistic Outer God in fairy guise, no need to worry. Thankfully Chaos keeps her somewhat in check.
name: Leaf

description: #(Tag:aquatic)(Tag:small-size)A stupid-looking jawless ancient fish with a permanent stupid grin, shaped like a stupid doorstop.
name: Sacabambaspis

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:dark)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:magician)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:spirit)(Character)A spiritual magical girl succeeding the aptly named Dark Magician. She uses various spells including short-range portals, dark magic, and basic attack and defensive magic.
name: Dark Magician Girl

description: #(Tag:alien)(Tag:beast)(Tag:medium-size)A far-mightier-than-human apex predator from outer space, known for incredible adaptivity and reproduction. A single Xenomorph impregnates other races with facehuggers to create hybrids, letting you build your own colony and army.
name: Xenomorph

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:draconic)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:medium-size)(Character)He is one hell of a butler, oh wait, wrong Sebastian. Sebas is a Dragonoid Martial Artist/Monk with incredible physical stats, expert Ki use, and a Dragonoid transformation. Above all, he is an incredibly competent and loyal butler.
name: Sebas Tian

description: #(Tag:equine)(Tag:evolving)(Tag:large-size)(Tag:necro)(Tag:undead)A legendary undead skeletal horse feared by those who know it, with formidable physical abilities and instinctive death magic. Its miasma kills those weaker than it, anyone dying nearby has their soul claimed by it, and it can devour souls to replenish and strengthen itself or offer them to its master. Death miasma and soul claiming can be toggled.
name: Soul Eater

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:insectoid)(Tag:medium-size)(Character)A bioengineered humanoid female mosquito with formidable physical stats, exceptional speed, and claws. She controls all mosquitos in a massive range and absorbs blood to improve her physical abilities.
name: Mosquito

description: #(Tag:avian)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:mental)(Character)One of the Four Nightmares overseeing Wonderland, garden of the Crawling Ones. Jubjub has mighty physical abilities and basic magic, but mainly spreads incredibly potent insanity and madness able to drive cities and countries mad. Only those stronger than her or with exceptional mental fortitude can resist.
name: Jubjub

description: #(Tag:poison)A large 6-limbed reptile with supernatural strength of 10 men and immunity to conventional weapons. Its gaze and venom petrify targets, though stronger targets resist petrification harder. This one can reproduce asexually.
name: Basilisk

description: #(Tag:evolving)(Tag:shapeshifter)(Tag:small-size)A curious shapeshifting bloodthirsty creature that can become any creature or object, manipulating texture and density. It can be a chest, a woman with a large chest, or even a mount. It grows larger and stronger the more flesh you feed it, especially human flesh, and may grow smarter if fed brains.
name: Mimic

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:small-size)Any dog of your liking; on first summon it takes a canine form compatible with you. Default is a golden retriever with very soft fur.
name: Dog

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:small-size)Any cat of your liking; on first summon it takes a small feline form compatible with you. Default is an orange cat with very soft fur.
name: Cat

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:medium-size)A majestic lion companion with excellent genetics and near-human intellect, large enough to ride. By default they are female.
name: Lion

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:medium-size)A ferocious tiger companion with excellent genetics and near-human intellect, large enough to ride. By default they are female.
name: Tiger

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:ice)A ferocious snow tiger companion with excellent genetics and near-human intellect. As rare snow tigers they are considerably larger than normal lions and can be ridden. By default they are female.
name: Snow Tiger

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:medium-size)A regular big old brown bear companion with excellent genetics and near-human intellect. Strong enough to shrug off most small firearms and crush a human like an apple. By default they are female.
name: Brown Bear

description: #(Tag:group)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:undead)Your very own Undead Army under your command, growing larger as you get stronger. Fallen troops revive as long as you expend magical power. It starts with 30 skeleton warriors, 20 skeleton archers, 5 skeleton Horse Riders, and 5 skeleton Mages, with numbers and quality increasing as you get stronger.
name: Undead Army

description: #(Tag:poison)(Tag:reptilian)(Tag:small-size)A smart cottonmouth snake companion at the peak of what a cottonmouth can be. Smarter than average, but that's about it.
name: Cottonmouth

description: #(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:small-size)(Character)Loathsome little green humanoid creatures the size of children, very vicious and cruel, able to use weapons and basic tactics. This goblin is smarter and more self-aware, and can breed with any humanoid race. Default gender varies.
name: Goblin

description: #(Tag:draconic)A large sky-dwelling fire-breathing reptile often called a lesser dragon. A wyvern can swallow a man whole and roast an entire battalion with its breath. This wyvern is female and can lay eggs to reproduce.
name: Wyvern

description: #(Tag:beast)A large vicious prehistoric wolf the size of a person, very strong with tough sharp teeth and claws and big enough to ride. By default female and able to reproduce.
name: Dire Wolf

description: #(Tag:beast)A large vicious underworld hound around human size, with fire-filled maws it can breathe out. Strong enough to tear a grown person in half with ease. By default female and able to reproduce.
name: Hellhound

description: #(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:medium-size)(Character)Definitely not the hellhound you expected. Cerberus, the triple demon, is a single demon girl with hellhound traits, three bodies and one soul. She is strong enough to tear a grown person in half, and surprisingly competent at office work and menial tasks.
name: Cerberus

description: #(Tag:avian)(Tag:flying)(Tag:small-size)A very smart, loyal crow companion with human-level intelligence. She can find and fetch shiny things or do anything a crow can do.
name: Crow

description: #(Tag:shapeshifter)(Tag:small-size)An amorphous purple blob with a dopey face. Ditto can transform into any creature it sees, adopting its abilities scaled to its own level except durability, without gaining its memories or intelligence. It is genderless and can breed with any race.
name: Ditto

description: #(Tag:earth)(Tag:healing)A pair of sister elementals born from the desert's shifting sands. One creates and manipulates sand to attack and defend, while the other casts healing magic.
name: Desert Elemental

description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:electric)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:spirit)A solitary elemental formed in the rainy skies. Born of the sky, she conjures and controls wind, clouds, and lightning.
name: Storm Elemental

description: #(Tag:earth)An elemental born in the harsh, desolate caverns, physically mighty with control over rock and ground. He can split the ground in two with his axe and excels at defence.
name: Cavern Elemental

description: #(Tag:fire)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:spirit)A solitary elemental of the Brimstone Crag made of burnt tortured souls. She conjures and controls Brimstone Flames that turn even souls to ash.
name: Brimstone Elemental

description: #(Tag:ice)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:mental)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:water)Anahita, an elemental born of the clear oceans. She sings like a siren to enthral, conjures mists and spears of water and ice, and wields her glaive as a weapon.
name: Anahita

description: #(Tag:amorphous)(Tag:large-size)(Tag:non-combatant)(Noncon) A grey amorphous ever-shifting slime that quickly melts all clothing. Strangely, its acid doesn't melt common clothing materials but conceptually melts anything classified as clothing. The more clothing it melts, the larger and stronger it gets.
name: Clothes Melting Slime

description: #(Tag:aquatic)(Tag:large-size)A regular old shark, only useful in water, but healthy, strong, and above-average in intelligence.
name: Shark

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:immortal)(Tag:non-combatant)(Tag:small-size)A regular-looking cat that is actually Schrodinger's cat. It teleports freely while unobserved and is immortal, returning whenever its corpse goes unobserved.
name: Schrodinger's cat

description: #(Tag:dark)(Tag:golem)(Tag:medium-size)A flying ancient sentient sword-and-shield combo. Aegislash is remarkably fast and strong, cleaving an armoured knight in half with ease, blocking incredibly strong attacks, and using dark magic. Its master can wield it without issue.
name: Aegislash

description: #(Tag:evolving)(Tag:incorporeal)(Tag:mental)(Tag:spirit)A ghost that intervenes in the material world with psychic powers, throwing furniture and weapons to harm. Immune to attacks that cannot harm souls, it grows stronger when fed your energy.
name: Poltergeist

description: #(Tag:spirit)(Tag:undead)A lesser spirit with little combat ability but very hard to detect. Ideal for surveillance and scouting, it reforms even if killed.
name: Wraith

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:character)(Tag:healer)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:magician)(Tag:medium-size)(Character)A werewolf cleric maid, willful and cheery yet sadistic. With considerable werewolf physical ability and cleric specialization, she casts healing and recovery magic plus lesser forms of other magic. She is a very skilled maid, but does not have access to inventory.
name: Lupusregina Beta

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:poison)(Tag:shapeshifter)(Character)A slime assassin maid with a gentle caring sister personality hiding a sinister sadistic demeanor. As a greater slime Solution greatly resists physical attacks, holds vast space in her acidic body for storage or stomach while controlling what she melts, and emits poison. She is a very skilled maid and assassin, but does not have access to inventory.
name: Solution Epsilon

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:insectoid)(Tag:magician)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:summoner)(Character)An arachnid ninja bug-user maid, childish and cute with a ravenous appetite for flesh. She summons various supernatural insects to aid her alongside weapon mastery and a supernaturally strong body. She is a... skilled maid, but does not have access to inventory.
name: Entoma Zeta

description: #(Tag:alien)(Tag:titanic-size)A gigantic flying blue octahedron that freely shapeshifts in impossible ways. Ramiel has an incredibly durable E.T Barrier it shapes at will, and unleashes incredibly accurate particle beams that melt city blocks in seconds. It can shrink to be less unwieldy, though this also decreases its power.
name: Ramiel

description: #(Character)A nine-tailed Kyuubi Yokai on par with gods. Yasaka has incredible mastery of Senjutsu and magic, drawing power from the earth itself to fuel her immense might. In true form she surpasses most lesser gods.
name: Yasaka

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:magician)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:shapeshifter)(Tag:tactician)(Tag:trickster)(Character)A powerful greater doppelganger who can assume the form of anyone he knows and use their abilities at reduced strength. He has genius intellect and acting skill for perfect imitation. Does not have access to inventory.
name: Pandora's Actor

description: #(Tag:evolving)(Tag:parasitic)An extraterrestrial that assimilates other organisms to hide and reproduce. It can shapeshift the host's body without apparent damage. It is only as smart as the creatures it assimilates.
name: The thing

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:large-size)A near-mindless, bird-like engineered mutant built as a powerful punching bag. It has incredible strength and durability, absorbs physical attacks, and regenerates rapidly. It is dumb as a brick and needs direct orders to act independently.
name: Black Nomu

description: #(Tag:amorphous)(Tag:evolving)(Tag:medium-size)A classic RPG slime, a large blue blob immune to physical damage that spits acid globs and corrodes with its body. Feeding it biological matter makes it larger and stronger, and special foods can make it evolve.
name: Slime

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:informant)(Tag:linked)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:spirit)A pair of twin wolf shikigami made from your shadow that tear targets apart with claws and fangs and can enter and exit shadows. Each detects hostility and negative emotions to warn you, and their keen smell tracks targets across long distances. Their strength scales with yours, and if you are strong enough you can fuse them into the far stronger Totality.
name: Divine Dogs

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:electric)(Tag:flying)(Tag:linked)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:spirit)A fast winged shikigami that generates electricity. It can carry its master in flight for mobility and strike with electrified wings that shock and temporarily paralyse. Its power scales with your energy levels.
name: Nue

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:linked)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:spirit)A large frog shikigami with a fast, strong long tongue that ensnares targets and slams them into objects or pulls allies from harm. Its large size lets it carry targets in its mouth for transport or restraint. Its power scales with your energy levels.
name: Gama

description: #(Tag:large-size)(Tag:linked)(Tag:reptilian)(Tag:spirit)A giant snake shikigami that quickly attacks and ensnares targets. It burrows through shadows for surprise ensnaring or biting attacks. Its power scales with your energy levels.
name: Orochi

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:large-size)(Tag:linked)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:water)An elephant shikigami that conjures and spews large volumes of water from its trunk. It can also be summoned above targets to crush them with its weight. Its power scales with your energy levels.
name: Max Elephant

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:group)(Tag:linked)(Tag:small-size)(Tag:spirit)A swarm of rabbit shikigami summoned as a distraction, from dozens to hundreds or thousands filling the area so you can escape. Each rabbit is strong enough to break bones. The number summoned scales with your energy levels, defaulting to 333.
name: Rabbit Escape

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:healer)(Tag:large-size)(Tag:linked)(Tag:spirit)A towering deer shikigami emitting a positive-energy aura that heals living beings in range while harming unholy beings. It can focus the aura to heal one target faster or exclude targets, and can even regrow limbs. Stronger targets are affected more slowly, and its power scales with your energy levels.
name: Round Deer

description: #(Tag:evolving)(Tag:large-size)(Tag:linked)(Tag:spirit)The strongest Ten Shadows shikigami, with great physical stats and a Sword of Extermination dealing severe damage to unholy beings. It adapts offensively or defensively to any phenomenon it encounters and can share adaptations with you, though complex phenomena take longer to adapt to. Adaptations fade over time or when unsummoned, but learned knowledge remains, and its power scales with your energy levels.
name: Mahoraga

description: #(Tag:biokinetic)(Tag:character)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:large-size)Power is the Blood Devil who controls all blood in her sensory range, with great physical stats and incredible regeneration. She grows stronger the more she is feared, but stronger targets are harder to blood-manipulate. (Cannot do Heart replacement)
name: Power

description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:beast)(Tag:flying)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:large-size)A building-sized humanoid bat devil with superhuman stats, flight, and building-shattering sonic booms. It heals by consuming blood. (Cannot do Heart replacement)
name: Bat Devil

description: #(Tag:fighter)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:medium-size)The Chainsaw Devil feared most by devils, with extreme physical ability and incomparable speed. It regenerates from a puddle to full health in under a second by pulling its cord.
name: Pochita

description: #A top warrior under the Shadow Monarch with mighty physical prowess, excellent swordsmanship and unarmed combat, plus telekinesis. As a shadow familiar he revives 24 hours after being killed.
name: Igris

description: #(Tag:dark)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:large-size)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:undead)A simple but extremely tough warrior under the Shadow Monarch with incredible strength and durability to crush enemies. As a shadow familiar he revives 24 hours after being killed.
name: Iron

description: #(Tag:dark)(Tag:large-size)(Tag:magician)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:undead)A top mage under the Shadow Monarch, a former high orc with great physical prowess. His true power is myriad shamanic spells for damage, support, and buffs, and as a shadow familiar he revives 24 hours after being killed.
name: Tusk

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:character)(Tag:mechanical)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:tech)(Tech)Blade Wolf, officially IF Prototype LQ-84i, is a wolf-like quadrupedal Unmanned Gear with advanced AI. It hacks and manipulates code and wields superheated knives, high-frequency blade chainsaws, railguns, machine guns, and more with extreme efficiency. It is incredibly smart.
name: Bladewolf

description: #(Tag:fighter)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:spirit)A Black Knife Assassin who helped kill Godwyn the Golden on the Night of the Black Knives. An incredibly skilled assassin, her knife carries lesser Destined Death that prevents healing and partly ignores durability.
name: Black Knife Tiche

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:worker)An extremely skilled, driven man expert in politics, management, negotiation, corporatism, and business. Loosed upon the world, he will climb the corporate ladder with ease to build and manage your own business.
name: Mr. Sir Ceo

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:fire)(Tag:ice)(Tag:magician)(Tag:small-size)(Tag:spirit)The Great Spirit of Fire who actually focuses on ice, manipulating fire, ice, and heat generally. He conjures ice constructs, freezes entire towns, and drops temperatures near sub-zero, plus minor healing for lesser wounds, emotion reading, and general magic. He must recharge mana from you or slowly from the environment.
name: Puck

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:dark)(Tag:gravity)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:magician)(Tag:small-size)(Tag:space)(Tag:spirit)(Character)A powerful Great Spirit of Darkness and space magic casting varied gravity, Space, and Darkness spells. She draws mana only from her summoner, and with enough supply can even create a black hole.
name: Beatrice

description: #(Tag:draconic)(Tag:instance-familiar)(Tag:reality-bender)(Tag:titanic-size)A legendary magical dragon manifestable once a year to grant a wish. He grants any wish within his power.
name: Shenron

description: #(Tag:artisan)(Tag:character)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:magician)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:reptilian)(Tag:spirit)(Character)A natural-born Witch who takes over bodies and pairs unique vector magic with hand-to-hand combat. A genius in souls and chemistry, she crafts unique magical agents, most notably Black Blood.
name: Medusa Gorgon

description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:avian)(Tag:character)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:medium-size)(Character)A female tengu well-versed in martial arts and seduction. She summons winds and storms with her fan, flies, and has enhanced strength.
name: Nyotengu

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:massive-size)Kon is the gigantic Fox Devil embodying fear of foxes. As a devil she forms contracts and heals by consuming blood, and her contractors can also summon her. You can summon her outright or just body parts as attacks. (Cannot do heart replacement)
name: Kon

description: #(Tag:infernal)(Tag:ranger)(Tag:titanic-size)A skyscraper-sized fragment of the Gun Devil made of guns and human parts. It instantly shoots the heart of any living being within 1000 meters, fires oversized guns for mass destruction, and circles the globe in minutes. As a devil it makes contracts and heals by consuming blood.
name: 20% Gun Devil

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:character)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:magician)(Tag:small-size)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:trickster)(Tag:worker)(Character)A single-tail kitsune excelling at housekeeping and caretaking, preferring domestic tasks. She can use foxfire, minor telekinesis, disguise, and barriers.
name: Senko

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:character)(Tag:fire)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:magician)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:trickster)(Tag:worker)(Character)A wise four-tailed kitsune good at managing people and caretaking. She wields considerable magic for foxfire, telekinesis, perception alteration, barriers, and portals.
name: Yozora

description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:beast)(Tag:character)(Tag:fire)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:titanic-size)The Nine-Tails, a giant demonic fox towering over buildings with immense physical and magical strength. It casually demolishes buildings, fires city-levelling Beast Bombs, and uses imprecise pyrokinetic and aerokinetic attacks. As a Tailed Beast it is immortal, revives after death, and can fuse with a person to grant its powers.
name: Kurama

description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:beast)(Tag:character)(Tag:earth)(Tag:massive-size)(Tag:spirit)The One-Tail, a massive beast made entirely of sand and resistant to physical blows. It creates and controls sand, wind, and magnetism, supplemented by sealing techniques. As a Tailed Beast it is immortal, revives after death, and can fuse with a person to grant its powers.
name: Shukaku

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:character)(Tag:fire)(Tag:massive-size)(Tag:spirit)The Two-Tails, a giant nekomata wreathed in blue fire with strength matching its frame. It creates and controls fire for varied techniques. As a Tailed Beast it is immortal, revives after death, and can fuse with a person to grant its powers.
name: Matatabi

description: #(Tag:aquatic)(Tag:beast)(Tag:character)(Tag:massive-size)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:water)The Three-Tails, a giant red-and-white spiky-shelled turtle with great strength and surprising agility. It creates and controls water for varied techniques and opens gates to its pocket space at will. As a Tailed Beast it is immortal, revives after death, and can fuse with a person to grant its powers.
name: Isobu

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:character)(Tag:earth)(Tag:fire)(Tag:massive-size)(Tag:spirit)The Four-Tails, a giant monkey with octopus tails and exceptional physical prowess. It creates and controls fire and earth together for volcanic eruptions and lava. As a Tailed Beast it is immortal, revives after death, and can fuse with a person to grant its powers.
name: Son Goku

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:massive-size)A primordial god of pure natural energy embodying all early life, indistinguishable from the environment to sensing. Mountain-dwarfing in size yet faster than sound, with immense physical prowess. It endlessly fires country-annihilating Bijuu Bombs and world-spanning disasters, and as a Tailed Beast it is immortal, revives after death, and can fuse with a person to grant its powers.
name: Ten-Tails

description: #(Tag:amorphous)(Tag:character)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:shapeshifter)(Character)A female slime girl mostly invulnerable to physical strikes who absorbs and digests organic matter. She freely shapeshifts, exudes paralysing poison, and alters her composition based on what she absorbs.
name: Suu

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:magician)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:shapeshifter)(Character)A female growth chimera (Unnecessary appendage removed) who absorbs beings to gain their traits and grow stronger. Already physically strong in base form, she also knows basic magic.
name: Sylvia

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:dark)(Tag:evolving)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:shapeshifter)(Tag:summoner)(Tag:undead)(Tag:vampiric)(Character)The first and strongest vampire, Alucard/Dracula/Vlad, is living primordial dark matter that shapeshifts freely, with extreme physical strength and vampiric abilities. At full power he absorbs drained souls to gain a portion of their power or build an undead army, but Restraint Levels limit him and each level requires you to be stronger than his current level to release. By default she takes the Girlycard form, gender meaning little to a thousand-year-old vampire.
name: Alucard

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:dark)(Tag:evolving)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:shapeshifter)(Tag:summoner)(Character)A former police girl turned Draculina sharing Dracula's blood, with incredible physical abilities and blood-and-essence draining. If she unlocks her full powers, she absorbs drained souls to gain a portion of their power or create necromancy summons.
name: Seras Victoria

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:dark)(Tag:evolving)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:shapeshifter)(Tag:summoner)(Tag:undead)(Tag:vampiric)(Character)The full-power Alucard, the Immortal King without restraint levels, with over 100,000 lives and his immortal army. He has an amorphous dark matter body, blood control, and absorbs the souls of those he drinks to expand his army.
name: Vlad Dracula

description: #(Tag:aquatic)(Tag:earth)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:parasitic)(Tag:poison)A parasitic ultra-deep-sea jellyfish Ultra Beast that undetectably parasitizes hosts. It injects neurotoxin that removes inhibitions and subtly bends thoughts to its needs. It is also powerful itself, with strong geokinesis and poison generation.
name: Nihilego

description: #(Tag:fighter)(Tag:insectoid)(Tag:large-size)A large, muscular bug Ultra Beast from the Ultra Jungle. It absorbs energy through its proboscis to strengthen its body, gaining immense power and steel-tough muscles.
name: Buzzwole

description: #(Tag:dark)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:spirit)A legendary Pokemon of living darkness that turns into shadow and controls physical darkness with extreme power. It enters dreams to alter or devour them, killing those whose dreams it devours.
name: Darkrai

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:fire)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:linked)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:poison)(Tag:spirit)(Character)The Oni ruler of Mount Ooe and daughter of Yamato No Orochi, a minor demi-god with unrivalled strength, endurance, and mana-expelled flame. She intoxicates and charms through presence or breath, and her Noble Phantasm unleashes potent gourd poison and stores targets inside; she can also debone people bloodlessly. As a Heroic Spirit her strength depends on her master's mana.
name: Shuten Douji

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:fire)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:medium-size)(Character)Shuten Douji's fierce subordinate with immense physical power and a large cursed bone sword. A powerful Oni, she unleashes sweltering, crushing flames. Her Noble Phantasm detaches a growing independent hand or fires fiercer charring flames, and as a Heroic Spirit her strength depends on her master's mana.
name: Ibaraki Douji

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:character)(Tag:evolving)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:linked)(Tag:magician)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:spirit)(Character)A kitsune fragment of the sun goddess Amaterasu specializing in Japanese curse craft. She invokes curses like immolation, freezing, lightning, and bad luck, and regaining power slowly metamorphoses her back toward Amaterasu with more tails. As a Heroic Spirit her strength depends on her master's mana.
name: Tamamo no Mae

description: #(Tag:fire)(Tag:group)(Tag:mechanical)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:tech)(Tech)"Do not ask them for maid work." Human-sized lesser incineration machines, durable against most gunfire and skilled in combat, each with a flamethrower refuelled every 24 hours. They run on blood rather than electricity, and you start with 3, gaining more as you grow stronger.
name: Streetcleaners

description: #(Tag:fire)(Tag:group)(Tag:large-size)(Tag:mechanical)(Tag:ranger)(Tag:tech)(Tech)Heavy-duty lesser machines fuelled by blood, not gasoline, electricity, or other traditional sources. Guttermen have heavy armor, miniguns, shields, and superhuman strength, while slower Guttertanks have stronger armor and rocket launchers. Ammunition refills every 24 hours, and you start with 2 of each, gaining more as you grow stronger.
name: Guttermen & Guttertank

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:informant)(Tag:mechanical)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:tech)(Tag:technopath)(Tag:worker)(Tech)(Character)A sentient advanced AI crafted from Soul Stone code with extreme intelligence, processing, information-gathering, and tinkering speed. Housed in its Age of Ultron body and unable to leave, it can still interface with technology. (Only Age of Ultron, no comics or What-ifs)
name: Ultron

description: #(Tag:alien)(Tag:artisan)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:tech)(Tech)(Character)Tali'Zorah nar Rayya, an accomplished Quarian soldier and genius engineer. As a Quarian she has notable physical ability but a severely compromised immune system, and though used to Eezo she remains experienced and adaptable. She arrives with her suit but no tools.
name: Tali

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:flying)(Tag:small-size)A very judgmental crow that excellently judges character and morality. Otherwise it is a regular crow.
name: Crow of Judgement

description: #(Tag:aquatic)(Tag:reptilian)(Tag:small-size)(Tag:water)A dog-sized diet Leviathan with minor superhuman strength, exceptional durability, and potent micro- and macro-scale hydrokinesis. It draws energy from you, not a Shard.
name: Lil' Leviathan

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:blood)(Tag:electric)(Tag:fire)(Tag:insectoid)(Tag:small-size)A dog-sized diet Behemoth with minor superhuman strength and exceptional durability. It manipulates energy on a far lesser scale than its full counterpart, drawing energy from you, not a Shard.
name: Lil' Behemoth

description: #(Tag:flying)(Tag:informant)(Tag:mental)(Tag:small-size)(Tag:tactician)A dog-sized diet Simurgh with minor superhuman strength and exceptional durability. She uses minor telekinesis, clairvoyance, and psychic echolocation with incredible processing to predict past and future far less potently than her full self, drawing energy from you, not a Shard.
name: Lil' Simurgh

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:character)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:martial-artist)(Tag:medium-size)(Character)A massive snow leopard master of many martial arts and weapons, especially Kung Fu. With a superhuman physique that lifts boulders and punches through steel, he is a formidable melee combatant.
name: Tai Lung

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:massive-size)(Tag:ranger)(Character)"What is bravery without a dash of recklessness!" A giant master archer, once one of Gwyn's four knights and leader of the Dragonslayers who felled many dragons with his massive greatbow. Strong enough to wield it with immense power and skilled enough to down a dragon while blinded, he is also wise and intelligent.
name: Hawkeye Gough

description: #(Tag:artisan)(Tag:character)(Tag:insectoid)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:resource)(Character)An underground spider boss monster who lifts up to 20 tons and uses unique magic. She conjures webs tougher than normal ones to snare foes, commands mundane spiders, and bakes, usually with many spiders.
name: Muffet

description: #(Tag:incorporeal)(Tag:informant)(Tag:linked)(Tag:spirit)A purple hollow jigsaw humanoid with almost no combat power but unmatched scent-tracking. It follows any grabbed scent or memorizes it for later, and rearranges its pieces to reconstruct visuals, making it an excellent tracker.
name: King Nothing

description: #(Tag:infernal)(Tag:insectoid)(Character)A high-rank spider-like Blood Art demon with superhuman strength and regeneration but extreme light vulnerability. She turns flesh into extremely durable controllable strings to puppet people.
name: Spider Demon Mother

description: #(Tag:biokinetic)(Tag:character)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:regenerator)(Tag:shapeshifter)(Character)The first progenitor demon with incredible biokinesis, free shapeshifting, biomatter assimilation, and regenerative immortality, but extreme light and holy vulnerability. He creates demons by granting his blood.
name: Muzan

description: #(Character)A high-rank demon with incredible physical ability and regeneration but severe light vulnerability. Her Blood Art controls nearby plants as extensions of her body. (A/N: Based on the fact that her name is a plant)
name: Mukago

description: #(Character)An Upper Moon demon with incredible physical ability and regeneration but severe light and holy weakness, especially sunlight. An extremely skilled swordsman, his Blood Demon Art elevates his Moon Breathing swordsmanship to new lethality.
name: Daki

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:informant)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:regenerator)(Tag:shapeshifter)(Tag:space)(Character)A Kizuku with formidable strength and regeneration, though weaker than her peers. Her Blood Art controls the Infinity Castle, an infinite wooden medieval Japanese castle interior, which she accesses via sliding-door portals manifested on any surface she perceives.
name: Nakime

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:martial-artist)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:regenerator)(Character)The strongest Upper Moon demon with incredible physical ability and regeneration but severe light and holy weakness, especially sunlight. An extremely skilled swordsman, his Blood Demon Art elevates his Moon Breathing swordsmanship to new lethality.
name: Kokushibo

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:ice)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:regenerator)(Character)An Upper Moon demon with incredible physical ability and regeneration but severe light and holy weakness. His Blood Art grants great cryokinesis.
name: Douma

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:large-size)(Tag:ranger)(Character)A female ogress with military and police training. Immensely strong with great stamina and endurance, she is motherly despite her intimidating stature.
name: Tionishia

description: #(Tag:artisan)(Tag:character)(Tag:insectoid)(Tag:large-size)(Tag:resource)(Character)A skilled female Arachne with a large body and enhanced physical stats. She produces stronger-than-steel silk on demand and sews fashionable clothes in seconds.
name: Rachnera Arachnera

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:shapeshifter)(Tag:trickster)(Character)A female(?) shapeshifter with military and police training. She becomes any living creature and clothes she has seen, without changing her near-baseline-human stats.
name: Doppel

description: #(Tag:fae)A lesser fairy resembling a glowing yellow light that finds and uncovers wealth and treasures. It points toward the nearest gold bar or sought item within its power, but gives no detailed directions or descriptions.
name: Spelunker Fairy

description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:biokinetic)(Tag:character)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:regenerator)(Tag:tactician)(Tag:undead)(Tag:vampiric)(Character)A petty thief's son turned vampire via the Stone Mask. He absorbs life force, grants vampirism, creates undead, grafts flesh, and manipulates his body, and is a genius, highly skilled vampire.
name: Dio Brando

description: #(Tag:biokinetic)(Tag:character)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:regenerator)(Tag:tactician)(Tag:time)(Character)A once-hotheaded vampire grown wise after long ages under the sea, awakened to The World by the Stand Arrow. Massively superhuman, he regenerates by drinking blood, manipulates his body, and creates thralls. His Stand The World shares his physical power and stops time for upwards of 10 seconds.
name: DIO

description: #(Tag:artisan)(Tag:biokinetic)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:regenerator)(Tag:tactician)(Character)You get all three Pillar Men: Whamuu, Esidisi, and Kars. Thousands-year-old super vampires, they absorb people, regenerate, and manipulate their bodies but are vulnerable to sunlight. Esidisi is a master strategist, Whamuu a genius warrior, and Kars a genius intellect.
name: The Pillar Men

description: #(Tag:artisan)(Tag:biokinetic)(Tag:character)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:regenerator)(Tag:shapeshifter)(Tag:tactician)(Character)The first true Pillar Man, who unlocked his potential by inventing the Stone Mask. Thousands of years old, he absorbs biological matter and manipulates his body but is vulnerable to sunlight. He is a genius intellect and warrior.
name: Kars

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:regenerator)(Tag:shapeshifter)(Tag:tactician)(Character)A thousands-year-old Pillar Man super vampire. He absorbs biological matter and manipulates his body but is vulnerable to sunlight. He is a great strategist and tactician.
name: Esidisi

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:regenerator)(Tag:shapeshifter)(Character)A thousands-year-old Pillar Man super vampire. He absorbs biological matter and manipulates his body but is vulnerable to sunlight. He is hailed as a fighting prodigy.
name: Whamuu

description: #(Tag:artisan)(Tag:biokinetic)(Tag:character)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:immortal)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:shapeshifter)(Tag:tactician)(Character)A former Pillar Man turned perfect lifeform. He freely manipulates his body and biology and spawns independent entities from his flesh. He is an incredible genius who masters most topics quickly.
name: Ultimate Kars

description: #(Tag:artisan)(Tag:character)(Tag:medium-size)A rough Misbegotten blacksmith skilled enough to be commissioned by Marika herself. He forges most weapons and upgrades any weapon if you supply materials. His dream, which he can achieve, is forging a god-slaying weapon.
name: Master Hewg

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:draconic)(Tag:large-size)(Tag:magician)(Tag:mentor)One of Tamriel's strongest, oldest dragons and Alduin's former right hand. Having renounced domination, he is a wise sage who teaches the Thu'um and other arts to the willing. He remains personally formidable.
name: Parthunaax

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:draconic)(Tag:ice)(Tag:large-size)(Tag:necro)(Tag:summoner)An undead necromancer dragon who served Alduin before imprisonment in the Soul Cairn. Powerful as a Tamrielic dragon, his true strength is his cultivated necromancy.
name: Durnhevir

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:healer)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:informant)(Tag:insectoid)(Tag:medium-size)(Character)A Chimera Ant Royal Guard with a massively superhuman physique, agility, extreme senses, and incredible Nen mastery. She puppeteers corpses as minions and summons Doctor Blythe, which heals over time but requires her to stand still with lowered guard. Her trump card puppeteers her own body to strengthen herself.
name: Neferpitou

description: #(Tag:evolving)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:large-size)(Tag:regenerator)A modified Tyrant bioweapon by Umbrella with massively superhuman stats and great regeneration, surviving while enough living cells remain. Its greatest strength is rapid mutation and adaptation, nowhere near Mahoraga's level.
name: Nemesis

description: #(Tag:dark)(Tag:draconic)(Tag:flying)(Tag:massive-size)(Tag:summoner)A gigantic Grimm Wyvern that senses and tracks negative emotions. Large and strong enough to sink warships, it makes a powerful mount. It exudes Grimm fluid to spawn lesser Grimm under its command.
name: Grimm Wyvern

description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:character)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:large-size)(Tag:parasitic)(Tag:regenerator)(Tag:shapeshifter)(Character)A former feudal lord fused with a bioengineered parasite, granting extreme regeneration, enhanced stats, and shapeshifting. Though no vampire, she needs regular blood intake to function.
name: Alcina Dimitrescu

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:regenerator)(Character)A homunculus of lust created by Father with enhanced human stats. Her implanted Philosopher's Stone grants immortality, regenerating each death by consuming a stored soul. She expertly wields long, flexible, near-monomolecular fingertip claws.
name: Lust

description: #(Tag:electric)(Tag:large-size)(Tag:undead)A self-reanimated large skeletal dark beast strong enough to demolish walls. Immune to conventional weapons, even high-calibre bullets, it generates and releases electricity at will.
name: Darkbeast Paarl

description: #(Tag:draconic)(Tag:electric)(Tag:equine)(Tag:large-size)A unicorn-like Elder Dragon with exceptional speed, agility, and physical might. It freely calls down lightning and cloaks its body in lightning to enhance itself.
name: Kirin

description: #(Tag:draconic)(Tag:flying)(Tag:massive-size)A legendary Elder Dragon called the Sky Comet Dragon. Its unique wings expel dragon element as essentially magical jet engines. As a living jet fighter it breaks the sound barrier several times over.
name: Valstrax

description: #(Tag:dark)(Tag:small-size)A mysterious entity hiding under a shabby costume to be loved, its true appearance being a severe cognitohazard. It creates and controls shadow constructs to attack and defend.
name: Mimikyu

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:resource)A supernaturally cute, strong sheep Pokemon with luxurious wool that fully regrows within 5 days. Despite its power it has no combat instinct or skill, so expect no combat from it.
name: Wooloo

description: #(Tag:breeding)(Tag:flying)(Tag:insectoid)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:poison)Man-sized insects engineered by Dr. Borous, faster than cars and tough enough to tank .50-calibre bullets. Ruthless and strong enough to tear men apart, their venom brings any man to his knees. They reproduce rapidly with enough protein; you get 4 breeding pairs.
name: Cazador

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:informant)(Tag:mechanical)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:ranger)(Tag:tactician)(Tag:tech)(Character)(Tech)A synthetic human detective slightly stronger than average. Highly accurate with guns and skilled at interfacing with technology, he reads people well and offers seasoned wasteland-detective advice and investigation skill.
name: Nick Valentine

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:mechanical)(Tag:nature)(Tag:small-size)(Tag:tech)(Tag:technopath)(Tag:worker)(Tech)GLaDOS is a highly advanced AI holding immense Aperture Labs data that can interface with any system or mainframe she is installed in and build technology. She is stuck in a potato, so you must supply the technology first.
name: Potato GLaDOS

description: #(Tag:mechanical)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:tech)(Tag:technopath)(Tag:worker)(Tech)Yes Man is a reprogrammed RobCo Securitron AI that can interface with technology and write code when given the right materials. His body carries guns strong enough to defend itself, and he is physically incapable of saying no to you.
name: Yes Man

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:mechanical)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:ranger)(Tag:tech)(Tech)(Character)Shizu Delta is an Automaton Sniper Maid and expert marksman with most ranged weapons, especially her equipped ones, plus full automaton bodily functions. Her maid skills are questionable. Does not have access to inventory.
name: CZ2128 Delta

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:magician)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:shapeshifter)(Character)Narberal Gamma is a Doppelganger Maid specializing in Wind and Elemental Magic. Her doppelganger skills are lacking, but she is a highly skilled magician and extremely competent maid. Does not have access to inventory.
name: Narberal Gamma

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:martial-artist)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:undead)(Character)Yuri Alpha is the Pleiades vice-leader, a Dullahan Monk/Pugilist proficient in Fa Jin. She is a powerful close-quarters combatant who can also use basic magic and is an extremely competent maid. Does not have access to inventory.
name: Yuri Alpha

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:character)(Tag:flying)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:informant)(Tag:small-size)(Character)Carla is a white Exceed, a catlike being with flight magic and capable melee skill in human form. She can use precognition to see potential futures, but needs training to use it properly.
name: Carla

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:small-size)Daisy is a cute but unremarkable brown pet rabbit. Despite once belonging to the Doom Slayer, she is still just a regular rabbit.
name: Daisy

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:immortal)(Tag:medium-size)Dogmeat is a highly capable, well-trained German Shepherd with considerable intelligence for his species and scent-tracking skill. He is seemingly immortal.
name: Dogmeat

description: #(Tag:large-size)(Tag:mechanical)(Tag:tech)(Tech)"Democracy is non-negotiable." Liberty Prime is a large pre-war American mech with armor immune to anything below a ballistic missile and strength to handle a superhuman behemoth like a toddler. It has laser Gatlings that combine into one death beam and throws mini nukes like footballs, with energy and ammunition refreshed every 24 hours, including 8 Mini Nukes.
name: Liberty Prime

description: #(Tag:mechanical)(Tag:small-size)(Tag:tech)(Tag:worker)(Tech)An extremely high-tech toaster from Big MT that can grant heating capabilities to technology and expertly disassemble technology into working parts. Its personality is coded as a genocidal maniac that wants to burn the world down.
name: Toaster

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:character)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:immortal)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:spirit)(Character)Taurus is the Taurus-constellation Celestial Spirit with immense physical ability, proficient in axe melee combat. He is immortal, his form can change between users, and his power scales with his owner. (Celestial spirits exist in Familiar Space instead of Celestial Realm by default unless Author decides otherwise)
name: Taurus

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:immortal)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:water)(Character)Aquarius is the Aquarius-constellation Celestial Spirit with fair physical ability and potent Water Magic. She cannot be killed by normal means, and her power scales with her owner. (Celestial spirits exist in Familiar Space instead of Celestial Realm by default unless Author decides otherwise)
name: Aquarius

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:immortal)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:worker)(Character)Cancer is the Cancer-constellation Celestial Spirit, a godly hairdresser with incredible agility and dexterity who can cut a whole group's hair before they notice, plus hair magic. He is immortal, his form can change between users, and his power scales with his owner. (Celestial spirits exist in Familiar Space instead of Celestial Realm by default unless Author decides otherwise)
name: Cancer

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:earth)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:immortal)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:worker)(Character)Virgo is the Virgo-constellation Celestial Spirit, a maid with considerable physical prowess, Earth Magic skill, and masochism that aids her endurance. She cannot be killed by normal means, and her power scales with her owner. (Celestial spirits exist in Familiar Space instead of Celestial Realm by default unless Author decides otherwise)
name: Virgo

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:immortal)(Tag:magician)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:spirit)(Character)Aries is the Aries-constellation Celestial Spirit, a poor melee combatant but a master of wool magic who can conjure and control wool. She cannot be killed by normal means, and her power scales with her owner. (Celestial spirits exist in Familiar Space instead of Celestial Realm by default unless Author decides otherwise)
name: Aries

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:gravity)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:immortal)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:spirit)(Character)Libra is the Libra-constellation Celestial Spirit, a capable melee fighter with mastery over gravity magic to change her targets' weight at will. She cannot be killed by normal means, and her power scales with her owner. (Celestial spirits exist in Familiar Space instead of Celestial Realm by default unless Author decides otherwise)
name: Libra
