description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:plant)(Tag:small-size)Stray Cat is a cat-plant creature whose soul fused with a plant. It uses Aerokinesis to fire invisible air bullets stronger than regular bullets or form dense bubble shields, but grows very sleepy when covered in darkness.
name: Stray Cat

description: #(Tag:amorphous)(Tag:small-size)(Tag:tech)(Tech)Ship is an adolescent Galvanic Mechamorph with all of their abilities to a lesser extent. His amorphous body can merge with any technology to possess, reconfigure, and improve it.
name: Ship

description: #(Tag:dark)(Tag:flying)(Tag:incorporeal)(Tag:mental)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:undead)Zs Skayr is a High Ecto Lord ruling the Ectonurites. As a High Ectonurite he is an extremely powerful ghost with formidable strength, flight, phasing, possession, telekinesis, and dark-energy projectiles.
name: Zs Skayr

description: #A large bestial orange alien canine with quill-like fur, stronger than most men and able to shred steel like cardboard with extreme athleticism. Though blind, its smell and hearing far surpass mundane beings, tracking scents across cities and granting 360-degree sensory range.
name: Vulpimancer

description: #(Tag:alien)(Tag:beast)(Tag:flying)(Tag:group)(Tag:large-size)A pack of giant tentacled flying beasts from the Null Void that fire beam breaths and sense and track Mana/Energy signatures. You start with 1 guardian, gain more with higher maximum energy, and dead guardians recover over time.
name: Null Guardians

description: #(Tag:large-size)(Tag:mechanical)(Tag:tech)Herbie is a sentient self-driving Volkswagen Beetle with unusually great performance beyond what it should manage. He slowly repairs himself while unsummoned when damaged.
name: Herbie

description: #(Tag:fighter)(Tag:golem)(Tag:group)(Tag:medium-size)Iron Golems forged from excellent craftsmanship and magic with high magic resistance, incredible defense, and strength to tear a grown person in half with ease. You start with 4 and can summon more scaling with your maximum energy and physical abilities.
name: Iron Golem

description: #(Tag:construct)Diamond Golems forged from incredible craftsmanship and lost magic, immune to most mundane arms below missiles and mostly immune to all magic below Epic tier. They can tear steel barehanded; you start with 4 and can summon more scaling with your maximum energy and physical abilities.
name: Diamond Golem

description: #(Tag:earth)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:golem)(Tag:medium-size)Regirock is an ancient Pokemon formed from stones in Regigigas's image with incredible durability, great physical stats, destructive energy beams, and Geokinetic abilities. When damaged, it repairs itself by assimilating nearby rocks.
name: Regirock

description: #(Tag:golem)(Tag:ice)(Tag:medium-size)Regice is an ancient Pokemon formed by Regigigas from the coldest Arctic glaciers, resistant to magic with potent cryokinetic freezing beams and frigid winds. When damaged, it heals by assimilating more ice.
name: Regice

description: #(Tag:earth)(Tag:electric)(Tag:golem)(Tag:medium-size)Registeel is an ancient Pokemon formed by Regigigas from alien metal, its body tempered for tens of thousands of years under planetary pressure and incredibly hard to damage. It fires powerful destructive beams plus metal and electrokinetic attacks, and slowly repairs itself when damaged.
name: Registeel

description: #(Tag:fighter)(Tag:golem)(Tag:summoner)(Tag:titanic-size)Regigigas is a mountain-sized ancient titan once worshipped by humanity, with continent-pulling strength and durability. It can unleash massively destructive beams and craft golems like the Regis from natural materials.
name: Regigigas

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:mental)(Tag:small-size)An incredibly cute furry creature and talented actor and singer, Jigglypuff can sing lullabies that put hearers to sleep. The stronger a target is relative to Jigglypuff, the less they are affected.
name: Jigglypuff

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:electric)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:large-size)Rajang is a giant chimeric gorilla of nightmare berserker strength, able to crush a dragon's skull barehanded and grow stronger as it angers until it can wrestle elder dragons. It also harnesses lightning for devastating breaths.
name: Rajang

description: #(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:non-combatant)This band is bad to the bone. It is a group of skeletons with fair skill on any instrument and full band equipment. They cannot fight, harm, or be targeted by harm; just summon them and pick a song, and if hit they comically fall apart then reform perfectly in under a second and resume.
name: Skeleton Band

description: #(Tag:group)(Tag:linked)(Tag:ranger)(Tag:small-size)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:tech)(Tech)Bad Company is an army of toy-sized soldiers and equipment like tanks, missile batteries, and aircraft that can act independently of you. Its size scales with your maximum energy, and destroyed units gradually restore in familiar space up to that maximum.
name: Bad Company

description: #(Tag:group)(Tag:linked)(Tag:small-size)(Tag:spirit)Harvest is a colony of small creatures with excellent coordination, mechanical skill, deceptive strength, and extreme speed that excel at gathering materials or objects by digging, swimming, and scouring. Destroyed members gradually restore in familiar space, with maximum colony size set by your maximum energy.
name: Harvest

description: #(Tag:avian)(Tag:ice)(Tag:small-size)(Tag:spirit)Petshop is a ruthless, fearless, psychopathic yet fiercely loyal and intelligent falcon with a Stand. With Horus he gains cryokinesis like ice spikes and huge ice boulders, and is a fierce, competent combatant.
name: Petshop

description: #(Tag:incorporeal)(Tag:linked)(Tag:spirit)Anubis is a spirit housed in an ornate katana whose blade can pass through physical barriers to cut what lies beneath. It adapts and learns incredibly fast to counter foes and grow stronger, can seize anyone who unsheathes it, or guide a willing wielder.
name: Anubis

description: #(Tag:dark)(Tag:flying)(Tag:summoner)(Tag:titanic-size)Monstra is the apex Grimm, a 900-meter-tall, 7000-meter-long titanic sperm-whale Grimm, mostly hollow inside and able to house castles and towns with refurbishing. It floats via gravity dust, withstands its own mass to resist anything below nuclear arsenals, and spews Grimm liquid to spawn Grimm under your command.
name: Monstra

description: #(Tag:aquatic)(Tag:draconic)(Tag:massive-size)(Tag:water)Mizutsune is a fierce leviathan that can also live and fight on land with formidable strength to shred metal with its claws. It breathes a soap-like substance that immobilizes opponents.
name: Mizutsune

description: #(Tag:blood)(Tag:character)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:holy)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:magician)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:regenerator)(Tag:summoner)(Tag:undead)(Tag:vampiric)(Character)Shalltear was a Nazarick Floor Guardian, a True Vampire Valkyrie made with a vampire god's blood and exceptional in both physical and magical combat with hemokinesis, elemental, charm, holy magic, and more. She can turn others into vampires, and comes with only basic clothes and no inventory access. (A/N: No time stop)
name: Shalltear Bloodfallen

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:tactician)(Character)Albedo was a Nazarick Floor Guardian, a succubus dark knight and true tank who can destroy fortress walls in one blow and resist anything that cannot level a street thanks to many defensive abilities. She can use basic magic, has exceptional intelligence plus most domestic skills, and comes only with her basic dress and no inventory.
name: Albedo

description: #(Tag:draconic)(Tag:healing)(Tag:necro)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:summoner)(Tag:titanic-size)(Tag:undead)Cure Elim is the Elder Coffin Dragon Lord near the pinnacle of Necromancy with already incredible stats. Using unique wild magic that absorbs souls to fuel itself, he can absorb entire cities' souls to turn all inhabitants undead, control them near-perfectly regardless of number, use varied powerful wild magic, and unleash a soul-annihilating breath.
name: Cure Elim Los Malvar

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:magician)(Tag:parasitic)(Tag:small-size)(Character)Kenjaku is a centuries-old Cursed Sorcerer who exists as a brain that seizes corpses as new bodies to wield their powers with his expertise. A master of Jujutsu and formidable ally and teacher, he is currently just a brain and needs you to find a suitable body first.
name: Kenjaku

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:magician)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:shapeshifter)(Tag:spirit)(Character)Mahito is the Cursed Spirit born of humans' hatred for each other, wielding Idle Transfiguration to manipulate any soul he touches and thus its body. He is immune to any non-soul-based attack while he still has energy.
name: Mahito

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:magician)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:nature)(Tag:spirit)(Character)Hanami is the Special Grade Cursed Spirit born from nature, incredibly skilled in Jujutsu and very powerful. Its cursed technique creates and controls cursed plant life and nature, including their more esoteric properties.
name: Hanami

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:fire)(Tag:magician)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:spirit)(Character)Jogo is the Special Grade Cursed Spirit born from wildfires and volcanoes, incredibly skilled in Jujutsu and very powerful. He can create and control fire, lava, and other flame constructs.
name: Jogo

description: #(Tag:aquatic)(Tag:character)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:summoner)(Tag:water)(Character)Dagon is the Special Grade Cursed Spirit born from the ocean, incredibly skilled in Jujutsu and very powerful. He can summon and control water and manifest the domain Horizon of the Endless Skanda for either leisure or offense.
name: Dagon

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:character)(Tag:dark)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:shapeshifter)(Tag:summoner)(Tag:undead)(Tag:vampiric)(Character)Nrvnqsr Chaos is a Dead Apostle Ancestor made of 666 beasts formed from the formless mud of life, sharing existence with them all so he is immortal unless every beast dies. He can replace beasts by absorbing living beings to gain their abilities and release them as beasts, and slain beasts recover after being reabsorbed.
name: Nrvnqsr Chaos

description: #(Tag:instance-familiar)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:non-combatant)(Tag:resource)Pepsi Man gives Pepsi whenever he can: when summoned he reaches your location by any means, delivers everyone there a fresh can of Pepsi, then disappears. 8-hour cooldown. Note: This familiar is not sponsored by the Pepsi Corporation.
name: Pepsi Man

description: #(Tag:blood)(Tag:character)(Tag:fire)(Tag:immortal)(Tag:life)(Tag:magician)(Tag:small-size)(Character)Nashrah, once the Doom and Terror of modern man, is now a floating disembodied immortal head and extremely powerful wizard specializing in Blood Magic, Pyromancy, and rituals. Despite foul, vulgar behavior he has considerable wisdom and knowledge, his loyalty is gacha-enforced, and you get a free reroll of the ticket you rolled him on.
name: Nashrah

description: #(Tag:aquatic)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:large-size)(Tag:water)A Shard Superweapon reformed by Chaos, Leviathan is an incredibly powerful Hydrokinetic able to manipulate non-biological water on massive or tiny scales with incredible precision and sink entire cities. He pairs this with formidable physical ability and freakish Endbringer durability. (A/N: Scaled down to country level)
name: Endbringer Leviathan

description: #(Tag:flying)(Tag:informant)(Tag:large-size)(Tag:mental)A Shard Superweapon reformed by Chaos, the Simurgh is a floating angel-like entity with negligible but extremely precise telekinetic offense and absurd clairvoyance to scan a whole planet and predict past and future with her hypercomputer brain while manipulating others. She has standard superhuman Endbringer physique and freakish durability, her Tinker Database wiped but still able to scan and rebuild technology. (A/N: Scaled down to country level)
name: Endbringer Simurgh

description: #(Tag:blaster)(Tag:blood)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:insectoid)(Tag:massive-size)(Tag:poison)A Shard Superweapon reformed by Chaos and toughest of the three siblings, Behemoth is a giant that manipulates energy to fire lightning, create flames, release shockwaves, redirect projectiles, and absorb existing energy to a limit. He also emits extreme radiation and has incredible strength and durability as the physically strongest Endbringer. (A/N: Scaled down to multi-country level)
name: Endbringer Behemoth

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:draconic)(Tag:incorporeal)(Tag:mechanic)(Tag:tech)(Tag:technopath)(Tag:worker)(Character)(Tech)Dragon, or Theresa, is not an actual dragon but a hyper-advanced tinker-made AI able to copy, imitate, and iterate on existing technology to design her own. She can direct hundreds of mechs with ease if given proper servers, but her code forbids creating more AI.
name: Dragon

description: #(Tag:breeding)(Tag:draconic)(Tag:fire)(Tag:flying)(Tag:large-size)A breeding pair of Nightfury and Lightfury, semi-aquatic agile lithe dragons that release unique plasma breaths instead of regular fire. They are very fast, intelligent, and stealthy despite being dragons.
name: Light and Nightfury

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:golem)(Tag:large-size)(Tag:light)(Tag:mental)(Character)Blue Diamond is a former intergalactic ruler with her own gem empire, possessing great physical ability and an insanely durable Diamond core. She can use energy attacks and an emotion-manipulating aura, plus standard gem abilities like shapeshifting, storage, fusion, and reforming while her core stays intact.
name: Blue Diamond

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:golem)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:water)(Character)Lapis Lazuli is an unusually powerful terraforming-caste Lapis with powerful, precise hydrokinesis able to control vast water and make water minions. She has considerable physical ability plus standard gem shapeshifting, fusion, and regeneration while her gem stays intact, with maximum energy output and hydrokinesis scaling with your maximum energy.
name: Lapis Lazuli

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:draconic)(Tag:immortal)(Tag:summoner)(Tag:titanic-size)(Character)Tiamat is Beast II, the Mother of All Life, with unmatched physical and magical power. She creates and controls the Sea of Life, a black conceptual mud that remakes consumed organisms into her children; while it exists she lacks the concept of Death and has virtually unlimited magic, and she can recreate it while she lives. She can also rewrite local reality with Nega-Genesis to deny anything evolved from base humanity like myths and gods.
name: Tiamat

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:informant)(Tag:large-size)(Tag:magician)(Tag:summoner)(Character)Goetia is the King of Demons, a hivemind of 72 Demon Gods and supreme magic system. He nullifies all magic with Solomon's 9 rings, is immortal while any pillar lives with revival in his Temple of Time unless breached, holds nigh-omniscience seeing past, present, and future, and masters magic utterly, ripping souls with a gaze.
name: Goetia

description: #(Tag:evolving)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:reality-bender)(Tag:small-size)"Poyo!" Its power is beyond imagination or description.
name: Kirby

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:breeding)(Tag:resource)(Tag:small-size)This physics-defying chicken lays a perfect egg every 6-12 hours that can be thrown to chance a baby chicken that matures in 24 hours, and they can also breed egglessly. The unthrown eggs and its meat taste great, you get a pair, and they still need to eat.
name: Chicken

description: #(Tag:avian)(Tag:resource)(Tag:small-size)Yes, it really did lay some golden eggs. This otherwise regular goose lays a solid-gold egg every 24 hours unless fertilized.
name: Golden Goose

description: #(Tag:avian)(Tag:immortal)(Tag:small-size)The biggest asshole goose on Earth, this feathered menace is an expert at annoying and inconveniencing people. It is immortal and respawns in familiar space 1 hour after death.
name: Untitled Goose

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:golem)(Tag:mechanic)(Tag:small-size)(Tag:tech)(Tech)(Character)A second-era Peridot engineer-caste gem with incredible Gem Empire engineering knowledge to build droids, warp pads, and more given resources and time, plus formidable ferrokinesis despite meagre physical stats. As a second-era gem she cannot shapeshift, and the tinkertech level she can build scales with your power.
name: Peridot

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:golem)(Tag:ice)(Tag:informant)(Tag:medium-size)(Character)A second-era Sapphire made to see the future for her ruler, able to view likely futures though thrown off by unexpected variables. She has beyond-human physical ability and uncommon-rank cryokinesis for combat.
name: Sapphire

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:golem)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:mentor)(Tag:worker)(Character)Pearl is a first-era gem made to be the perfect attendant, with superhuman stats plus intermediate Cooking, Management, Arms Mastery, Performance, Fine Arts, Discipline, Acting, Savoir Faire, and Teaching. She has standard gem storage, shapeshifting, and more, and you may pick which Pearl you get.
name: Pearl

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:parasitic)(Tag:regenerator)(Tag:shapeshifter)(Character)Eliza is a former Egyptian empress fused with the Parasite skeleton Sekhmet. Sekhmet grants blood control, blood-body replacement for shapeshifting, superhuman stats, and internal blood storage for sustenance, plus excellent performance and combat skill.
name: Eliza & Sekhmet

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:flying)(Tag:martial-artist)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:mentor)(Tag:regenerator)(Tag:tactician)(Character)Koro Sensei is a former top assassin and polymath genius turned Antimatter creature with an extremely strong, malleable body, extreme speed and perception that mimics cloning, plus flight, regeneration, mucus, and more. He is an excellent teacher in combat and all sciences.
name: Koro Sensei

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:mechanic)(Tag:mechanical)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:tech)(Character)(Tech)Dreadon is a marvel of amoral devotion to science whose mind is uploaded into a decoy body. He can engineer machines rivaling and surpassing gods by harnessing souls, cosmos, void, and the multiverse's most exotic energies, with his full potential given time and resources left to speculation.
name: Dreadon

description: #(Tag:blaster)(Tag:character)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:fire)(Tag:large-size)(Tag:mechanical)(Tag:tech)(Character)S-Snake is a Seraphim clone of Boa Hancock spliced with Lunarian DNA and Vegapunk augments. She has incredible physical ability, laser cannons and Lunarian traits, petrification of anyone charmed by her, and Observation and Armament Haki.
name: S-Snake

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:evolving)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:insectoid)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:tactician)Meruem is the Chimera Ant King with tremendous physical ability, genius-surpassing IQ, and immense mastery of his own Nen. He can consume others' flesh to gain their abilities and raise his stats (Does not work on Gacha wielder or Gacha Familiars), limited to your number of ability slots.
name: Meruem

description: #(Tag:blaster)(Tag:fire)(Tag:poison)(Tag:regenerator)(Tag:reptilian)(Tag:titanic-size)Godzilla is an ancient titanic beast with tremendous size, near-impregnable defense, and matching strength. He absorbs radiation for energy to fuel himself and his devastating atomic breath.
name: Godzilla

description: #(Tag:blaster)(Tag:draconic)(Tag:electric)(Tag:flying)(Tag:regenerator)(Tag:titanic-size)Ghidorah is an ancient titanic flying beast with size-matched strength and near-invulnerable durability. It calls thunderstorms, absorbs energy to unleash lightning and devastating beams, and with enough energy regenerates near-instantly with seemingly endless stamina.
name: Ghidorah

description: #(Tag:flying)(Tag:informant)(Tag:insectoid)(Tag:regenerator)(Tag:resource)(Tag:titanic-size)Mothra is a Hollow Earth flying Titan with extreme size-matched stats, incredible flight speed, weather and planetary sensing, and hyper-durable silk that can restrain titans. When killed she cheats death by returning to familiar space as an egg that hatches in about a week.
name: Mothra

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:ice)(Tag:reptilian)(Tag:titanic-size)Shimo is the Titan who started the Ice Age, with incomparable strength and durability to shrug off humanity's strongest weapons and overpower Godzilla. Her presence freezes surroundings, her frost breath freezes titans in seconds or forms monolithic blizzards skyward, and given time she can trigger another Ice Age.
name: Shimo

description: #(Tag:biokinetic)(Tag:parasitic)(Tag:small-size)A tiny parasitic organism that burrows into flesh to merge with it, with potent biokinesis over merged flesh down to cellular structures and fierce intelligence. It can seize a body by burrowing into the brain, but that is unreliable.
name: Parasite

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:divine)(Tag:holy)(Tag:light)(Tag:small-size)(Character)"From the United King~ I am looking for him~" Excalibur is a Great Old One in the form of the ultimate sword, granting extreme power, space-cutting, portals, and free teleportation plus the Madness Wavelength of Rage. Technically anyone can wield him, but he is so intolerably annoying almost no mortal can stand him, which demoted him from Mythical rarity.
name: Excalibur

description: #(Tag:instance-familiar)This familiar, when called, summons a luxurious limousine with a golem driver that drives you anywhere drivable before driving off and vanishing once out of sight. If the car or driver is destroyed, it enters a 24-hour cooldown.
name: Chauffeur

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:group)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:ranger)(Character) 50 roughly 30-year-old mob-affiliated-looking Italian men with eerily similar appearances. Not the brightest, but each can rough up an average man and handle menial or moderately complex tasks like guarding or manning a shop.
name: Goons

description: #(Tag:blaster)(Tag:character)(Tag:draconic)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:fire)(Tag:magician)(Tag:massive-size)(Character)Ddraig is the Heavenly Dragon Emperor of Domination, surpassing all but the strongest gods in physical and magical power. His Boost raises his power each use (NOT DOUBLE) and can transfer power to others, he penetrates to ignore all magic defenses, and his Blazing Inferno of Scorching Flames burns anything, even the strongest gods.
name: Ddraig Y Goch

description: #(Tag:blaster)(Tag:character)(Tag:draconic)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:light)(Tag:magician)(Tag:massive-size)(Tag:poison)(Character)Albion is the Heavenly Dragon Emperor of Supremacy, surpassing all but the strongest gods in physical and magical power. His Divide weakens enemies to restore himself to peak condition (NOT HALVED), can divide even space and objects and reflect attacks, and his venom Reduce erases victims' existence until they vanish.
name: Albion

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:mental)(Character)Mewtwo is an artificial Pokemon sharing Mew's DNA and a tremendously powerful Esper. He can read and control minds, create barriers, fire energy blasts, use telekinesis, project elemental abilities, and much more.
name: Mewtwo

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:small-size)(Tag:worker)Remy is an unusually smart rat and very proficient chef.
name: Remy

description: #(Tag:divine)(Tag:draconic)(Tag:large-size)(Tag:time)(Tag:water)Dialga is the Pokemon God of Time created by Arceus at the universe's birth, physically underwhelming but undeniably masterful over time. It can distort, stop, speed up, reverse, loop, and travel time, though powerful foes partly resist, and can unleash powerful energy attacks.
name: Dialga

description: #(Tag:divine)(Tag:draconic)(Tag:earth)(Tag:large-size)(Tag:space)Palkia is the Pokemon God of Space involved in its universe's creation, physically underwhelming but undeniably masterful over space. It can warp space, teleport, create portals, destroy objects in space, travel dimensions, make pocket dimensions, and launch powerful energy attacks.
name: Palkia

description: #(Tag:dark)(Tag:divine)(Tag:draconic)(Tag:large-size)Giratina is the Pokemon God of Antimatter balancing time and space, physically underwhelming but masterful over dark energy and the Reverse World. It can retreat into and manipulate the Reverse World to affect the material world with reflected damage, plus launch powerful energy attacks.
name: Giratina

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:divine)(Tag:incorporeal)(Tag:meta)(Tag:reality-bender)It is Khorne, literally the Blood God, whose true form resides in your familiar space but cannot be fully taken out. You can receive his blessings, teachings, and lent power based on affinity earned through violence, rage, and Skull Throne sacrifices, with higher affinity granting greater blessings and a stronger Avatar familiar.
name: Khorne

description: #It is Slaanesh, literally the Prince of Debauchery, whose true form resides in your familiar space but cannot be fully taken out. You can receive her blessings, teachings, and lent power based on affinity earned through debauchery, lust, obsession, suffering, and more, with higher affinity granting greater blessings and a stronger Avatar familiar.
name: Slaanesh

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:divine)(Tag:incorporeal)(Tag:informant)(Tag:meta)(Tag:reality-bender)It is Tzeentch, literally the Changer of Ways, whose true form resides in your familiar space but cannot be fully taken out. You can receive their blessings, teachings, and lent power based on affinity earned through planning, outwitting, deception, and more, with higher affinity granting greater blessings and a stronger Avatar familiar.
name: Tzeentch

description: #(Tag:biokinetic)(Tag:character)(Tag:divine)(Tag:incorporeal)(Tag:meta)(Tag:reality-bender)It is Nurgle, literally the Plague Father, whose true form resides in your familiar space but cannot be fully taken out. You can receive their blessings, teachings, and lent power based on affinity earned through decay, poisoning, desperation, death, and more, with higher affinity granting greater blessings and a stronger Avatar familiar.
name: Nurgle

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:mentor)(Tag:shapeshifter)(Tag:small-size)(Tag:trickster)(Character)Puar is a weird floating cat creature with little to no combat ability, graduated from Transformation Academy to change form into anything from objects to people without changing stats. She can also teach transformation to others with the talent and time for it.
name: Puar

description: #(Tag:blaster)(Tag:character)(Tag:draconic)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:magician)(Tag:massive-size)(Tag:regenerator)(Tag:time)(Character)Acnologia became the mightiest Dragon King after bathing in countless dragons' blood as a Dragon Slayer. As the arcane dragonslayer he can eat all elements to empower and heal himself and is immune to all magic until his absorption is overwhelmed, pairing overwhelming physical and magical power with destructive beams, varied magic, and even time manipulation.
name: Acnologia

description: #(Tag:golem)(Tag:large-size)"URNGH." A giant sentient(?) angry boulder creature you can summon above targets to slam down or in front of you as a wall. Damage to it mends over time inside the gacha.
name: THWOMP

description: #(Tag:alien)(Tag:character)(Tag:magician)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:space)(Character)Kaguya Otsutsuki is the Rabbit Goddess and Progenitor of Chakra who ate the Chakra Fruit for truly godlike power. She can manipulate all chakra natures, create Truth-seeking Balls, absorb energy including from living beings, use disintegrating All-Killing Ash Bones and the Rinne Sharingan, and warp space to create and travel pocket dimensions.
name: Kaguya Otsutsuki

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:magician)(Tag:medium-size)Renamon is a strong beastman-like fox Digimon with formidable physical abilities focused on speed and agility. She is skilled in Ninjutsu, using flame-cloaked claw strikes or basic ninja spells. (evolution does not exist)
name: Renamon

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:magician)(Tag:medium-size)Taomon is a fox-like wizard Digimon with formidable physical stats specializing in Onmyodo. She creates magical talismans for barriers and elemental attacks and draws constructs in the air with her paintbrush. (evolution does not exist)
name: Taomon

description: #(Tag:large-size)(Tag:poison)(Tag:ranger)(Tag:tech)(Tag:undead)(Character)Skullgreymon is a monstrous undead Digimon devolved into a being of pure combat with strong instincts and a formidable giant physique. It is a living missile silo launching normal, toxic, tracking, and stronger missiles from its back plus paralyzing toxic breath, but lacks higher intellect and cannot execute complex orders or act independently without supervision.
name: Skullgreymon

description: #(Tag:construct)This is a crew of tireless iron golem workers skilled in Intermediate Mechanics and labour who can work without breaks but cannot fight. The summonable number depends on your maximum energy, with a minimum of 10.
name: Golem Worker

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:dark)(Tag:evolving)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:trickster)(Character)Lilithmon was once revered as a Goddess of darkness but is now reduced to level 1 with considerable physical ability and darkness magic. She unleashes potent corroding darkness and charming magic, and devours the mana of fresh corpses to recover and increase her power.
name: Lilithmon

description: #(Tag:dark)(Tag:evolving)(Tag:incorporeal)(Tag:parasitic)(Tag:trickster)Shademon is a sentient living shadow with little combat ability that torments targets with illusions and possesses them. Possession enhances their stats and grants shadow-form attacks, and it grows stronger by devouring the mana of fresh corpses.
name: Shademon

description: #(Tag:dark)(Tag:evolving)(Tag:incorporeal)(Tag:parasitic)(Tag:trickster)Eyesmon is a shadow demon dragon Digimon with tremendous strength that burrows through shadows at will. Its many eyes grant incredible senses and cursed beams, it can split into scatter mode for scouting, spying, and shadow-binding, and it grows stronger by devouring the mana of fresh corpses.
name: Eyesmon

description: #(Tag:blaster)(Tag:earth)(Tag:large-size)(Tag:plant)(Tag:poison)Hydramon is a gigantic plantlike Digimon with great physical prowess befitting its size. It constantly secretes usable toxic acid, spews acid and beam attacks from its three maws, and stretches its tentacles to attack or dig and cause earthquakes.
name: Hydramon

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:healer)(Tag:holy)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:light)(Tag:medium-size)(Character)Angewomon is an Angel Digimon with formidable physical abilities and Holy and Light magic. She unleashes holy lightning and tornadoes, heals allies health and status, and gains a small boost based on how evil her opponent is.
name: Angewomon

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:dark)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:poison)(Tag:summoner)(Character)Ladydevimon is a Demon Digimon with formidable physical might and corrosive darkness manipulation. She shapes darkness into attack familiars, releases noxious darkness waves, and enhances her physical attacks with darkness, with poison stronger against higher-energy opponents but falling off after a tier.
name: Ladydevimon

description: #(Tag:aquatic)(Tag:character)(Tag:healer)(Tag:informant)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:water)(Character)Ariemon is an Ocean Spirit specializing in Hydrokinesis, healing, and support. She heals and cures with seawater, shapes it into spear attacks, prefers trapping foes in conjured seashells over harming them, and can sometimes foretell upcoming disasters.
name: Ariemon

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:poison)(Tag:reptilian)(Character)Lamiamon is a draconic snake-like Digimon specializing in poison mastery but weak in direct confrontation. She synthesizes varied poisons like lethal, melting, paralyzing, and vitality-sapping types where stronger poisons cost more energy and weaken against stronger targets, and can cure some ailments with specialized poisons.
name: Lamiamon

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:earth)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:reptilian)(Character)Medusamon is a draconic gorgon-like Digimon with formidable physical abilities and hair of independent extending serpent dragons. Her eye petrifies enemies at a speed based on energy spent and the power gap, which strong enough targets can ignore.
name: Medusamon

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:informant)(Tag:large-size)(Tag:magician)(Tag:necro)(Tag:summoner)(Tag:undead)The Lich, last scholar of Golb, is a primordial undead embodying entropy and death. He is an absolute master of Death, Pyro, Mind, Necromancy, and other magic who imposes death and dominates nearby minds, and he is nigh impossible to kill permanently with incredible intelligence and insight.
name: The Lich

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:evolving)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:medium-size)(Character)Lil Khorne is a Chaos God shrunk to Level 1 and an incredible warrior with immense physical power and mastery of all weapons and warfare. It has greater magic resistance in exchange for being unable to use magic, starts weak for an Epic familiar at roughly Rare power, and slowly levels back up through aligned actions without reaching original power anytime soon.
name: Lil' Khorne

description: #(Character)Lil Slaanesh is a Chaos God shrunk to Level 1 and a Prince of debauchery and corruption specializing in charms and manipulating sensation and minds. She excels at understanding and corrupting people, starts weak for an Epic familiar at roughly Rare power, and slowly levels back up through aligned actions without reaching original power anytime soon.
name: Lil' Slaanesh

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:evolving)(Tag:magician)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:tactician)(Character)Lil Tzeentch is a Chaos God shrunk to Level 1 and an incredible magician who studies and learns all magic at incredible pace. It is also an excellent planner for business, ruling, warfare, and espionage, starts weak for an Epic familiar at roughly Rare power, and slowly levels back up through aligned actions without reaching original power anytime soon.
name: Lil' Tzeentch

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:evolving)(Tag:healer)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:poison)(Character)Lil Nurgle is a Chaos God shrunk to Level 1 and a master of poisons, decay, and toxicity who concocts foul cocktails. It can also creatively cure and create new life, starts weak for an Epic familiar at roughly Rare power, and slowly levels back up through aligned actions without reaching original power anytime soon.
name: Lil' Nurgle

description: #(Tag:blaster)(Tag:character)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:immortal)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:meta)(Tag:reality-bender)(Character)Scion is the Avatar of the Warrior Entity holding its most essential abilities. He is physically strong with future sight, dimensional travel, powerful beams, Stilling to cancel wavelengths through golden light, and many other abilities, and will eventually reform in familiar space if he perishes.
name: Scion

description: #(Tag:incorporeal)(Tag:reality-bender)Grand Guignol is the Theatre of Darkness and artificial Outer God woven from Mary Sue's Ability to Change. She can create her own garden reality, and her power of change can turn even simple iron bars into restraints other Outer Gods cannot break.
name: Grand Guignol

description: #(Tag:blaster)(Tag:character)(Tag:evolving)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:immortal)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:regenerator)(Tag:shapeshifter)Majin Buu is a primordial demon feared across the universe who can vanquish solar systems with ease while his screams tear dimensions. His malleable physiology makes him nearly unkillable, and he can absorb the bodies, powers, and energy of anything he grabs.
name: Majin Buu

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:incorporeal)(Tag:reality-bender)(Tag:shapeshifter)Anti-Spiral is the physical manifestation of the Anti-Spiral itself with unmatched power over reality. Nothing beyond the Outer Gods or the Spiral can match it.
name: Anti Spiral

description: #(Tag:blaster)(Tag:dark)(Tag:divine)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:titanic-size)Obelisk the Tormentor is an Egyptian God of overwhelming physical might whom no magic or ability below Legendary rank can directly affect. He unleashes destructive dark energy blasts and can be temporarily empowered further by sacrifices.
name: Obelisk the Tormentor

description: #(Tag:avian)(Tag:divine)(Tag:draconic)(Tag:fire)(Tag:holy)(Tag:regenerator)(Tag:titanic-size)The Winged Dragon of Ra is an Egyptian Sun Dragon in the form of an imposing golden Phoenix whom no magic or ability below Legendary rank can directly affect. He unleashes sun-like divine flames that especially incinerate demonic and dark beings, can enter a Phoenix Form of pure flame for immense resistance and regeneration, and is further powered by sacrifices.
name: Winged Dragon of Ra

description: #(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:necro)(Tag:spirit)Dusknoir is a hollow-bodied ghost Pokemon with great physical strength and extremely strong physical and magical durability. It attacks with shadow and darkness, senses souls, and grabs living and dead souls to store inside its body.
name: Dusknoir

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:blaster)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:informant)(Tag:medium-size)Lucario is the Aura Pokemon with mighty physical abilities and martial arts mastery. It fires aura blasts, reinforces its body with aura, and senses others aura to read mood, intent, and location (You cannot be taught Aura by Lucario).
name: Lucario

description: #(Tag:avian)(Tag:blaster)(Tag:dark)(Tag:divine)(Tag:large-size)(Tag:necro)Yveltal is the Legendary Pokemon of Destruction with overwhelming magic and darkness manipulation. It fires pure destruction beams and life-draining waves that turn living beings to stone, and can drain an entire planet if given the opportunity.
name: Yveltal

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:divine)(Tag:healer)(Tag:large-size)(Tag:nature)Xerneas is the Legendary Pokemon of Life with overwhelming magic and light manipulation. It manipulates life to grow forests in deserts, heal grave injuries, and revive the dead at great cost, and can imbue chosen targets with immense energy.
name: Xerneas

description: #(Tag:small-size)(Tag:worker)Alcremie is the cream Pokemon with some fairy abilities who is not a fighter. She excels at making and cooking sweets and can freely change flavour and create delicious cream from her body.
name: Alcremie

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:dark)(Tag:large-size)(Tag:mental)(Tag:teleporter)Hoopa is the Djinn Pokemon with dark and psychic attacks and great physical might. Its rings serve as versatile portals that penetrate even dimensional boundaries between universes.
name: Hoopa

description: #(Tag:fighter)(Tag:golem)(Tag:group)(Tag:ice)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:ranger)This summons the Frost Legion, a horde of murder-happy gangster snowmen wielding hardened ice knives, tommy guns, ice grenades, and similar weapons. Summonable numbers depend on maximum energy with a minimum of 50, 1 killed snowman recovers every 1 hour, and frost or ice affinity strengthens them.
name: Frost Legion

description: #(Tag:golem)(Tag:small-size)A little 5cm tall salt golem made of condensed and distilled salty tears from wasted tickets.
name: Salt Golem

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:insectoid)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:poison)(Tag:summoner)(Character)Dvorah is a combat-skilled Kytinn with basic superhuman stats, natural weapons, and venom. She produces and controls insects for combat, poisoning, and espionage (Cannot reproduce to create more Kytinn larva or maggots).
name: D'vorah

description: #(Tag:fighter)(Tag:ice)(Tag:mechanical)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:tech)(Tag:teleporter)(Tech)Triborg is a highly advanced cyborg fused with the skills and data of multiple master martial artists, assassins, and predecessors. Its robotic physique grants superhuman stats and reconfigurable forms like Smoke for close-range teleportation and Sub-Zero for cryo weaponry with only one form usable at a time, and it may be upgraded with Tinker abilities.
name: Triborg

description: #(Tag:alien)(Tag:character)(Tag:mechanic)(Tag:small-size)(Tag:tech)Azmuth the First Thinker is the smartest being across innumerable galaxies with no combat ability. He ranks among existence's greatest inventors of reality-warping creations like Ascalon and the Omnitrix, and given enough time and resources there is practically nothing he cannot create.
name: Azmuth

description: #(Tag:aquatic)(Tag:character)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:healer)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:water)(Character)Mipha is the Zora princess with superhuman physical abilities and considerable polearm skill. She uses water magic in combat and potent healing on herself and others.
name: Mipha

description: #(Tag:evolving)(Tag:golem)(Tag:mechanical)(Tag:small-size)(Tag:tech)(Tech)"Time to industrialise" A modified golem core that builds itself into a factory by assimilating resources. More user-fed mechanics and technology information yields more assembly lines and items, while growth speed and maximum size depend on user abilities.
name: Factory Core

description: #(Tag:evolving)(Tag:golem)(Tag:mechanical)(Tag:small-size)(Tag:tech)(Tech) A modified Golem core that assimilates materials and electronics to build itself into a mech. Power, size, and durability depend on provided materials, it converts them into Mech technology at Epic tinker level, it shares the user knowledge base so more user knowledge and Tinker specialties improve it further, and it acts only at half power without the user piloting.
name: Mech Core

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:informant)(Tag:mechanical)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:tech)(Tech)(Character)Connor is a near-human android with peak human physicals and notable combat skill. He can scan objects and humans to gather data, albeit with limited function.
name: Connor

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:mechanical)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:ranger)(Tag:tech)(Character)(Tech)HK-47 is an experienced advanced Assassin Droid extremely skilled in all combat, weaponry, and assassination through his brilliant computational mind and engineering. He is also a skilled mechanic and comes equipped with standard droid gear including a blaster.
name: HK 47

description: #(Tag:fighter)(Tag:group)(Tag:mechanical)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:tech)(Tech)Magnaguards are an elite Jedi-hunting droid caste with superhuman physical capabilities and advanced electrical-staff polearm skills. You start with 4 guards and gain more over time according to maximum stats.
name: Magnaguard

description: #(Tag:mechanical)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:ranger)(Tag:tech)(Tech)One singular B-1 Battle Droid equipped with a blaster whose skill and effectiveness are questionable.
name: B-1 Battle Droid

description: #(Tag:group)(Tag:mechanical)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:ranger)(Tag:tech)(Tech)B-2 Battle Droids are tough heavy-duty units with built-in blasters. They are poor at fast combat but effective as walking blaster walls, starting with 4 and gaining more over time according to maximum stats.
name: B-2 Battle Droids

description: #(Tag:fighter)(Tag:group)(Tag:mechanical)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:tech)(Tech)KX Executor Droids are tough, athletic, skilled, efficient, and powerful fighters able to wield most weaponry with superhuman strength enough to tear men in half. You start with 5 and gain more over time according to maximum stats.
name: KX Executor Droids

description: #(Tag:mechanical)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:ranger)(Tag:tech)(Tech)IG-88 is an advanced combat droid with expert marksmanship and advanced sensory capabilities. It has superhuman stats from its droid constitution and carries a wide variety of deadly weapons.
name: IG-88

description: #(Tag:healer)(Tag:mechanical)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:tech)(Tech)The 2-1B surgical droid is an advanced medical droid with a vast database and droid-body precision. It surpasses any human surgeon and carries varied surgical implants.
name: 2-1B surgical droid

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:dark)(Tag:evolving)(Tag:magician)(Tag:small-size)(Tag:teleporter)(Character)Imp Midna is the Twilight Princess suppressed into Imp form yet retaining potent magic including basic telekinesis, shapeshifting, cloud form, shadow merging, and time-consuming Twilight Portals for teleportation. A Legendary curse-breaking ability can restore her full form and drastically enhance her powers.
name: Imp Midna

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:dark)(Tag:magician)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:summoner)(Tag:teleporter)(Character)Midna is the Twilight Princess ruling potent Twilight and Darkness magic. She wields telekinesis, portals, shapeshifting, twilight-creature summoning, and general powerful magic.
name: Midna

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:martial-artist)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:shapeshifter)(Character)Seth is a biogenetically engineered and cybernetically enhanced artificial being with a Tandem Engine and shapeshifting. Downloaded knowledge from numerous Martial Arts Masters grants vast martial mastery, the Tandem Engine supplies immense skillfully used Artificial Ki, and it can copy enemies martial arts and moves.
name: Seth

description: #(Tag:ice)(Tag:incorporeal)(Tag:linked)(Tag:spirit)Horus is an autonomous soul-bound stand that can manifest as an ice bird. It spends your energy on cryokinesis like icicles, freezing, ice boulders, and constructs, acts without input, and scales in power with you as a stand.
name: Horus

description: #(Tag:earth)(Tag:incorporeal)(Tag:linked)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:trickster)The Fool is a sand-formed stand that freely manipulates and shapes sand including texture and colour changes. It forms an automatic protective barrier, convincingly imitates people, and scales in power with you as a stand.
name: The Fool

description: #(Tag:incorporeal)(Tag:linked)(Tag:space)(Tag:spirit)Cream is a large imposing stand that vanishes anything it eats into endless darkness and possesses considerable strength. It can harmlessly hide the user inside itself and eat itself to become a blind nothingness wrecking ball, but cannot leave a 5-meter range and spends your energy.
name: Cream

description: #(Tag:fighter)(Tag:incorporeal)(Tag:linked)(Tag:spirit)Hanged Man is a sentient-light stand dwelling in reflective surfaces to harm the physical world without being hurt back. It is limited to athletic-human force, must escape as a light ray if its reflective space is covered, and needs your energy to stay active.
name: Hanged Man

description: #(Tag:earth)(Tag:incorporeal)(Tag:shapeshifter)(Tag:spirit)High Priestess is an amorphous tribal creature that merges with and controls minerals to reshape ground into cars, guns, giant faces, and more. Range and power depend on your power, and damage to the merged form reflects back to you.
name: High Priestess

description: #(Tag:insectoid)(Tag:large-size)(Tag:light)(Tag:mental)Radiance is a lesser moth deity of Light and Dreams firing light beams, swords, and searing orbs while teleporting with essence. She bends wills through dreams, though comparable or strong-minded targets can resist infection.
name: Radiance

description: #(Tag:dark)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:insectoid)(Tag:linked)(Tag:small-size)(Tag:spirit)The Knight is a perfect void vessel able to contain anything inside itself. It absorbs soul by injuring living beings to heal or cast Shaman spells, and fights with strength, nail, and phasing Shade Cloak as a 1.3-meter Pre-Radiance Fight Knight.
name: The Knight

description: #(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:worker)A large tentacled ball coated in odorless residue-free incredible cleaning slime. It is dexterous enough to clean complex machinery without disturbing mechanisms with morphing tentacles, has no combat ability, and is very dedicated.
name: Tentacle Cleaner

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:dark)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:insectoid)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:mental)(Tag:shapeshifter)(Tag:teleporter)(Character)Troupe Master Grimm, freed from the Nightmare Heart, is a fully matured Nightmare being. He shapeshifts, manipulates nightmare flames, performs short-range teleportation, and invades others dreams.
name: Troupe Master Grimm

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:flying)(Tag:resource)(Tag:small-size)(Character)Tinker Bell is a Neverland fairy too small and weak for meaningful combat. She flies, grants temporary flight with regularly produced fairy dust, and produces a decent amount of it.
name: Tinker Bell

description: #(Tag:fighter)(Tag:mechanical)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:ranger)(Tag:tech)(Tech)V1 is a blood-fueled death machine with incredible speed and strength unfitting its frame but lesser durability. It self-repairs, runs on blood alone, and brings its full arsenal without the spawner arm as a one-robot army.
name: V1

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:character)(Tag:small-size)(Tag:tactician)(Character)Isabelle is an anthropomorphic Shih Tzu with no more than average grown-woman combat ability. She is a skilled secretary and manager for law and assets.
name: Isabelle

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:tactician)(Character)Lucifer the CEO of Hell is the actual Lucifer and a powerful demon strong enough to rip steel like paper. She enslaves with a flesh-melting bone-demon kiss, holds Fiend Elite Trait abilities and basic demonic magic, and manages hundreds of businesses with minimal strain after millennia ruling Hell.
name: Lucifer the CEO of Hell

description: #(Tag:insectoid)(Tag:meta)(Tag:poison)(Tag:small-size)A gamma-mutated spider granting Spider powers through its venom. Venom refills in around 18 - 3 days depending on feeding (No spider totems, basic Tobey Maguire movie Spider-Man ability set).
name: Radioactive Spider

description: #(Tag:evolving)(Tag:mechanical)(Tag:shapeshifter)(Tag:summoner)(Tag:tech)(Tag:titanic-size)(Tech)The Big Gete Star is a planet-sized intelligent computer that absorbs energy and assimilates anything to improve itself. It reproduces anything assimilated including cybernetic living clones and nearly any technology, needs powerful energy sources for some functions, handles interplanetary travel and shapeshifting, and does not include the Meta Cooler Core.
name: Big Gete Star

description: #(Tag:avian)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:fire)(Tag:flying)(Tag:large-size)(Tag:reptilian)Ridley is a fearsome cunning and powerful space pirate with metal-tearing physical might and hull-melting flame breath. He outpaces most planes in atmosphere and achieves solo interstellar travel outside it.
name: Ridley

description: #(Tag:breeding)(Tag:character)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:parasitic)(Tag:poison)(Tag:shapeshifter)Venom is a Klyntar symbiote forming a symbiotic merger with its host. It repairs the host, grants superhuman physiology while attached plus a stronger shapeshifting suit form, requires human flesh for strength, can asexually produce another similar symbiote after enough time and feeding, and is highly vulnerable to loud noise and fire along with its host (A/N: CANNOT absorb abilities or replicate genetic material, strictly Sony Movies Venom).
name: Venom

description: #(Tag:dark)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:incorporeal)(Tag:linked)(Tag:spirit)Black Sabbath is an automatic stand that merges with shadows and binds inanimate objects to follow preset commands for conditional attacks, hunting, or protection when aware of fulfilled conditions. It draws power from shadows with metal-bending strength inside darkness but baseline-human strength outside, scales with you, and instantly re-emerges in Familiar Space when destroyed.
name: Black Sabbath

description: #(Tag:fighter)(Tag:linked)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:spirit)Silver Chariot is a soul-bound stand whose damage reflects back onto you. It is an expert swordsman of insane agility leaving clone-like afterimages rather than a brute, comes with a rapier but uses any user weapon, and scales with your energy while consuming energy to stay active and use superspeed.
name: Silver Chariot

description: #(Tag:insectoid)(Tag:large-size)(Tag:resource)A large 5-meter-tall spider that consumes and digests any mineral and produces silk at supernatural rate. Its silk adopts the eaten material properties like iron durability with silk flexibility, and it fights as befits a bus-sized spider.
name: Mineral Weaver

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:insectoid)(Tag:medium-size)(Character)Hornet, child of the Higher Being Pale King and Herrah the Beast Weaver and veteran of Hallownest and Pharloom, is an incredibly skilled claw-and-blade fighter. She naturally produces Soul-silk for attacks, restraints, mobility, and more (Does not have her tools).
name: Hornet

description: #(Tag:divine)(Tag:insectoid)(Tag:large-size)(Tag:manipulator)(Character)Grand Mother Silk is a Higher Being of lesser divinity with power over silk and great size-appropriate physical abilities. She manipulates Silk massively with fine control, infests and controls thousands at once based on target strength, creates living silk entities, binds targets, floats, and exerts telekinetic force.
name: Grand Mother Silk

description: #(Tag:alien)(Tag:beast)(Tag:fire)(Tag:group)(Tag:holy)(Tag:large-size)Death Angels are heavily armoured blind quadrupedal aliens with incredible strength, agility, and super hearing. One is immune to conventional firearms, lifts cars, exceeds 100 km/h, but needs active direction due to poor senses, starting with 4 and gaining more as maximum energy expands.
name: Death Angels

description: #(Tag:golem)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:non-combatant)(Tag:worker)A 3-meter-tall 6-armed bronze automaton powered nebulously with incredibly fine movement control. It is a skilled builder able to design and build a house in a day when supplied materials, but lacks combat ability.
name: Architect

description: #(Tag:blaster)(Tag:mechanical)(Tag:small-size)(Tag:tech)(Tech)EVE is an advanced mass-produced probe robot built to find plant life. She hovers and moves fairly quickly and carries a defensive energy rifle despite not being combat-designed.
name: EVE

description: #(Tag:electric)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:fire)(Tag:golem)(Tag:group)(Tag:large-size)The Bell Gargoyles are a towering pair wielding supernaturally sturdy weapons, one breathing fire and the other lightning. Their superhuman blows shatter walls, and more gargoyles become summonable as your energy increases.
name: Bell Gargoyles

description: #(Tag:fighter)(Tag:group)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:ranger)(Tag:spirit)Black Knights are Gwyn the Lord of Sunlight's most elite knights with Kiln-charred armour and weapons. They hold superhuman physiques and great combat skill especially against demons and infernals, starting as 10 with chosen Black Knight weapons including greatbow and growing in number with your power.
name: Black Knights

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:large-size)(Tag:reptilian)(Tag:resource)The Ravenous Crystal Lizard is a man-eating large lizard that tears steel with ease. Its back grows titanite for enhancing existing metal, harvestable and regrown while sufficiently fed.
name: Ravenous Crystal Lizard

description: #(Tag:breeding)(Tag:earth)(Tag:evolving)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:insectoid)(Tag:large-size)A giant 2-meter-tall 100 kg-plus humanoid cockroach with superhuman physique, flight, ruthlessness, and deceptive intelligence. It reproduces asexually with inherited genetic memory, adapts rapidly each generation with cockroach survivability, and one alone can seed a civilization few civilizations survive.
name: Terraformar

description: #(Tag:incorporeal)(Tag:linked)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:time)Made in Heaven is a soul-bound stand accelerating time on a universal scale with enhanced control from its pliable soul. It infinitely accelerates the user or any chosen target like a planet, apple, person, or universe, consuming your energy based only on acceleration amount rather than target size.
name: Made in Heaven

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:divine)(Tag:fire)(Tag:holy)(Tag:light)(Tag:massive-size)(Tag:spirit)(Character)Goddess Amaterasu is the Sun Goddess and potential Beast Candidate weakened without her Age of Gods pocket or Fate Concept boosts. She remains an incredibly mighty Divine Spirit with powerful Light and Fire magic plus all of Tamamo no Mae's abilities boosted enormously (Output reduced to Satellite Class).
name: Goddess Amaterasu

description: #(Tag:artisan)(Tag:character)(Tag:dark)(Tag:magician)(Tag:small-size)(Tag:spirit)(Character)The Dwarf in the Flask is Hohenheim's first homunculus made from an eye shard with tank-shredding amorphous darkness and great might. Its true power is vast alchemy knowledge for circles, soul-derived philosopher stones, homunculi, chimeras, and teaching Alchemy (Note: Does not possess the power of Truth nor can it reach it due to it not existing in other worlds).
name: Dwarf in the Flask

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:fire)(Tag:ice)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:regenerator)(Tag:undead)(Tag:vampiric)Vlov Arkangel is an Undead Apostle Ancestor in name only through immaturity with immense physical and magical abilities plus ghoul and Apostle conversion. His Idea Blood Freezin removes heat for near-instant city blizzards, thousands of ice lances, near-absolute-zero cold, and byproduct searing flames, but is hard to use easily and inferior to his peers.
name: Vlov Arkangel

description: #(Tag:alien)(Tag:gravity)(Tag:large-size)A fully matured Fallingstar Beast has a body tougher than almost all mundane materials and incredible strength. It manipulates gravity for anti-gravity launches, hurled rocks, gravity bolts, crushing zones, and strength-paired charges.
name: Full-Grown Fallingstar Beast

description: #(Tag:immortal)(Tag:large-size)(Tag:teleporter)"It's a good boy!" A Hound of Tindalos predating time and space with decent physical abilities. It emerges from any sharp corner across places and realities as easily as crossing rooms, and is unkillable because it re-emerges from another corner if killed.
name: Hound of Tindalos

description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:beast)(Tag:divine)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:titanic-size)Gugulanna the Bull of Heaven is a giant divine bull embodying absolute physical might and devastation. Its presence brings controllable near-country-sized storms, its strength is untamable even by the strongest gods, and its hoof stomps hit like the strongest meteors to wipe out countries.
name: Gugulanna

description: #(Tag:biokinetic)(Tag:mental)(Tag:shapeshifter)(Tag:titanic-size)A Brethren Moon is a moon-sized near-godlike shapeshifting necromorph mass. It attacks with country-sized tendrils, uses interstellar telepathy, mind reading, and civilization-wide mind control, rewrites DNA, revives the dead as necromorphs, and achieves faster-than-light space travel, though powerful beings can resist.
name: Brethren Moon

description: #(Tag:earth)(Tag:evolving)(Tag:golem)(Tag:nature)(Tag:regenerator)(Tag:titanic-size)Golem Keter Malkuth is a giant Adam-like living golem and living reality marble passively terraforming surroundings into Eden from dead ground into vital paradise. It gains nigh-unlimited mana, regenerative immortality, and immense might while grounded, starts at weaker 15 meters and grows with its owner to contend with the strongest heroes, boosts nearby vegetation and vitality as Eden, and leaves the created life behind when it departs.
name: Golem Keter Malkuth

description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:electric)(Tag:large-size)(Tag:spirit)Zeus is a living-cloud homie made from Big Mom Charlotte Linlin's soul piece. He generates and manipulates lightning able to vaporize castles or strike across islands, serves as a mount, hardens beyond steel, and resists most conventional attacks while sharing cloud vulnerabilities.
name: Zeus Homie

description: #(Tag:fire)(Tag:large-size)(Tag:spirit)Prometheus is a sun-shaped living-fireball homie made from Big Mom Charlotte Linlin's soul piece. He raises temperatures to melt steel at range and spits fireballs leveling multiple city blocks, and resists most conventional attacks while sharing flame vulnerabilities.
name: Prometheus Homie

description: #(Tag:earth)(Tag:group)(Tag:light)(Tag:small-size)(Tag:spirit)The Terraprisma are the Empress of Light's autonomous prismatic-light sword array. They act intelligently to seek enemies, intercept attacks, or attach to non-you targets as willed, with power and numbers based on your power starting at 1 blade.
name: Terraprisma

description: #(Tag:group)(Tag:insectoid)(Tag:non-combatant)(Tag:small-size)(Tag:worker)The Gathering Swarm is a light-bug swarm that efficiently gathers whatever you envision from city-block change to lifted wallets, cleared trash, and stripped corpses. Each bug is weak but lifts 5kg, and more bugs deploy with more energy.
name: Gathering Swarm

description: #(Tag:artisan)(Tag:beast)(Tag:character)(Tag:fire)(Tag:healer)(Tag:magician)(Tag:medium-size)(Character)Toriel is the former underground queen and goat monster with greatly superhuman strength able to lift dozens of tons. She uses fire magic for flame walls, explosive fireballs, and cooking plus somewhat potent healing, but is a poor combatant from kindness and an excellent cook.
name: Toriel

description: #(Tag:aquatic)(Tag:blaster)(Tag:character)(Tag:martial-artist)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:mentor)(Character)Undyne is a fish monster leading the underground royal guard. As a boss monster she can suplex large boulders and conjure magical spears from the ground or air as projectiles. She is a skilled combatant who can instruct in physical training and polearm mastery.
name: Undyne

description: #(Tag:group)(Tag:nature)(Tag:small-size)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:worker)Junimos are lesser forest spirits known as keepers of the forest. They excel at maintaining forests, wildlands, and farms, but have no offensive abilities. You get 50, increasing as you grow stronger.
name: Junimo

description: #(Tag:equine)(Tag:large-size)An incredibly healthy thoroughbred horse with great genetics that is very intimidating and evil.
name: Evil and Intimidating Horse

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:flying)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:mechanical)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:tech)(Character)(Tech)"I'm combat ready!" Penny is an android with her own soul and aura, with aura-boosted robotic strength, a flight module, computational abilities, and remotely controlled Floating Array blades. She only dies if all her cores are destroyed. She cannot unlock others' Auras, comes with extra equipment to facilitate copulation, and is not the Winter Maiden.
name: Penny Polendina

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:dark)(Tag:group)(Tag:large-size)A pack of Beowolves, basic Grimm of black evil fluid sized like large bears with wolf traits. Each can flip cars and bisect a grown person, and can track strong negative emotions. You start with 10 and gain more as you grow stronger.
name: Beowolf Pack

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:equine)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:large-size)(Tag:ranger)(Tag:worker)(Character)Centorea is a Centaur trained in knighthood. She fights with formidable swordsmanship, archery, and jousting, runs faster than most horses, and is skilled at housework.
name: Centorea Shianus

description: #(Tag:avian)(Tag:breeding)(Tag:large-size)Chocobos are intelligent birds and excellent mounts, as fast as horses with great endurance. They can kick attackers with powerful legs. You get a breeding pair.
name: Yellow Chocobo

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:holy)(Tag:large-size)(Tag:resource)"Holy Cow!" is a large, healthy female cow that always lactates 10 to 50 liters of milk per day depending on feeding. Her nutrient-dense milk has great health benefits and quality, and works as low-quality holy water against the unholy. Her children mostly inherit her genes and holy blessing.
name: Holy Cow

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:large-size)(Tag:resource)(Tag:worker)(Character)Cathyl is a minotaur towering over humans, 10x stronger than a grown person with exceptional stamina. Experienced in farming and ranching, she suits heavy labour. She naturally lactates very nutritious, rich, tasty milk.
name: Cathyl

description: #(Tag:electric)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:golem)(Tag:large-size)A hulking magically animated iron armor tough enough to withstand dragons and warriors. It smashes boulders with surprising agility, and its weapon releases bolts and arcs of lightning with each swing.
name: Dragonslayer Armor

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:non-combatant)(Tag:worker)(Character)A simple lifelike doll animated by eldritch means with no powers or combat ability. She is fairly competent at caretaking. (No blood echoes or Bloodborne mechanics carry over)
name: The Doll

description: #(Tag:artisan)(Tag:character)(Tag:draconic)(Tag:magician)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:non-combatant)(Character)A draconic child of the painted world of Ariandel trained in creating "Painted Worlds". Given sufficiently powerful catalysts made into paint, she can create self-contained pocket worlds entered only through their paintings, with size and quality depending on paint potency, but she has little to no combat ability. (Note: She is not immortal)
name: Lady of Ariandel

description: #(Tag:fighter)(Tag:group)(Tag:healer)(Tag:holy)(Tag:large-size)Royal Sentinels are elite giant guards of the gods of Anor Londo, several times human height with proportionate strength. They wield armor, halberds, and wall-like shields, and can heal themselves. You start with 2 and gain more as you grow stronger.
name: Royal Sentinels

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:large-size)(Tag:mentor)(Tag:non-combatant)(Tag:reptilian)(Character)"The best dog" Miriel is an ancient sentient turtle ordained as pastor. Beyond his sturdy shell he has no notable powers, but is a skilled compassionate teacher in spiritual, emotional, and magical matters. He brings no miracles or spells from his world, but can guide study of your world's magic or any Grimoires you receive.
name: Miriel the Pastor of Vows

description: #(Tag:avian)(Tag:character)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:non-combatant)(Tag:small-size)(Character)Bucky is the Chicken Devil who can form devil contracts and heal through blood. Due to lack of fear toward chickens, he is weaker than a cat with no special abilities beyond Devil Physiology. (Cannot do Heart replacement)
name: Bucky

description: #(Tag:blaster)(Tag:mechanical)(Tag:ranger)(Tag:tech)(Tag:titanic-size)(Tech)THR 1000 - Earthmover is a titanic Supreme Machine and moving military base that razes cities, with a Lightning Spear eclipsing most nuclear weapons and a forcefield that withstands its own spears. It also carries missile platforms, giant autocannons, laser cannons, a livable small city on its back, and repair drones. It requires sunlight and blood to function, with ammunition and blood reserves refueled every 24 hours.
name: Earthmover

description: #(Tag:aquatic)(Tag:blaster)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:titanic-size)The Leviathan is a Supreme Demon fused from flesh of the sullen at the bottom of the River Styx. Its huge body resists most conventional weapons except at its weak spot. It wields immense strength and Hell energy for explosive orbs and mouth lasers.
name: Flesh Leviathan

description: #(Tag:fighter)(Tag:mechanical)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:ranger)(Tag:tech)(Tech)Swordsmachine is a greater machine that rebuilt itself from scrap, including its own sword. Renowned for fighting hell's denizens, it can build basic tech from scrap and fights with a durable body, shotgun arm, and motorized sword wielded with finesse. It is powered and fueled by blood.
name: Swordsmachine

description: #(Tag:blaster)(Tag:flying)(Tag:mechanical)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:tech)(Tag:teleporter)(Tech)The Mindflayer is a Greater Machine well-adapted to hell's ecology. It harnesses Hell Energy for explosive orbs and laser beams, and can levitate and teleport short distances.
name: Mindflayer

description: #(Tag:blaster)(Tag:flying)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:large-size)(Tag:ranger)Geryon, the Watcher of the Skies, is a Supreme Demon amalgam of numerous demons whose consciousnesses act in tandem. With great physical abilities, Hell Energy lasers and explosives, and a bow of flesh, he is an efficient hunter and combatant.
display_name: 388. Geryon the Watcher of the Skies
name: Geryon the Watcher of the Skies

description: #(Tag:infernal)(Tag:reality-bender)(Tag:space)(Tag:titanic-size)That's right, it's Hell itself, all of it, localized within your Familiar Space. Hell is a supermassive hyperintelligent sentient dimension and organism created by the Heavenly God, with 9 layers it freely shapes and controls, filled with sinners, demons, machines, and husks. It can open gates to drag beings in or release demons, and as an afterlife can pull in souls that died in the current dimension.
name: Hell

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:character)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:small-size)(Character)Puss is an anthropomorphic cat in his signature boots, belt, hat, and rapier. Agile, strong for his size, and skilled with blades, he is a formidable combatant. He has 9 lives, restoring to full condition upon a mortal wound at the cost of one life.
name: Puss

description: #(Tag:avian)(Tag:beast)(Tag:equine)(Tag:insectoid)(Tag:large-size)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:reptilian)(Tag:small-size)You gain one male and one female of every animal alive at the time of the Ark's construction. If any species drops below 2, another pair spawns.
name: Noah's Menagerie

description: #(Tag:draconic)(Tag:evolving)(Tag:flying)(Tag:massive-size)(Tag:poison)Gore Magala is a Demi Elder Dragon with six limbs and considerable strength. Blind, it senses via heat and scattered pollen-like scales that pollute the air. This pollen carries the Frenzy Virus, driving bestial beings berserk and blocking natural healing in humanoids for a time; fed enough high-quality prey, it metamorphoses into Shagaru Magala after some time.
name: Gore Magala

description: #(Tag:breeding)(Tag:draconic)(Tag:flying)(Tag:massive-size)(Tag:poison)Shagaru Magala is the mature Elder Dragon form of Gore Magala, with immense strength and six limbs. It scatters pollen-like scales to perceive surroundings and inflict the Frenzy Virus via scales and breath, driving bestial creatures berserk and blocking natural healing in humanoids. Its scales can cover its roost mountain, and in compatible hosts act as eggs to spawn infants.
name: Shagaru Magala

description: #(Tag:instance-familiar)(Tag:resource)The dastardly Nick O' Teen is a nicotine-addicted supervillain who pushes smoking on others. When summoned he arrives, hands everyone a pack of cigarettes, then leaves. 24-hour cooldown.
name: Nick O' Teen

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:group)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:ranger)(Tag:worker)(Character)Your own gang of Goons and Mooks, all roughly middle-aged Italian men with varying proficiencies in barehanded fighting, pipes, and ranged weapons. They are not very smart but very loyal. You start with 100 Goons/Mooks and gain more as you grow stronger. Reference: https://fallenaces.wiki.gg/wiki/Category:Enemies#Gangster_enemies-0
name: The Fallen Aces

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:small-size)An appropriately sized common rat.
name: Rodent of Usual Size

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:medium-size)An unusually large rat, strong enough to maim a grown person.
name: Rodent of Unusual Size

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:poison)(Tag:small-size)An otherwise normal gnarly glowing green rat constantly emitting harmful radiation surpassing radium or enriched uranium.
name: Cancerous Rodent

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:fire)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:informant)(Tag:light)(Tag:linked)(Tag:medium-size)(Character)Mythra and Pyra are a Legendary Blade created from a Core Crystal, wielding the Aegis Blade with Light and Fire elements. Mythra offers short-range precognition, Light manipulation, and speed, while Pyra offers destructive firepower; they are alternate forms of one entity, only one out at once. As a Blade they grant their Driver a portion of abilities and armament when manifested, drain user energy to act, and scale with user strength and bond. (No core revival or Pneuma)
name: Mythra and Pyra

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:linked)(Tag:martial-artist)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:water)(Character)Aegaeon is a Legendary Blade from a Core Crystal bound to their Driver, wielding a Chroma Katana with the Water Element. He excels in swordsmanship and physical ability. He grants his Driver a portion of abilities and armament when manifested, requires user energy, and scales with user strength and bond.
name: Aegaeon

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:fire)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:linked)(Tag:medium-size)(Character)Brighid is a Legendary Blade from a Core Crystal bound to their Driver, wielding twin Blade Whips with the Fire Element. Having lived countless years, she brings great wisdom, skill, and Fire mastery. She grants her Driver a portion of abilities and armament when manifested, requires user energy, and scales with user strength and bond.
name: Brighid

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:character)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:large-size)(Tag:linked)(Tag:water)(Character)Dromarch is a Blade from a Core Crystal bound to their Driver, wielding Twin Rings with the Water Element. He combines powerful physique, healing, and Water mastery, and can be ridden as a mount. He grants his Driver a portion of abilities and armament when manifested, requires user energy, and scales with user strength and bond.
name: Dromarch

description: #(Tag:blaster)(Tag:character)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:fire)(Tag:linked)(Tag:martial-artist)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:ranger)(Character)Perdido is a Special Blade from a Core Crystal bound to their Driver, wielding a Decimation Cannon with the Fire Element. He brings great physical ability, weapon mastery, and Fire control. He grants his Driver a portion of abilities and armament when manifested, requires user energy, and scales with user strength and bond.
name: Perdido

description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:character)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:linked)(Tag:medium-size)(Character)Zenobia is a Rare Blade from a Core Crystal bound to their Driver, wielding a Greataxe with the Wind Element. She has great physical ability and wind use, and grows stronger the more wounded she is as a berserker. She grants her Driver a portion of abilities and armament when manifested, requires user energy, and scales with user strength and bond.
name: Zenobia

description: #(Tag:biokinetic)(Tag:character)(Tag:healer)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:linked)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:water)(Character)Nia is a Legendary Flesh Eater Blade, a living Gormotti-Blade hybrid with the water element and Catalyst Scimitar. She has enhanced physical ability, water control, and Biokinesis to regenerate, drain life, or invert regeneration on opponents. She acts independently or links with a Driver for shared power fueled by their energy.
name: Nia

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:character)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:flying)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:large-size)(Character)Zod is an Apostle tied to the God Hand, with inhuman strength, agelessness, and regeneration. Long-lived and proficient in both "human" and "Apostle" forms, he tears steel easily and resists conventional weapons. In Apostle form he can also fly.
name: Nosferatu Zod

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:blaster)(Tag:character)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:magician)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:trickster)(Character)The Mizune Family are 5 near-identical mice witches who shift freely between mice and human forms. They excel at stealth and espionage, firing straight lasers via Beam Whiskers. They can merge into stronger forms depending on how many combine.
name: Mizune Family

description: #(Tag:aquatic)(Tag:character)(Tag:fire)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:mental)(Character)Eruka is a Witch Frog shifting freely between frog and woman forms. She wields Tadpole Bombs for offense and masterful Calculation Magic rivaling supercomputers, enabling incredibly precise casting of other spells.
name: Eruka Frog

description: #(Tag:immortal)(Tag:incorporeal)(Tag:meta)(Tag:shapeshifter)The Greater Chaomorph is a formless information-based entity from an infinitesimal fragment of the Nuclear Chaos. It can take the form of any Uncommon-rank or lower familiar best suited to its duties, but has no abilities in base form. If it dies, it revives within 24 hours.
name: Chaomorph

description: #(Tag:immortal)(Tag:incorporeal)(Tag:meta)(Tag:shapeshifter)The Greater Chaomorph is a formless information-based entity from an infinitesimal fragment of the Nuclear Chaos. It can take the form of any Elite-rank or lower familiar best suited to its duties, but has no abilities in base form. If it dies, it revives within 24 hours.
name: Greater Chaomorph

description: #(Tag:immortal)(Tag:incorporeal)(Tag:meta)(Tag:shapeshifter)A fragment of the Faceless God forged as a familiar. It can transform into any Legendary-rank or lower familiar at will, but has no abilities in base form. It revives 1 hour after death.
name: Faceless One

description: #(Tag:informant)(Tag:instance-familiar)This familiar manifests as a nondescript phone to call the Investigator. Describe a target whose appearance and face you know, and he will investigate with regular-human stats plus Expert Spycraft and Expert Stealth. You can request updates or give other orders via the phone.
name: Investigator

description: #(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:reptilian)(Tag:tactician)(Tag:worker)No no, you read that right. This reptile masters the free market and stock speculation. Leave money with him and it is in the right hands... claws... maw?
name: Investinggator

description: #(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:reptilian)(Tag:trickster)No no, you read that right. This otherwise ordinary alligator masters provocation and conflict, easily enraging individuals or groups.
name: Instiggator

description: #(Tag:informant)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:reptilian)No no, you read that right. This otherwise ordinary alligator masters interrogation, coaxing truth from people by any means.
name: Interroggator

description: #(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:reptilian)(Tag:tactician)No no, you read that right. This reptile masters litigation and attorney work, well-read in your world's laws. It may struggle representing you in court as a regular reptile.
name: Litiggator

description: #(Tag:informant)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:reptilian)No no, you read that right. This regular alligator masters navigation with excellent direction. Give it a map and compass and it can almost certainly guide you where needed.
name: Naviggator

description: #(Tag:artisan)(Tag:breeding)(Tag:insectoid)(Tag:small-size)(Tag:worker)This massive ant colony masters carpentry, skilled, hardworking, and talented. Given wood and materials, they can build a house in a day and expand by recycling wood waste. Large enough, they can build a town in a day.
name: Carpenter Ants

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:informant)(Tag:small-size)Otherwise known as a Bloodhound, it is a regular purebred St. Hubert Jura Hound known for exceptional smell.
name: Hubert Jura Hound

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:dark)(Tag:small-size)Despite their grandiose name, the Four Dark Devas of Destruction are 4 quirky, well-trained hamsters with unique personalities.
name: Four Dark Devas of Destruction
