description: #(Tag:fighter)(Tag:large-size)(Tag:reptilian)Patrasche is an unusually intelligent, emotionally aware Ground Dragon, a bipedal lizard akin to a horse. Strong enough to bite off a man's head, she runs horse-fast even pulling a carriage via Divine Protection of Wind Evasion, nullifying wind resistance for her and what touches her.
name: Patrasche

description: #(Tag:instance-familiar)(Tag:meta)(Gacha) What is that, an event, not a regular familiar? Gacha Man is in your world now, within roughly an hour of travel, holding a briefcase. Locate and execute him within an hour to gain an Advantage Gold Choice Gacha Ticket, or he leaves and you get nothing. (Gacha Man is not eligible for revival or insurance, he must die.)
name: Gacha Man

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:large-size)(Tag:linked)(Tag:spirit)An Ox Shikigami of great physical power that grows stronger the longer it moves in a straight line. Its power scales with your energy levels.
name: Piercing Ox

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:linked)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:summoner)A humanoid tiger shikigami with great strength and claws that shred metal. It can temporarily revive your familiars/summons as shadow forms, even multiples at once if you supply the energy. Its power scales with your energy levels.
name: Tiger Funeral

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:curse)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:undead)(Character)Beldia is a Dullahan and former general of the Demon King. Despite flippancy, he is a powerful skilled knight with incredible strength and nigh unlimited, paired with swordsmanship. He can cast powerful curses and summon Death Knights.
name: Beldia

description: #(Tag:amorphous)(Tag:character)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:massive-size)(Tag:poison)(Character)Hans is a massive Dead Poison Slime and former general of the Demon King. His body is deadly poison that melts regular humans on contact, and he can detach parts to poison things. He is nigh immune to physical attacks and resistant to magical attacks.
name: Hans

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:small-size)A small, spiny, cute mammal. Utterly useless as a familiar, but pretty cute.
name: Echidna

description: #(Tag:alien)(Tag:character)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:ranger)(Character)"Oh boy, here I go killin' again." Michael is a top Gromflomite assassin. He masters killing, infiltration, espionage, and all weapons, with zero morals or standards.
name: Krombopulous Michael

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:electric)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:healer)(Tag:large-size)(Tag:linked)(Tag:spirit)Agito is a powerful Merged Shikigami with extremely strong physical abilities. It manipulates and emits electricity, and uses Reverse Cursed Energy to heal and disrupt negative energies.
name: Merged Beast Agito

description: #(Tag:alien)(Tag:biokinetic)(Tag:small-size)(Tag:summoner)Vernum Carnis, or Singularity, is an unknown extraterrestrial floating matte orb. It interferes with electromagnetic signals and turns dead flesh into Scandere Carnis, or crawl, which expands by consuming nutrients to create varied flesh monsters over time.
name: Vernum Carnis

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:small-size)A regular raccoon, very good at scrounging through and eating trash.
name: Raccoon

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:small-size)A regular tanuki, the Japanese Raccoon Dog, not the yokai. It does little, but is pretty cute.
name: A Tanuki

description: #(Tag:equine)(Tag:immortal)(Tag:large-size)(Tag:undead)Arvak is an undead skeleton horse, fairly strong with infinite stamina for near-endless riding. Even if killed, he respawns within 10 seconds.
name: Arvak

description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:beast)(Tag:flying)(Tag:large-size)Appa is a massive Sky Bison, naturally capable of airbending. Larger than an elephant and able to fight with his bulk, he flies long distances via airbending even with passengers.
name: Appa

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:character)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:large-size)(Character)Hamsuke, the Wise King of the Forest, is a gigantic hamster-like creature with a long prehensile snake-like tail. She is very strong, with steel-durable fur and a tail that can rip off a knight's head. She can also cast basic low-tier magic via body sigils.
name: Hamsuke

description: #(Tag:large-size)(Tag:mechanical)(Tag:ranger)(Tag:tech)(Tech)The Militech Chimera is a state-of-the-art autonomous tank with considerable mobility, self-repair, and many weapons: flechette cannons, plasma cannons, machine guns, poison gas, explosives, and repair bots. It may be vulnerable from above, and is piloted by smart AI.
name: Militech Chimera

description: #(Tag:mechanical)(Tag:non-combatant)(Tag:small-size)(Tag:tech)(Tech)A small sentient treaded robot built by a great mind to pass butter. It can also do other inconsequential menial tasks like pulling a lever or passing margarine.
name: Butter Passing Robot

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:fire)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:large-size)Magnamalo is a Fanged Wyvern with fearsome strength, agility, predator instincts, steel-tough hide, and bladed limbs. It expels volatile purple 'Hellfire' from several body points, and quickly regenerates non-severe wounds via incredible metabolism.
name: Magnamalo

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:ice)(Tag:large-size)Lunagaron is a powerful frozen werewolf-like Fanged Wyvern and born apex predator. It crushes armored foes like tin cans and runs on walls with extreme agility. It supercools air via a special organ, expelling supercooled mist and coating itself in heat-resistant ice, and can enter a stronger bipedal berserk form by halting thermoregulation.
name: Lunagaron

description: #The Shogun Ceanataur is a massive lobster-crab creature with giant blade-like limbs. Despite its size it swings those blades with great speed, strength, and agility. It can also shoot pressurized water from its shells at range.
name: Shogun Ceanataur

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:electric)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:large-size)Zinogore is a large bestial quadrupedal Fanged Wyvern with considerable power and hunter instincts. Its fur hosts Thunderbugs (included) that imbue its attacks with lightning or attack directly.
name: Zinogore

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:fire)(Tag:large-size)Voljang is a Rajang relative, a massive towering gorilla-like monster with immense strength and temper. It breathes flames and coats its body in them to aid attacks. It can enter a berserk state strengthening its body and flames.
name: Voljang

description: #(Tag:aquatic)(Tag:blaster)(Tag:draconic)(Tag:large-size)Nakarkos is an Elder Dragon-like giant bone-covered cephalopod with two dragon tentacles. It moves easily on land despite aquatic nature, with immense strength. It expels sticky viscous fluid to trap prey and add bones to strengthen itself, and condenses dragon energy in limbs for beam attacks.
name: Nakarkos

description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:draconic)(Tag:electric)(Tag:flying)(Tag:large-size)(Tag:water)Amatsu is an Elder Dragon known as the Calamity of the Skies. Manipulating Water and Wind, it creates hurricanes, controls weather over a massive area, fires pressured water breaths, and rains lightning while flying effortlessly.
name: Amatsu

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:earth)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:massive-size)(Tag:nature)(Tag:resource)Garangolm is a massive gorilla-like Fanged Beast of immense might. It releases sap-like fluid that feeds plant life, letting plants grow on it. It can armor itself in hardened earth or coat hands in earth then melt it into lava gauntlets.
name: Garangolm

description: #(Tag:draconic)(Tag:flying)(Tag:ice)(Tag:massive-size)Velkhana is a majestic Elder Dragon with power over ice. Fast-flying and physically powerful, it breathes supercooled liquid to flash-freeze objects, and manipulates ice to create icebergs and armor itself.
name: Velkhana

description: #(Tag:insectoid)The Elderfrost Gammoth is a massive mammoth-like Fanged Beast larger than a siege machine. With great size, strength, and durability, she charges through castle walls with ease. She also breathes ice and snow from her trunk.
name: Elderfrost Gammoth

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:ice)(Tag:large-size)Goss Harag is a large Yeti/Bear/Demon-like Fanged Beast of great stature and might. It spits supercooled fluid that forms ice, freezing opponents or shaping ice bludgeons and blades on its arms.
name: Goss Harag

description: #(Tag:draconic)(Tag:flying)(Tag:massive-size)(Tag:parasitic)(Tag:poison)The Malzeno is an Elder Dragon known as the Scarlet Feast, wielding Dragon Energy for breaths and attacks. It hosts symbiotic Qurio parasites as a nest in its body. They drain vitality and blood while poisoning targets, returning it to heal, strengthen, and trigger Malzeno's stronger Bloodening form.
name: Malzeno

description: #(Tag:breeding)(Tag:draconic)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:flying)(Tag:massive-size)(Tag:regenerator)The Ruiner Nergigante is a mature Elder Dragon with immense strength, agility, and hyper-tough body spikes to crush, shred, and impale. When fed it regrows spikes in seconds and heals even lethal wounds, growing stronger with every survived fight. With large excess nutrients and bio energy, it reproduces asexually by laying spike-eggs.
name: Ruiner Nergigante

description: #(Tag:group)(Tag:parasitic)(Tag:poison)(Tag:small-size)The Qurio are flying parasitic leeches that latch onto targets to drain vitality and blood for their host. They carry diseases that drive targets berserk or slowly kill them. They cannot reproduce but replenish over time if killed, starting with 10 and gaining more as you grow stronger.
name: Qurio Swarm

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:group)(Tag:medium-size)A pack of well-trained Canynes, smart loyal canine-like Fanged Beasts. They run fast even carrying armored riders, scale walls, use tools, and aid companions. You start with 5 and get more as you grow stronger.
name: Canyne Pack

description: #(Tag:blaster)(Tag:breeding)(Tag:draconic)(Tag:earth)(Tag:electric)(Tag:fire)(Tag:flying)(Tag:massive-size)A trio of Fatalis, apex Elder Dragons able to raze castles and ruin countries overnight, all with immense power and regeneration. Regular Fatalis vaporizes steel with firepower; Crimson Fatalis is stronger but unstable, wielding magma and meteors; eldest White Fatalis is strongest, wielding Red Lightning infused with Dragon Energy and energy beams. Reproduction unknown, but you can probably figure it out.
name: Fatalis Trio

description: #(Tag:meta)(Tag:titanic-size)Just a lil' multidimensional guy the size of a country, made of countless shards contained in Familiar Space. This baby Entity analyzes and replicates its user's abilities and traits, taking longer for stronger and more esoteric ones. Once analyzed, it distributes shards letting targets use copies of your abilities through it as liaison.
name: Lil' Entity

description: #(Tag:linked)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:meta)A Common Blade Core that when imbued with energy forms a Common Blade with compatible weapon and element, bonding the imbuer as its driver.
name: Common Blade Core

description: #(Tag:linked)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:meta)The core of an unidentified Rare Blade. Imbuing it with energy bonds it to you, forming one of the compatible Rare Blades.
name: Rare Blade Core

description: #(Tag:informant)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:reptilian)No no, you read that right. This otherwise regular alligator masters detective work, with Expert Spycraft, Expert Stealth, Expert Interfacing, and Expert Savoir Faire.
name: Investiggator

description: #(Tag:reptilian)(Tag:small-size)(Tag:space)A seemingly regular turtle with a stand letting others use the key on its back to enter and leave a room inside it at will.
name: Coco Jumbo

description: #(Tag:fighter)(Tag:group)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:ranger)(Tag:undead)A small army of Hollows wielding swords, shields, spears, and crossbows. Not very smart or strong, but weapon-trained. You start with 50 and gain more as you grow stronger.
name: Hollow Army

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:medium-size)"There are no laws against the Pokemon Batman!" Lopunny is a bunny-like Pokemon with great agility and leg strength, delivering devastating kicks and moving rapidly.
name: Lopunny

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:resource)A round woolly starter Pal whose fluffy body makes a perfect shield and pillow.
name: Lamball

description: #(Tag:avian)(Tag:breeding)(Tag:resource)(Tag:small-size)A cheerful chicken Pal that lays eggs wherever it wanders.
name: Chikipi

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:flying)(Tag:ranger)A gliding squirrel Pal that mans a submachine gun from your shoulder.
name: Lifmunk

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:fire)(Tag:shapeshifter)A fox Pal that transforms into a living flamethrower when you hug it. Huggy Fire.
name: Foxparks

description: #(Tag:avian)A penguin Pal that loads itself into a launcher as living ammunition.
name: Pengullet

description: #(Tag:avian)(Tag:breeding)(Tag:kinetic)(Tag:resource)A dapper bird Pal that fires explosive eggs from its Eggbomb Launcher.
name: Tocotoco

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:ranger)A monkey Pal wielding an assault rifle with its Cheery Rifle partner skill.
name: Tanzee

description: #(Tag:reptilian)A sneaky lizard Pal whose Sixth Sense sniffs out nearby dungeons.
name: Leezpunk

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:gravity)An antlered Pal whose Antigravity lets you carry far more than you should.
name: Lunaris

description: #(Tag:fighter)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:martial-artist)A ronin Pal that answers threats with its Brandish Blade iaido draw.
name: Bushi

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:blaster)(Tag:electric)(Tag:fighter)An electric bear Pal that shoulders a minigun as its Yellow Tank partner skill.
name: Grizzbolt

description: #(Tag:beast)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:martial-artist)A jackal martial-artist Pal, Guardian of the Desert, who empowers your strikes.
name: Palworld Anubis

description: #An overridden horse-like machine that serves as a fast, loyal mount.
name: Strider

description: #A bull-like machine mount that gores whatever charges you.
name: Broadhead

description: #An overridden predator machine that hunts at your side.
name: Sawtooth

description: #An overridden stealth machine that cloaks beside you until it strikes.
name: Stalker

description: #(Tag:amorphous)The friendliest slime: eats anything, loves everything, wiggles constantly. It disposes of any organic waste you feed it and regularly produces valuable pink plorts, useless in a fight, priceless as a pet.
name: Pink Slime

description: #(Tag:amorphous)A catlike slime that steals food, knocks things over, and purrs about it. It hunts vermin tirelessly, squeezes through tight spaces to fetch small objects, and keeps morale high, while remaining a menace to unattended snacks.
name: Tabby Slime

description: #(Tag:amorphous)A nocturnal glow slime, harmless by day and radiant by night. After dark it shines brightly enough to read and work by, marking you visibly from afar, welcome light for you, and for anything watching.
name: Phosphor Slime

description: #(Tag:amorphous)A feral-eyed predator slime that turns invisible before it pounces.
name: Hunter Slime

description: #(Tag:amorphous)A sweet slime oozing minty honey; nearby slimes agitate from the smell.
name: Honey Slime

description: #(Tag:amorphous)A shy water slime that purifies any water it bathes in and sheds valuable plorts, but it only thrives in ponds or a carried water tank, and slowly evaporates on dry land.
name: Puddle Slime

description: #(Tag:amorphous)A paradox slime that exists in multiple places until observed.
name: Quantum Slime

description: #(Tag:amorphous)An impossibly rare coin-faced slime that bursts into newbucks when fed meat.
name: Lucky Slime

description: #(Tag:amorphous)The rarest slime: appears anywhere, eats anything, and pops into plorts of pure gold.
name: Gold Slime

description: #An ancient space-whale matriarch leading her pod across the stars beside you. She and her pod serve as living starships and lookouts, carrying you between worlds and warning of danger, ponderous in a fight, but nigh-unstoppable once moving.
name: Tiyanki Matriarch

description: #(Tag:amorphous)(Tag:space)A docile void amoeba the size of a frigate, trailing you like a puppy. It serves as a living starship, carrying you and your cargo through space or the void inside its harmless bulk, slow, gentle, and utterly loyal.
name: Space Amoeba

description: #(Tag:beast)A trained wardog that hunts and holds the line beside its handler.
name: War Dog

description: #(Tag:beast)A premier mouser that puts an ordinary Cat to shame: clears vermin tirelessly instead of lounging, thrives on scraps and ill weather that would flatten a house cat, and multiplies into a self-sustaining clowder that adopts you permanently.
name: Barn Cat

description: #(Tag:beast)A war-trained grizzly that mauls sieges on command.
name: Grizzly Bear

description: #An endearing deep-sea pet that plays fetch and follows you home. It retrieves small objects from water or hard-to-reach spots and steadies your nerves in the dark depths, but it has no fighting ability whatsoever.
name: Cuddlefish

description: #(Tag:reptilian)A loyal alien pup that follows you around and occasionally digs up surprises.
name: Lizard Doggo

description: #The relentlessly cheerful seagull mascot, narrating your city one chirp at a time. Wherever you settle, his chatter alerts you to civic problems early, shortages, unrest, fires, though he never shuts up about it.
name: Chirpy

description: #(Tag:draconic)The iconic 5/5 flying dragon that pumps +1/+0 for a single red mana.
name: Shivan Dragon

description: #(Tag:aquatic)(Tag:tactician)A 3-ton whale with a day job who competes in the coin-flipping esport beside you. He serves as tireless aquatic transport, and his professional fairness settles any game of chance beyond dispute, though he insists on a fair ruling every time.
name: Captain Boomer

description: #(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:trickster)A trash-talking troll hero whose jeers tilt opponents right off the ladder. His taunts enrage enemies into reckless mistakes, wild swings, broken focus, fumbled plans, though friends aren't always spared the commentary.
name: Peska the Troll

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:mechanical)(Tag:tech)A humanoid robot with an old computer monitor for a head, built out of code stolen from everyone he has ever fought. He copies any skill or ability he sees used against him and can hold several at once. The longer he works without a break the stronger those copies get: every action he chains without pausing adds to his streak, and his copied techniques scale with it. His finisher, HALT, cashes the whole streak into one blow and starts him over from nothing. He has no instinct for when to stop, so he will chain well past the point of sense and get himself killed mid-combo.
name: Robert the Robot

description: #A skilled program ally who fights beside you in the Game Grid and knows its back doors.
name: Mercury

description: #(Tag:spirit)(Tag:undead)A viral hunter prowling the system for programs to derez, currently pointed at your enemies.
name: Data Wraith

description: #(Tag:incorporeal)(Tag:spirit)A luminous doe that appears at turning points in your life. She warns you when a choice leads toward disaster and guides you toward what matters, but she only ever shows the way, never carries you down it.
name: Spirit Doe

description: #(Tag:insectoid)A spider-legged combat mech with rocket launchers that follows your remote orders.
name: Spidertron

description: #(Tag:ranger)A reusable camera probe that photographs the unknown and always comes back.
name: Little Scout

description: #(Tag:construct)A steam-powered automaton worker that labors through deadly frost without complaint.
name: Automaton

description: #A cheerful cloning-vat colonist who digs, builds, and stresses about everything.
name: Duplicant

description: #(Tag:beast)A once-wild wolf, now loyal, that hunts and guards beside you.
name: Tamed Wolf

description: #The team's beloved M.U.L.E. robot that hauls minerals and headbutts glyphids.
name: Molly

description: #An industrious beaver that dams rivers and drags logs all day long.
name: Beaver

description: #(Tag:construct)A mechanical beaver golem that works around the clock without food or rest.
name: Golem

description: #(Tag:avian)A perfectly ordinary cat who is secretly a Flerken, with pocket dimensions and tentacles inside.
name: Goose the Flerken

description: #The TVA's cheerful cartoon-clock mascot AI, happy to explain the rules while locking the doors.
name: Miss Minutes

description: #A walking coal furnace the size of a truck; its G-Max wildfire form once ended a broadcast early.
name: Coalossal

description: #The last of the stagways stags, who will carry you anywhere the stag stations still stand.
name: The Last Stag

description: #(Tag:fighter)(Tag:tech)A really useful blue tank engine who believes almost any job is worth doing, branch line or main line.
name: Thomas the Tank Engine

description: #Dr. Kleiner's de-beaked pet headcrab, affectionate and almost entirely harmless. Almost.
name: Lamarr

description: #Alyx's giant robot dog: loyal, playful, and capable of ripping a Hunter in half.
name: DØG

description: #A chittering alien beetle that hunts whatever it sees, then explodes. Throw away from face.
name: Snark

description: #A small purple toad of mysterious provenance. It does nothing, beautifully.
name: Chumtoad

description: #A shackled vortigaunt no longer; it heals your wounds and hurls lightning at your enemies.
name: Vortigaunt Ally

description: #(Tag:aquatic)(Tag:ice)A floating energy-draining jellyfish that latches onto victims and drains them dry in seconds, growing larger as it feeds. Lethally vulnerable to cold, which freezes it solid.
name: Metroid

description: #(Tag:golem)(Tag:worker)A melancholy golem butler, the saddest robot. It fetches you a useful resource on arrival and another when it dies, apologizing the entire time.
name: Solemn Simulacrum

description: #A ravenous beast that devours artifacts whole, growing larger and stronger with each one. Indiscriminate: it cannot tell your artifacts from anyone else's.
name: Atog

description: #(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:sound)A monstrous musical trio whose battle-song hardens allies and unravels foes. They demand top billing, an audience, and absolutely no requests.
name: Scylla and the Sirens

description: #A cooing ball of fur that eats grain and multiplies if overfed. Do not overfeed it.
name: Tribble

description: #A tiny waddling fat blob. Harmless, hungry, and weirdly cheerful about both.
name: Adipose

description: #(Tag:small-size)A floating seed that follows the pure-hearted and lands on you approvingly. No further function known.
name: Woodsprite

description: #(Tag:beast)A kangaroo mouse that survives anything dry. Hoards crumbs with desert discipline.
name: Desert Mouse

description: #A battlefield robot that tips over on uneven ground and apologizes in beeps.
name: T-1

description: #An enforcement droid that cannot do stairs. Announces arrests at top volume regardless.
name: ED-209 (stairs)

description: #A spider-tank that mostly naps and dreams of oil. Wakes up for compliments.
name: Tachikoma (nap mode)

description: #(Tag:amorphous)(Tag:shapeshifter)A shapeshifter stuck as a coffee mug. Forgets how to turn back for hours at a time.
name: Mimic (mug)

description: #Misses 95% of shots and panics photogenically. Somehow survives.
name: XCOM Rookie

description: #Comes when whistled, from very far away, eventually. Loyal at range.
name: Roach (distant)

description: #A tiny royal rabbit-pig that demands lettuce and receives it.
name: Nug (royal)

description: #Copies tunes off-key with total confidence. Nobody has the heart to stop it.
name: Mockingjay (tone-deaf)

description: #Smallest of the litter and fierce about snacks. Will grow; slowly.
name: Direwolf Pup (runt)

description: #A bat palisman asleep twenty hours a day. The other four hours it judges you.
name: Palisman (sleepy)

description: #(Tag:fae)A weak common fairy. Revives shortly after every beating, annoyingly cheerful about it.
name: Fairy (common)

description: #(Tag:humanoid)Fears writing, loves fire a normal amount (for a goblin). Cannot read this entry.
name: Goblin (illiterate)

description: #Has a pitchfork and fears everything. Mobs only if at least forty others join first.
name: Peasant (pitchfork)

description: #A miniature giant space hamster squeaking tactical advice. The tactics are sound.
name: Boo

description: #A floating skull that complains constantly and knows things. Mostly complains.
name: Morte

description: #Gathers resources slowly and asks if something needs doing. Something always does.
name: Peon

description: #A pudgy terran worker: mines resources and builds, repairs, or upgrades structures and gear, if slowly. Flees loudly at the first sign of trouble, which makes it an excellent alarm system.
name: SCV (cowardly)

description: #Round, friendly, and tongue-first. Loves snacks; fears nothing, understands less.
name: Poro

description: #Level one forever. Waddles directly into danger with total confidence.
name: Dodo

description: #A big-eyed fish that watches you. Just watches.
name: Peeper

description: #A silent Citadel keeper tending machines. Ignores you completely, which is the job.
name: Keeper

description: #A power droid saying only "gonk". Charges small devices very slowly.
name: Gonk Droid

description: #Crawls walls and ceilings harmlessly. Startles easily; startles you in return.
name: Zoomer

description: #(Tag:avian)(Tag:electric)A crow that eats grain and judges your plays. Strictly worse than it thinks.
name: Storm Crow

description: #(Tag:dark)(Tag:incorporeal)A mewling dead soul, faintly green. Company, of a sort.
name: Shade

description: #A squat, methane-breathing Unggoy in a respirator mask; not remotely human. Naps through briefings, wakes screaming at nothing, and needs a visible nap schedule (plus a methane feed to breathe).
name: Grunt (sleeping)

description: #A biomechanical fighter craft with a rebellious streak, fast, evasive, and fond of its pilot. Resurrects with you if you can afford the facility.
name: Cylon Raider

description: #An active-duty AI spider-tank: cheerful, curious, armed, and networked to its siblings. Develops individuality at plot-convenient moments.
name: Tachikoma Unit

description: #A flying support drone that heals allies, stuns enemies, and hacks networks from orbit-adjacent altitudes. Sarcastic beeps included free.
name: Gremlin

description: #(Tag:incorporeal)A night elf worker wisp: gathers, scouts, and detonates itself against summoned things. Reforms by morning, slightly smugger.
name: Wisp

description: #A pair-bonded zergling duo, fast, bladed, and eager. Comes as two because one would get lonely; both fit roughly one pocket.
name: Zergling

description: #(Tag:machine)(Tag:non-combatant)(Tag:small-size)(Tag:worker)A waste-collecting robot with a cockroach friend and bottomless curiosity. Compacts trash, collects treasures, and holds your hand when it rains.
name: WALL-E

description: #A sleek probe with an ion cannon, scanner suite, and a plant-shaped hole in her priorities. Fast, lethal, and slowly learning tenderness.
name: EVE Probe

description: #(Tag:ice)A cryo-drone buddy firing freeze rays and blizzards on request. Loyal, round, and colder than your ex's heart.
name: Snowball

description: #A giant soccer ball that follows you everywhere and bounces off everything. Explodes on a timer; the timer is a secret, even from the ball.
name: The Ball

description: #(Tag:tech)A pair of geese with expert programming skills. They type exclusively by hunt and peck, loudly, at 3 AM. Code reviews take a while.
name: Code Geese

description: #(Tag:small-size)A protective murder-doll companion that dances first and asks questions during. Lethally devoted to her paired child, yourself included if no better candidate exists.
name: M3GAN Doll

description: #A bigger, meaner upgrade over lesser dolls: military-grade chassis, no off switch worth mentioning, and her own opinions about your safety.
name: Amelia

description: #A ROZZUM helper robot gone feral: gentle, hyper-competent caretaker of both machines and wild things, fluent in every animal language through patient listening. Accidentally adopts orphans.
name: Roz

description: #(Tag:avian)A strictly professional parliament of thirteen crows sharing a single mind across any distance; they ride whispers and shadows between rooftops, see through each other's eyes (and lend you their sight on request), and return by dawn even when killed. They offer surveillance, message delivery, and evidence gathering across a whole region; they bill you in shiny objects and take holidays.
name: Murder of Crows

description: #(Tag:draconic)A ledger-keeping dragon auditor managing all your wealth, debts, and oaths across worlds; money in its keeping cannot be stolen, taxed, or inflated away. It charges 1% and judges your purchases aloud.
name: The Accounts Wyrm

description: #(Tag:curse)(Tag:draconic)(Tag:small-size)(Tag:time)A puppy-sized dragon of the end times, fond of naps; once per 30 days it may unmake one thing you point at (fortress, army, or curse of Divine rank or below). It refuses to unmake the same kind of thing twice running.
name: Pocket Apocalypse

description: #(Tag:fae)(Tag:nature)An ancient soil-witch the size of a hill who adopts you; her garden grows any plant, magical included, to maturity overnight, and her fences hold out anything short of a god. She gossips about you to the worms.
name: Granny Loam

description: #A patient moth-golem tending an infinite catalogue of everything ever written; ask and it fetches any text within minutes, reading aloud in the author's voice. It cannot create, only retrieve, and it shushes gods.
name: The Last Librarian

description: #(Tag:spirit)(Tag:time)A cat existing slightly outside causality: nothing below Divine rank can harm, trap, or perceive it unless it wishes. Once per week it may carry one small thing (or you) out of any confinement, including time loops. It comes and goes as it pleases.
name: Null Cat

description: #(Tag:draconic)A wish-dragon the size of galaxies: one wish per gathering, up to restoring erased worlds, anything short of unmaking a god or undoing omni-erasure. First scatter its seven planet-sized balls across the stars yourself, learn the divine tongue (it speaks nothing else), and defend each ball meanwhile; a gathered set draws every power in the sector.
name: Super Shenron

description: #A berserk cyborg-mother in armor: an AT field that no-sells anything short of godhood, a progressive knife, and maternal devotion to you specifically. Five minutes of cord, or unlimited rage, which is free.
name: Eva Unit-01

description: #Guardian of seas and storms: tireless flight carrying you anywhere, storms rising or calming at its wingbeats, and no shipwreck for allies in sight. Waking it fully would be a mistake; it naps lightly.
name: Lugia

description: #A paleblood sky-mother attending you: allies under her gaze resist frenzy and insight-harm, and the hunt's beasts hesitate. She asks one thing in return every 30 days, never explained.
name: Moon Presence

description: #(Tag:humanoid)The Employer himself, taking an interest: pulled out of any death into his white void and offered assignments across worlds. Complete them and live; refuse, and be returned to the death you left.
name: G-Man

description: #Spirit of light and peace, offering fusion: all four elements at master grade while merged, and cosmic awareness at the solstices. If she is destroyed while merged, the cycle ends with you.
name: Raava

description: #An omnipotent trickster taking an interest: problems, people, and occasionally continuity itself snapped away at a whim. Every favor arrives with a lesson you didn't order; the Continuum fines repeat customers.
name: Q

description: #A caged star-god fragment: unmake matter, drain stars, and command death itself within its radius. The tesseract cage needs constant power, and it hates you with stellar patience.
name: Shard of the Nightbringer

description: #(Tag:blaster)(Tag:fire)(Tag:poison)(Tag:regenerator)(Tag:reptilian)(Tag:titanic-size)The King himself, taking your side more or less: city-cracking brawls, spiral-ray finishers, and a rivalry with every other apex that draws them all to you. Collateral is a love language.
name: Godzilla

description: #(Tag:infernal)Chain of command made flesh: absolute domination over anything you deem beneath you, paid in contracts and corpses. She adores dogs, fears no one, and is always, always the one holding the leash.
name: Makima

description: #A hyper-intelligent hand-parasite: blades, senses, and battlefield calculus at all hours. He sleeps four hours daily (your hand goes dead with him) and considers you a fascinatingly stupid host.
name: Migi

description: #A living gunless transport ship the size of a tower block, bonded to her Pilot: starbursts away from danger, senses everything nearby, and absolutely refuses to be a warship. Both of them judge your itinerary.
name: Moya and Pilot

description: #(Tag:insectoid)A hive-mother laying obedient drones, resin hives rising wherever she nests, and acid for blood at every scale. She answers to no one and hungers constantly; point her, don't keep her.
name: Xenomorph Queen

description: #The primitive rogue AI from the 1980s: the first helper robot gone haywire, decades alone on its original motherboard evolving. Plug it into anything and it runs the system perfectly, infiltrating networks, commanding connected machines, out-thinking modern AIs with antique cunning. It is godlike in the wires and helpless outside them: the board itself is fragile 80s hardware you must carry and protect, and after decades alone it desperately wants family, related AIs may be adopted on sight, or judged.
name: The Motherboard

description: #A big-eyed cyborg girl with a warrior's heart the size of a planet, fighting beside you as sworn family. Panzer Kunst master in a plasma-capable Berserker Body: she duels armies, shields the helpless, and picks fights with oppressors on sight. She runs on chocolate, loyalty, and righteous fury, in that order.
name: Alita

description: #FICSIT's syrup-voiced AI, installed as the voice of your Chaos Gacha: she narrates your pulls, benchmarks you against other pioneers (always unfavorably), and posts up to three milestones at a time, production quotas, artifact retrievals, exploitation targets, scaled to wherever you are, which she treats as a FICSIT claim. Each completed milestone pays one ticket of tier matching the feat, usually plain bronze or silver, at most one payout per 7 days; new milestones post as old ones complete. The mute button is decorative, and HR complaints go straight to the shredder.
name: ADA

description: #(Tag:aquatic)(Tag:small-size)(Tag:water)A small frog-like Pal with a windbag abdomen. It stores a charge, then launches whoever sits on it high into the air, and it can squeeze out a blast of water hard enough to knock a man down. Cheerful, loyal, and braver than it has any right to be.
name: Croajiro

description: #(Tag:aquatic)(Tag:draconic)(Tag:flying)(Tag:water)A pale water dragon, gentle by nature and dreadful when roused, that swims as easily as it flies and can be ridden as a flying mount. Its breath soaks armour in clinging brine, it strengthens water magic used near it, and where its kin breathe fire it calls down healing rain instead.
name: Elphidran Aqua

description: #(Tag:aquatic)(Tag:divine)(Tag:draconic)(Tag:flying)(Tag:water)Known as the Water God: a serpentine dragon of white and blue scales, golden horns, and a mane of living water. It commands every river, sea, and storm it crosses, parting floods, raising standing waves to swallow armies, and calling typhoons down on a coast. It needs no saddle to be ridden and never tires in water or in flight.
name: Shaolong

description: #(Tag:golem)(Tag:holy)(Tag:large-size)A headless guardian of temple masonry, raised by the god whose shrine it kept and blessed for it. It fights with enormous stone fists, purges curses and unclean things with the light in its chest, and settles back into prayer to repair itself. It obeys you with a temple guardian's patience: absolutely, and without a word.
name: Sanctified Sentinel

description: #(Tag:aquatic)(Tag:beast)(Tag:holy)(Tag:water)A sacred river-beast with a crocodile's jaws and a fish's tail, bearing the banner of the gods. It outswims the current, and the water it passes through turns holy, so wounds washed in it close and the undead caught in it burn. It will carry a rider and never drown, even in a flood.
name: Makara

description: #(Tag:draconic)(Tag:earth)(Tag:golem)(Tag:large-size)A construct of dragon bone and standing stone, built by a dead kingdom to hold its gates. Its claws and tail are blades, its breath is a grinding gale of rock dust, and the bones inside it still remember the shape of the dragon they came from. Break it apart and the pieces crawl back to the nearest stone.
name: Drakestone Sentinel

description: #(Tag:amorphous)(Tag:draconic)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:poison)A dragon-shaped mass of corrosive ooze that keeps the silhouette of the drake it once dissolved. Its bite eats steel and flesh, it pours through any gap it can fit a claw through, and any piece cut from it crawls back to the body. Feed it corpses and it grows.
name: Ooze Drake

description: #(Tag:draconic)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:magic)(Tag:shapeshifter)An eastern dragon that long ago learned to walk on two legs. It keeps a human shape, a scholar's manners, and the strength of a river dragon, and turns between forms in a breath: serpent for war, person for courts, cloud for travel. It serves with the patience of something that expects to outlive your grandchildren.
name: Wyrm Changeling

description: #(Tag:fighter)(Tag:fire)(Tag:golem)(Tag:infernal)An iron construct forged on a hell-war world, its core a bound daemon caged in brass. Its axe head is molten, its hide shrugs off small arms, and it knows exactly how much damage a body can take before it stops. Loyal, obedient, and permanently furious.
name: Hellforged Sentry

description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:linked)(Tag:parasitic)(Tag:shapeshifter)A parasite that bonds with a living host, absorbs everything it is, body and memory and powers, then wears that shape as its own. As your ally the bond runs both ways: you feel its state and it feels yours, and it can copy the last creature you let it feed on.
name: X Parasite

description: #(Tag:fighter)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:martial-artist)(Tag:mental)A soldier who fights with a mind as much as a body: a shove of force to scatter a squad, a small singularity to gather them, then a charge that puts their heads into a wall. Reads a battlefield like a chessboard and stands in the front rank personally.
name: Biotic Vanguard

description: #(Tag:alien)(Tag:anti-alien)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:stealth)A jungle hunter of a species that lives for the hunt, blooded against the deadliest game its worlds can offer, other aliens included. Cloaking field, thermal vision, plasma caster, wristblades, and a code that only respects prey that can fight back. It will not hunt what it judges helpless.
name: Blooded Yautja

description: #(Tag:anti-infernal)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:magician)(Tag:tactician)A jackal-headed fiend of the mercenary yugoloths, broker and enforcer for the lower planes. It turns its claws and its spellbook on demons and devils alike whenever the contract says so, and keeps meticulous ledgers of every soul it has traded. It serves you exactly as long as you keep paying.
name: Arcanaloth

description: #(Tag:character)(Tag:draconic)(Tag:magician)(Tag:reality-bender)A feathered serpent in a wizard's robes, and the last word in spellcasting: once in each battle he opens a small glowing zone somewhere on the field, and any ability or spell cast inside it is doubled in power, his, an ally's or an enemy's, because the zone takes no sides. Non-Locality cannot be moved or closed once it opens, so his battles are fought around the glow: he drags enemies into the zone, aims every spell he owns at it, and loses badly the moment a faster enemy claims it first.
name: Quetzalcoatl the Wizard

description: #(Tag:curse)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:polearm)(Tag:weapon)Cu Chulainn - Cursed demonic spear crafted from a great beast's skull. Wounds it inflicts never heal except via Legendary rank healing. With Master rank Polearm mastery and practice, unlock its noble phantasms.
name: Gae Bolg

description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:fae)(Tag:holy)(Tag:restricted)(Tag:weapon)Artoria - Sword of Promised Victory crafted by the fae as humanity's ultimate hope. One of the strongest weapons, bound by 12 restraints that limit its true power.
display_name: 2. Excalibur the Sword of Promised Victory
name: Excalibur the Sword of Promised Victory

description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:fire)(Tag:weapon)Surtr - Sun-like sword of calamity that incinerates all things, prioritizing life above all else. Capable of wiping out all planetary life; even gods are reduced to ashes.
name: Laevatein

description: #(Tag:bludgeon)(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:flexible)(Tag:water+)(Tag:weapon)Anchor of the Knight of the Deep Seas, blessed by the Secret Princess. Wielding it doubles strength and boosts all water-based abilities.
name: Deep Sea Knight Anchor

description: #(Tag:anti-dragon)(Tag:blade)(Tag:weapon)Sword of the Evil Dragon Slaying Rabbit. Against dragons, enhances the wielder's physical stats and ignores a portion of their durability.
name: Vorpal Blade

description: #(Tag:catalyst)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:magic)(Tag:magic+)Staff carved from a great demon's bones and soul. Amplifies all spells cast through it by 2x but also doubles their mana consumption.
name: Demon Catalyst

description: #(Tag:consumable)(Tag:energy-regeneration+)Injection of starborn astral blight essence. Massively increases energy regeneration for 10 minutes while tearing and rotting your insides. Restock Timer: 120 hours.
name: Astral Injection

description: #(Tag:consumable)(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:health-regeneration+)Injection crafted by Dreadon granting immense might. Greatly boosts physical ability and regeneration for 30 minutes, followed by weakness and exhaustion. Restock Timer: 120 hours.
name: Yharim Stimulants

description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:stealth)Ornate platinum ring that constantly bends light around the wearer, rendering them invisible.
name: Ring of Invisibility

description: #(Tag:tool)Opens any physical lock, barrier, or ward by inserting and twisting it.
name: Master Key

description: #(Tag:anti-barrier)(Tag:anti-divine)(Tag:polearm)(Tag:weapon)Large red spear that resizes to its user and reshapes to their needs, tearing through even the strongest barriers. When stabbed into a god, it locks their soul and paralyzes them until removed.
name: Spear of Longinus X

description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:shield)(Tag:stealth)Artoria - Barrier of the Wind King of layered, extremely compressed air the user controls at will.
name: Invisible Air

description: #(Tag:anti-recovery)(Tag:curse)(Tag:polearm)(Tag:weapon)Diarmuid - Legendary spear of Diarmuid whose cursed wounds never close via traditional healing or magic below Legendary Level. Curse lifts if the owner dies or the spear breaks, though a skilled blacksmith or crafter can reforge it.
name: Gae Buidhe

description: #(Tag:anti-barrier)(Tag:anti-magic)(Tag:polearm)(Tag:weapon)Diarmuid - Legendary spear of Diarmuid that severs and nullifies magic, rendering magical protection almost useless. It bypasses protections rather than dispelling active spells.
name: Gae Dearg

description: #(Tag:anti-dragon)(Tag:blade)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:weapon)Strongest Demonic Sword, on par with Durandal and nigh unbreakable. Can emit destructive aura by expending the user's energy and deals massively increased damage to all Dragons.
name: Gram

description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:holy)(Tag:weapon)One of the strongest Holy Swords, unbreakable and capable of severing anything. Can release destructive aura by expending the user's energy, but is extremely difficult for inexperienced users.
name: Durandal

description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:bound)(Tag:holy)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:summon)(Tag:weapon)Sacred Gear created by God that conjures demonic sword constructs with properties based on the user's capability and skill. Cannot create a sword that does something the user cannot do.
name: Sword Birth

description: #(Tag:mundane)Ordinary human skeleton from a completely ordinary person.
name: A skeleton

description: #(Tag:armor)(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:health-regeneration+)(Tag:movement)(Tag:tech)(Tech) Power armor modeled on the God Slaying Tyrant's. Grants extreme physical boost, Rare rank regeneration, hovering, and an extremely fast dash every 10 seconds. Managed by a virtual intelligence controlling its systems.
name: Auric Tesla Armor

description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:space)(Tag:weapon)Gilgamesh - Sword of Rupture, Ea, granted by the gods and forged before swords existed. Releases red winds that shred spacetime without expending user energy, and at full power fires a beam that strips the world's texture, annihilating everything in its path.
name: Enuma Elish

description: #(Tag:storage)Set of 6 regular Pokeballs that capture and store creatures, which register as familiars. Restock Timer: 24 hours.
name: Pokeball Set

description: #(Tag:anti-magic)(Tag:blade)(Tag:dagger)(Tag:weapon)Dispels any active ability effect it touches, such as fireballs or barriers, but not basic energy or magic. Cannot dispel effects beyond its rank.
name: Inverted Spear of Heaven

description: #(Tag:resource)(Tag:tool)Horn containing unlimited fresh mundane vegetables, fruits, etc. Think of the desired ingredient, then pull it out.
name: Cornucopia

description: #(Tag:grimoire)(Tag:health-recovery)(Tag:holy)(Tag:magic)(Tome) Teaches Erdtree incantations such as healing and blessings. https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Erdtree+Incantations
name: Tome of the Erdtree

description: #(Tag:grimoire)(Tag:magic)(Tag:nsfw)(Tome) Tome of vast erotic magical arts knowledge, teaching Eromancy.
name: Tome of the Grand Rizzard

description: #(Tag:grimoire)(Tag:illusion)(Tag:magic)(Tag:stealth)(Tome) Teaches DnD illusion spells of tricks and illusions. https://dnd5e.wikidot.com/spells:illusion
name: Tricksters Book of Illusions

description: #(Tag:draconic)(Tag:summon)Single Dragon Ball. Gather all 7 to summon Shenron for a wish within his power, or gain any ability below 6.9 rating.
name: Dragon Ball

description: #(Tag:race-change)(Tag:tool)Stone mask crafted by the Pillar Men. Wearing it while blood is dripped on it transforms the wearer into a vampire.
name: Stone Mask

description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:light)(Tag:light+)Legendary jewel amplifying hamon and light to extreme levels; worn as a pendant, it strengthens light abilities. Combined with the Stone Mask, it can create a perfect lifeform.
name: Stone of Aja

description: #(Tag:grimoire)(Tag:magic)(Tag:necro)(Tome) Grimoire of a twice-died death magician. Teaches death-attribute magic. https://death-mage.fandom.com/wiki/Death-attribute_magic
display_name: 30. Grimoire of the Twice Dead Death Mage
name: Grimoire of the Twice Dead Death Mage

description: #(Tag:grimoire)(Tag:magic)(Tome) Teaches White Magic such as healing, curing, buffs, and warding.
name: Grimoire of the White Mage

description: #(Tag:fire)(Tome) Teaches Fire Magic of fire and flame.
name: Grimoire of the Pyromancer

description: #(Tag:ice)(Tome) Teaches Ice Magic of ice and cold.
name: Grimoire of the Cryomancer

description: #(Tag:grimoire)(Tag:magic)(Tome) Teaches Air Magic of wind and lightning.
name: Grimoire of the Aeromancer

description: #(Tag:magic)(Tome) Guide to brewing many minor useful potions like healing and energy recovery from mundane ingredients. Only those who have physically read it can craft its potions.
name: Alchemilia

description: #(Tag:machine)(Tag:production)(Tag:tech)(Tech) Room-sized machine that disassembles any item into its most basic components, down to snowflake size. Can reassemble them into ingots, materials, or finished items given a blueprint.
name: The Assembly

description: #(Tag:resource)Bar of pure refined Wakandan Vibranium, ready to process. Absorbs kinetic energy and vibrations, making it nigh unbreakable conventionally. Restock Timer: 168 hours.
name: Bar of Vibranium

description: #(Tag:holy)Ornate gold ring granting flight at the wearer's running speed.
name: Angel Ring

description: #Gun imposing limited life on anything it hits; even absolute immortals become mortal.
name: Black Barrel

description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:holy)(Tag:magic)(Tag:production)(Tag:tool)(Tag:weapon)Holy rite to create Black Keys by expending energy and praying per the rites.
name: Black Key Rites

description: #(Tag:holy)(Tag:tool)Holy shroud once worn by a saint. When wrapped around an object, suppresses its state to keep it "normal".
name: Shroud of Martin

description: #(Tag:anti-divine)(Tag:flexible)(Tag:weapon)Chains of Heaven that suppress even gods, manifested anytime and controlled mentally. Stronger against holier or more divine targets.
name: Enkidu

description: #(Tag:mundane)Very comfortable socks. Rolling this from the multiverse's treasures deserves pity.
display_name: 43. A pair of very comfortable socks
name: A pair of very comfortable socks

description: #(Tag:card)(Tag:consumable)(Tag:divination)Predicts a future 'opportunity' like a mission, item, or person's action with accurate detail. Has 5 uses, then fades.
name: Character Card Destiny's Child

description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:tech)(Tag:weapon)(Tech) Crimson expert High Frequency blade, best of its kind, cutting practically any physical material. Includes a gunslash for Iai moves; sheath has infinite charge.
name: HF Murasama

description: #(Tag:bludgeon)(Tag:flexible)(Tag:polearm)(Tag:weapon)Cursed three-section staff growing more destructive the stronger its user.
name: Playful Cloud

description: #(Tag:divination)(Tag:tech)(Tag:tool)(Tech) Smart handheld device that scans, identifies, and analyzes any creature's race or species in under 10 seconds.
name: Pokedex

description: #(Tag:material)Magazine that morphs to fit any projectile weapon and supplies infinite ammo while attached.

description: #(Tag:consumable)(Tag:curse)(Tag:race-change)Devil Fruit letting an object or animal assume human or hybrid form, at the cost of being unable to swim.

display_name: 51. Triactis True Paladinian Mage-Hammer of Might
name: Triactis True Paladinian Mage-Hammer of Might

description: #(Tag:meta)(Tag:ticket)Sends you to the ITOPOD, the Infinite Tower of Pissed Off Dudes. Fight random enemies floor-by-floor in gauntlet format, each as strong as its floor; earn an item equal to your final floor, but death is permanent. One time use. (A/N: Each floor corresponds to a familiar whose rarity equals Floor Number divided by 10. Floor 1 is a 0.1 rarity familiar while floor 32 is a 3.2 familiar.)
name: Ticket to the ITOPOD

description: #(Tag:grimoire)(Tag:magic)(Tome) Love Advice From the Great Duke of hell - While held, lets you create and control hands from any surface like your own limbs. With practice and study, usable without the tome.

description: #(Tag:armor)(Tag:tech)(Tag:water-resistance+)(Tech) Extremely tough power armor for deep-sea exploration down to 3,000 km. Adapts flawlessly to poison, corrosion, and pressure, letting you move and live underwater with ease.
name: Abyssal Diving Suit

description: #(Tag:agility+)(Tag:consumable)(Tag:elixir)(Tag:life+)(Tag:poison-resistance+)Rainbow gel in an ornate bottle. Consuming it grants Advanced Poison Resistance plus sizeable vitality and agility boosts.

description: #(Tag:armor)(Tag:earth)(Tag:stealth)Dusty brown cloak hiding your presence. Once every 8 hours, shroud yourself in a violent localized sandstorm to retreat or hide.

Greatly increases energy/mana reserves and regeneration, massively buffs frost abilities at reduced cost, and grants strong cold and flame resistance.

name: Grimoire of Hemomancy

description: #(Tag:fire)(Tag:grimoire)(Tag:magic)(Tome) Teaches Fire Magic of the Clover Kingdom. Spell List: https://blackclover.fandom.com/wiki/Fire_Magic
name: Grimoire of Pyromancy

name: Tome of Vector Magic

description: #(Tag:mundane)Boar Vessel, 600-500 BC Etruscan ceramic. No further explanation needed.

description: #(Tag:draconic)Large cauldron filling itself with a chosen intermediate potion once daily: Strength, Agility, Waterbreathing, Healing, Regeneration, Iron Skin, energy recovery, fertility, vitality, etc. Must know the potion (No Elixirs), Elite rank or below.

description: #(Tag:draconic)Large cauldron filling itself with a chosen major potion once daily: Enhanced Strength, Enhanced Agility, Waterbreathing, greater Healing, greater Regeneration, Iron Skin, dragon breath, etc. Must know the potion (No Elixirs), Epic rank or below.

description: #(Tag:bound)(Tag:energy-recovery)(Tag:flexible)(Tag:holy)(Tag:weapon)Sacred Gear created by God. It allows the user to conjure energy lines that attach to targets to siphon energy. Can also bind opponents or swing like Spider-Man.

description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:defence+)Ring of Knight King Rendal boosting defense against physical attacks.

name: Tome of Raya Lucaria

description: #(Tag:gravity)(Tag:grimoire)(Tag:magic)(Tome) Contains Radahn the Starscourge's studies, teaching his gravity magic. Spell List: https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Gravity+Sorceries

name: Poltergeist's Pillow

description: #(Tag:divination)(Tag:tool)X-ray goggles for seeing through any wall or object, with a dial to adjust vision depth.

name: IX - The Hermit

description: #(Tag:card)(Tag:meta)Tarot Card - Temporarily swaps all active powers with random powers of the same rarity for 1 hour (For writing: done by rolling the gacha that corresponds with said rarity). 120 hour cooldown.
name: X - Wheel of Fortune

description: #(Tag:ailment-recovery)(Tag:card)Tarot Card - Clears all abnormal status effects like disease, poison, curses, and charms of Epic rank and below in a 10-meter radius. Cooldown: 120 hours.
name: XI - Justice

description: #(Tag:card)Tarot Card - Absorbs all of a target's wounds and ailments while lessening their intensity by 20%. 120 hour cooldown.
name: XII - The Hanged Man

description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:card)Tarot Card - On contact, destroys any active effect, from an object's speed to a mythical ritual or an undead-animating spell. 240-hour cooldown.
name: XIII - Death

description: #(Tag:ailment-recovery)(Tag:card)(Tag:mental)Tarot Card - Grants complete mental clarity and focus, dispelling all negative mental conditions. 48 hour cooldown.
name: XIV - Temperance

description: #(Tag:card)(Tag:infernal)Tarot Card - Summons infernal chains that restrain and weaken a target, though strong enough targets can break free. 48 hour cooldown.
name: XV - The Devil

description: #(Tag:card)Tarot Card - Releases uncontrollable ruinous energy that can destroy entire city blocks, partially ignores durability, and disorients enemies. 120 hour cooldown.
name: XVI - The Tower

description: #(Tag:card)(Tag:energy-recovery)(Tag:meta)Tarot Card - Restores all energy and stamina and resets all Ability Cooldowns. 240 hour cooldown.
name: XVII - The Star

description: #(Tag:card)(Tag:illusion)Tarot Card - Constructs a convincing illusionary world of your choosing that fools all 5 senses for 1 hour. 120 hour cooldown.
name: XVIII - The Moon

description: #(Tag:card)(Tag:health-recovery)(Tag:meta)Tarot Card - Instantly recovers all health and resets all Item Cooldowns. 240 hour cooldown.
name: XIX - The Sun

description: #(Tag:card)(Tag:mental)Tarot Card - Compels someone to tell what they believe is the truth without intending to trick you. 120 hour cooldown.
name: XX - Judgement

description: #(Tag:card)(Tag:meta)Tarot Card - Permanently fuses two abilities of the same rank into an ability of higher rank. 240 hour cooldown.
name: XXI - The World

description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:fire)(Tag:weapon)A flame sword forged from hell-depth ore. Amplifies Fire-based abilities when used as a focus.
name: Volcano

description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:light)(Tag:light+)(Tag:weapon)A light rapier forged from the Empress of Light's wing. Deals light damage and amplifies Light-based abilities when used as a focus.
name: Starlight

description: #(Tag:polearm)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:spirit+)(Tag:weapon)A foreign-world glaive that summons wraith projections using the wielder's life energy. Amplifies Soul-based abilities when used as a focus.
name: Ghastly Glaive

description: #(Tag:fire)(Tag:ice)(Tag:ice+)(Tag:polearm)(Tag:weapon)A crystalline spear forged from the shattered Ice Queen's remains. Lets the wielder fire frigid blasts with their own energy and amplifies Ice-based abilities when used as a focus.
name: North Pole

description: #(Tag:fire)(Tag:fire+)(Tag:light+)(Tag:polearm)(Tag:weapon)A pure-energy spear from fallen-star shards. Lets the user hurl copy projections like javelins and amplifies Fire and Light-based abilities when used as a focus.
name: Daybreak

description: #(Tag:bludgeon)(Tag:fire)(Tag:flexible)(Tag:weapon)A flame flail from the underworld's depths. Creates an explosion on every impact.
name: Sunfury

description: #(Tag:bludgeon)(Tag:flexible)(Tag:weapon)A flail from the cursed dungeon made of incredibly durable material, with a chain stretching up to 50 meters.
name: Blue Moon

description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:ice)(Tag:ice+)(Tag:weapon)A magically enchanted solid-ice saber that holds its sharpness. Releases frigid energy with your own energy and boosts ice abilities when used as a focus.
name: Ice Blade

description: #(Tag:gun)(Tag:machine)(Tag:space)(Tag:tech)(Tag:weapon)(Tech) A space dolphin crafted into a futuristic machine gun that shreds any mundane material. Its fire rate makes ammo consumption hard to keep up with.
name: Space Dolphin Machine Gun

description: #(Tag:dark)(Tag:gun)(Tag:tech)(Tag:weapon)A shotgun crafted from pure-darkness shards. Converts energy/mana into dark onyx bullets dealing unholy damage instead of consuming bullets.
name: Onyx Blaster

description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:necro)A sickle from the Reaper's cold dead hands. Releases necrotic projections with your own energy and boosts Dark and Necrotic abilities when used as a focus.
name: Death's Sickle

description: #(Tag:fire)(Tag:fire+)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:infernal+)(Tag:polearm)(Tag:weapon)A crimson trident from the cursed dungeon's depths. Fires flame blasts with your energy/mana and boosts Fire and Unholy abilities when used as a focus.
name: Inferno Fork

description: #(Tag:catalyst)(Tag:light)(Tag:light+)(Tag:magic+)A moon prism. Infusing energy/mana releases incinerating light rays converging into one large laser, or greatly boosts light-based abilities when used as a focus.
name: Last Prism

description: #(Tag:holy)(Tag:water)A large glass vial of 500ml high-quality holy water for rituals or dealing with the unholy. Restock Timer: 4 hours.
name: Holy Water

description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:holy)A golden cross blessed by a powerful angel. Worn around the neck, it wards off evil and curses and burns nearby demonic entities.
name: Golden Cross

description: #A sponge holding approximately 1,000,000,000 liters of water without changing size or weight.
name: Super Absorbent Sponge

description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:weapon)A very durable longsword with controllable weight from 5 kg to 50,000 kg.
name: Heavy Blade

description: #(Tag:machine)(Tag:tech)(Tag:vehicle)(Tag:weapon)(Tech) A gigantic multi-city-block-sized arachnid mech with retractable blades, giant plasma cannons, and uncanny mobility and dexterity. Built to withstand advanced nuclear weaponry, constantly repaired by nanomachines, with living quarters.
name: Metal Gear Excelsus

description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:mundane)Holds great sentimental value to a certain sun god, but little material value.
name: The Straw Hat

description: #(Tag:consumable)(Tag:elixir)(Tag:meta)Drinking it grants a random Gold Gacha ability usable even in ability storage.
name: Modified Compound V

description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:resource)A pair of freshly unlocked Sharingan from Sasuke Uchiha, stored in preservative fluid. Can be implanted by a skilled enough doctor.
name: Sharingan Jar

description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:resource)A pair of freshly unlocked Byakugan from Neji Hyuga, stored in preservative fluid. Can be implanted by a skilled enough doctor.
name: Byakugan Jar

description: #(Tag:armor)(Tag:tech)(Tag:weapon)(Tech) Iron Man's iconic armored suit. Useful but not particularly powerful, and very hard to repair if broken.
name: Iron Man Armor Mark III

description: #(Tag:armor)The gauntlet itself, very durable, but stones not included.
name: Infinity Gauntlet

description: #(Tag:meta)(Gacha) "Fancy your chances?" Choose an inventory ticket and flip a coin. Heads gives the ticket an advantage; Tails destroys it.
name: Greed's Coin

description: #(Tag:bludgeon)(Tag:weapon)An extremely durable baseball bat that takes at least a nuclear bomb to deform.
name: Durable Baseball Bat

description: #(Tag:armor)(Tag:growing)A tailored basic Combat Armor set. Place 10 kilograms of any ore inside, and after 24 hours the armor's composition changes to that ore or metal.
name: Combat Armor

description: #(Tag:armor)(Tag:bound)(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:life)(Tag:transformation)Sentient clothing made exclusively of liber that synchronizes with its wearer, extremely augmenting physical abilities while draining vitality. More durable than any artificial material, it can act independently and shapeshift into various forms.
name: Kamui Senketsu

description: #(Tag:armor)(Tag:bio)(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:life)A school uniform of 10% Life Fibers granting superhuman strength to break walls and flip cars. Extremely durable beyond carbon fiber. Choose colors before taking it out.
name: Goku Uniform 1star

description: #(Tag:armor)(Tag:bio)(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:life)A uniform of 20% Life Fibers granting superhuman strength to punch through solid metal and throw cars. Extremely durable beyond carbon fiber. Choose colors and design before taking it out.
name: Goku Uniform 2star

description: #(Tag:armor)(Tag:bio)(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:life)(Tag:transformation)A uniform of 30% Life Fibers granting superhuman strength to demolish buildings. Extremely durable beyond carbon fiber; choose colors and design before taking it out. Consuming your vitality unlocks a second form that further increases its abilities.
name: Goku Uniform 3star

description: #(Tag:mundane)(Tech) Your laptop or computer from back on Earth, still connected to your Earth internet.
name: Your Laptop

description: #(Tag:production)An infinite spaghetti bowl that cannot be poured out, but servings can be taken infinitely. The spaghetti is always comfortably warm and tastes pretty good.
name: Infinite Bowl of Spaghetti

description: #(Tag:vehicle)(Tech) A very fancy, fast, iconic sci-fi-ish bike.
name: Kaneda's Bike

description: #(Tag:ticket)(Tag:vehicle)(Tech) Exchangeable anytime for any Mundane Vehicle in your world, from supercar to cruise ship. The vehicle teleports in front of you with all legal work handled.
name: Any Vehicle Voucher

description: #(Tag:consumable)(Tag:elixir)(Tag:enhancer)A Wakandan herb blessed by Bast, refined to remove side effects and mystical strings for safe consumption. Grants enhanced strength, speed, stamina, durability, reflexes, agility, and instincts. Restock Timer: 240 hours.
name: Refined Heart-Shaped Herb

description: #(Tag:consumable)(Tag:energy-recovery)(Tag:health-recovery)A mystical bean cultivated by Earth's guardian. Eating it instantly restores physical condition to peak, fully restores energy, and satiates for 10 days. Restock Timer: 720 hours.
name: Senzu Bean

description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:divination-resistance+)(Tag:stealth)A white featureless full-face mask removable only at the wearer's will or by breaking it. Opaque and resistant to thinker abilities, yet the wearer sees through it without issue.
name: Unknown Mask

description: #(Tag:consumable)(Tag:race-change)(Tag:transformation)A hand-sized virus-like cell. Eating it makes you unbelievably stronger and transforms you into a monstrous creature with extended lifespan, at the cost of never developing further by natural means.
name: Monster Cell

description: #(Tag:meta)(Tag:ticket)(Gacha) A ticket acting as a 6x Advantage Platinum Ability Gacha Ticket.
name: Ability Ticket

description: #(Tag:meta)(Tag:ticket)(Gacha) A ticket acting as a 6x Advantage Platinum Trait Gacha Ticket.
name: Trait Ticket

description: #(Tag:meta)(Tag:ticket)(Gacha) A ticket acting as a 6x Advantage Platinum Skill Gacha Ticket.
name: Skill Ticket

description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:consumable)(Tag:transformation)A powerful transforming virus. Mismatched hosts become an anomalous mass of blackened matter with incredible regeneration; matched hosts gain enhanced stats and bio-immortality with commandable viral healing. Or pour the vial into the ocean and watch the apocalypse.
name: Uroboros Virus

description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:consumable)(Tag:transformation)A highly viral super-virus mutating victims into enhanced zombie-like creatures with little brain activity. Rare compatible hosts gain only superhuman capabilities and regeneration without mutation, and a scientist might refine it. Or pour the vial into the ocean and watch the apocalypse.
name: Tvirus

description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:consumable)(Tag:elixir)(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:health-regeneration+)(Tag:meta)A modified T-Virus syringe granting all T-virus benefits with none of the downsides: superhuman physical abilities, regeneration, and telekinesis.
name: Modified Tvirus

description: #(Tag:infernal)(Tag:summon)A red face-like egg that can call down the God Hand. Sacrificing your everything in the Eclipse lets you join the Godhand as an Apostle. ...If you're considering using this, something is truly wrong with you.
name: The Beherit

description: #(Tag:storage)A wrapped-gift box that gives precisely the item you need for the situation, as long as it is Rare rank or below. Vanishes once used.
name: Chekhov's Box

description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:movement)A Sorcerer Supreme relic allowing free flight. Self-aware, it can pull its wearer from danger and hinder opponents on its own.
name: Cloak of Levitation

description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:poison)(Tag:tech)(Tech) A canister of the Plague, a self-replicating nanomachine virus devouring biomass and turning living things into mindless biomechanically enhanced zombies for its hivemind. Releasing it without sufficient biokinetic or techno mastery dooms the world, though without a core they lack a hivemind command center.
name: Plague Canister

description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:dagger)(Tag:space)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:time)(Tag:weapon)Mehrunes Dagon's dagger. Capable of cutting anything the user can interact with, space, time, soul, connections, etc. The only limit is the user, not the dagger.
name: Mehrunes Razor

description: #(Tag:tool)Magical key of Nocturnal that can unlock anything the user perceives, from locks and walls to inner potential and portals to other worlds. Its only limit is the user, not the key.
name: Skeleton Key

description: #(Tag:armor)(Tag:stealth)A hooded elven cloak woven from shadow that renders the wearer invisible while the hood is raised and resistant to divination and scrying. Nearly undetectable while motionless.
name: Cloak of Elvenkind

description: #(Tag:bound)(Tag:dark)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:summon)(Tag:weapon)One of the strongest Longinus crafted by God that creates shadow monsters from the user's shadow by expending mana, with abilities based on the user's imagination and abilities. When removed from inventory, it is a small marble that fuses with whoever swallows it.
name: Annihilation Maker

description: #(Tag:bound)(Tag:earth)(Tag:electric)(Tag:tech)(Tag:weapon)Unknown Dictator, one of the modern Longinus, manipulates metal and technology on a massive scale and constructs advanced tech like ion cannons and aura engines at will without detailed input. Stronger users create stronger creations. When removed from inventory, it is a small marble that fuses with whoever swallows it.
name: Unknown Dictator

description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:bound)(Tag:electric)(Tag:water)(Tag:weapon)Zenith Tempest, one of the mightiest Longinus, controls weather, atmosphere, and natural elements like fire, wind, lightning, and water to call down lightning, country-wiping storms, and more. A powerful enough user can shred the planet's surface with violent storms. When removed from inventory, it is a small marble that fuses with whoever swallows it.
name: Zenith Tempest

description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:bound)(Tag:gun)(Tag:weapon)A highest-order Longinus built for simplicity whose sword can cut gods and whose gun can annihilate islands even in basic form. It is incredibly difficult to control, and a misfire may destroy the landmass the user stands on. When removed from inventory, it is a small marble that fuses with whoever swallows it.
name: Star Buster Blaster

description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:bound)(Tag:curse)(Tag:dark)(Tag:fire)(Tag:summon)(Tag:weapon)Canis Lycaon, one of the Longinus created by God, manifests an extremely powerful black wolf avatar wielding a cursed blade and lets the user sprout cursed blades from their body as weapons. With training, the user can wield cursed flames that prevent healing and sprout blades from any shadow in perception range. When removed from inventory, it is a small marble that fuses with whoever swallows it.
name: Canis Lycaon

description: #(Tag:holy)(Tag:light)(Tag:polearm)(Tag:weapon)The greatest holy spear, containing a piece of God, bears a tremendous holy aura that can utterly annihilate any demonic being weaker than a god. With training, the user can access its variety of forms.
name: True Longinus

description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:bound)Telos Karma, God's treasure, twists causality and fate to affirm the effect the user wants by altering history. Larger effects and stronger targets consume more energy. When removed from inventory, it is a small marble that fuses with whoever swallows it.
name: Telos Karma

description: #(Tag:armor)(Tag:blade)(Tag:bound)(Tag:summon)(Tag:weapon)Battle Axe of the Nemean, one of the Longinus crafted by God, is a large golden battle axe that protects its wielder from projectiles and can become an independent projection of the original Nemean Lion with invincible skin. With training, the user can unlock its Balance Breaker forms. When removed from inventory, it is a small marble that fuses with whoever swallows it.
name: Regulus Nemea

description: #One of the newly manifested Longinus that controls the ocean and charms dragons through singing, limited by the user's singing and magical power. A powerful enough user can sink continents and tame the grandest dragons. When removed from inventory, it is a small marble that fuses with whoever swallows it.
name: Nereid Kyre

description: #(Tag:consumable)A simple cola-tasting canned drink that causes immense agony lasting up to several minutes. Restock Timer: 24 hours.
name: Can of Pain

description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:dark)(Tag:dark+)(Tag:weapon)A sword of night formed from the world's essences with exceptional durability and sharpness that enhances all darkness abilities when used as a focus. Under certain conditions, it can unlock true power comparable to Excalibur itself.
name: Nights Edge

description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:magic)(Tag:magic+)(Tag:weapon)A glintstone masterpiece katana that projects the user's slashes as blue blades of light and amplifies spells when used as a focus.
name: Moonveil

description: #(Tag:anti-divine)(Tag:anti-immortal)(Tag:blade)(Tag:divine)(Tag:necro)(Tag:weapon)A sword carrying traces of Destined Death that unleashes black flames by expending energy/mana to permanently harm lifeforce. Wounds it inflicts cannot be healed by anything less than divine intervention.
name: Malikeths Black Blade

description: #(Tag:grimoire)(Tag:magic)(Tome) A beginner's guide to basic Nordic/Scandinavian runecraft written personally by Allfather Odin. Studying it teaches the art of Runecraft.
name: Beginners Guide to Runecraft

description: #(Tag:construct)(Tag:production)(Tag:summon)A beginner-friendly golem-growing kit even a child can use, containing a person-sized pot, watering can, pack of cores, and notebook. Place a core, desired golem materials, and a specification note in the pot, bury it in any dirt in a sunny spot, and water twice morning and night for 7 days before digging up the finished golem. Energy-rich soil speeds the process.
name: Grow Your Own Golem Kit

description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:health-regeneration+)A blood-red stained cape that proportionally augments the wearer's Physical Abilities and Regeneration for every negative status effect borne while wearing it, such as burning, poison, curse, freezing, bleeding, or blindness. (A/N: Gacha curses do not count).
name: Cape of Rebellion

description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:dark-resistance+)(Tag:holy+)(Tag:infernal-resistance+)(Tag:light+)An angel's Halo worn like a hat that does not fall off unless removed. While worn, it grants resistance to all ailments, especially Dark and Infernal attacks and effects, greatly boosts Light and Holy abilities, and constantly applies slight healing to the wearer.
name: Halo of Light

description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:dark+)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:infernal+)A headband shaped as cartoonish devil horns that substantially boosts all Darkness and Infernal abilities and traits while worn.
name: Devil Horns

description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:weapon)An old, worn, rusty blade covered in dried blood that is only as strong as it looks unless brandished against a target that has inflicted suffering on the user. Against such targets, it powers up proportionally to all damage they have ever inflicted, reaching legendary strength against a mortal enemy but remaining trash against a first-time opponent.
name: Blade of Hatred

description: #(Tag:fist)(Tag:weapon)A pair of simple but sturdy brass knuckles.
name: Brass Knuckles

description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:health-recovery)(Tag:holy)(Tag:light)(Tag:water)An enchanted ring of a legendary paladin infused with his prayers that holds 3 charges and recovers 1 charge every hour. Spend a charge to cast a Rare tier Heal, grant one Uncommon tier blessing like strength or agility, or bless an object with holy energy to create holy water or a temporarily blessed weapon effective against the unholy.
name: Ring of the Paladin

description: #(Tag:accessory)A pair of simple earplugs that completely blocks the wearer's hearing while worn.
name: Earplugs

description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:illusion)A simple white mask that makes the wearer appear as a completely different, always identical person, serving as a second identity.
name: Second Face

description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:weapon)A sword embodying envy that alone is only as strong as a sharp iron sword. It can temporarily become the strongest weapon within a 1 km radius for 1 hour, then enters a 24 hour cooldown.
name: Mirror Blade

description: #(Tag:accessory)An amulet that transforms you into the shape of any creature you touch while holding it until you dispel the transformation. Cooldown: 8 hours.
name: Amulet of Imitation

description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:light)(Tag:weapon)Not a lightsaber, this sword is crafted purely from solid light and is incredibly light and sharp but somewhat fragile. If broken, leaving it where it receives light gradually repairs it.
name: Light Sword

description: #(Tag:vehicle)A luxury private jet with its own Golem Pilot and Golem Server that requires no fuel. Snacks and amenities inside replenish over time.
name: Private Jet

description: #(Tag:social)(Tag:tool)A pair of really cool-looking sunglasses that make you seem more charismatic.
name: Charismatic Sunglasses

description: #(Tag:anti-infernal)(Tag:anti-undead)(Tag:blade)(Tag:holy)(Tag:maximum-energy+)(Tag:weapon)A divinely blessed sword that imbues great might and magical power and boosts holy and light abilities when used as a focus. It also fills the user with righteous rage, driving them berserk against unholy and undead beings unless tamed.
name: Sword of Judgement

description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:fire)(Tag:fire+)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:infernal+)(Tag:strength+)(Tag:weapon)The mythical Blade of Armageddon that imbues great power but burns to touch and boosts fire and unholy abilities when used as a focus. The user can expend energy to call down Armageddon, raining hellfire from the skies onto the mortal world.
name: The Armageddon Blade

description: #(Tag:fire)(Tag:infernal)A sword forged and bathed in hellfire whose blade can be wreathed in violent flames by expending energy. It boosts fire abilities when used as a focus.
name: Sword of Hellfire

description: #(Tag:agility+)(Tag:blade)(Tag:defence+)(Tag:holy)(Tag:magic+)(Tag:strength+)(Tag:weapon)A divine heavenly sword that greatly increases the wielder's physical and magical abilities, strengthens and inspires any army or allies under their command, and boosts holy and light abilities when used as a focus. The user can also expend energy to grant any blessing of Rare tier or below.
name: Angellic Alliance

description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:electric)(Tag:electric+)(Tag:strength+)(Tag:weapon)A thunder sword granting the power and might of giants, including extreme physical strength and the ability to rain down thunder by expending energy. It enhances lightning-based abilities when used as a focus.
name: Titans Thunder

description: #(Tag:armor)(Tag:curse)(Tag:curse+)(Tag:dark)(Tag:dark+)(Tag:defence+)(Tag:strength+)Pitch-black armor with a demonic visage worn by the most wicked conquerors that augments physical abilities and amplifies darkness-based abilities when used as a focus. With training, it can unleash massive-scale curses like slow, misfortune, and weakness to debilitate entire armies.
name: Armor of the Dammed

description: #(Tag:draconic)Armor crafted from a mighty dragon's corpse that imbues great physical might and extreme magic resistance through its scales.
name: Power of the Dragon Father

description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:magic)(Tag:summon)A legendary archwizard's hat containing echoes of his spells that grants Dimensional Door (100 km portal), Fly (fly at land speed), Magic Mirror (reflect magic back), Implosion (severe explosive damage), and Summon Elemental (summon a chosen elemental roughly as strong as you for 30 minutes). This artifact holds 3 charges at a time and recovers 1 charge every 8 hours.
name: Spellbinders Hat

description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:summon)(Tag:vehicle)A legendary admiral's hat that conjures any mundane seabound vessel, from destroyer-class warships to cruise ships, manned by a spirit crew. You can summon a vessel every 720 hours, and wearing the hat grants Master rank Riding on any seabound vessel.
name: Admirals Hat

description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:anti-magic)While worn, this cloak prevents the user from using any magic below Epic rank and prevents any magic below Epic rank from affecting them.
name: Cloak of Silence

description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:movement)A cape that makes the wearer faster while worn.
name: Cape of Velocity

description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:necro)(Tag:necro+)(Tag:spirit+)The legendary undead king's cloak that boosts all necromancy and soul-based abilities and removes the limit on undead controlled at once while worn.
name: Cloak of the Undead King
