description: #(Tag:nsfw)(Tag:rule)(Noncon) Your swimmers are the strongest in the world; anyone you cum inside WILL get pregnant, even if they are more barren than arid deserts. (If you lack the right equipment, you gain it should you choose to. If not, reroll this trait.)
name: Golden Shot

description: #(Tag:energy-recovery)(Tag:health-recovery)(Tag:survival)"You only live once." At the moment of your death, you resuscitate with all lethal wounds healed and some energy restored, then this trait is deleted from your status.
name: Ygdar Orus Li Ox

description: #(Tag:holy+)(Tag:light+)(Tag:social)(Tag:talent)You are a Hero in training, fit for the title or not; all your Holy and Light abilities are slightly enhanced, and your blessings gain strength and duration.
name: Hero Candidate

description: #(Tag:dark+)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:infernal+)(Tag:talent)You are a Demon Lord to be, fit for the title or not; all your Darkness and Unholy abilities are slightly enhanced, but you are more vulnerable to Holy and Light abilities.
name: Demon Scion

description: #(Tag:social)Goths, emos, and those with daddy issues are drawn to you, making their affection and favor easier to garner. People also overlook your less-favorable actions more easily.
name: Goth Magnet

description: #(Tag:stealth+)You fade into the background easily; unless you draw attention, people often overlook you and find you hard to notice. This fails against those looking for you or aware you are there. Your Stranger-class abilities are slightly more potent.
name: Background NPC

description: #(Tag:divination-resistance+)You are very hard to track: cameras stop recording when you enter frame, the elements cover your footprints, and witnesses cannot recall which way you went.
name: Untraceable

description: #(Tag:social)People want you on their side and dote on you to prevent your defection; higher-ups in your organization like and accommodate you more easily. Kings and queens who meet you will likely take a liking to you as well.
name: The Favorite

description: #(Tag:meta)All your abilities that create constructs or new matter cost significantly less energy to produce and maintain.
name: Ex Nihilo

description: #(Tag:nsfw)(Tag:talent)You are peerless in bed, quickly adapting to partners' preferences and learning their weak spots, and you improve in the tantric arts much faster. None leave your bed unsatisfied.
name: Peerless

description: #(Tag:infernal)(Tag:social)"You wake up, dreaming of a harem of demons." Infernally aligned/Demonic beings find you more attractive and grant their affection more easily.
name: Helltaker

description: #(Tag:holy)(Tag:social)"You wake up, dreaming of a harem of... angels? That doesn't sound right-" Holy aligned/Angelic beings find you more attractive and grant their affection more easily.
name: Heaventaker

description: #(Tag:spirit)(Tag:survival)Hell's gates are closed to you and heaven kicked down the ladder, leaving you stuck here. You remain in the mortal world as a soul after death.
name: Denied from Oblivion

description: #(Tag:curse-resistance+)(Tag:energy-regeneration+)(Tag:maximum-energy+)Your unique physique devours curses like a hungry animal, fighting and slowly eating any curse placed on you, scaling with your maximum energy. Fully devouring a curse slightly increases your maximum energy, with diminished returns for repeats of the same curse. You also recover energy faster in places with more negativity.
name: Curse Devouring Physique

description: #(Tag:energy-regeneration+)(Tag:maximum-energy+)Your energy reserves and recovery speeds exceed the norm, letting you use abilities and spells longer.
name: Mysticism

description: #(Tag:reflex+)Your nervous system is overhauled, making your reflexes so fast they almost seem like precognition.
name: Hyper Reflexive

description: #(Tag:magic)(Tag:magic+)Your mystical connection is far more potent; any magic you use is far stronger, and you can overload spells without breaking them.
name: Surging Magic Power

description: #(Tag:health-recovery)(Tag:survival)You have nine lives; each time you die, you expend one life and return to full health.
name: Nine Lives

description: #(Tag:mind)(Tag:talent)You excel at reading, learning, and retaining information; you can read 50 books in a day and retain all their information.
name: Scholar

description: #(Tag:ice)(Tag:ice+)(Tag:ice-resistance+)You were born in harsh winter winds; you resist cold and ice-based abilities better, and your ice-based abilities cost less energy.
name: Winterman

description: #(Tag:meta-resistance+)You are a constant; your body cannot be changed by outside influences without your consent (such as soul manipulation or biomancy, not regular attacks). You are immune to paradoxes, and only one of you exists since you cannot be cloned or replicated.
name: Constant

description: #You master riding any mount; when mounted, your senses link and you communicate your intentions to your mount instantly.
name: Master Rider

description: #(Tag:draconic)(Tag:social)(Tag:summon+)(Tag:talent)You are destined to ride dragons; all dragons view you more favorably and grant their affection far more easily.
name: Dragon Rider

description: #(Tag:social)You are an excellent master; servants under you view you more favorably and grant affection more easily. This also applies to submissive people.
name: My Master

description: #(Tag:social)Your presence is very corrupting; the longer you influence people, the more willing they become to betray their morals for you and ignore your actions' morality.
name: Corrupting

description: #(Tag:rule)You can turn off your killing potential; even if you hit a medieval serf with a final flash, he survives, albeit barely.
name: Pacifism

description: #(Tag:growth+)(Tag:talent)You are a gym nut; your body recovers from exercise far quicker and better, and your physical training efficiency is considerably increased. You can achieve peak human fitness in a few months of decent training.
name: Gym Nut

description: #(Tag:energy-regeneration+)(Tag:fire)(Tag:fire-resistance+)(Tag:health-regeneration+)You were born in flames and molded by them; you are completely immune to all fire-based attacks. The higher your body temperature, the faster you recover energy and health, up to 500%.
name: Fireborn

description: #(Tag:meta)You gain an extra ability slot.
name: High Capacity

description: #(Tag:meta-resistance+)Your body refuses to change; you incredibly resist transformative abilities, forcing anyone changing you without consent to wrestle control first. Abilities like rot or wither inducement, sickness inducement, biokinesis, etc. are automatically resisted.
name: Immutable

description: #(Tag:elemental-resistance+)(Tag:ice)(Tag:ice+)You are the Ice Monarch, ruler of all ice; you massively resist all elemental effects, and every element contacting you freezes. All your ice and frost-related abilities below Mythical Tier are increased by rank and cost less energy. All ice and frost-aligned beings instinctively recognize you as Monarch, and you are immune to ice and cold-based abilities.
name: Ice Monarch

description: #(Tag:energy-regeneration+)(Tag:fire)(Tag:fire+)(Tag:fire-resistance+)(Tag:maximum-energy+)You are the Fire Monarch, ruler of all Fire and Plasma; your energy is massively enhanced, as your soul is an eternal reactor. All your Fire and Plasma-related abilities below Mythical Tier are increased by one rank and cost less energy. All fire and heat-aligned beings instinctively recognize you as Monarch, and you are immune to Fire and Plasma-based abilities.
name: Fire Monarch

description: #(Tag:defence+)(Tag:earth)(Tag:earth-resistance+)You are the Earth Monarch, ruler of all Earth; your durability is massively enhanced, as you are as immovable as earth. All your Earth and Metal-related abilities below Mythical Tier are increased by one rank and cost less energy. All earth-aligned beings instinctively recognize you as Monarch, and you are immune to earth and metal-based abilities.
name: Earth Monarch

description: #(Tag:ice-resistance+)(Tag:vitality+)(Tag:water)(Tag:water+)(Tag:water-resistance+)You are the Sea Monarch, ruler of all Water and the depths; your vitality is massively increased, as the sea is the mother of all life. All your water-related abilities below Mythical Tier are increased by one rank and cost less energy. All water and sea-aligned beings instinctively recognize you as Monarch, and you are immune to water and ice-based abilities.
name: Sea Monarch

description: #(Tag:agility+)(Tag:air)(Tag:air+)(Tag:air-resistance+)(Tag:electric)(Tag:electric+)(Tag:electric-resistance+)You are the Sky Monarch, ruler of all Sky; your agility is massively enhanced, as you are as free as wind. All your wind and lightning-related abilities below Mythical Tier are increased by one rank and cost less energy. All sky-aligned beings instinctively recognize you as Monarch, and you are immune to wind and lightning-based abilities.
name: Sky Monarch

description: #(Tag:holy+)(Tag:holy-resistance+)(Tag:light+)(Tag:light-resistance+)(Tag:physical+)You are a Hero, a child blessed by light and holy. All your Light and Holy-based abilities strengthen alongside your physical abilities. Divine/Clergy-aligned beings view you with greater favor, reverence, and affection, rewarding your merits and service, and all blessings are stronger and last longer on you.
name: Hero

description: #(Tag:avian)(Tag:talent)You are a perfect flyer; flight comes as naturally as walking or breathing, and all your flight abilities are more precise, potent, and cost considerably less to maintain.
name: Free Bird

description: #(Tag:stamina+)Your stamina is ridiculous; even as a regular human you can run a marathon unwearied. You recover from exhaustion very fast and are hard to exhaust.
name: Relentless Stamina

description: #(Tag:earth)(Tag:rule)You almost always land on your feet when falling and are immune to all fall damage; even falling from space to earth will not hurt your legs.
name: Cat's Feet

description: #(Tag:social)You are the king of cuddling; anyone you cuddle or share skinship with feels comfortable. You make the best cuddling partner for building relationships.
name: Cuddle King

description: #(Tag:perception+)Your sight and visual acuity far exceed the norm; you see much farther and clearer than average.
name: Eagle Eyes

description: #(Tag:perception+)Your smell far exceeds the norm, rivaling canines, and you differentiate smells with great accuracy.
name: Bloodhound

description: #(Tag:perception+)Your hearing far exceeds the norm; you distinguish quieter sounds easily, differentiate between sounds, and automatically adjust to noise levels.
name: Sharp Hearing

description: #(Tag:social)Your hugs feel deeply comforting and therapeutic, helping dispel negative emotional states.
name: Soft Hugger

description: #(Tag:stamina+)Your stamina is boundless; even as a regular person you can run a marathon with ease and need only a minute's rest afterward. Your stamina recovers incredibly quickly and exhaustion fades much faster.
name: Boundless Stamina

description: #(Tag:luck+)(Tag:nsfw)(Nsfw)(Noncon) You often stumble into lucky perverted or lewd situations, as the chaos of infinity distills into making you more likely to find someone changing.
name: Lucky Sukebe

description: #(Tag:spirit)(Tag:spirit+)You are talented with all things spirits; spiritual creatures and objects take a liking to you, and your soul-based abilities are easier to master.
name: Spirit Affinity

description: #(Tag:spirit)Your soul is immortal; it can be wounded and shattered but never annihilated while you possess energy.
name: Immortal Soul

description: #(Tag:physical+)When your health drops to 10% or you stand on the brink of death, your physical stats increase by a stage.
name: Last Stand

description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:talent)Your killing mindset is a marvel of nature; you instinctively know how to land lethal blows and find weak points through sheer animal instinct.
name: Lord Death of Murder Mountain

description: #(Tag:strength+)Your existing strength is enhanced, increasing the physical force you exert in proportion to your strength.
name: Enhanced Strength

description: #(Tag:agility+)Your existing agility is enhanced, augmenting your speed and reflexes.
name: Enhanced Agility

description: #(Tag:vitality+)Your existing vitality is enhanced, letting you recover from wounds and afflictions quicker and stay healthier overall.
name: Enhanced Vitality

description: #(Tag:defence+)Your existing endurance is enhanced, letting you function longer before tiring and endure more punishment.
name: Enhanced Endurance

description: #(Tag:dexterity+)You are unusually dexterous, with impeccable hand-to-eye coordination, motor skills, and bodily control.
name: Dexterous

description: #(Tag:physical+)(Tag:power+)When fighting any target you have lost to before, all your abilities and traits increase by a stage (+), so Uncommon becomes Uncommon+.
name: Vengeful

description: #(Tag:energy-recovery)"Hurt me more." Whenever you are hurt or damaged, you recover energy proportional to the damage received.
name: Masochism

description: #(Tag:dark+)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:infernal+)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:social)(Tag:summon+)You are a Demon Lord; all your Darkness and Unholy magic and abilities strengthen alongside your physical stats, increased further if your race is demonic or infernal. You greatly resist all Darkness and Unholy attributes. Demonic/Infernal beings serve you more readily and obey your authority more easily, and those under your service or command are easier to command and manage and gain minor buffs from you.
name: Demon Lord

description: #(Tag:meta)Your gacha items carry a warranty; if equipment you own breaks beyond effective use, within 24 hours it and all its parts are replaced with a perfect replica, as long as it was not traded or given away. This applies only to breakage during intended use, not sacrifice, smelting, destruction during modification, etc., and not to consumables.
name: Item Warranty

description: #(Tag:time)You can activate this only once a week; when fighting to protect someone, all your enhancement abilities receive a full rank boost.
name: Hero Time

description: #(Tag:time)-A Hero arises. Once every 120 hours, you restore your stamina and energy to full, but hours afterward you become extremely exhausted.
name: In Time of Need

description: #You are naturally talented at sewing; you spot flaws in clothing and easily make or fix garments.
name: Seamster

description: #You are wrath given form; all your physical stats increase the angrier you get, capping at Epic Rank.
name: Wrath Made Manifest

description: #(Tag:rule)Your existence is oppression; in your presence, any creature below Epic rank has all energy lowered by one rank, and anyone more than two ranks below you cannot breathe without your permission.
name: Pride King

description: #(Tag:energy-recovery)(Tag:growth+)(Tag:maximum-energy+)You extract energy from any object you eat to permanently increase your own energy reserves.
name: Gluttonous Abyss

description: #You master flight; flying is as natural as walking or breathing while you are capable of flight, and your ability-based flight costs less energy.
name: Free Flier

description: #(Tag:perception+)(Tag:talent)You never lose your balance short of your legs being sheared off.
name: Stable

description: #(Tag:growth+)(Tag:maximum-energy+)(Tag:physical+)Every time you return from near death, all your stats permanently increase.
name: Zenkai Boost

description: #(Tag:dark+)(Tag:energy-regeneration+)(Tag:maximum-energy+)(Tag:necro+)(Tag:summon+)(Tag:undead)You hold a second metaphysical heart that massively increases your mana capacity and regeneration while significantly boosting all necromancy abilities.
name: Black Heart

description: #(Tag:energy-regeneration+)(Tag:maximum-energy+)Your heart is replaced by a metaphysical alternative pumping raw energy through your veins, massively increasing your maximum energy reserves. Your natural regeneration speeds add to your energy regeneration alongside regular recovery.
name: Energy Heart

description: #(Tag:survival)You can substitute blood, food, water, or air with your own mana, but do not depend on it too long or you may instantly die when you run out of mana.
name: Mana Substitution

description: #(Tag:mental-resistance+)(Tag:mind)Your mind is iron and your body obeys; exhaustion and starvation minimally affect your performance, keeping it optimal regardless of suffering. This does not extend to physical limitations or wounds. You also gain increased resistance to all Negative Mental Ailments.
name: Iron Mind

description: #(Tag:survival)(Tag:vampiric)You hardly bleed; even drained of most blood, you feel no effect as long as a cupful remains. If you are a vampire, you no longer suffer the need for blood.
name: Bloodless

description: #(Tag:body)Your body holds 10x the blood and regenerates blood 10x faster, without changing mass or size.
name: Bloodbank

description: #(Tag:body)Your body holds virtually limitless blood and regenerates it 100 times faster; you can feed a whole vampire clan for life or serve as the ultimate bank for a Hemokinetic.
name: Eternal Bleed

description: #(Tag:energy-recovery)(Tag:maximum-energy+)You recover energy by converting others' fear of you into energy; if enough people fear you, you may even gain permanent stat increases.
name: Living Nightmare

description: #(Tag:curse)(Tag:energy-regeneration+)(Tag:health-regeneration+)You rule fear; if your opponent fears you, their energy drains into yours, and you can physically interact with and absorb fear into your energy.
name: Lord of Fear

description: #(Tag:energy-recovery+)(Tag:necro+)(Tag:talent)(Tag:undead)Specialization - You are a natural-born necromancer dealing in death and souls. Any death or soul-related ability is easier to master and costs less energy.
name: Necromancer

description: #(Tag:poison)Specialization - You are a natural-born contagion; spreading disease, poison, and decay is second nature. Any poison or disease-related ability is easier to master and costs less energy to use.
name: Plaguemaster

description: #(Tag:bio+)(Tag:talent)(Tag:transformation+)Specialization - You master all biological and body-alteration abilities faster and use them for less energy.
name: Shapesmith

description: #(Tag:magic)(Tag:rule)You can destroy at will any contract or clause bound to you that you agreed to, including soul bindings and magical enforcement.
name: Non-Binding Clause

description: #(Tag:defence+)(Tag:strength+)You are far stronger and more durable than you should be, able to rip a man in two bare-handed as a regular human and withstand your own punches. This bonus strength scales with your current physical abilities.
name: Lil' Hercules

description: #(Tag:body)(Tag:growth+)You are the genetic peak of your race, immune to its impurities and genetic defects.
name: Peak Specimen

description: #(Tag:bloodline)(Tag:meta)You are the secret child of a great figure, such as a legendary swordsman or magician, rather than of mundane parentage. Once you unlock your lineage ability or talent, this trait is replaced by it.
name: Ancestry

description: #(Tag:mind)You can shrug off panic and fear at will and act with audacity even before a god.
name: Chutzpah

description: #(Tag:mental-resistance+)(Tag:mind)"A lifetime defined by futile struggle." Your mind may bend but never breaks, even under centuries of boredom, torture, or futile labor. You are MASSIVELY resistant to all external mental interference.
name: Sisyphean

description: #(Tag:maximum-energy+)You possess an abnormally large energy pool, letting you use abilities and spells for far longer.
name: Magic Well

description: #(Tag:maximum-energy+)Your energy reserves are noticeably above average, though not at genius level.
name: Big Battery

description: #(Tag:draconic)(Tag:energy-regeneration+)(Tag:maximum-energy+)You possess a dragon's energy core instead of ordinary reserves, a power plant where an average mage has a generator.
name: Dragon Core

description: #(Tag:maximum-energy+)Your energy storage is infinite, though your regeneration and output are unchanged. You can hold the energy equivalent of a billion supernovas, even if you can only conjure a measly fireball.
name: Energy Abyss

description: #(Tag:magic)(Tag:talent)Your magical talent is one in a trillion. You learn even the most complex spells in a hundredth of the time an average "genius" needs and can invent spells on the fly.
name: Lord of Magic

description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:talent)Your talent in weaponry and warfare is one in a trillion. You master almost any martial art and weapon in a hundredth of the time an average "genius" needs. You are basically Garou.
name: Warlord

description: #(Tag:bloodline)(Tag:meta)You are the child of an unknown god who may dote on you or turn on you once they learn of you. After you discover your lineage and awaken your ability, this trait is replaced by it.
name: Demigod

description: #(Tag:mind)"I can do this all day." You never feel tired or exhausted, even when your energy is nearly gone or you have run for days, though your body still suffers the negative effects of overwork.
name: Untired

description: #(Tag:stamina+)"I can do this forever." You never run out of bodily stamina and never get out of breath, though you can still strain your body. This does not affect mana/energy.
name: Infinite Stamina

description: #(Tag:meta)(Tag:rule)Your ability drawbacks are severely reduced. You can draw upon more power than your body should handle and barely feel it.
name: Recoilless

description: #(Tag:social)You carry royal blood and project above-average charisma, making others readily accept you as an authority figure. Those you are responsible for view you with greater respect and authority.
name: Your Majesty

description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:social)(Tag:talent)Swordsmen, martial artists, and competitive people seek you out to test themselves and grow fond of you more easily, especially if you defeat them. Your martial skills grow faster in combat.
name: Rivalry

description: #(Tag:dark)(Tag:dark+)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:infernal+)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:social)(Tag:talent)You are the reincarnation of a Demon God. Your Darkness and Unholy abilities and magic below Mythical level gain a tier and cost less energy, your basic physical stats are massively increased, and you can convert your energy directly into a darkness attribute like a Mana Burst. Demonic and infernal beings weaker than you recognize you as absolute authority, while stronger ones still recognize what you are.
name: Demon God

description: #(Tag:social)Organizations want you on their side and refuse to let you leave. You receive far better treatment and face far looser rules in any organization you join.
name: Wanted

description: #(Tag:divination)"Another settlement needs our help, I'll mark it on the map for you." Whenever you receive a quest or request, you can summon an arrow pointing toward your objective.
name: Quest Marker

description: #(Tag:social)You are not physically more attractive, but others find your face and figure more appealing to their tastes. A 5/10 in their eyes becomes a solid 7/10.
name: Pretty Privilidge

description: #(Tag:social)People in power, such as nobles, bosses, and royalty, perceive your boldness as charming rather than disrespectful. They also find themselves more attracted to you.
name: Lese Majeste

description: #(Tag:social)(Tag:talent)You understand others better and express your own feelings more clearly through speech and words. This is essentially talent in communication.
name: Lovers

description: #(Tag:body)(Tag:social)Your eyes do not hypnotize people like mystical charming eyes, they are simply very pretty.
name: Charming Eyes

description: #(Tag:dexterity+)You wield your abilities and spells with exceptional precision and control, and your mastery over your own moves and body is beyond the norm.
name: Precise

description: #(Tag:dexterity+)You control your abilities and spells with incredible precision that others struggle to match.
name: Exact

description: #(Tag:mind)(Tag:time)You possess a perfect internal clock. You recall exactly when you last did something down to the millisecond and time things as perfectly as a stopwatch.
name: Chronolog

description: #(Tag:survival)When you die, you keep moving and using your abilities for up to 1 hour before death finally claims you.
name: Post Mortem

description: #(Tag:rule)You can always pull exactly what you need to pay from your pocket as perfect legal tender that causes no inflation. You somehow find enough money whenever you need it.
name: Infinite Money Glitch

description: #(Tag:magic)(Tag:power)You possess natural Magic Circuits that act as magic computers in your body, helping you regenerate energy and actualise magic and abilities. Their quantity and quality depend on your energy reserves and energy traits, or double if you already have Magic Circuits.
name: Magic Circuits

description: #(Tag:energy-regeneration+)(Tag:nature)(Tag:nature+)(Tag:social)Nature favors you: trees offer you fresh fruit, animals and nature-aligned beings are affectionate and aid you, and you maneuver forests with ease. You recover energy faster the closer you are to nature.
name: Nature's Embrace

description: #(Tag:energy-regeneration+)(Tag:nature)(Tag:nature+)(Tag:social)As Mother Nature's favored one, you receive her protection in forests and nature. Wild animals are friendly, understand your words, trees part to guide you, bounties offer fresh produce, and nature-aligned beings recognize her touch on you. You recover energy faster the closer you are to nature.
name: Nature's Chosen

description: #(Tag:power)(Tag:vitality+)You instinctively use and master Hamon breathing to harness Life Magnetism and sunlight through your breath. Extended practice grants you a superhuman physique, vitality, longevity, and more, and you can grant others Hamon Breathing by punching their diaphragms.
name: Hamon

description: #(Tag:energy-regeneration+)(Tag:nature)(Tag:nature+)(Tag:social)You are Gaia's child, and Mother Nature actively defends you in forests with spear-hard branches, rising trunks, and shielding roots. Animals and nature-aligned beings favor you affectionately, and some recognize her touch on you.
name: Gaia's Child

description: #(Tag:rule)(Tag:strength+)"I am Heavy Weapons Guy." The heavier the object you wield, the proportionally stronger you become, and you suffer no penalties for wielding oversized weapons.
name: Heavy Weapons Guy

description: #(Tag:electric)(Tag:electric+)(Tag:electric-resistance+)(Tag:energy-recovery)(Tag:talent)Your body channels lightning, making all lightning-based abilities more potent, cheaper, and easier to master. You can also ground lightning and electricity to absorb a portion of their energy.
name: Superconductor

description: #(Tag:earth)(Tag:earth+)(Tag:earth-resistance+)(Tag:energy-regeneration+)(Tag:talent)You are one with the primordial earth. All earth-based abilities are far more potent, cheaper, and easier to master, and you recover energy faster on the ground and even faster underground.
name: Earthbound Ancient

description: #(Tag:earth)(Tag:earth+)(Tag:earth-resistance+)(Tag:energy-regeneration+)(Tag:talent)You embody the immovable earth. All earth-based abilities are more potent, cheaper, and easier to master, and you recover energy faster underground.
name: Grounded

description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:air+)(Tag:air-resistance+)(Tag:energy-regeneration+)(Tag:talent)You belong to the skies. All wind-based abilities are more potent, cheaper, and easier to master, and you recover energy faster while in the sky.
name: Skyward

description: #(Tag:talent)(Tag:tech)(Tech) All Tinker abilities are easier for you to use and innovate with, and you interface with any existing machine and network with greater ease. (A/N: Reroll if you don't have a tinker ability)
name: Electric Sheep

description: #(Tag:dexterity+)You are more flexible than an expert contortionist.
name: Flexible

description: #(Tag:dark)(Tag:dark+)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:infernal+)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:social)(Tag:summon+)(Tag:talent)You are the destined Demon King. Your Darkness and Unholy-related abilities and magic and your physical abilities are greatly enhanced, further increased if your race is demonic or infernal, and you greatly resist all Darkness and Unholy attributes. Demonic and infernal beings are servile and obedient toward you, weaker ones are compelled to serve, and you grow slightly stronger for each creature that submits to you, based on its power.
name: Demon King

description: #(Tag:holy+)(Tag:light+)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:social)(Tag:talent)You are the True Hero blessed by the divines. Your Light and Holy-based abilities and physical abilities are greatly enhanced, and all blessings on you are stronger and longer-lasting. Divine and Clergy-aligned beings regard you with reverence and reward your service, and you gain a temporary boost to all stats when fighting to save someone, scaled to your willpower and the stakes.
name: True Hero

description: #(Tag:holy+)(Tag:light+)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:social)(Tag:talent)You are the chosen Hero of Humanity. Your Light and Holy-based abilities below Mythical rank gain a rank, your base physical abilities are massively enhanced, and all blessings on you are permanent. Divine and Clergy-aligned beings revere you and reward your service, and you gain a temporary boost to all stats when fighting to save someone, scaled to your willpower and the stakes.
name: Chosen Champion

description: #(Tag:nsfw)(Tag:talent)(Nsfw) You possess a smooth, alluring top-tier singing voice that impresses even the pickiest listeners and sounds more convincing. It enhances your voice-based abilities.
name: Alluring Whisper

description: #(Tag:social)You project a charismatic aura that draws people in and elevates you in their eyes.
name: Charisma

description: #(Nsfw) You project a subtle sensual presence that increasingly attracts and arouses those exposed to it. It only affects people friendly to you.
name: Sensual Presence

description: #(Tag:social)You face far less resistance from potential partners and society when building a harem, though it remains challenging.
name: Harem Keeper

description: #(Tag:social)Your preferred partners are more attracted to you, and neither society nor your partners object to your harem itself, though other relationship issues may remain.
name: Harem Sovereign

description: #(Tag:social)You build affection, trust, and respect with teammates and allies much faster, especially by fighting alongside them. You also cooperate with others far more effectively.
name: Camaraderie

description: #(Tag:social)You strike strangers as dependable and trustworthy, making their trust and respect easier to earn. This does not work on people with a negative opinion of you.
name: Trustable Face

description: #(Tag:rule)Any pocket, backpack, or similar container you own is 10x larger on the inside, without changing the object itself.
name: Large Pockets

description: #(Tag:rule)"I love a good challenge." Conflict and worthy opponents are drawn to you like a magnet, challenging your life, but conflict also brings rewards.
name: Conflict Drive

description: #(Tag:meta)A challenge board is added to your gacha, offering 3 limited-time quests based on your location, state, and power level. You can take one challenge every 48 hours when the board resets, or every 168 hours after a failure.
name: Challenge DLC

description: #(Tag:meta)(Tag:social)A relationship tracker is added to your gacha page, showing your standing with people of interest and what they think of you, plus their interests, likes, and dislikes.
name: Relationship Tracker DLC

description: #(Tag:meta)(Tag:physical+)Your fists are your only true weapon. Your physical stats are augmented proportionally to the strongest weapon you own, but this bonus is negated the moment you wield any weapon.
name: The Real Weapon

description: #(Tag:rule)You are one with your weapon: whatever item you wield gains your physical stats added to its own. A copper coin in your hands can out-toughen diamond if you are strong enough.
name: One with the Blade

description: #(Tag:defence+)(Tag:strength+)(Tag:talent)Unga Bunga. You possess a caveman's enhanced strength and endurance, skill with blunt instruments, and ability to tough it out in the wild.
name: Caveman

description: #(Tag:perception+)(Tag:space+)You are a child of the Void with enhanced spatial awareness. You sense portals opening a kilometre away, and all Space-based abilities are more potent and faster to master.
name: Void Childe

description: #(Tag:time)(Tag:time+)(Tag:time-resistance+)You are Time's favourite: you are immune to all time-based abilities, time travel, and paradoxes, and time cannot be stopped in your world even by the mightiest gods. Your time-related abilities and magic cost massively less strain and energy, and you ignore the paradox and time resistance of targets below god level.
name: Father Time

description: #(Tag:eldritch)(Tag:nsfw)(Tag:social)(Tag:vitality+)Thanks to her blessing, your vitality and virility are considerably increased. Those with maternal instincts find themselves more attracted to you, and you are assured to be a great father.
name: Shub's Favor

description: #(Tag:eldritch)(Tag:space+)(Tag:space-resistance+)Thanks to Yog's blessing, all drawbacks from your Space-related abilities are mitigated, they cost less energy, and their range is far higher. You also gain incredible resistance to Space attribute attacks.
name: Yog's Blessing

description: #(Tag:nsfw)(Tag:stamina+)(Nsfw) During sexual activity, your stamina recovery, endurance, and resilience are massively boosted, letting you continue for literal days without rest.
name: Carnal Engine

description: #(Tag:luck+)You are modestly lucky, with fate's scales skewed toward you without reaching blatantly supernatural levels. (Does not affect Gacha)
name: Four Leaf Clover

description: #(Tag:luck+)You are naturally very lucky and favored by Lady Fate. You can rob a casino blind, and matters without high impact on fate go in your favor. (Does not affect Gacha)
name: Rabbits Foot

description: #(Tag:luck+)You are incredibly lucky without seeming superhuman. You almost never lose games of chance unless you choose to, if it is up to chance, it lands in your favour. (Does not affect Gacha)
name: 21 Leaf Clover

description: #(Tag:luck+)You are absurdly lucky, enough for luck alone to count as an ability. Chance falls in your favour and fate bends toward you, though not all luck is good. (Does not affect Gacha)
name: Fortune's Lover

description: #(Tag:anti-monster)(Tag:martial)(Tag:perception+)(Tag:reflex+)(Tag:talent)You are the true hunter of inhumans such as Ghouls, Ghosts, Cryptids, and Demons. Against them, your reflexes and skills are enhanced, you enter a focused state, and your intuition is heightened.
name: Hellsing

description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:talent)You are a natural marksman with exceptional aim and accuracy with most projectiles, especially bows and ranged weaponry.
name: Marksman

description: #(Tag:agility+)(Tag:defence+)(Tag:magic-resistance+)(Tag:strength+)Whenever you suffer a debuff or binding, your physical stats and magical resistance increase. The more penalties you incur, the stronger this boost becomes.
name: Rebellion

description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:talent)As a child blessed by Artemis, goddess of the hunt, your proficiency and talent with all ranged weapons are greatly increased. Your tracking and wayfinding are supernaturally enhanced, letting you trail prey across a country and never lose your way in the deepest woods.
name: Child of Artemis

description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:rule)(Tag:social)You wield any weapon as if you have trained with it for 10 years and bypass any wielding requirements, such as being an angel or chosen hero. All sentient weapons adore you and yearn to be wielded by you.
name: Master of Arms

description: #(Tag:rule)You qualify to wield any item or pass through any qualified door, even if the item deems you unworthy like Excalibur. You must be holding the weapon, unarmed combat does not count, and mastery vanishes when you let go.
name: Qualified

description: #(Tag:social)People are far more forgiving toward you and cannot stay angry at you for long, even in court.
name: Innocuous

description: #(Tag:social)People are far more generous toward you, pay you handsomely, and rarely keep secrets from you.
name: Sharing Is Caring

description: #(Tag:anti-holy)(Tag:anti-light)The child of evil rebels against the heavens. All your stats are significantly increased against Holy- or Light-aligned enemies, but you cannot receive Holy or Light blessings or healing.
name: Lucifer's Child

description: #(Tag:social)People automatically normalize your weirdness and oddities, from skipping class to speaking strangely.
name: Nothing Strange

description: #(Tag:social)People rationalize and accept your unusual or alarming actions, though this effect weakens the more drastic and inexcusable your actions become.
name: Common Sense

description: #(Tag:social)"This could get problematic." The more evil someone is, the more easily you win their favor and affection.
name: Lethal Charm

description: #(Tag:strength+)Your body is unnaturally powerful. Even as a basic human, you are at least a hundred times stronger than you should be and can demolish the entire world military with ease.
name: Titan Crusher

description: #(Tag:social)"Dattebayo!" You are an excellent motivational speaker whose corny words strike hearts instead of sounding cringey. You easily get through to even stubborn listeners.
name: Motivational Speaker

description: #(Tag:magic)(Tag:talent)As a child blessed by Isis, goddess of magic, you learn and comprehend magic with ease regardless of affinity or race restrictions.
name: Blessing of Isis

description: #(Tag:anti-evil)(Tag:mental-resistance+)As a child blessed by Durga, goddess of righteous fury, you are immune to corruption, negative effects, and mental statuses during combat. The more evil your enemy, the greater your advantage against them.
name: Blessing of Durga

description: #(Tag:curse-resistance+)(Tag:dark-resistance+)(Tag:fire+)(Tag:holy)(Tag:light+)As a child blessed by Amaterasu, goddess of the Sun, you greatly resist curses and darkness-based attacks while your light-based abilities are much stronger.
name: Blessing of Amaterasu

description: #(Tag:curse-resistance+)(Tag:necro+)(Tag:necro-resistance+)(Tag:spirit+)As a child blessed by Izanami, goddess of the Underworld and Death, you greatly resist all curses and necrotic effects. Your affinity for all Spirit and Death abilities, spells, and items is increased, and the dead favour you more.
name: Blessing of Izanami

description: #(Tag:mental-resistance+)(Tag:social)(Tag:vitality+)As a child blessed by Hestia, goddess of hearth, you resist all mental effects and negative ailments. Your body is far healthier, and your natural aura puts people at ease.
name: Blessing of Hestia

description: #(Tag:agility+)(Tag:reflex+)(Tag:social)Blessed by Bast, goddess of cats and grace, you gain cat-like reflexes, agility, and night vision. Felines adore you.
name: Blessing of Bast

description: #(Tag:nsfw)(Tag:rule)(Noncon) You freely adjust your own fertility from absolute sterility to extreme potency. You can impregnate even the completely infertile, or match the Goat of a Thousand Young.
name: Fertility Calibration

description: #(Tag:luck+)Your fate is strong and immoderate, curving toward you like a main protagonist. You draw plenty of luck, both good and bad.
name: Draw of Fate

description: #(Tag:fae)(Tag:rule)(Tag:social)"A Deal's a Deal." People feel compelled to fulfil their end of any explicit deal they make with you (No clever wording or Fae deals). It is also far easier for you to goad people into outrageous bets.
name: Dealmaker

description: #(Tag:nsfw)(Tag:rule)(Nsfw)(Noncon) Your fate draws you into "erotic" situations, such as meeting a hot single mom next door, that often lead to sexual encounters. Others are also far more affected by sexual situations involving you.
name: Hentai Protagonist

description: #(Tag:nsfw)(Tag:rule)(Nsfw)(Noncon) Your path is shaped by the Ecchi genre, drawing you into situations like walking in on someone changing, joining a dorm of attractive people, or getting locked in a closet with someone hot.
name: Ecchi Protagonist

description: #(Tag:social)You project an aura that draws honesty from others. People lie worse around you and feel greater remorse for deceiving you.
name: Honesty

description: #(Tag:social)Whenever you speak what you believe to be true, people believe your words, however you choose to word them.
name: Truthspeaker

description: #(Tag:social)People are naturally more loyal to you, more willing to risk themselves for you and less inclined to betray you.
name: Loyalty

description: #(Tag:divination-resistance+)Information-gathering abilities and technologies malfunction when targeting you.
name: Vault

description: #(Tag:mind)Your mind is organized and efficient like a library, with slightly faster memory, clarity, and speed.
name: Library Mind

description: #(Tag:social)Your embrace feels as soft as a mother's love, calming, comforting, and therapeutic. Even an evil man might break down crying in your arms.
name: Embrace

description: #(Tag:body)(Tag:talent)You are transhuman, whatever your race. Genetic and mechanical augments work exceptionally well on you, and you suffer no penalty for changing race or installing cybernetics.
name: Transhuman

description: #You hold basic mastery over all mundane skills and mild talent in every field, cooking without burning eggs, basic mechanics, dancing without tripping, wielding a sword without cutting yourself.
name: All Trades

description: #(Tag:rule)(Tag:social)You and your familiars always carry the relevant papers. You can reach into your pocket and find whatever legal identification you need.
name: Paper Trail

description: #(Tag:nsfw)(Tag:social)(Nsfw) People do not mind your open displays of affection, so long as you are not too overt.
name: No Strangers

description: #(Tag:divination-resistance+)(Tag:meta-resistance+)Information gathering fails against you: scrying spells collapse, precognition fails, and cameras stop recording.
name: No Peeking

description: #(Tag:meta)You spend less energy on your other abilities for each ability slot you leave unused. If you use only one of 3 slots, that ability costs 3x less.
name: Battery Saver

description: #(Tag:nsfw)(Tag:rule)You live in a reality retconned across all existence where some men are now women and some women are now men.
name: Rule 63

description: #(Nsfw) The more monstrous a member of the opposite sex is, the more attracted they are to you. This only affects those you would find attractive yourself.
name: Monster Master

description: #(Tag:nsfw)(Tag:social)(Nsfw) Your scent smells very good and slightly arousing.
name: Musk

description: #Everyone you meet forms a good impression of you once they get to know you, even evil dictators, violent murderers, or mindless beasts. This only works on named characters.
name: No Enemies

description: #Everyone you meet starts friendly toward you unless they already hold a preconceived opinion of you. You can share a drink with even Thanos or Death itself.
name: My Friend Now

description: #(Tag:bloodline)(Tag:fire)(Tag:fire+)(Tag:martial)(Tag:maximum-energy+)(Tag:power)(Tag:talent)You carry Uchiha Clan blood, granting you increased Martial Talent, Energy Reserves, and Fire Affinity. You can potentially unlock a Natural Sharingan (Epic Ability) that costs no ability slot. (Does not give Chakra)
name: Uchiha

description: #(Tag:bloodline)(Tag:health-recovery)(Tag:maximum-energy+)(Tag:power)(Tag:vitality+)You carry Uzumaki Clan blood, granting you greatly increased Vitality and Energy Reserves. You heal yourself and others by imbuing your blood with energy and life force, and you can potentially unlock Adamantine Sealing Chains (Epic Ability) that costs no ability slot. (Does not give Chakra)
name: Uzumaki

description: #(Tag:bloodline)(Tag:dexterity+)(Tag:martial)(Tag:maximum-energy+)(Tag:power)(Tag:talent)You carry Hyuga Clan blood, granting you increased Martial Talent, Energy Reserves, and Dexterity. You can potentially unlock a natural Byakugan (Elite Ability) that costs no ability slot. (Does not give Chakra or dormant alien god genes)
name: Hyuga

description: #(Tag:bloodline)(Tag:martial)(Tag:maximum-energy+)(Tag:nature)(Tag:power)(Tag:talent)(Tag:vitality+)You descend directly from Hashirama Senju, gaining greatly increased lifeforce, energy reserves, and martial prowess. You can potentially unlock natural Wood Release (Legendary Ability) and gain increased Nature Affinity. (Does not give Chakra)
name: Senju

description: #(Tag:bloodline)(Tag:martial)(Tag:talent)You are a Hanma with exceptional genetics, giving you increased poison resistance, far faster physical stat growth, and greatly increased martial talent. You carry overwhelming testosterone compared to other men, or equal genetic gifts without the testosterone if you are female.
name: Hanma

description: #(Tag:necro)(Tag:race-change)Race - You are a lesser undead and must choose between zombie or skeleton. You have no stamina and spend energy for everything, gaining unique bonuses and demerits based on your choice, and this race toggle is permanent until contested.
name: Lesser Undead

description: #(Tag:necro)(Tag:race-change)Race - You are a greater undead and transform into a Death Knight or Lich based on your stats. You have no stamina and spend energy for everything, gaining unique bonuses and demerits based on your form.
name: Greater Undead

description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:race-change)(Tag:talent)(Tag:water)(Tag:water+)Race - You are a Fishman of a random hybrid with naturally stronger physical stats than humans. You breathe underwater, hold great water affinity, communicate with sea-bound creatures, and can learn Fishman Karate.
name: Fishman

description: #(Tag:defence+)(Tag:fire)(Tag:fire+)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:race-change)Race - You are a Lunarian of a legendary race with massively increased physical stats, wings, and natural fire manipulation. While the fire on your back stays lit, your durability is massively increased.
name: Lunarian

description: #(Tag:health-recovery)(Tag:maximum-energy+)(Tag:necro)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:race-change)(Tag:time)(Tag:vampiric)Race - You are a Nightkin vampire created from Dead Apostle blood with superhuman physical and magical abilities. You regenerate by rewinding as long as you hold blood, and you grow stronger and can evolve to the next undeath stage by consuming enough blood.
name: Nightkin

description: #(Tag:health-recovery)(Tag:maximum-energy+)(Tag:necro)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:power)(Tag:race-change)(Tag:time)(Tag:vampiric)Race - You are a Nightmare vampire born from Dead Apostle blood with superhuman physical and magical abilities. You regenerate by rewinding while you hold blood and can turn people into ghouls. You wield your own unique Elite Rank Ability with no ability slot and evolve to the next undeath stage by consuming enough blood.
name: Nightmare

description: #(Tag:health-recovery)(Tag:maximum-energy+)(Tag:necro)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:power)(Tag:race-change)(Tag:time)(Tag:vampiric)Race - You are a fully realized Dead Apostle with vastly superior physical stats and time-rewinding regenerative immortality while you hold blood. You gain your own Epic ranked ability that costs no ability slot, turn humans and animals into lower-ranking apostle thralls, and grow stronger and recover energy the more blood you consume.
name: Dead Apostle

description: #(Tag:health-recovery)(Tag:maximum-energy+)(Tag:necro)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:power)(Tag:race-change)(Tag:time)(Tag:vampiric)Race - You are a true Dead Apostle Ancestor with immense physical and magical power, rewinding your own time to heal whenever you are injured while you hold blood. You wield your own Idea Blood, a Legendary Ability costing no ability slot, turn anyone who ingests your blood into a powerful vampire instantly, and all vampires and undead acknowledge you as the ultimate vampire class.
name: Dead Apostle Ancestor

description: #(Tag:agility+)(Tag:beastkin)(Tag:perception+)(Tag:race-change)(Tag:strength+)(Tag:vitality+)Race - You are a beastkin of a random animal such as bear, rabbit, cat, wolf, etc., with enhanced physical stats and night vision. You gain unique traits and biological features based on your hybrid.
name: Beastkin

description: #(Tag:agility+)(Tag:defence+)(Tag:health-regeneration+)(Tag:race-change)(Tag:strength+)Race - You are a flesh-eating ghoul with a chosen Kagune and formidable regeneration. You cannot digest anything but human flesh, and you slowly turn feral if you go longer than two weeks without dining.
name: Ghoul

description: #(Tag:agility+)(Tag:defence+)(Tag:health-regeneration+)(Tag:race-change)(Tag:strength+)Race - You are a One-Eyed Ghoul, stronger than an average ghoul, with superhuman stats and a chosen Kagune. You grow stronger by eating human flesh but can also eat normal human food.
name: One-Eyed Ghoul

description: #(Tag:agility+)(Tag:defence+)(Tag:health-recovery)(Tag:race-change)(Tag:strength+)(Tag:vampiric)Race - You are a vampire born of the Stone Mask created by Pillar Man Kars. You gain amped physical stats, ghoul and vampire creation, and flesh manipulation, but you are deathly vulnerable to sunlight.
name: Vampire

description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:health-regeneration+)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:race-change)(Tag:transformation)Race - You are a pillar man unlocked by the Stone Mask with self-biokinesis, flesh absorption, thrall creation, and massively increased physical stats. You are vulnerable to sunlight.
name: Pillar Men

description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:health-regeneration+)(Tag:mind+)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:race-change)(Tag:talent)(Tag:transformation)Race - You are a perfect lifeform unlocked as a pillar man by the Stone Mask with the super Aja. You gain enhanced physical and magical stats and freely manipulate your own biology and body shape.
name: Perfect Lifeform

description: #(Tag:defence+)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:power)(Tag:race-change)Race - You are a Viltrumite of one of the galaxy's fiercest warrior races with an incredibly powerful body and free flight. You are almost invulnerable except to a specific sound frequency.
name: Viltrumite

description: #(Tag:growth+)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:power)(Tag:race-change)Race - You are a Kryptonian whose physical and energy reserves grow with sunlight exposure. You gain heat vision, ice breath, high-speed flight, no need to breathe, tactile telekinesis, X-ray vision, and more, becoming basically a living god under a yellow sun.
name: Kryptonian

description: #(Tag:growth+)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:power)(Tag:race-change)Race - You are a Saiyan warrior with a great natural physique and a monkey tail weakness. Under a full moon you turn into a rampaging giant monkey with massively increased stats, but you still need decades of training to grow truly strong.
name: Saiyan

description: #(Tag:bloodline)(Tag:martial)(Tag:mental)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:power)(Tag:talent)You are the child of the God Emperor of Mankind, sharing his gifted physique, charisma, martial prowess, scientific gift, and potential as the strongest Psyker. You can master all non-Chaos Psyker Disciplines and eventually tear apart a planet with Psyker power alone through training, as your power emulates the Warp without connecting to it.
name: Child of Man

description: #(Tag:growth+)(Tag:health-regeneration+)(Tag:maximum-energy+)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:power+)(Tag:race-change)Race - You are a Majin descendant of Majin Buu with a malleable gum-like physique and massively enhanced physical and magical stats. You survive and regenerate from even a handful of your body and absorb people and objects to strengthen yourself, though you start with only greatly superhuman abilities and increased energy.
name: Majin

description: #(Tag:bloodline)(Tag:martial)(Tag:power)(Tag:talent)You are a Brazilian descendant of the legendary Jetstream Sam. You can double jump and hold talent in swordsmanship and swordsmithing.
name: Rodrigues

description: #(Tag:blood)(Tag:bloodline)(Tag:infernal+)(Tag:necro+)(Tag:social)(Tag:vampiric)You descend from the legendary Tepes bloodline of original vampires. Your Vampirism, Unholy, and Hemokinetic abilities are more potent, and all undead and vampires respect you more.
name: Tepes

description: #(Tag:body)(Tag:defence+)Your skeleton is unusually durable, flexible, and better at conducting energy, taking far more punishment before damage. Note that your skeleton isn't real mithril and scales with your physical stats.
name: Mithril Skeleton

description: #(Tag:body)(Tag:defence+)Your skeleton is incredibly durable and dense, seeming nigh unbreakable without poisoning you. Note that your skeleton isn't real adamantium and scales with your physical stats.
name: Adamantium Skeleton

description: #(Tag:body)(Tag:defence+)(Tag:physical+)Your skeleton resembles Vibranium more than bone, seeming nigh unbreakable while absorbing and storing kinetic energy. You spend that stored energy to temporarily enhance your physical strength. Note that your skeleton isn't real Vibranium and scales with your physical stats.
name: Vibranium Skeleton

description: #(Tag:body)(Tag:defence+)Your skeleton is bonded with Adamantium, making it borderline unbreakable but severely poisoning you. You should wait to activate this trait unless you have countermeasures lined up.
name: Adamantium Bonding

description: #(Tag:sense+)(Tag:talent)You hold a knack for sensing and locating energy/mana/chakra, etc. Your energy-sensing and Thinker abilities are enhanced.
name: Sensor

description: #(Tag:defence+)(Tag:energy-regeneration+)(Tag:stamina+)(Tag:strength+)You grow stronger the more you are outnumbered in a fight, with enemies counting only if they will inflict grievous harm on you. This caps at 1 vs 1000 and halves for each ally fighting the outnumbering enemies alongside you.
name: Man vs World

description: #(Tag:physical+)(Tag:rule)Your stats increase during a one vs one fight, and this effect ends if any other combatant intervenes. People are also less likely to interrupt your duels.
name: Duelist

description: #(Tag:mind)You divide your attention across multiple tasks without losing efficiency. Your efficiency may still decline if you take on too many tasks at once.
name: Multitasking

description: #(Tag:luck+)(Tag:rule)You hold a better chance of finding something useful whenever you scavenge for treasure, lost parts, artefacts, etc.
name: Scavenger

description: #(Tag:luck+)(Tag:rule)You are much more likely to encounter romantic interests in favourable positions during daily life.
name: Meet Cute

description: #(Tag:blood)(Tag:energy-recovery)(Tag:life)You can treat your vitality as a secondary mana bar at a 1-to-1 exchange rate. Expended vitality cannot be healed and only returns through rest.
name: Blood Mana

description: #(Tag:holy)(Tag:holy+)(Tag:light+)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:race-change)Race Change - You are an Angel created with holy power, with slightly increased physical stats and natural winged flight. Your Holy and Light-based abilities are more potent and include Holy Light (Rare Rank Ability), while your Darkness and Unholy abilities weaken and you stay vulnerable to Unholy attributes.
name: Angel

description: #(Tag:holy)(Tag:holy+)(Tag:light+)(Tag:maximum-energy+)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:power)(Tag:race-change)Race Change - You are a Principality, a higher-tier angel with two pairs of wings and holy power. You gain increased physical stats, energy reserves, and natural winged flight, stronger Holy and Light-based abilities including Holy Light (Rare Rank Ability), weaker Darkness and Unholy abilities, and vulnerability to Unholy attributes.
name: Principality

description: #(Tag:holy)(Tag:holy+)(Tag:light+)(Tag:maximum-energy+)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:power)(Tag:power+)(Tag:race-change)(Tag:talent)Race Change - You are a Dominion, a high-tier angel with three pairs of wings and increased magical and physical abilities. Your Holy and Light attributes are considerably boosted and cost less mana, you instinctively learn Holy and Light Magic and convert energy into greater Holy Light (Elite Rank Ability), while your Darkness and Unholy attributes are greatly weakened.
name: Dominion

description: #(Tag:holy)(Tag:holy+)(Tag:light+)(Tag:maximum-energy+)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:power)(Tag:power+)(Tag:race-change)(Tag:talent)Race Change - You are a Throne, one of the highest-ranking angels with four pairs of wings and great physical and magical abilities. Your Holy and Light attributes are greatly boosted and cost less mana, you instinctively develop Holy and Light Magic and convert energy into searing Holy Light or pure holy energy, while your Darkness and Unholy attributes are greatly weakened and hurt you upon use.
name: Throne

description: #(Tag:holy)(Tag:holy+)(Tag:light+)(Tag:maximum-energy+)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:power)(Tag:power+)(Tag:race-change)(Tag:talent)Race Change - You are a Seraphim, the strongest Angel kind with 5 pairs of wings and incredible magical and physical power. Your Holy and Light abilities and magic at Legendary rank or below gain a tier boost, you instinctively use and develop Holy and Light Magic and convert Mana into a Holy Mana Burst, but you cannot use any Darkness or Unholy abilities and magic.
name: Seraphim

description: #(Tag:talent)You learn faster and easier when taught personally by someone more skilled than you in the subject.
name: Student

description: #(Tag:social)(Tag:talent)You learn faster and easier when taught personally by someone more skilled than you in the subject. You also earn your teachers' favour more easily.
name: Disciple

description: #(Tag:social)(Tag:talent)You are THE Pupil who learns much faster and far more easily when taught personally by someone more skilled than you. You also earn your teachers' favour more easily.
name: Prodigious Pupil

description: #(Tag:holy)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:social)You are the Taker whom Infernal, Holy, or Divine beings you find attractive find more attractive in return. You earn their affection more easily.
name: The Taker

description: #(Tag:nsfw)(Tag:rule)(Nsfw) Hybrid girls and those of the opposite gender with monster or beast traits like you more and build relationships with you more easily. Some monsters you encounter seem oddly humanoid and compatible.
name: Monstergirl Enthusiast

description: #(Tag:social)Upgrade to Terrifying Presence - You project a nightmarish presence that can make a grown person soil themselves without a word. Every gesture you make can feel like a death threat when you want it to.
name: Reaper's Presence

description: #(Tag:magic-resistance+)(Tag:rule)All magic is completely nullified against you, so even a god of magic dropping the Big Bang on you would not scratch you. You cannot use magic to any extent while this trait stays active.
name: Magic Is Not Real

description: #(Tag:summon+)You summon and command creatures, familiars, spirits, and summons naturally. Your familiars gain enhanced stats for less energy, your projection-type abilities and spells grow more potent, and you build affection and loyalty with summons and contracted entities more easily.
name: Summoner

description: #(Tag:magic)(Tag:magic+)(Tag:talent)You wear the brand of Tzeentch, the Changer of Ways, greatly speeding your comprehension and learning. You improve skill and magic far faster and can learn spells normally barred to you by restrictions like race. Note: Brands do not connect you to the Chaos Gods or Warp.
name: Brand of Tzeentch

description: #(Tag:social)(Tag:talent)You wear the brand of Slaanesh, the Lord of Pleasure, greatly increasing your understanding of others and letting you vaguely feel their emotions. Your presence grows naturally more charismatic and alluring. Note: Brands do not connect you to the Chaos Gods or Warp.
name: Brand of Slaanesh

description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:talent)You wear the brand of Khorne, the Blood God, greatly increasing your combat propensity with heightened instincts and intuition for any weapon or skill. You track blood and sense killing intent instinctively as a natural killing machine. Note: Brands do not connect you to the Chaos Gods or Warp.
name: Brand of Khorne

description: #(Tag:poison)(Tag:poison+)(Tag:poison-resistance+)(Tag:talent)You wear the brand of Nurgle, the Plague Father, making you immune to poisons, toxins, and diseases below Legendary rank and greatly resistant above it. You understand poisons, toxins, and diseases better, increasing related ability potency and your power to cure them. Note: Brands do not connect you to the Chaos Gods or Warp.
name: Brand of Nurgle

description: #(Tag:meta)If you hold the will, you find a way.
name: Spiral

description: #(Tag:fire)(Tag:health-regeneration+)(Tag:holy)(Tag:holy+)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:power)(Tag:race-change)(Tag:survival)Race Change - You are a monster of god transformed by Helena's Nail through your heart, with monstrous physical stats and holy energy so potent your touch sets a true vampire ablaze. You conjure and freely control holy thorned vines like limbs that protect you on instinct and set anything unholy they touch ablaze with holy fire. You stay completely immortal while your heart remains intact as your vines rebuild your body without consuming energy or using an ability slot.
name: Monster of God

description: #(Tag:lifestyle)You perform all transformations with overly dramatic Magical Girl Transformation flair.
name: Magical Girl Transformation

description: #(Tag:survival)You are ordinarily hard to kill as your existence constantly preserves itself by swapping ability slots to instantly heal you or rearranging your insides. Your abilities grow more effective and cost-efficient the closer you are to death. Even at death, this trait can use your abilities and items for up to 10 minutes to revive or preserve you.
name: Hard to Kill

description: #(Tag:rule)(Tag:survival)You lack the concept of death rather than holding immortality, so no afterlife claims you and immortal-killing weapons cannot put you down forever. Even if every quark in your body is annihilated, you eventually reform.
name: Deathless

description: #(Tag:rule)You use any item, ability, or spell without suffering drawbacks and instantly meet all qualifications. You can wield Excalibur, Rhongomyniad, hijack the Gate of Babylon, or use an item with a 99.999% kill chance.
name: True User

description: #(Tag:growth+)(Tag:rule)You carry something primordial inside you that devours any infiltrator or transgressor in your mind, soul, body, or existence. You shred even a possessing god into ether and tear telepathic connections into pure nourishing energy.
name: All Devouring Physique

description: #(Tag:social)You are quite well known as news of your exploits and accomplishments travels fast with slightly increased reputation effect. If you save a village, even the king may learn of it and reward you.
name: Renown

description: #(Tag:lifestyle)You hold a bureaucrat's eye for easily understanding legal jargon, contract loopholes, and quickly briefing documents. This saves you time in any world with an established government. (If not, the ticket this trait came from can be rerolled)
name: Bureaucrat's Eye

description: #(Tag:lifestyle)You pay no taxes or rent as the government or collectors waive them. Officials and authority figures may even overlook and pardon your minor crimes or mischief.
name: Legal Exemption

description: #(Tag:meta)You halve the restock timer and cooldown of all your items.
name: Hoarder

description: #(Tag:meta)More, more, more: you cannot get enough, as the restock timers and cooldown of all your items drop by 100x.
name: Avaricious Greed

description: #(Tag:blood)(Tag:infernal)You are a demon transformed by Muzan's blood with a superhuman physique and biological immortality. You suffer lethal harm from sunlight and the light attribute, develop your own demon blood art equal to an Uncommon rank ability, and must consume humans or starve to death.
name: Blood Demon

description: #(Tag:health-regeneration+)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:power)(Tag:race-change)(Tag:survival)You are a progenitor sharing all of Muzan Kibutsuji's powers with free shapeshifting, extremely powerful regeneration, and superhuman physical abilities. You turn others into demons with your blood, but sunlight is extremely lethal to you.
name: Progenitor Demon

description: #(Tag:healing)(Tag:health-recovery+)(Tag:health-regeneration+)Your body receives all healing unusually well with 5x stronger natural regeneration and 2x more effective healing effects.
name: Regenerative

description: #(Tag:rule)You send any items you wear to your wardrobe while retaining their bonuses, letting you gain equipment benefits without wearing them. You cannot wear two magical items for the same body part and can only wear mundane items while active.
name: Wardrobe

description: #(Tag:meta)You gain literally nothing, which makes your unluckiness simply impressive.
name: Nothing

description: #(Tag:rule)You set any negative resistance you hold to zero, turning even an 8x fire weakness to neutral and leaving even a shadow demon unharmed by light.
name: No Weakness

description: #(Tag:maximum-energy+)(Tag:power)(Tag:power+)(Tag:spirit)You are a Beast of Humanity formed from humanity's evil who loves Humanity. You hold nigh unlimited magical power and mystery with your own Logos or Law and your own Nega ability, a Divine-level authority costing no slot. You also hold Independent Manifestation and any other powers a beast holds.
name: Beast

description: #(Tag:body)You control your unnaturally variable metabolism at will. You slow it to a near stop or speed it to unnaturally fast levels.
name: Metabolism

description: #(Tag:energy-recovery)(Tag:health-recovery)You recover energy and health slightly faster by eating food. The more nutritious your food, the better your recovery.
name: Hunger

description: #(Tag:energy-regeneration+)(Tag:health-regeneration+)You digest everything with extreme efficiency to draw more nutrients and energy and recover energy and health faster. Your stomach is 50x bigger inside than outside, and you never suffer digestive issues.
name: Voracity

description: #(Tag:energy-regeneration+)(Tag:health-regeneration+)You recover energy and health faster while you sleep.
name: Restful

description: #(Tag:energy-regeneration+)(Tag:health-regeneration+)(Tag:lifestyle)You are blessed by Hypnos, the God of Sleep, drastically increasing your health and energy recovery while you sleep. You fall asleep anywhere into uninterrupted restful sleep, but the blessing needs at least 10 minutes of constant sleep to start.
name: Hypnos' Blessing

description: #(Tag:meta)You gain your own Inventory Page that stores objects as long as their weight stays within what you carry under optimal conditions. Items from the gacha store without issue and ignore this limit.
name: Inventory DLC

description: #(Tag:social)You increase your fame and gain recognition and rewards for achievements more easily. You also assert your achievements and make people believe you more easily.
name: Vaunt

description: #(Tag:social)You are a Gloryhound with a sixth sense for opportunities that increase your fame and reputation. You make people perceive you as you want more easily by shifting your vibe to feel dangerous, comforting, or imposing.
name: Gloryhound

description: #(Tag:social)You hold the King Engine in your heart that beats loudly at just the right moments. You master bluffing so fully that others delude themselves about you without your claims, making you almost invincible with enough luck to back it up.
name: King Engine

description: #(Tag:meta)(Tag:power)You are a Psyker who emulates Immaterium power through infinite Chaos instead of drawing from it. You choose one of the 5 common disciplines to specialise in and wield. (Only one may be chosen, another can be chosen if the trait is rolled again)
name: Psyker

description: #(Tag:meta)(Tag:power)You are a Greater Psyker who emulates Immaterium power through infinite Chaos instead of drawing from it. You master disciplines far quicker and master all 5 common disciplines without penalty.
name: Greater Psyker

description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:power)You are a Psyker emulating Immaterium power through infinite Chaos who specialises in Biomancy and trains to manipulate the flesh of friend and foe with your mind. (You can only train in the specialised discipline capabilities). Spell List: https://warhammer40k.fandom.com/wiki/Psyker#Biomancy_Discipline
name: Psyker(Biomancy)

description: #(Tag:fire)(Tag:power)You are a Psyker emulating Immaterium power through infinite Chaos who specialises in Pyromancy and trains to create fire from your mind and weave it into firestorms and attacks. (You can only train in the specialised discipline capabilities). Spell List: https://warhammer40k.fandom.com/wiki/Psyker#Pyromancy_Discipline
name: Psyker(Pyromancy)

description: #(Tag:kinetic)(Tag:power)You are a Psyker emulating Immaterium power through infinite Chaos who specialises in Telekinesis and trains to manipulate space and the material world with your mind. (You can only train in the specialised discipline capabilities). Spell List: https://warhammer40k.fandom.com/wiki/Psyker#Telekinesis_Discipline
name: Psyker(Telekinesis)

description: #(Tag:mental)(Tag:power)You are a Psyker emulating Immaterium power through infinite Chaos who specialises in Telepathy and trains to bind the wills and minds around you. (You can only train in the specialised discipline capabilities). Spell List: https://warhammer40k.fandom.com/wiki/Psyker#Telepathy_Discipline
name: Psyker(Telepathy)

description: #(Tag:divination)(Tag:power)You are a Psyker emulating Immaterium power through infinite Chaos who specialises in Divination and trains to uncover the past, present, and future around you. (You can only train in the specialised discipline capabilities). Spell List: https://warhammer40k.fandom.com/wiki/Psyker#Divination_Discipline
name: Psyker(Divination)

description: #(Tag:blood)(Tag:bloodline)(Tag:magic)(Tag:maximum-energy+)(Tag:meta-resistance+)(Tag:talent)(Tag:vitality+)You carry Great One blood granting you greater vitality, energy, Esoteric resistance, and larger reserves that make Magic and Esoteric Arts easier to learn, understand, and train. Your blood heals in proportion to your vitality, but heavy drinkers risk your corruptive presence while you can exert greater influence over those who consume it. (You are not an actual Great One)
name: Old Blood

description: #(Tag:body)Your tears are now twice as salty.
name: Salty Tears

description: #(Tag:luck+)(Tag:rule)You hold substantially increased luck in romance.
name: Lucky Romantic

description: #(Tag:luck+)(Tag:rule)You hold greatly increased luck in romance. Remember to thank Cupid.
name: Cupid's Blessing

description: #(Tag:electric)(Tag:electric+)(Tag:nsfw)(Tag:social)(Tag:talent)(Tag:transformation+)(Nsfw) You are a child blessed by Zeus who can bed anyone, with increased charisma, fertility, and talent in the carnal arts. Your Changer abilities are easier and cheaper to use and maintain, and your lightning-based abilities are stronger too.
name: Blessing of Zeus

description: #(Tag:maximum-energy+)(Tag:power+)You hold an infinite energy source for every use, from magical power to stamina to soul energy. Your energy output is massively increased, letting even a common rank fire ability dwarf nuclear bombs ten times over.
name: Infinite

description: #(Tag:rule)You always win because reality passively eliminates outcomes where you fail your actively pursued objective. Your degree of success may still depend on your own abilities.
name: Absolute Victory

description: #(Tag:rule)(Tag:survival)You are immortal in every way that matters with regeneration faster than sight. Even universal collapse, erasure by the One Above All, or absolute nothingness cannot stop you from regenerating back. You may even survive the Blind Idiot.
name: Immortality

description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:dark)(Tag:dark-resistance+)(Tag:earth)(Tag:earth-resistance+)(Tag:fire)(Tag:fire-resistance+)(Tag:ice-resistance+)(Tag:light-resistance+)(Tag:water)(Tag:water-resistance+)You are absolutely immune to all damage from natural elements such as Fire, Water, Earth, Wind, Light, and Dark. Even a Supernova or Absolute Zero will not scuff your clothes, though physical attacks and unreal elements like Space, Time, and Raw Energy bypass your defences.
name: Elemental Immunity

description: #(Tag:energy-recovery)You absorb anything with your body and soul, especially Energy, surviving the sun by soaking heat into your energy reserves. Your absorption speed and degree scale with your stats, but even as a base human only a nuclear bomb or worse bypasses your basic absorption.
name: Absolute Absorber

description: #(Tag:lifestyle)While active, you prevent transformations, race changes, and similar shifts from altering your looks in ways you consider undesirable.
name: Cosmetic Calibration

description: #(Tag:dark+)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:infernal+)(Tag:race-change)Race Change - You are an Imp, a low-rank Demon. You gain increased physical and magical stats and increased affinity for Unholy, Darkness, and Fire, but you gain vulnerability to Holy, Light, and exorcisms.
name: Imp

description: #(Tag:dark+)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:infernal+)(Tag:maximum-energy+)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:race-change)Race Change - You are a Demon, a middle-rank infernal being. You gain augmented physical and magical stats and greater affinity for Unholy, Darkness, Infernal, and Fire, but you gain vulnerability to Holy, Light, Divine, and exorcisms. You can turn body parts into natural weapons such as sharp teeth and claws.
name: Demon

description: #(Tag:dark+)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:infernal+)(Tag:maximum-energy+)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:power)(Tag:race-change)Race Change - You are a Fiend, a high-rank infernal demon. You gain considerable physical and magical abilities and greater affinity for Unholy, Darkness, Infernal, and Fire, letting you master related abilities and spells much faster and naturally create Hell Flame (Rare Rank Ability), but you gain extreme vulnerability to Holy, Divine, Light, and exorcisms.
name: Fiend

description: #(Tag:dark+)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:infernal+)(Tag:maximum-energy+)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:power)(Tag:race-change)(Tag:social)Race Change - You are an Archfiend, a Demon Noble. You gain greatly superhuman stats, potent magical abilities, and a presence that commands respect and fear from weaker Infernals. You gain incredible affinity for Unholy, Darkness, and Infernal, letting you use related abilities and spells to a greater degree and naturally create Hell Flame (Rare Rank Ability), but you cannot use Holy or Light under normal circumstances and you gain vulnerability to them. You can unleash your demonic power to assume a more demonic appearance, further augmenting your stats and imbuing your abilities with Darkness at the cost of faster energy drain.
name: Archfiend

description: #(Tag:dark)(Tag:dark+)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:infernal+)(Tag:maximum-energy+)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:power)(Tag:race-change)(Tag:social)Race Change - You are a True Demon, a Demon Royalty. You gain incredible physical and magical might. Your true blood lets you command lower-ranked Infernals, though strong wills can partly resist. You gain unmatched affinity for Darkness, Infernal, and Unholy, letting you convert your energy into Dark or Unholy attributes and naturally create Greater Hell Flame (Elite Rank Ability), but you cannot use Holy or Light under normal circumstances and you gain vulnerability to Holy. You can unleash your True Demon form to assume a more demonic appearance, augmenting your stats while considerably increasing energy drain.
name: True Demon

description: #(Tag:dark)(Tag:dark+)(Tag:energy-regeneration+)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:infernal+)(Tag:magic+)(Tag:maximum-energy+)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:power)(Tag:power+)(Tag:race-change)(Tag:social)Race Change - You are a Daemon, more than a mere infernal being. You gain superhuman physical abilities, incredible magical power, energy reserves, and regeneration. You gain incredible affinity for Darkness, Infernal, and Unholy, letting you invent spells on the spot and massively amplify related abilities and spells. When you unleash your true spirit form, your maximum health and regeneration convert into magical power, you become incorporeal, massively amplify your energy output, and imbue your powers with Unholy and Darkness. Since energy replaces vitality, you cannot die while you have energy.
name: Daemon

description: #(Tag:dark+)(Tag:health-regeneration+)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:magic-resistance+)(Tag:martial+)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:race-change)(Tag:social)(Tag:transformation)Race Change - You are a Demon Kaiser, a primordial Infernal. You gain increased magical ability, massively amplified physical abilities and regeneration, and can flatten hills with your fists at base. You can bend any weaker Infernal to your will. You gain incredible affinity for Infernal and Unholy, letting you augment related abilities below Legendary rank to a higher tier, but you gain vulnerability to Holy and Light. When you unleash your True Kaiser form, your physical stats massively amplify, you gain incredible magical resistance, and you lose your Holy and Light vulnerability, but your energy consumption amplifies and the form dispels once you run out of energy.
name: Demon Kaiser

description: #(Tag:maximum-energy+)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:race-change)(Tag:tech)(Tag:tech+)(Tech) Race Change - You are a convert, half flesh and half machine. You gain increased physical stats and energy reserves and increased affinity for Tinker abilities, technology, and interfacing, but you gain vulnerability to Electricity and Interfacing.
name: Augmented

description: #(Tag:energy-recovery)(Tag:maximum-energy+)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:power)(Tag:race-change)(Tag:tech)(Tag:tech+)(Tag:tinker+)(Tech) Race Change - You are an Android, a higher-class machine-flesh hybrid. You gain increased physical abilities and energy reserves, but your natural energy regeneration lessens and you can charge yourself like a machine. You gain increased effectiveness with Tinker abilities and technology, but you gain vulnerability to Electricity and Interfacing. You possess basic augments such as a head computer and retractable mantis blades in your arms and legs (Cyberpunk). You can tinker with yourself to alter your body to an extent (You still have fleshy bits).
name: Android

description: #(Tag:energy-recovery)(Tag:maximum-energy+)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:power)(Tag:race-change)(Tag:tech)(Tag:tech+)(Tag:tinker+)(Tech) Race Change - You are an Advanced Model Android. You gain superhuman physical abilities and increased energy reserves, but your natural energy regeneration lessens and you can charge yourself like a machine. Your Tinker abilities progress faster and work more efficiently, and your capacity to handle technology greatly increases, but you gain vulnerability to Electricity and Interfacing.
