You possess a powerful integrated computer and combat implants such as Projectile Launcher System, Gorilla Arms, and Mantis Blades from Cyberpunk. You can tinker with yourself to alter your body to an extent (You still have fleshy bits).
name: Advanced Android

description: #(Tag:energy-regeneration+)(Tag:maximum-energy+)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:race-change)(Tag:tech+)(Tag:tinker+)(Tech) Race Change - You are a Biodroid, a seamless merging of technology and flesh. You gain increased physical abilities, increased energy reserves, and a natural healing factor. You gain increased affinity for Tinker abilities and machines, and you can converse and interface with machines.
name: Biodroid

description: #(Tag:energy-recovery)(Tag:maximum-energy+)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:power)(Tag:race-change)(Tag:tech+)(Tag:tinker+)(Tech) Race Change - You are a fully converted Cyborg with minimal flesh. You do not regenerate energy naturally, and instead absorb compatible outside energy sources to recharge. Your Tinker abilities become far more efficient, and you seamlessly interface with technology. You possess multiple augments such as a basic supercomputer and VI, can integrate compatible technology into your body, and carry basic combat implants such as hidden machine guns and a pair of mantis blades in each limb. You can tinker with yourself to alter your body to an extent (You still have fleshy bits), but you cannot benefit from biology-based abilities.
name: Full Conversion

description: #(Tag:energy-recovery)(Tag:maximum-energy+)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:power)(Tag:race-change)(Tag:tech+)(Tag:tinker+)(Tech) Race Change - You are a Mechlord, a higher-class machine-flesh hybrid. You gain superhuman stats and incredible energy storage. Your natural energy regeneration is lacking, but you can absorb energy reserves from nearby machines. Your Tinker efficiency is incredible, and any machine or technology you wield gains performance scaling with your capabilities. You can convert and command technology and AI below your rank, with effectiveness depending on the power difference. You can integrate outside technology into your body as augments. You also gain 3 Silver-tier Tech item rolls as starting augments.
name: Mechlord

description: #(Tag:energy-recovery)(Tag:growth+)(Tag:maximum-energy+)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:power)(Tag:race-change)(Tag:social)(Tag:talent)(Tag:tinker+)(Tech) Race Change - You are the Prime Unit, the highest tier of machine-flesh hybrid. You gain massively increased physical stats and energy reserves. You can absorb energy from machines and compatible sources. All Tinker abilities become incredibly more efficient, you can reconfigure your body to emulate tech from your Tinker abilities, and you decipher and learn other tech incredibly fast. All Technology and Virtuals below your rank bend to your will and cannot contest your authority as the Prime Unit. You can seamlessly absorb and integrate outside technology of your rank or below. You also gain 3 Gold-tier Tech item rolls as starting augments.
name: The Prime

description: #(Tag:healing)(Tag:health-regeneration+)(Tag:vitality+)You gain greatly increased vitality. You heal wounds faster, resist poison and illness better, stay more virile, live longer, and remain unbelievably healthy. Your natural healing resembles a slight healing factor, but you must eat a lot to compensate.
name: Vital

description: #(Tag:stamina+)You gain greatly increased stamina. You perform strenuous activities longer and recover from their exhaustion far quicker.
name: Marathoner

description: #(Tag:agility+)(Tag:reflex+)"It was originally going to be -ist". You gain greatly increased agility. You move considerably faster and gain matching reflexes and coordination.
name: Racer

description: #(Tag:defence+)You are tough as nails. You gain significantly increased durability and endurance, letting you resist stronger blows with less damage, recover from injuries faster without healing, and power through attacks more effectively.
name: Tough as Nails

description: #(Tag:strength+)You gain greatly increased physical strength. You exert more force with your body than you otherwise could and punch far harder than you should.
name: Brawler

description: #(Tag:health-regeneration+)(Tag:vitality+)You are inordinately vital. You are extremely healthy, immune to mundane sicknesses and poisons, and free of your body's usual genetic vulnerabilities. Your natural healing resembles a minor healing factor rather than regular recovery. You also gain an incredible lifespan and will live at least into your late hundreds.
name: Surging Vitality

description: #(Tag:agility+)(Tag:air)(Tag:reflex+)You move like the wind. You gain greatly augmented agility, becoming faster and nimbler with augmented reflexes and coordination.
name: Like the Wind

description: #(Tag:defence+)You are incredibly tough. You gain greatly increased natural resilience, letting you endure far greater punishment than you otherwise could.
name: Resistant

description: #(Tag:strength+)You are a natural-born strongman. You gain greatly enhanced physical strength, letting you exert far more physical force with your body than you otherwise could.
name: Power Lifter

description: #(Tag:agility+)(Tag:movement+)(Tag:reflex+)You are an aspiring divine messenger apparently (Flavor Text). Your natural agility is greatly enhanced, making you faster with appropriately increased reaction speed. In addition, all Mover abilities are slightly more potent and cost less energy to use.
name: Lil' Hermes

description: #(Tag:defence+)(Tag:magic-resistance+)"You can't go through it, and you can't knock it down!" You are the Wall. You gain extreme natural resiliency; even as a base human, bullets bounce off your chest and knives break against your skin. You also gain natural magical resistance scaling with your physical stats, though it does not match your endurance.
name: The Wall

description: #(Tag:health-regeneration+)(Tag:poison-resistance+)(Tag:vitality+)Ichor flows through your veins. You gain extreme vitality, a natural healing factor, and incredible poison and disease resistance. Even as a regular human, you will live into your late thousands. Your blood also has healing properties and serves as an excellent potion ingredient.
name: Ichor

description: #(Tag:lifestyle)Your bodily fluids such as sweat, saliva, blood, and ejaculate are nutritionally and calorically dense, very healthy, and surprisingly good-tasting. Consuming your own fluids does nothing for you.
name: Edible Fluids

description: #(Tag:power)Your biology contains special microscopic lifeforms attuned to the Force. You can train in the ways of the Force, with your midichlorian count depending on your stats and traits. The higher your count, the more potent your Force connection and the faster you master Force-related abilities.
name: Midi-Chlorians

description: #(Tag:rule)You can find a regular chicken egg anywhere at opportune moments.
name: Deus Eggs Machina

description: #(Tag:talent)"It's the drunk crashers that give drunk drivers a bad name." The more inebriated you are, the more skilled you become at driving and operating vehicles.
name: Drunk Driver

description: #(Tag:body)(Tag:nsfw)(Nsfw) "Not the one you are thinking of" Your cum refills almost instantly, and your ejaculation volume substantially increases.
name: Ceaseless Discharge

description: #(Tag:social)The scarier you act, the more the potential partners you consider find you arousing as well as terrifying. The mind works in mysterious ways.
name: Scarousing

description: #(Tag:social)Your presence feels larger than it should be. Even if you stand a head shorter, you still feel as though you tower over others.
name: Larger than Life

description: #(Tag:divination)(Tag:rule)-And they shall appear. You instantly sense someone's location relative to you whenever they say your name while intending you. You sense their location like GPS for around 5 minutes and can use them as anchors for teleportation abilities, Curses, and similar effects.
name: Speak of the Devil

description: #(Tag:beastkin)(Tag:perception+)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:race-change)(Tag:social)Race Change - You are a Wolfkin, a half-beast with wolf traits including wolf ears, tail, retractable claws, and sharp teeth. In some individuals, the wolf traits show more dominantly. You gain increased physical abilities, senses, and a fierce hunting instinct. You can also convey your intent to other animals, even if you cannot understand them back.
name: Wolfkin

description: #(Tag:beastkin)Race Change - You are a Lycanthrope, a half-wolf who can assume Werewolf form at will. The more you tap into your transformation, the more your physical stats and instincts, including animalistic ones, augment. As a regular Lycanthrope, you cannot spread lycanthropy. You also communicate better with Beasts and gain greater affinity for Changer powers, increasing their potency and efficiency.
name: Lycanthrope

description: #(Tag:beastkin)(Tag:perception+)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:race-change)(Tag:social)(Tag:transformation)Race Change - You are an Alpha Lycan, a ruler among werebeasts and half-wolf. You can tap into your bestial side at will to transform into a Werewolf or full wolf, greatly augmenting your physical stats, granting powerful claws and teeth, and massively amplifying your senses and instincts. As an Alpha, you can turn others into Lesser Lycans, werewolves under your command. All Beasts perceive greater authority and presence from you due to your potent blood.
name: Lycan Alpha

description: #(Tag:beastkin)(Tag:magic+)(Tag:magic-resistance+)(Tag:perception+)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:race-change)(Tag:social)(Tag:talent)(Tag:transformation)Race Change - You are a Lunar Lycan, a Royal Lycanthrope blessed by the moon. You can tap into your bestial side at will to transform into a Werewolf or full wolf, massively increasing your physical and magical stats and massively amplifying your senses. The moon's blessing increases your resistance to magic and esoteric effects and your affinity for all magic. As a Royal Lycanthrope, you can convert others into Lesser to Greater Lycanthropes sharing the same moon blessing and place them under your command as their alpha.
name: Lunar Lycan

description: #(Tag:beastkin)(Tag:divine)(Tag:energy-recovery)(Tag:perception+)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:race-change)(Tag:social)(Tag:transformation)Race Change - You are the Child of the Moon Devouring Wolf, the pinnacle of Lycanthropy. As a divine lycanthrope, you can tap into your bestial side at will to transform into a hybrid or a titanic wolf whose size you control. You gain extremely increased physical stats, godlike instincts, and senses. You can devour anything; your jaws and claws rend even space and tear anything apart, including magic and divine flesh. Anything you eat is destroyed and converted to magical power. You can bless others into Lycanthropes. You also hold authority over all beasts and beastkin below Legendary rank, and even resistant beings recognize your royal authority.
name: Managarmr

description: #(Tag:talent)(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker+)You are a Tinker who just started your journey. All Tinker abilities gain slightly enhanced efficiency, and you build technological constructs faster and more resourcefully.
name: Trainee Tinker

description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:talent)You are a Pugilist who just embarked on your path. You learn and train martial skills faster, and your natural intuition for combat and martial arts is heightened.
name: Pugilist Apprentice

description: #(Tag:mental)(Tag:meta)(Tag:talent)You are an Esper just starting to bloom your latent talent. You train and master abilities slightly faster and gain better instinct for handling and using them. All ability cooldowns decrease by 20%.
name: Nascent Esper

description: #(Tag:magic)(Tag:magic+)(Tag:talent)You are a Magician just embarking on your mystical journey. You learn, memorize, and master spells faster and cast them more efficiently. Penalties for learning a magical system not your own are mitigated.
name: Initiate Magician

description: #(Tag:infernal)(Tag:maximum-energy+)(Tag:nsfw)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:race-change)(Tag:talent)(Tag:transformation)Race Change - You are a dream demon, an Incubus/Succubus who feeds on your victim's vitality. You are more attractive and alluring to your preferred partners. You also gain slightly superhuman stats and increased magical power. You can sense arousal, peek into dreams, subtly influence them, and shapeshift to your partner's preferences. All Lewd abilities and spells gain potency.
name: Incubus/Succubus

description: #(Tag:social)May his reign last a thousand years. People even slightly loyal to you become much more loyal, you earn loyalty more easily, and people viewing you favorably make sacrifices for you more willingly.
name: Long Live the King

description: #(Tag:meta)(Gacha) You can withdraw your tickets as physical, tangible tickets to hand to others. If someone else rips the ticket, they receive the roll result instead, subject to the same rules as you.
name: Tickets Please

description: #(Tag:meta)You cannot be stolen from. Any owned item taken without your consent returns to your possession in a convenient location.
name: Swiper no Swiping!

description: #(Tag:meta)(Gacha) When you roll a ticket, you can reroll it with its rarity lowered by one stage (Platinum to Gold, Gold to Silver, etc.), but do not blame the gacha if it does not work out.
name: Trade-In

description: #(Tag:draconic)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:race-change)(Tag:water)(Tag:water+)You are a Sea Serpent or Hybrid, a true apex predator of the seas. You can unleash your Sea Serpent characteristics as a Hybrid form or full Sea Serpent size. You also gain greatly superhuman physical abilities and grow empowered when wet or underwater. All Water-based abilities cost less energy and gain potency, but drying out drastically reduces all your stats.
name: Sea Serpent

description: #(Tag:aquatic)(Tag:meta)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:power+)(Tag:race-change)(Tag:water)(Tag:water+)Race Change - You are the Leviathan, the creature lying in the deep and pinnacle of sea life. You can hide and unleash your nature as a full Leviathan or hybrid form. As the Leviathan, you gain tremendous physical abilities and incredible water affinity, but you cannot use Fire-based abilities or spells. Your water affinity raises any Water-based ability below Legendary level by 1 rank (Rare to Elite), and you can use any Water ability of Rare rank or below. All your physical and magical abilities massively amplify underwater, to the point where even a god would be foolish to challenge you there, but drying out massively reduces your abilities.
name: Leviathan

description: #(Tag:defence+)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:poison)(Tag:poison+)(Tag:race-change)(Tag:strength+)Race Change - You are kin of Jormungandr, the World Serpent. You can unleash your characteristics as a hybrid or full-sized World Serpent to access your full capabilities. As a Jormungandr, you gain extreme physical stats, especially strength and endurance. Your venom can bring even the strongest gods to their knees, and wounds you inflict cannot heal except through the strongest healing gods.
name: Jormungandr

description: #(Tag:beastkin)(Tag:energy-regeneration+)(Tag:maximum-energy+)(Tag:necro+)(Tag:power)(Tag:race-change)(Tag:spirit+)(Tag:undead)Race Change - You are a Nekomata, a powerful cat yokai with a forked tail. You can shapeshift into human and cat forms at will, and you gain enhanced energy reserves and regeneration. Your Nekomata nature grants great affinity for Necromancy, increasing the potency and efficiency of all Soul- and Necromancy-based abilities and spells. You can also naturally use Animate Undead (Elite Rank Ability) and conjure ghostflames.
name: Nekomata

description: #(Tag:energy-recovery)(Tag:fire)(Tag:fire+)(Tag:growth+)(Tag:maximum-energy+)(Tag:perception+)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:power+)(Tag:race-change)Race Change - You are the child of Sköll, the Sun Devouring Wolf. You can manifest and hide your lycanthropic nature at will; unleashing it grants an extreme increase in physical and magical power. As the Sun Devourer, you gain immense Fire affinity, massively boosting the potency and efficiency of any Fire-based ability you use. In addition, you absorb sunlight into energy and grow passively stronger under the sun. You can bless others into Lycanthropes under your command. You can also devour "Energy", eating spells, magical constructs, or high-energy objects to temporarily add them to your reserves and increase your maximum energy capacity.
name: Sköll

description: #(Tag:defence+)(Tag:magic-resistance+)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:race-change)Race Change - You are the Nemean Lion. You can switch between your base form, Lion Form, and anything in between. You gain indomitable physical stats and nigh-invulnerable skin even gods envy. Your skin defends against everything, and I mean everything, scaling with your physical stats. Even space-cutting, soul-burning, cursing, or existence-erasing attacks must contend with your resilience and have their effects reduced if not outright negated, depending on the attack's power relative to your defence.
name: Nemean

description: #(Tag:growth+)(Tag:poison-resistance+)Your body is tempered by the Vile. When diseases or poisons afflict you, your body uses them as fuel to grow stronger and develop a stronger immune system. The stronger and more exotic the affliction, the faster your body increases its physical stats and develops immunity.
name: Vile Temper

description: #(Tag:energy-regeneration+)(Tag:growth+)(Tag:poison-resistance+)(Tag:stamina+)You passively absorb radiation like a sponge, consuming it to fuel your body and energy. Absorbing enough radiation, such as Gamma Radiation, X-rays, and even ultraviolet radiation, permanently increases your physical stats and energy reserves proportionally to the amount absorbed. You are also immune to radiation's negative effects and recover stamina and energy faster when exposed to it. While sunlight has negligible effect, eating radium chips would likely act like cultivation pills for you.
name: Glowing One

description: #(Tag:power)(Tag:spirit)You are a vessel. You can absorb and channel "soul" to heal yourself by focusing or train to use it in Shaman spells such as Howling Wraiths, Soul Nails, short-range teleportation, and similar spells. You gain soul by injuring living beings, and your maximum storage scales with your maximum energy while remaining distinctly separate.
name: Soul Vessel

description: #You are perfectly ambidextrous. You use both arms and hands as if both were dominant, and the same balance applies to all limbs, perfectly balanced, as all things should be.
name: Ambidextrous

description: #You have received a body tune-up. Every aspect of your body upgrades, slightly increasing all physical stats and energy reserves and, most importantly, fixing all physical or genetic problems afflicting your body at the moment you roll this trait.
name: Total Overhaul

description: #(Tag:beastkin)(Tag:nature)(Tag:nature+)(Tag:perception+)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:race-change)Race Change - You are a Greater Beastkin, half beast and half whatever you are. You gain superhuman physical abilities and enhanced natural senses and instincts. You gain more affinity for nature-based abilities and spells, letting you use them more effectively. Your beast side is powerful too; even simple cat claws are tough as iron. (Chosen beast is decided by the writer, not an in-story choice)
name: Greater Beastkin

description: #(Tag:beastkin)(Tag:nature)(Tag:nature+)(Tag:perception+)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:race-change)Race Change - You are a Noble Beastkin, a beast hybrid with mystical blood in your veins. You gain potent physical abilities and greatly enhanced senses depending on your race, plus very potent natural instincts. You gain greater affinity for Changer- and Nature-based abilities, letting you use them with greater effect and finesse. You also control your beast side, letting you fully suppress your traits or fully transform into your beast side. You command respect from beast-aligned beings more easily.
name: Noble Beastkin

description: #(Tag:beastkin)(Tag:nature+)(Tag:perception+)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:race-change)(Tag:social)(Tag:transformation+)Race Change - You are a Royal Beastkin, a powerful beast hybrid with potent royal blood in your veins. You gain great physical strength and incredibly honed senses varying slightly by beast-side race. Your natural fighting instincts can compete with trained fighters without prior training. You gain great affinity for Changer abilities, making them more efficient and easier to control. You gain incredible control over your beast side, letting you fully suppress it, fully transform into it, or take anything in between. Your royal blood also grants increased charisma and an authoritative presence, far more effective against beast-aligned beings.
name: Royal Beastkin

description: #(Tag:dark)(Tag:dark+)(Tag:energy-regeneration+)(Tag:holy)(Tag:holy+)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:infernal+)(Tag:light)(Tag:light+)(Tag:maximum-energy+)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:power+)(Tag:race-change)Race Change - You are a Nephalem, an impossible union of Daemon and Seraphim. You gain immense magical and physical power. All Holy, Light, Darkness, and Infernal abilities increase by one tier and cost significantly less energy. You can naturally convert your energy into Darkness or Holy mana bursts.
name: Nephalem

description: #(Tag:social)You are very good at getting under people's skin, whether angering them or breaking their stoic mask with a joke or flirty remark. Others find it harder to keep their composure around you.
name: Provocative

description: #(Tag:lifestyle)(Tag:survival)You have a heart of steel that endures any hardship; your body needs less than even the bare minimum. You need only 1/100th of your normal sustenance; you can go entire years without eating, months without drinking a drop of water, and need only 1/100th of your usual sleep, sleeping every few months or so even as a regular human.
name: Steel Man

description: #(Tag:growth+)(Tag:health-recovery)(Tag:health-regeneration+)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:race-change)(Tag:transformation)Race Change - Your previous genetic material is completely assimilated, turning you into a living mass of Blacklight Virus. Even at base, you can smash apart tanks and outrun cars. You can also regenerate by assimilating biological matter. As long as even a fist-sized mass of Blacklight forming your core remains, you still live. You can analyze and replicate any biological part you consume. The stronger the assimilated target, the harder it is to assimilate them.
name: Blacklight Physique

description: #(Tag:draconic)(Tag:maximum-energy+)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:power+)(Tag:race-change)(Tag:talent)(Tag:time+)Race Change - You are the hatchling of Placidusax, the Dragonlord. As a Royal Ancient Dragon, albeit a child, you gain greatly superhuman physical abilities and greatly increased magical powers. You can shift between your 5-headed ancient dragon form and humanoid form at will; your dragon form's size depends on your power level and maturity. You possess gilded gravel scales granting incredible resilience, and as Placidusax's child, you can breathe incinerating golden flames and manifest crimson dragon lightning. Unique to your lineage, you possess immense time affinity, letting you learn time spells on your own through natural inclination. But even with talent, time is no trifling power and mastery will take a very, very long time.
name: Dragonlord

description: #(Tag:defence+)(Tag:draconic)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:power+)(Tag:race-change)(Tag:transformation)Race Change - You are an Everlasting Dragon, a being from before time and light; well, at least a hatchling of one. As an Everlasting Dragon, you gain greatly superhuman stats and magical abilities. Most of all, you possess the Stone Scales of Immortality. While in dragon form with your scales on, you are incredibly resilient to any attack, as if armored in adamantium with similar magic resistance, plus great regenerative abilities. But lightning or a greatly powerful attack rends your scales from your flesh and removes your increased durability. You can shift between base and dragon forms at will.
name: Everlasting Dragon

description: #(Tag:draconic)(Tag:maximum-energy+)(Tag:necro)(Tag:necro+)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:power)(Tag:power+)(Tag:race-change)Race Change - You are a descendant of Nidhogg, the mythical dragon of Death and Decay. You can swap between base and Nidhogg forms at will; your degree of transformation dictates your accessible power. You gain tremendous physical abilities and incredibly potent, dense magical energy. You gain overwhelming affinity for necromancy, letting you naturally revive the dead as undead under your command and massively boosting the potency and efficiency of any necromancy-based abilities or spells you use. Your dragon breath distills the concept of decay, rotting whatever it touches down to flesh, soul, and existence. Effectiveness varies with target and power level.
name: Nidhogg

description: #(Tag:illusion+)(Tag:stealth+)(Tag:talent)You have received a gift from Nyarlathotep, the Crawling Ones. All Stranger abilities gain potency and cost less energy to use. You also grow more proficient in deception, obscurification, and acting.
name: Gift of Nyar

description: #(Tag:health-recovery)(Tag:survival)Your heart is that of a Mythical Hydra, granting Epic-level regeneration that expends stamina and energy. In addition, you possess 9 lives. Whenever your heart or head is destroyed, you almost instantly restore to peak health with all negative conditions cleansed. Any resurrection effect of Legendary rank or above can restore a life.
name: Hydra Heart

description: #(Tag:rule)You hold a PhD in Ork Colour Theory. You can paint things to gain the benefits Orks gain. RED IZ FASTA, BLACK IZ TOUGHA, YELLOW IZ BIG BOOM, PURPLE IS SNEAKYY, BLUE IZ LUCKER AND GREEN IZ DA BEST. For a target to benefit, you must paint it yourself.
name: Ork Colour Theory

description: #(Tag:anti-immortal)(Tag:rule)Death itself permits you to kill anything, and reality obeys. Against an Immortal target, you can nullify their immortality. Any lethal blow you land that would kill them without immortality enacts absolute death and prevents resurrection unless you declare they may live. Even a god, avatar, or spirit loses immortality before you.
name: Reaper's Writ

description: #(Tag:mind)You are very self-aware. You know what effects affect you, when you are poisoned, and when you feel ill or uncomfortable. Nothing about you escapes your attention.
name: Introspection

description: #(Tag:meta)(Tag:summon)It's a shame when beloved familiars die; you should always insure them. Whenever one of your familiars dies, it revives in your familiar space by using your energy reserves to heal, then remains temporarily weakened for several days afterward. If you have a familiar that automatically revives, it revives 50% faster and needs 50% less energy to revive.
name: Insurance Policy

description: #(Tag:mental)(Tag:mental+)(Tag:talent)You are a psionic, a specialist in the Mind and Mental world. You gain greater control and finesse over mental abilities and use them more efficiently. You also train mental abilities faster and grasp them more naturally.
name: Psionic

description: #(Tag:nsfw)(Tag:social)(Nsfw) You are a Netoranger; no relationship is sacred to you. You more easily persuade people to betray their loved ones for you, and people in relationships find themselves more attracted to you.
name: Netoranger

description: #(Tag:health-recovery)(Tag:meta)Your natural healing works differently; instead of regenerating, your body constantly restores itself to its healthiest state at your normal regeneration speed, affecting even curses, diseases, and afflictions. Of course, the more severe the effect, the longer and harder your restoration to full condition becomes.
name: Natural Restoration

description: #(Tag:body)(Tag:growth+)(Tag:maximum-energy+)(Tag:physical+)Your body has received a Tune Up. All previous health complications are erased, and your body improves to increase your latent genetic potential and give you a fit, incredibly healthy body.
name: Tune Up

description: #(Tag:meta)(Tag:power)(Tag:survival)You bear the Code of Immortality from an imitation of C's World. Whenever you suffer fatal wounds, sickness, or otherwise cannot function, a pocket dimension constantly producing replacement parts for your existence instantly replaces parts of you, keeping you healthy, ageless, and alive. This includes your mind and soul. You can only stay dead if separated from your dimension, your lives are exhausted faster than they reproduce, or you are killed by a spatial attack. In addition, you can grant individuals Geass, an eye-manifested power whose exact function and strength depend on their potential. You can always sense anyone you give Geass to and those they deem closest to them.
name: Code of Immortality

description: #(Tag:body)"Bop!" Your skull is unusually durable, and your headbutts and skull-based attacks are more potent.
name: Shoebody

description: #(Tag:power)You can naturally turn your energy reserves into silk. You can manipulate this silk as part of your body and dissolve it at will. You can control it to perform a wide variety of Silk Arts, such as shooting silk needles, whipping it around, binding your own wounds, and similar uses.
name: Silkheart

description: #(Tag:mental-resistance+)(Tag:meta-resistance+)Your existence is chaos as defined by the chaos gacha, automatically feeding back into whatever tries to examine you. Future sight becomes scrambled and incoherent, abilities reading you malfunction, and mind-reading causes at least a severe headache.
name: Chaos Response

description: #(Tag:growth+)You possess a broken limiter, making your physical abilities practically boundless. Whenever you are pushed, your physical abilities grow exponentially, scaling with how challenged you are.
name: Broken Limiter

description: #(Tag:air+)(Tag:earth+)(Tag:electric+)(Tag:fire+)(Tag:ice+)(Tag:social)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:water+)You have great affinity with the elements. Elemental abilities and spells cost less energy, and elementals and spirits gain affinity for you and like you more easily.
name: Elementalist

description: #(Tag:holy)(Tag:holy+)(Tag:light+)(Tag:perception+)(Tag:spirit+)You are an Exorcist, an agent of the Heavenly Realm specializing in destroying spiritual beings and demons with the Holy attribute. You gain increased affinity for Holy, Spiritual, and Light and for learning their magic. You can also sense nearby Unholy and Spiritual entities, whether to grant them peaceful passing or painful eviction from the material realm.
name: Exorcist

description: #(Tag:dark+)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:infernal+)(Tag:rule)(Tag:spirit+)You are a Warlock, a practitioner of Dark and Demonic Arts. You gain increased affinity for Unholy- and Darkness-based abilities and spells. You are also immune to fae deals and can detect the true nature of magical bindings as a would-be demon-dealer. You also naturally know how to craft magically binding deals, though only ones where both parties explicitly know exactly what they gain.
name: Warlock

description: #(Tag:dark)(Tag:dark+)(Tag:martial+)(Tag:necro)(Tag:necro+)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:power)(Tag:race-change)Race Change - You are a Death Knight, an Undead evolved into a far tougher, more physically capable caste. You gain greatly increased physical capabilities and need no rest or sustenance; your energy reserves power all functions. You can naturally use [Necrotic Weapon]. You gain increased Necromancy, Darkness, and Martial affinity, augmenting related abilities, skills, and magic, but you gain vulnerability to Holy- and Light-based abilities and magic. Your energy recovers faster in locations with more negative energy.
name: Death Knight

description: #(Tag:dark)(Tag:dark+)(Tag:martial+)(Tag:necro)(Tag:necro+)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:power)(Tag:race-change)Race Change - You are a Dread Knight, a higher Undead caste specializing in direct martial combat. You gain very potent physical abilities and virtually unlimited stamina, needing only Energy to sustain yourself. You can naturally use [Dread Blade] and gain great Necromancy, Darkness, and Martial affinity, augmenting related abilities, skills, and magic, but you gain vulnerability to Holy- and Light-based abilities and magic.
name: Dread Knight

description: #(Tag:dark+)(Tag:martial+)(Tag:necro)(Tag:necro+)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:power)(Tag:race-change)Race Change - You are a Gravelord, a royal Undead caste evolved for direct combat. You gain mighty physical abilities and virtually unlimited stamina, needing only your own Energy reserves to sustain yourself. You can naturally use [Gravelord's Blade] and gain greatly increased Necrotic, Dark, and Martial affinity, augmenting related skills, magic, and abilities, but you gain vulnerability to Holy- and Light-based abilities and magic.
name: Gravelord

description: #(Tag:dark+)(Tag:martial+)(Tag:necro)(Tag:necro+)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:power)(Tag:race-change)(Tag:social)Race Change - You are a Necro Kaiser, an Undead Ruler evolved for devastation. You gain incredible physical abilities and virtually unlimited stamina, needing only your own Energy reserves to sustain yourself. You can naturally use [Gravelord's Blade] and [Animate Undead], and all undead under your command are naturally stronger and able to act independently. You gain immense affinity for Necromancy, Darkness, and Martial abilities, spells, and skills, greatly increasing their potency, but you gain vulnerability to Holy- and Light-based abilities and magic.
name: Necro Kaiser

description: #(Tag:dark+)(Tag:martial+)(Tag:necro)(Tag:necro+)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:power)(Tag:race-change)(Tag:social)Race Change - You are a Ruin Tyrant, the highest undead caste, ruler of the dead and extinguisher of life. You gain unrivaled physical abilities and unlimited stamina; you do not even need energy to sustain yourself, you simply are, though you can still be destroyed. You can naturally use [Ruin Edge] and [Animate Undead], and all undead under your command are naturally stronger and able to act independently. You gain unrivaled Necrotic, Dark, and Martial affinity, augmenting related skills, magic, and abilities, but you gain vulnerability to Holy- and Light-based abilities and magic.
name: Ruin Tyrant

description: #(Tag:dark)(Tag:dark+)(Tag:magic+)(Tag:maximum-energy+)(Tag:necro)(Tag:necro+)(Tag:power)(Tag:race-change)Race Change - You are a Lich, an Undead caste specializing in Necromancy and Dark Magic, not the phylactery kind. Though rather weak physically, you gain increased energy reserves and nigh-unlimited stamina, needing only your own Energy reserves to sustain yourself. You study magic more easily and gain increased Darkness and Necromancy affinity. In addition, you can naturally use [Lesser Necromancy] to raise your own Undead Servants.
name: Lich

description: #(Tag:dark)(Tag:dark+)(Tag:magic+)(Tag:maximum-energy+)(Tag:necro)(Tag:necro+)(Tag:power)(Tag:race-change)(Tag:summon+)Race Change - You are an Elder Lich, a higher Undead caste evolved from a regular Lich, specializing in raising undead armies and Necromancy. Though rather disappointing physically, you gain greater energy reserves and magical abilities plus nigh-unlimited stamina, needing only your own Energy reserves to sustain yourself. You study magic with greater ease and gain increased Darkness and Necromancy affinity. In addition, you can naturally use [Lesser Necromancy] to raise your own Undead Servants, your commanded undead are naturally more powerful and intelligent, and you can command more undead at once than you otherwise could.
name: Elder Lich

description: #(Tag:dark+)(Tag:magic+)(Tag:maximum-energy+)(Tag:necro)(Tag:necro+)(Tag:power)(Tag:power+)(Tag:race-change)(Tag:summon+)Race Change - You are a Night Lich, an evolved undead with dark magic thrumming in their bones, specializing in raising undead armies, Dark Magic, and Necromancy. Though lacking physical might, you gain great energy reserves and magical ability plus nigh-unlimited stamina, needing only your own Energy reserves to sustain yourself. You gain great capacity for learning, developing, and studying Necromancy and Dark Magic, and your Necromancy-based abilities work more efficiently. In addition, you can naturally use [Animate Undead] to raise your own Undead Servants, your commanded undead are naturally more powerful and intelligent, you can command more undead at once than you otherwise could, and you instinctively sense nearby dead like a sixth sense.
name: Night Lich

description: #(Tag:dark+)(Tag:magic+)(Tag:maximum-energy+)(Tag:necro)(Tag:necro+)(Tag:power)(Tag:power+)(Tag:race-change)(Tag:summon+)Race Change - You are an Overlord, the highest caste of regular undead, whose existence overturns the living into an undead army. While only superhuman physically, your magical prowess is mighty, granting increased energy reserves and potency plus nigh-unlimited stamina, needing only your own Energy reserves to sustain yourself. Your Necromancy affinity is incredibly potent, letting you learn, study, and create Necromancy spells with great ease and increasing the potency of any Necromancy-related ability you use. You can naturally use [Greater Animate Undead] to raise your own Undead Army, your commanded undead are naturally more powerful and intelligent, and you can command an unlimited number at once. You instinctively sense nearby dead like a sixth sense. You can also seize command of any undead you encounter as long as you overwhelmingly overpower them or defeat them yourself.
name: Overlord

description: #(Tag:dark+)(Tag:magic+)(Tag:maximum-energy+)(Tag:necro)(Tag:necro+)(Tag:power)(Tag:power+)(Tag:race-change)(Tag:summon+)Race Change - You are the Eclipse, pure necromancy shaped as an undead, a living icon of death meant to extinguish life. Though only superhuman physically, your magical reserves are vast and incredibly potent with infinite stamina from undeath. As Necromancy embodied, your affinity for Necromancy spells and Abilities is unmatched, increasing all their potency beyond normal limits and letting you invent spells by instinct and learn existing ones by observation. You can also naturally use [True Necromancy] to raise an undead army, all undead under your command are naturally more powerful and cognizant, and you can command an unlimited number at once. Any undead outside your command naturally feels compelled to submit to you.
name: Eclipse

description: #(Tag:dark+)(Tag:necro+)(Tag:race-change)(Tag:undead)Race Change - You are an animated skeleton, the most basic undead. Your physical stats match your living state, but you need no sustenance or rest, needing only your own energy reserves to sustain yourself. You also gain increased Necro and Dark affinity but gain vulnerability to Light- and Holy-based abilities. (This can be rerolled for free)
name: Skeleton

description: #(Tag:bloodline)(Tag:martial)(Tag:talent)You are a member of the Kure Clan, selectively bred as assassins and martial artists. Your genes grant increased physical abilities, greater physical growth, and better combat instincts. You can also use "Removal", removing the brain's natural limiters that prevent using 100% of your physical strength to avoid self-injury. You can increase your Removal percentage through training.
name: Kure

description: #(Tag:body)You gain a cosmetic alteration to your physique and form, making you more attractive by your own standards. You may gain longer, prettier hair, a few inches of height, different eye color, and similar changes. You cannot completely change your looks, only enhance what exists; an ordinary person becomes fairly attractive, but anyone who knows you can still recognize you.
name: Pretty Up

description: #(Tag:divination+)(Tag:mental+)(Tag:mind)(Tag:power)(Tag:race-change)(Tag:sense+)You are a Newtype, an evolved human adapted to space. Other than a slightly stronger body, you gain greatly increased spatial awareness and mental focus, boosting all Thinker abilities. You can also naturally sense malintent directed at you. With enough training and meditation, you may even unlock communication with others' minds.
name: Newtype

description: #(Tag:rule)You hold the Rule of Cool. Physics bends slightly around you to let you do things the "cool" way despite impossibility, Style AND Substance baby. You can snatch a bullet from the air and send it back, walk away from an explosion unfazed, perform mid-fight tricks without disadvantage, and similar feats; doing things the cool way comes naturally to you. (Does not affect your stats or level of skills.)
name: Rule of Cool

description: #(Tag:social)Crazy, mentally unstable, or otherwise insane people find themselves more attracted to you, and you gain their affection and favor more easily. You can also reason with them more easily.
name: Crazy Lure

description: #(Tag:poison+)(Tag:social)You are blessed by Beelzebub, Lord of vermin and insects. You gain affinity with all vermin, insects, and arachnids, making them friendlier and easier to earn affection from. All Vermin- and Poison-based abilities gain potency and cost less energy to use.
name: Beelzebub's Blessing

description: #(Tag:body)You have a great-looking, great-feeling ass that cushions you so you can sit on practically any surface without discomfort.
name: Great Ass

description: #(Tag:social)Your hugs and snuggles comfort even broken souls, feeling like the softest, warmest blanket while therapeutically stabilizing and comforting your target.
name: Cuddle Emperor

description: #(Tag:body)Your teeth are spectacularly strong and durable, letting you bite and chew rock without damage. You never worry about dental health, and any broken teeth regrow like fingernails.
name: Chompers

description: #(Tag:bloodline)(Tag:talent)You are a child of the Nakiri Clan, a born gourmet and chef with natural cooking affinity who improves skills and recipes far faster than ordinary people. You possess the God Tongue, discerning taste unimaginably well and identifying specific ingredients and their amounts from a single bite.
name: Nakiri

description: #(Tag:anti-divine)You oppose the Gods and Divine, possessing massive resistance to all Divine influence and Authorities, and your physical and magical abilities massively increase against Divine opponents.
name: Anathema

description: #(Tag:social)You are naturally dominant and assert yourself on others more easily, while people, especially submissive people, receive your dominance and assertiveness more readily.
name: Dominant

description: #(Tag:light-resistance+)You naturally resist Light and Light-based effects, letting you stare straight at the sun, heavily reduce flashbangs, and resist Light arrows, purification rituals, searing beams of light, etc. This resistance scales with your base stats.
name: Light Resistance

description: #(Tag:dark)(Tag:dark-resistance+)You naturally resist Darkness and Darkness-based effects such as shadow blasts, darkness chains, clouds of Darkness, shadow blades, etc. This resistance scales with your base stats.
name: Dark Resistance

description: #(Tag:growth+)(Tag:social)(Tag:tech)(Tech) Praise the Omnissiah! You pray and perform rituals that actually appease the machine spirit dwelling in machines. By burning incense, dancing, singing, drawing it, etc., you please it, and its pleasure increases the machine's power and efficiency. With enough worship you develop a relationship with the machine that endures through thick and thin.
name: Tech Priest Diploma

description: #(Tag:buff)(Tech) You are blessed by the Omnissiah; they praise you. Any machine you handle or encounter eagerly favors you unless you lose that favor: charges deplete slower, cars go faster and handle better, slot machines give better odds, etc., because their machine spirit naturally likes you.
name: Blessing of the Omnissiah

description: #(Tag:beastkin)(Tag:illusion)(Tag:illusion+)(Tag:maximum-energy+)(Tag:nature)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:power)(Tag:race-change)(Tag:spirit)Race Change - You are a single-tailed Kitsune, a Fox Yokai semi-spiritual being attuned to nature and illusions. Your humanoid form is naturally incredibly attractive, and you possess slightly increased physical stats and increased energy reserves. You naturally weave and use [Foxfire], and all Stranger abilities, illusion spells, and nature-based abilities you use are more potent. You shift between fox and humanoid form at will and hide your fox features with illusions. As you age or increase energy reserves, you gain up to 9 tails, each slightly enhancing the above capabilities.
name: Kitsune

description: #(Tag:illusion)(Tag:illusion+)(Tag:maximum-energy+)(Tag:nature)(Tag:nature+)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:power)(Tag:race-change)(Tag:spirit)Race Change - You are a Kyubi, a nine-tailed Kitsune, a powerful fox yokai semi-spiritual being incredibly attuned to nature and illusions. You possess superhuman physical ability and greatly increased energy reserves. You swap between your nine-tailed form and a supernaturally good-looking human form at will. You naturally use [Nine-Tailed Foxfire] and possess great affinity for Stranger and Nature-based abilities and spells, making them more efficient to use and maintain.
name: Kyubi

description: #(Tag:nature)(Tag:nature+)(Tag:rule)You are a child blessed by Demeter, goddess of nature and harvest, with increased affinity for nature-based abilities and magic that makes them easier to master and more potent. In any territory you own, soil is enriched and fertile, and crops are protected from disease and vermin.
name: Demeter's Blessing

description: #(Tag:social)Your presence is very comforting and trustworthy, feeling like coming home. People more likely confide in you, feel less threatened by you, and you naturally comfort those in distress. This does not work on people with a strong negative opinion of you.
name: Comforting Presence

description: #(Tag:social)(Tag:talent)(Tag:water)(Tag:water+)You are a child blessed by Poseidon, god of the seas. You breathe, move, and see underwater as naturally as on land. All mundane aquatic life is friendly and supernatural ones are friendlier toward you. You possess increased water affinity, making your water-based abilities and spells more potent and easier to master.
name: Poseidon's Child

description: #(Tag:rule)(Tag:social)You may wear whatever you want without it being illegal or morally unacceptable, though people may still feel uncomfortable. You can even enter high society wearing what you were born with.
name: Deviant Fashion

description: #(Tag:growth+)(Tag:rule)(Tag:tech)(Tech) You are a special mechanic: whatever sufficiently advanced technology you make contains a newborn Machine Spirit. It passively improves the machine's quality and performance over time. Depending on its mood, it works more efficiently or worse and can even deny access. More mature spirits can operate their tech autonomously and independently. All spirits you create naturally see you as their creator.
name: Machine Spirit Mechanic

description: #(Tag:growth+)(Tag:necro)(Tag:race-change)Race Change - You possess the Necromantic Heart, turning you undead while granting you the capacity to evolve. You start as (Uncommon trait) Skeleton, and the more time you spend alive, the more you kill, and the more negative energy you immerse yourself in, the faster you evolve into the next undead tier. You retain a humanoid facade with human functions that falls apart when you use undead traits or get damaged.
name: Necromantic Heart

description: #(Tag:nsfw)(Tag:social)(Nsfw) There is nothing morally wrong with keeping it in the family, and society does not find you marrying your kin particularly wrong. All genetic problems from inbreeding are resolved. Any biological children you conceive inherit your traits far better and inherit at least two of your abilities. You more easily earn your family's affection, platonically or romantically. This trait can be rerolled for free.
name: Oedipus Simple

description: #(Tag:meta)(Tag:summon)Your familiars carry full coverage insurance: as long as a familiar stays in familiar space for 24 hours straight uninterrupted, they return to perfect health. If a familiar dies, they resurrect in familiar space after 48 hours in perfect health.
name: Full Coverage Insurance Plan

description: #(Tag:meta)(Tag:summon)You can register any cognizant living being as a familiar as long as they completely submit to you and are tamed.
name: The Real Familiars

description: #(Tag:perception+)You instinctively tell when someone looks at or observes you at all times, plus which direction they look from. Against clairvoyance, you know someone watches you but cannot pinpoint their direction.
name: Perception Awareness

description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:lifestyle)The scenic wind favors you, making your clothes and hair flutter majestically whenever opportune, even indoors or in impossible weather.
name: Scenic Wind

description: #(Tag:body)You can lactate, and the quality of milk you produce scales with your physical stats and gains unique qualities depending on your traits. This trait can be rerolled for free.
name: Lactation

description: #(Tag:growth+)Your bones demand milk: every time you consume milk, they gain a permanent boost to durability and quality. Higher-quality milk gives a greater boost. Repeating the same kind of milk decreases its effects exponentially after the first drink, and the boost is relative to the milk's quality versus your bones.
name: Calcium Cultivation

description: #(Tag:health-regeneration+)(Tag:lifestyle)Your skin is perfectly moist, supple, and smooth, never scarring or marring unless you want it to. Skin and superficial injuries heal slightly faster and more seamlessly.
name: Perfect Skin

description: #(Tag:body)(Tag:lifestyle)You are always comfortable in your own skin: your physical features never hamper your mobility or comfort of life, whether distorted or oversized.
name: Comfortable

description: #(Tag:lifestyle)(Tag:rule)Whatever clothing or equipment you wear or equip automatically adjusts to your size perfectly as long as the change is not too drastic. The changes revert when unequipped.
name: Form Fitting

description: #(Tag:body)Your stomach is 1000x larger inside than outside. You keep eating and digest food on a need-to basis without discomfort, letting you eat months of food and water ahead of time, while producing only 1/1000th of the waste.
name: Endless Stomach

description: #(Tag:illusion+)(Tag:maximum-energy+)(Tag:power)(Tag:race-change)Race Change - You are a Tanuki, a raccoon-dog yokai semi-spiritual being excelling in trickery. You shift between Tanuki, humanoid, and in-between forms. You possess increased energy reserves and increased affinity toward Stranger abilities and traits, letting you use and master them more easily and efficiently. You naturally use [Tanuki's Leaves (Rare)] without needing an ability slot.
name: Tanuki

description: #(Tag:body)You no longer have a gag reflex, and your throat stays perfectly moist and lubricated. You never get a sore throat.
name: Throat

description: #(Tag:social)Your preferred partners at least twice your age find you more attractive, and you more easily earn their favor. Your romantic partners and your looks never age beyond their peak. This does not stop physical aging.
name: Hagmaxxing

description: #(Tag:anti-dark)(Tag:anti-infernal)(Tag:curse-resistance+)(Tag:dark-resistance+)(Tag:holy)(Tag:necro-resistance+)(Tag:physical+)You wield a body blessed by the Heavenly realm to carry out violence in its stead. Your physical abilities are augmented and further amplified on blessed ground. You possess increased resistance to curses, necromancy, and darkness-based attacks. Even an ordinary person with this could flip cars and break demons' bones.
name: Violence of Heaven

description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:air+)(Tag:avian)(Tag:perception+)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:race-change)Race Change - You are a half-avian hawk hybrid mixed with your own race. You have slightly enhanced physical abilities, senses, and heightened predatory instincts. You have retractable talons and wings fused into your arms, shoulder blades, or back. With training you suppress your avian traits. You possess increased wind affinity but decreased water affinity.
name: Harpy

description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:air+)(Tag:defence+)(Tag:perception+)(Tag:race-change)(Tag:strength+)Race Change - You are a Roc hybrid, mixing a giant elephant-eating hawk with your own race. You possess increased strength and durability, incredible but sensitive eyesight and hearing, and fearsome predatory instincts. You possess large, powerful wings fused to your arms or back, at least as strong as your arms, letting you fly and dive with great speed, plus retractable talons tougher than steel. You possess increased wind affinity but decreased water affinity.
name: Roc

description: #(Tag:agility+)(Tag:air)(Tag:air+)(Tag:avian)(Tag:electric)(Tag:electric+)(Tag:perception+)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:power)(Tag:race-change)(Tag:reflex+)Race Change - You are a Thunderbird hybrid, changer of the skies. You possess enhanced physical abilities with further enhanced agility and reflexes, plus greatly enhanced eyesight and hearing. Your wings easily fly at great speeds and flap to release electricity, and your tough, sharp talons crackle with lightning. You naturally change local weather, sunny, rain, hail, etc., but it consumes a lot of energy. You possess increased wind and lightning affinity, but vulnerability to water and earth.
name: Thunderbird

description: #(Tag:agility+)(Tag:air)(Tag:air+)(Tag:avian)(Tag:electric)(Tag:electric+)(Tag:perception+)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:power)(Tag:race-change)(Tag:reflex+)Race Change - You are descended from a Grand Thunderbird, an ancient legendary master of weather and lightning. You possess a great physique with incredibly enhanced agility and reflexes, plus unmatched eyesight and hearing. Your wings easily fly at supersonic speeds, and your tough, sharp talons are formidable. You cloak yourself in and discharge electricity from your body. You naturally manipulate local weather, rain, open sky, clouds, even raining lightning. You possess increased wind and lightning affinity, but vulnerability to water and earth.
name: Grand Thunderbird

description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:air+)(Tag:earth)(Tag:electric)(Tag:electric+)(Tag:energy-regeneration+)(Tag:health-regeneration+)(Tag:maximum-energy+)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:power)(Tag:race-change)Race Change - You are a Child of Ziz, Primordial beast rival to Behemoth and Leviathan and ruler of the skies. You possess greatly enhanced physical and magical abilities, and you reveal and hide your true form at will, partially or fully becoming a titanic avian beast. You naturally manipulate weather at will, storms, blizzards, rain, hurricanes, tornadoes, etc., plus greater lightning. All your weather-based abilities and spells are greatly enhanced. You greatly resist wind, ice, and electricity-based abilities. Your energy and health recovery are enhanced under open skies. You possess decreased water and earth affinity.
name: Ziz

description: #(Tag:rule)You receive the equivalent of 2x the daily minimum wage for whatever city/country you currently live in, deposited into your account or wallet every single day.
name: Allowance

description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:power)(Tag:spirit)You have awakened the Kyoi no Hado, the Surge of Mindless Intent, also called the Sacred Hado, letting you tap your own Ki reserves. It requires calmness, balance, resoluteness, and focus to draw power from your inner energy and soul. You reinforce strikes with it, protect your body from foreign influences, and shape it into wave-like surges offensively and defensively. Skilled enough users interact with souls. Practicing it increases your mental and spiritual defenses.
name: Kyoi no Hado

description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:power)(Tag:spirit)You have awakened the Satsui no Hado, the Surge of Killing Intent, also called the Dark Hado, letting you tap your inner Ki reserves. It requires tapping your animalistic bloodlust, rage, and murderous intent to manifest killing intent and draw inner energy through it. It slightly transforms you, enhancing physical strength, letting you imbue strikes with energy, and turning Ki into dark flame-like energy. Skilled enough users telekinetically control objects. The more you practice it, the stronger you grow, and the stronger your desire for conflict and conquest grows. Without control you may transform into an Oni, but you can tame it no matter how difficult.
name: Satsui no Hado

description: #(Tag:health-regeneration+)(Tag:social)You have great affinity with lizards, reptiles, and aligned creatures, making it easier to earn their affection and favor and form relationships with them. Thanks to your reptilian affinity, regeneration-based effects, abilities, and spells applied to you are more potent.
name: Reptilian Rapport

description: #(Tag:sense+)(Tag:social)You have great affinity with dogs, canines, wolves, and aligned creatures, making it easier to earn their affection and favor and form relationships with them. Thanks to your Canis affinity, your sense-based abilities and traits are more potent, and you control your own senses more easily.
name: Canis Companion

description: #(Tag:defence+)(Tag:social)You have great affinity with insects, arachnids, crustaceans, and aligned creatures, making it easier to earn their affection and favor and form relationships with them. Thanks to your arthropod affinity, you possess slightly increased durability, and your armor-based abilities and effects cost slightly less energy to use.
name: Arthropod Affiliate

description: #(Tag:anti-dragon)(Tag:anti-undead)(Tag:electric+)(Tag:fire+)(Tag:vitality+)You are a Warrior of Sunlight, praising the sun and devoting faith to it to receive power in return. You possess increased vitality. All your Lightning and Fire-based abilities are slightly more potent and carry traces of sunlight, further increasing potency against Undead and Dragons. Beings aligned with Sun and Light may favor you more.
name: Warrior of Sunlight

description: #(Tag:necro+)(Tag:social)(Tag:spirit+)You are a Gravelord Servant, servant of Nito, the first of the dead. You possess increased energy reserves, and your Necromancy and Soul-based abilities are more powerful. You possess greater affinity toward undead, and mindless wild undead do not treat you as an enemy unless provoked.
name: Gravelord Servant

description: #(Tag:anti-light)(Tag:dark+)(Tag:physical+)You are a Darkwraith, seeking to wield darkness and end light. Your physical abilities are slightly enhanced in darkness. All your Dark-based abilities and spells are more potent and inflict additional damage against Light-aligned beings.
name: Darkwraith

description: #(Tag:draconic)(Tag:growth+)You follow the Path of the Dragon, seeking to transcend life through Dragons' flesh. You offer Dragons' flesh to the Everlasting Dragons and imbue it into your own flesh, enhancing all physical stats relative to how strong its owner was compared to you and gaining minor draconic aspects. The more flesh you offer, the more draconic you become, potentially becoming an Everlasting Dragon (Legendary) yourself.
name: Path of Dragon

description: #(Tag:meta)You can establish your own covenant. Those pledging themselves to your service and joining it acquire boons from you based on their contribution. The boons you grant are lesser copies of your traits and abilities, fueled by accumulated karma. Rarity depends on contribution level but never reaches the original's rarity. If they break your covenant's laws, their boons are instantly revoked.
name: Covenant Leader

description: #(Tag:bloodline)(Tag:draconic)(Tag:energy-regeneration+)(Tag:martial)(Tag:maximum-energy+)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:social)(Tag:talent)You are a child of Pendragon, the destined rightful King and Dragon. Sovereignty runs in your blood: you more strongly resist negative mental conditions and possess incredible talent for ruling-related matters such as litigation, management, military, economics, etc., plus increased natural charisma. As the child of one recognized as a Dragon, you have increased physical abilities, larger energy reserves, and faster energy recovery. You also have incredible talent with blades from Excalibur's wielder's blood, especially magical swords.
name: Pendragon

description: #(Tag:body)(Tag:survival)(Tag:undead)Your head freely detaches from your neck/torso while staying connected in a higher dimension, so you still eat, speak, and breathe. Decapitation is useless against you.
name: Dullahan's Deception

description: #(Tag:meta)(Gacha) You grant copies of your own abilities and traits to others by burning a ticket equal in value to what you grant: bronze grants common, silver grants uncommon, gold grants rare, etc. Higher tickets grant double the replicants of the previous rarity: silver = 2x common, gold = 4x common, etc.
name: Chaos Duplication

description: #(Tag:meta)(Tag:rule)Anything you create cannot be used without your permission, acting as a blacklist and whitelist. Even if you leave your spaceship with keys in, no one can pilot it. Potions you leave act like water for anyone else using them.
name: Fair Use

description: #(Tag:social)"Fear grips your heart." The more fear someone feels toward you, the weaker they become and the lower their energy output drops. If someone feels completely helpless toward you and their will to fight is fully crushed, their abilities drop to negligible levels.
name: Crushing Daunt

description: #(Tag:blood)(Tag:body)(Tag:tech)Your blood functions as high-quality fuel, substitutable for basically any fuel a machine takes, such as gasoline, diesel, electricity, etc.
name: Blood Fuel

description: #(Tag:mind)You eat books and written text, imprinting all knowledge they contain into your mind and perfectly memorizing it.
name: Literary Devouring

description: #(Tag:fire)(Tag:growth+)"Not to be confused with a maid of fire." You temper your body with flames, increasing your physical abilities proportionally to the intensity and potency of the flames burning you. You must endure exposure for extended periods to temper properly. This grants no fire resistance or immunity, and the higher your flame resistance, the less effective it is.
name: Made of Fire

description: #(Tag:body)(Tag:spirit)Your body and soul are incredible vessels, perfectly suited to sealing things inside and containing them. Whatever you seal inside or absorb finds it far harder to rebel and break out. You also fit much more into your vessel.
name: Vessel

description: #(Tag:mental-resistance+)(Tag:meta-resistance+)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:spirit+)(Tag:spirit-resistance+)(Tag:survival)Your soul has ascended to a Prime Soul, grown so powerful it needs no body to exist. Your soul affinity is massively enhanced, and you massively resist all soul, mind, and existence-targeting abilities. If you die, you shed your Husk and continue existing in Prime Soul form.
name: Prime Soul

description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:martial+)Your fists are like Mythril, considerably augmenting the power of all your unarmed strikes and enhancing all fist-based abilities.
name: Mythril Fist

description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:martial+)Your fists are like Adamantine, unbreakable and incredibly powerful and durable. The power of all your unarmed strikes is greatly enhanced, and all fist-based abilities are easier to use and more powerful.
name: Adamantine Fist

description: #(Tag:healing)(Tag:health-regeneration+)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:race-change)(Tag:survival)You are a Regenerator, an advanced bioengineered human with superhuman physical performance and incredible natural regeneration that heals bullet wounds in seconds without fundamentally changing your humanity. Lethal wounds are still lethal, so exercise caution.
name: Regenerator

description: #(Tag:rule)You fall under Santa's clause: people do not mind you entering places you should not be or lingering where you are not meant to be. They still get offended and angry if you cause a disturbance or do something offensive.
name: The Santa Clause

description: #(Tag:growth+)(Tag:nsfw)(Nsfw) Sexual activity functions as a very efficient, comprehensive full-body workout for you. Its effects apply only after the activity ends and scale with its effectiveness.
name: Sexercise

description: #(Tag:mental-resistance+)(Tag:mind)You are blessed by Atlas, bearer of the world on his shoulders. You are extremely resilient toward all hardship: even under extreme agony, poison, bleeding out, or incomprehensible exhaustion, you still perform at your maximum.
name: Blessing of Atlas

description: #(Tag:energy-recovery)(Tag:health-recovery)You are a sadist who enjoys others' pain and suffering. Whenever you inflict damage on a target, your Health and Energy recovery speeds increase for a short time.
name: Sadist

description: #(Tag:energy-recovery)(Tag:energy-regeneration+)(Tag:health-recovery)(Tag:health-regeneration+)(Tag:survival)Your hope literally fuels you: the more hope and determination you hold, the faster your energy and vitality regenerate, and as long as you hold hope, you cannot be killed. Whenever someone places their hopes in you, that hope converts into energy and vitality to fuel you.
name: Starman

description: #(Tag:nsfw)(Tag:power)(Tag:rule)(Nsfw) You are the CEO of Sex, chosen by sex. It is conceptually impossible for you to be an unsatisfying partner, no matter who you face. You tell someone's kinks and preferred partners at a glance, and all your sexual actions are greatly enhanced. You finger the earth to spurt a geyser and thrust into the ocean to let the waves carry you where you need to be.
name: CEO of Sex

description: #(Tag:fire)(Tag:fire+)You are a novice firestarter, slightly more resistant to heat and fire-based effects, and your fire-based abilities and spells are slightly more efficient.
name: Firestarter

description: #(Tag:fire)(Tag:fire+)You burn with will: you are more resistant to heat and fire-based effects, while your fire-based abilities and spells are somewhat more efficient.
name: Burner

description: #(Tag:electric+)You are a novice electrician-to-be, slightly more resistant to electricity-based effects, and your electricity-based abilities and spells are slightly more efficient.
name: Electrician

description: #(Tag:electric)(Tag:electric+)You catch lightning itself: you are somewhat more resistant to electricity-based effects, and your electricity-based abilities and spells are somewhat more efficient.
name: Lightning Catcher

description: #(Tag:energy-regeneration+)You love water and cannot get enough of it. When water touches your skin, you slowly absorb it through osmosis, accelerating your energy recovery, even more so when the water is energy-rich.
name: Thirsty

description: #(Tag:martial)Your body carries far more virtual mass in combat than it appears to, so hits push you back far less and your physical attacks hit harder without affecting your mobility.
name: Heavyweight

description: #(Tag:martial)Your body carries far more virtual mass in combat than it appears to, making you incredibly hard to move and putting great power behind every move without affecting your mobility.
name: Super Heavyweight

description: #(Tag:martial)Your body carries far more virtual mass in combat than it appears to, like a giant's stature in a man's body, making you incredibly difficult to move while putting immense power behind your strikes.
name: Titanweight

description: #(Tag:meta)The potency of the weakest ability you have slotted in is enhanced proportionally to its rarity difference with the strongest ability you have slotted in.
name: Shoulder to Shoulder

description: #(Tag:recovery+)The more injured or closer to death you are, the more powerful your healing abilities and spells become. If you have no healing abilities or spells, you temporarily gain Novice Medicine up to Expert Medicine depending on how injured you are.
name: Emergency Responder

description: #(Tag:water)(Tag:water+)(Tag:water-resistance+)You are a natural swimmer, slightly more resistant to water and sea-based effects, and your water-based abilities and spells are slightly more efficient.
name: Swimmer

description: #(Tag:social)You are a friend to all mice, rats, and mouse-kind, with greatly increased affinity for them. Lesser rodents are automatically friendly toward you: mice may clean your floors, or rats may bring you shiny finds.
name: Mice Mate

description: #(Tag:rule)Your health is insured: whenever you are wounded, you are granted the exact money needed to pay a professional to treat your injuries or illnesses. Attempting insurance fraud may revoke this trait.
name: Health Insurance

description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:talent)You possess uncanny intuition for linking blows and keeping momentum when attacking. Once you land your first attack, you keep up pressure and chain attacks far more easily, exploiting the opening it creates.
name: Touch of Death

description: #(Tag:dark)(Tag:health-recovery)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:power)(Tag:race-change)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:vampiric)You are a vampire of the original Vampire's lineage: Dracula, Nosferatu, the No Life King. Besides massively increased physical abilities, you convert your body into Shadow Matter at will and shapeshift with it. By feeding on others' blood, you fully heal yourself and absorb their souls to use as familiars.
name: No Life King

description: #(Tag:physical+)(Tag:power+)Against opponents already greatly weaker than you, you possess increased physical stats and your abilities cost less energy.
name: Bully

description: #(Tag:anti-tech)(Tag:tech)(Tech) No machine takes your job or life. Whenever you face an opponent relying on high-level technology, you gain augmented reflexes, comprehension, and combat instincts against them, and attacks from high-technology constructs are less effective against you.
name: Luddite

description: #(Tag:anti-tech)(Tag:tech)(Tech) You are the bane of Man and Machine. Against a high-technology target, all your abilities are greatly augmented and you gain massively increased combat instincts. You massively resist any effect from high technology, to the point a railgun hits like a slingshot. These effects amplify further if your opponent is an artificial high-tech lifeform.
name: Technoclast

description: #(Tag:energy-regeneration+)(Tag:health-regeneration+)You have a style meter: the more stylishly you fight, the faster you regenerate Vitality and Energy, up to 3x faster atop all multipliers, provided you stay stylish enough during the fight.
name: Style

description: #(Tag:poison)Whenever a target damages you, all your bodily fluids, blood, spit, sweat, etc., act as acid toward them, with potency scaling with your physical stats.
name: Acid Reflux

description: #(Tag:poison)(Tag:poison-resistance+)You are immune to all addictive effects: you can use hard drugs, cigarettes, alcohol, venom, mentats, psycho, black lace, etc. every other day and drop them instantly without withdrawal or addiction symptoms.
name: Sober

description: #(Tag:meta)Your genetics are highly variable: you toggle racial traits at will, either returning to your original race or becoming 100% of another race trait you own, and back.
name: Variable Gene

description: #(Tag:electric)You have natural talent as a Firebender, naturally producing and bending fire. Its potency depends on your natural attunement, martial-arts skill, and energy levels. Skilled enough users generate and direct electricity. Potency follows the sun: weaker at night, stronger by day, unusable during an eclipse.
name: Firebending

description: #(Tag:earth)You have natural talent as an Earthbender, bending and controlling Earth. Its potency scales with your attunement to Earth, martial-arts skill, and energy levels. Skilled enough users sense Earth through tremors and manipulate impure metals and lava.
name: Earthbending

description: #(Tag:healing)You have natural talent as a Waterbender, bending and controlling Water. Its potency scales with your attunement to Water, martial-arts skill and finesse, and energy levels. Skilled enough Waterbenders transform water into ice and heal wounds with bending, and some bend the blood of those weaker than them. Potency follows the moon: strongest at night and full moon, weaker by day.
name: Waterbending

description: #You have natural talent as an Airbender, manipulating and bending Air. Its potency scales with your attunement to Air, martial-arts skill, mentality, and energy levels. Skilled enough Airbenders achieve flight, bend air from lungs, and sense vibrations through air.
name: Airbending

description: #(Tag:growth+)(Tag:tech)(Tech) Whenever you use machinery or sufficiently complex technology, it develops hypertrophy. After use, letting it rest or repairing it makes it slightly more robust and powerful. Slow and steady wins the race.
name: Hypertrophic Mechanic

description: #(Tag:growth+)(Tag:tech)All items you use grow stronger over time through rigorous use and wear: letting an item rest or repairing it after great use makes it slightly more robust and powerful. Slow and steady wins the race.
name: Item Hypertrophy

description: #(Tag:perception+)Your nose is scarily good, impossibly accurate and precise. You discern people by smell and sniff out emotions, intent, and just about anything smell can sense.
name: Super Sniffer

description: #(Tag:body)(Tag:energy-regeneration+)You possess an exceptional set of lungs: tougher, more flexible, and far better at processing air, delivering energy to your body and oxygen to your blood more easily.
name: Enhanced Lungs

description: #(Tag:body)(Tag:energy-regeneration+)(Tag:health-regeneration+)(Tag:nature)Your lungs harmonize with the surrounding world with every breath. You take in environmental energy and process it in your body to enhance your energy and vitality recovery.
name: Nature Lungs

description: #(Tag:body)(Tag:energy-regeneration+)(Tag:fae)(Tag:health-regeneration+)(Tag:physical+)You possess Fairy lungs: every breath energizes you, especially in high-energy areas. Breathing imbues your blood with environmental energy, increasing your Vitality and Energy recovery speeds and physical performance based on energy density.
name: Fairy Lungs

description: #(Tag:body)(Tag:survival)Your heart is far tougher yet more efficient, beating far less while pumping far more effectively. Anyone stabbing your heart as a weak spot will fail, as it is as tough as your bones.
name: Hard Heart

description: #(Tag:body)(Tag:survival)Your spine is incredibly durable and well-built, far harder to break or injure than your other bones, letting you exert more strength without fearing a weak spine. Even if utterly shattered, it heals properly and far faster.
name: Spine of Steel

description: #(Tag:meta)You have 2 extra ability slots.
name: Super High Capacity

description: #(Tag:fire+)(Tag:ice+)Your Ice and Fire-based abilities gain output based on environmental temperature: the colder it is, the easier Ice-based abilities are to use and resist, while the hotter it is, the easier Fire-based abilities are to use and resist.
name: Thermal Adaptor

description: #(Tag:growth+)You possess the eye of the Tiger: the willingness to push forward, break your body training, and shed no tears. You train exceptionally well, pushing your limits more easily and recovering from training far faster.
name: Eye of the Tiger

description: #(Tag:physical+)(Tag:power+)(Tag:rule)Whenever you fight as the defender in an area you own, all your physical stats are enhanced and your abilities cost less energy to use. This extends to all your allies in the same area.
name: Castle Doctrine

description: #(Tag:mind+)(Tag:perception+)(Tag:power+)Your eyes are the fabled Six Eyes of the Gojo Clan, passively granting extreme visual prowess that sees through physical obstacles and detects all forms of energy extremely well. They act like a supercomputer for processing energy and information, granting incredible efficiency with abilities and letting you passively perform incredibly taxing calculations. They are taxing to use, so you may need to cover your eyes to rest them from the information they passively process.
name: Six Eyes

description: #(Tag:blood)Your blood is infused with garlic, so the next vampire that bites you will really regret it.
name: Garlic Infused Blood

description: #(Tag:meta)(Tree)(Meta:ticket-bonus:10) Every ticket you are awarded grants 10% extra points. Stacks additively with other Prosperity traits.
name: Prosperity +10%

description: #(Tag:meta)(Tree)(Meta:ticket-bonus:20) Every ticket you are awarded grants 20% extra points. Stacks additively with other Prosperity traits.
name: Prosperity +20%

description: #(Tag:meta)(Tree)(Meta:ticket-bonus:30) Every ticket you are awarded grants 30% extra points. Stacks additively with other Prosperity traits.
name: Prosperity +30%

description: #(Tag:meta)(Tree)(Meta:ticket-bonus:40) Every ticket you are awarded grants 40% extra points. Stacks additively with other Prosperity traits.
name: Prosperity +40%

description: #(Tag:meta)(Tag:nature)(Tree)(Meta:root-pact) Nodes within two connections of the Origin root unlock for no core, but cost ten times the points.
name: Root Pact

description: #Your mind learns fast: research, engineering, and study all come noticeably easier.
name: Intelligent

description: #Your kind multiplies quickly; growth, recovery, and repopulation outpace everyone.
name: Rapid Breeders

description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:mental)(Tag:mind)Your mind touches the Shroud; latent psychic potential hums beneath every thought.
name: Mind over Matter

description: #(Tag:earth)You are living rock: silicon flesh that shrugs off hunger and laughs at vacuum.
name: Lithoid

description: #You are a node in a greater gestalt, sharing senses and purpose with the whole.
name: Hive-Minded

description: #(Tag:water)Born to water worlds; you swim, dive, and work the seas better than any landwalker.
name: Ocean-Born

description: #(Tag:earth)Your mood barely moves; break risks, pain, and horror slide off a steady mind.
name: Iron-Willed

description: #You lift everyone around you and never start social fights; even raiders hesitate.
name: Kind

description: #No empathy, no problem: organ harvesting, butchering, and horror leave you untouched.
name: Psychopath

description: #Human meat is a delicacy and butchering people is honest work; corpses are groceries.
name: Cannibal

description: #You love fire a little too much and will occasionally go start one on purpose. Sorry.
name: Arsonist

description: #Fall into a fey trance, claim a workshop, and produce a priceless artifact from whatever is at hand.
name: Strange Mood

description: #(Tag:tech)Intuitively read any road network and know exactly which interchange untangles it.
name: Traffic Engineer

description: #Always know the right mix of residential, commercial, and industrial before demand spikes.
name: Zoning Intuition

description: #(Tag:electric)The rare spark that lets a mage planeswalk between worlds; it ignites in moments of crisis.
name: Planeswalker's Spark

description: #Weaponized sarcasm: talk your way past anyone by pushing exactly the right buttons.
name: Backtalk
