description: #(Tag:light)Bonded with Vertumna's alien Glow, a symbiotic light living in you that lets you see in darkness and sense the presence, health, and mood of living things nearby, and occasionally nudges you toward what it wants.
name: Glow-Touched

description: #(Tag:nature)System-level permissions: locked doors open, restricted subroutines run, and ICPs look the other way.
name: Root Access

description: #(Tag:magic)(Tag:meta)Your abilities no longer compete for a handful of slots: every ability you own becomes a node on a hexagonal grid that replaces your ability slots entirely. Four fixed nodes sit on the grid, one for each way a fight can turn, winning a flip, losing a flip, taking damage and dealing damage, and whenever one of them fires it also activates every node sharing an edge with it. You may flip a coin at any moment to set the flip nodes off yourself, though every flip costs you energy. Your abilities take the free nodes: each may activate once per battle per point of its rarity, rounded up, and cannot be moved again while a battle is running. For every five abilities you own you may mark one ability node so that it too activates its neighbours when it activates. A battle begins the moment you take or deal damage or flip a coin, and ends when fifteen minutes pass without any of those things.
name: Hexagonal Slots

description: #(Tag:survival)No matter the frost or the cost, you will keep the last city alive through the storm. Your leadership stretches food, fuel, and medicine several times further through ruthless rationing, keeps followers warm and obedient through deadly cold with far less shelter, and holds morale under hardship that would break anyone else, but every harsh decree breeds lasting resentment.
name: The City Must Survive

description: #(Tag:earth)For Rock and Stone! Morale, teamwork, and mineral yields all improve when shouted properly.
name: Rock and Stone

description: #(Tag:sense)You hear zombies, alarms, and breaking windows from much further away.
name: Keen Hearing

description: #You are handy: maintenance, repairs, and barricading all go faster in your hands.
name: Handy

description: #You think in production lines: you design, build, and automate workshops, machines, and supply chains faster and better than any sane person should, and every operation you run keeps expanding its output, along with its bottomless appetite for raw materials and space.
name: The Factory Must Grow

description: #You hold a doctorate from MIT and solve physics problems the way other people breathe.
name: MIT Graduate

description: #(Tag:stealth)You simply never speak, and somehow this only makes everyone trust you more.
name: Silent Protagonist

description: #You have a vague arrangement with a reality-adjusting bureaucrat in a blue suit. Rise and shine.
name: Employed by the G-Man

description: #Once per day, your first activation of any ability is empowered and costs no energy.
name: Miracle

description: #(Tag:necro)A killing blow against you instead restores you to half strength, once per day. Death keeps count, and it does not appreciate repeat performances.
name: Death Defiance

description: #Voluntarily shackle yourself with underworld conditions, harder foes, fewer boons, tighter timers, and fate pays out proportionally greater rewards. Lift conditions freely; rewards scale with what you currently bear.
name: Pact of Punishment

description: #(Tag:command)Once per day, force a reroll of any random outcome rolled for you and take the new result, for better or worse. Fate will not be moved twice on the same matter.
name: Fated Authority

description: #Every defeat tempers you against its cause, stacking resistance up to a firm cap. Dying deliberately still counts; the gods find it hilarious.
name: God Mode

description: #Charge any attack or technique with your energy for an empowered omega version: wider, harder, and hungrier. Overcharging past your limits burns you instead.
name: Omega Moves

description: #(Tag:vampiric)Race Change - You are half-vampire: manageable blood hunger, sunlight that itches rather than kills, and no power over thralls. You keep the fangs, the pallor, and the dramatic entrances.
name: Dhampir

description: #(Tag:beastkin)(Tag:illusion)(Tag:illusion+)(Tag:maximum-energy+)(Tag:nature)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:power)(Tag:race-change)(Tag:spirit)Race Change - You are a nine-tailed fox spirit; tails mark power ranks, with foxfire and layered illusion growing stronger per tail.
name: Kitsune

description: #(Tag:race-change)Race Change - You are a tree-bound fey rooted to a bonded tree: bloom, root, and seasonal moods, empowered near your tree and diminished far from it.
name: Dryad

description: #(Tag:race-change)Race Change - You are living stone by day and a winged hunter by night: near-invulnerable while perched motionless, ravenous once the sun sets.
name: Gargoyle

description: #(Tag:time)Race Change - You are a Time Lord with limited regenerations: death becomes a new body instead, with a new face and a reshuffled temperament. Regenerations spent do not return.
name: Time Lord

description: #(Tag:race-change)Race Change - You are a Yautja trophy hunter with thermal vision and cloaking affinity, bound by a hard honor code around worthy prey.
name: Yautja Hunter

description: #(Tag:race-change)Race Change - You are a krogan battlemaster with redundant organs and blood rage, famously hard to kill and, thanks to the genophage, famously hard to make more of.
name: Krogan Battlemaster

description: #(Tag:race-change)Race Change - You are living tissue over a hyperalloy endoskeleton: no pain, no fear, no stopping, plus a power cell with opinions.
name: T-800

description: #(Tag:race-change)Race Change - You are Fremen of the deep desert: moisture discipline, stillsuit synergy, and the art of walking without rhythm.
name: Fremen

description: #(Tag:race-change)Race Change - You are Furyan: eyeshine that turns darkness transparent, rage-fueled resilience, and an affinity with animals.
name: Furyan

description: #(Tag:race-change)Race Change - You are a Belter with elongated low-g physiology and stellar navigation intuition, and bones that go brittle the moment real gravity shows up.
name: Belter

description: #(Tag:race-change)Race Change - You are Na'vi: nine feet of blue muscle and bone with a neural queue that bonds with beasts and the world-mind alike.
name: Na'vi

description: #Trouble finds you first on away missions. Senior officers keep forgetting your name.
name: Redshirt

description: #You always announce your return, and you always do. Eventually.
name: I'll Be Back

description: #Non-player characters insist they will remember your choices. They won't.
name: They'll Remember That

description: #An old arrow wound aches in cold or damp weather. It is never plot-relevant.
name: Arrow to the Knee

description: #Your socks never match, no matter how carefully you pair them. The dryer denies everything.
name: Mismatched Socks

description: #Every umbrella you own is lost within a month. Rain finds this hilarious.
name: Umbrella Loser

description: #You forget every password except old expired ones.
name: Password Forgetter

description: #You arrive exactly five minutes early to everything, and wait where everyone can see you.
name: Chronically Early

description: #You always end up in the aisle seat, wanted or not. Climbing over you is everyone's cardio.
name: Aisle Seat

description: #Your hair wakes up styled by a storm. Combs have filed complaints.
name: Bedhead

description: #Your feet are always cold, regardless of socks, weather, or magic. Thick socks help slightly.
name: Cold Feet

description: #(Tag:healing)Share your body with a Tok'ra symbiote: two minds, one body, rapid healing, and centuries of stolen Goa'uld secrets. Veto rights are mutual and absolute.
name: Tok'ra Blending

description: #(Tag:life)(Tag:recovery)Death downloads you into a fresh identical body, memories intact to the moment of death. Needs a resurrection facility in range; without one, you stay dead like everyone else.
name: Cylon Resurrection

description: #(Tag:nature)Survive the mutagenic Trial: lightning reflexes, immunity to most poisons and diseases, decades of extended life, and sterility. Most subjects do not survive it; you did.
name: Trial of the Grasses

description: #Rise as a knight of the Ebon Blade: runeblade hunger, frost and unholy command, no need for rest or breath. Holy ground itches; paladins itch more.
name: Ebon Knight

description: #Zerg infestation creeps through you: fast regeneration, creep affinity, and hive whispers at the edge of hearing. Fire still works on you, fans included.
name: Infested

description: #(Tag:fire)Perform well and you catch fire: burning bright, hitting harder, and announcing yourself to everyone. Slumps extinguish you; the flame remembers.
name: On Fire

description: #Reflexively celebrate every rescue, block, and near-miss with genuine joy. Allies find it inspiring; opponents find it personal.
name: What a Save!

description: #(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:power)While wearing a cheap costume you have supersoldier strength and toughness, but cannot make any visually impressive moves. You're not incompetent, just unimpressive as you walk up to your foes and knock them down.
name: Power of the Bear

description: #On a weekly basis you receive an extravagant thoughtful gift or a singing telegram. It might be from your landlord.
name: Mysterious Lover

description: #You speak, read, and learn any language on first exposure, including dead, coded, magical, and machine tongues; you cannot forget one, and puns follow you everywhere.
name: Polyglot of Babel

description: #Any project you lead costs half the materials, time, and labor it should; the savings must go somewhere, and the universe collects in mishaps.
name: Econ of Scale

description: #(Tag:sound)You rhyme with legend: stories told about you become slightly true (deeds exaggerated in your favor manifest as minor luck and skill), while slander withers unbelieved. You cannot start the stories yourself.
name: Mythic Resonance

description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:electric)Your emotions charge the air: anger calls targeted lightning, joy clears skies for miles, grief brings rain. You are immune to weather and electricity; strong winds may still carry you off mid-tantrum.
name: Thunderhead Soul

description: #(Tag:spirit)You see, hear, and negotiate with the dead of any world as naturally as the living; the dead find you credible and trade favors for remembrance. You cannot compel them.
name: Death's Secretary

description: #No place, oath, curse, or summoning can bind, track, or hold you; teleportation and banishment slide off. This includes Gacha Curses, which are therefore never offered to you, tickets and all, as well as magical restraints, compulsions, and enchantments laid upon you. The price: no blessing, ward, or healing not of your own making can find you either.
name: Rootless

description: #A tailed beast sealed within you: vast reserves, regeneration, and beast modes escalating with tails borrowed. Befriend it and it lends everything; fight it and you fight forever, inside and out.
name: Jinchuriki

description: #(Tag:gravity)(Tag:space)Every power you hold grows roughly one tier-equivalent per year of active use, while control frays in matching step: leakage, misfires, and effects that overshoot their mark. Rest does not pause it; only passing a power on resets its clock (and starts someone else's).
name: Quirk Singularity

description: #Divine ki: undetectable by mortal senses, its pressure alone buckles weak wills, calm hands wield planet-breaking output. Rage spends it double; serenity spends it clean.
name: God Ki

description: #Refuse one death per week: killing blows leave you standing at a single hit point instead. Fate notices repeat offenders.
name: But It Refused

description: #(Tag:sound)Hear the voices of all things: objects, beasts, seas, and islands speak, and addressed directly they answer truthfully from their own experience, a sword's history, the sea's mood, what passed this strait. They know only what they have witnessed: nothing of the future, nothing beyond their ken. In crowded seas the chorus never shuts up.
name: Voice of All Things

description: #Forerunner geas of stewardship: absolute authority over Forerunner systems and instinct for galaxy-scale logistics, plus the crushing certainty that every extinction is your fault. The systems obey; the guilt is free.
name: Mantle-Bearer

description: #You are a Blank: warp, psychic phenomena, and daemonic presences gutter out around you, and psykers sicken in your company. Daemons fear you on sight. Everyone else finds you subtly, inexplicably repellent.
name: Untouchable

description: #(Tag:time)The Worm loves you: time hiccups around you, once per day, reroll up to one minute just lived, keeping full memory of the undone version. And it WILL be fed: leave it living sacrifices at every landing, or it feeds on your crew and companions instead. What was, will be.
name: Beloved of the Worm

description: #(Tag:nature)Linked to the planetary consciousness: all Pandoran-analog life answers your call and shares its senses with you. Unplug, and the silence aches for weeks.
name: Eywa Communion

description: #A human computer: perfect computation, recall, and projection from available data, lips stained with sapho. You need the data first; garbage in, gospel out.
name: Mentat

description: #Prana-bindu body control, truth-sense, and the Voice: pitch-perfect vocal command that the unprepared cannot disobey. Strong minds, the deaf, and recording-equipment operators are immune.
name: Bene Gesserit Conditioning
